title: 1st Level IT‑Support (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Ihre Aufgaben im Support

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden nehmen Sie Supportanfragen entgegen und sorgen für einen reibungslosen IT-Betrieb in öffentlichen Verwaltungen und mittelständischen Unternehmen.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Erfahrung im Bereich IT-Support oder Helpdesk

  • Kundenorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse

Ihr Arbeitsumfeld bei n-komm GmbH

Seit über 20 Jahren fokussieren wir uns als IT-Unternehmen mit 51 bis 200 Mitarbeitenden in Karlsruhe auf die Betreuung von öffentlichen Verwaltungen und mittelständischen Unternehmen mit bis zu 1.000 Clients. Unser Team aus über zwei Dutzend IT-Consultants, IT-Experten und Software-Entwicklern lebt das Motto: IT – Einfach, Verständlich, Praktikabel!

Ihre Vorteile

Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten sowie eine Home-Office-Ausstattung und ein Firmenlaptop sowie ein Firmenhandy. Nutzen Sie Angebote zur beruflichen Bildung, ein Mentoring und ein Sabbatical. Profitieren Sie zudem von einer betrieblichen und privaten Altersvorsorge, einer privaten Krankenversicherung, einer Entschädigung für Reisekosten und einem Firmenwagen sowie kostenlosem Parken. Für Ihr Wohlbefinden am Standort Karlsruhe sorgen eine Cafeteria, kostenlose Getränke, kostenlose Snacks und erlaubte Haustiere.

Vergütung

Das Bruttogehalt für diese unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Wochenstunden und 30 Urlaubstagen im Jahr liegt zwischen EUR 36,000 und 48,000 per year.

Ihre ersten Monate

Sie nehmen Anfragen unserer Kunden entgegen, analysieren Supportanfragen und begleiten den täglichen IT-Betrieb unserer langjährigen Partner.

title: 2027 Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Programme
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Program you’ll work alongside experienced professionals, gaining hands-on experience and a comprehensive introduction to digital payments and technology. The program offers an extensive learning experience through technical training, professional development workshops, and direct access to industry experts. You'll be part of a global Early Careers, Graduate community, with regular networking events, mentoring opportunities, and social activities designed to build connections and accelerate your growth and leadership potential. By the end of the scheme, you’ll be equipped with the knowledge, experience, and confidence to make a lasting impact at Checkout.com and beyond.

How you’ll make an impact

During the programme, you may:

  • Analyse commercial and business performance in order to help the business assess where it is creating value.

  • Leverage AI tooling as a force multiplier to build and automate reusable analytical workflows and agents to create insights from financial data.

  • Collaborate directly with Data Engineering and Data Science to support the development and enhancement of our core financial data models, and the context layer that enables AI agents to leverage that data.

  • Craft executive-style deliverables, which may include decks, models, written documents or AI-powered apps.

  • Work with your manager to translate ambiguous requests from leadership, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders into clear, decision-ready insights.

  • Drive continuous reporting improvements, standardisation, and simplification whilst documenting definitions and limitations - leaving no room for approximation.

  • You will work with Finance and Data partners to scope requirements and support the delivery of key initiatives.

What we’re looking for

You’re a curious, analytical and innovative individual, either due to graduate in summer 2027 or having graduated within the last 12 months, who is excited to dive into the world of Finance.

You’ll bring:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative or business discipline.

  • Strong analytical mindset - You’re comfortable working with numbers, identifying the underlying patterns and drawing sound conclusions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills - You have the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels.

  • Commercial curiosity - You want to dive into the details to understand how merchant, product, and commercial dynamics affect financial performance.

  • Confidence with data tools - You have a clear aptitude and willingness to learn data tooling. Python and SQL experience is a plus.

  • Exceptional attention to detail - You rigorously validate data, pressure-test assumptions, and transparently communicate analytical limitations.

  • Payments or financial knowledge is a bonus, but not required.

Early Careers experience

You’ll receive:

  • Dedicated onboarding and payments-focused training.

  • Professional skills workshops and leadership sessions.

  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues.

  • Networking and community events.

  • Opportunities to work on meaningful, business-critical projects.

  • Regular feedback and transparent performance conversations.

  • Potential progression into a permanent role, subject to performance, readiness, headcount availability and business requirements.

Eligibility

  • Graduated within the last 12 months or due to graduate by the programme start date, depending on the selected pathway.

  • Available to work full-time for the duration of the programme.

  • Able to work from the stated programme location and meet applicable right-to-work requirements.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Account Director, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

The Enterprise Account Director will lead our sales efforts, driving growth by seeking new business opportunities while fostering strong relationships with WPP & key clients. You will develop and execute strategic sales initiatives, focusing on acquiring net new accounts and expanding existing partnerships, ensuring we meet and exceed our revenue goals. 

A successful Account Director is a driven, results-oriented hunter with a relentless focus on opening new doors and securing net new business opportunities. You’ll use your proactive approach and adaptability to identify and engage with key decision-makers, consistently working to expand StackAdapt’s footprint. You'll work closely with StackAdapt Account Managers to grow and retain existing accounts by crafting tailored campaign strategies that meet clients' needs, building strong relationships, and delivering impactful results. Your main objective will be to fuel StackAdapt's growth by driving new business and establishing long-term client partnerships.

StackAdapt is a remote first company. We will be prioritizing candidates located in London for this role.

What you'll be doing:

  • Prospect, identify and target new brands within untapped markets, using your expertise in lead generation to fill the sales pipeline with high-quality prospects.
  • Take lead in responding to RFP’s or new inner agency opportunities, including qualification & win strategy
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with top executives at WPP and their associated brands
  • Engage in discussions about product development based on client feedback with senior stakeholders across sales, product and engineering
  • Partner with your dedicated StackAdapt Account Manager to grow and retain existing accounts by presenting new campaign strategies and solutions to clients, and building strong relationships
  • Showcase the benefits of StackAdapt's media buying platform through detailed product demonstrations
  • Accurately manage and communicate quarterly forecasts and pipeline

What you'll bring to the table:

  • 5-10+ years experience at a DSP/SSP
  • Experience in building and executing successful sales strategies from the ground up, with a proven track record of developing new business and driving growth.
  • Deep understanding of client business goals with the ability to translate programmatic solutions to help drive success for clients while meeting sales targets.  
  • Strong established network and relationships with decision-makers at hold-co advertising agencies, independent agencies, and brands
  • A solutions oriented approach: ability to understand and communicate customer challenges and pain points and navigate internally to help solve challenges
  • A deep understanding of the programmatic ecosystem and DSP dynamics
  • Ability to travel to meet with customers in-market and conduct senior-level presentations
  • Strong communication, presentations skills, and story-telling ability
  • Curious, eager to learn, and consistent strive for excellence
  • Proven track record of exceeding revenue expectations
  • Previous experience selling programmatic advertising

The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. We do not ask candidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer.

This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Factors Influencing Final Compensation:

  • The final compensation offer will be determined by a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to: the candidate's specific experience, technical skills, knowledge, abilities, and relevant education, licensure, and certifications.
  • Other business factors, such as organizational needs and budget alignment, may also be considered in the final offer.
Base Salary Band£78,019—£107,276 GBP

StackAdapter's Enjoy:

  • Highly competitive salary
  • Retirement/ 401K/ Pension Savings globally
  • Competitive Paid time off packages including birthday's off!
  • Access to a comprehensive mental health care program
  • Health benefits from day one of employment
  • Work from home reimbursements
  • Optional global WeWork membership for those who want a change from their home office and hubs in London and Toronto
  • Robust training and onboarding program
  • Coverage and support of personal development initiatives (conferences, courses, books etc)
  • Access to StackAdapt programmatic courses and certifications to support continuous learning
  • An awesome parental leave program
  • A friendly, welcoming, and supportive culture
  • Our social and team events!

Please note: Benefits and perks may vary depending on your country of employment and the nature of your engagement. In locations where StackAdapt does not have a legal entity, employment and benefits are administered in accordance with local regulations and partner policies.

StackAdapt is a diverse and inclusive team of collaborative, hardworking individuals trying to make a dent in the universe. No matter who you are, where you are from, who you love, follow in faith, disability, superpower status, ethnicity, or the gender you identify with (if you’re comfortable, let us know your pronouns), you are welcome at StackAdapt.   StackAdapt is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know.   We use artificial intelligence (AI) to streamline the resume reviews of candidates and assess their fit based on the criteria outlined in the job posting. title: Account Director - (F/H) - CDI
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. 

A propos de WPP Media: 

WPP is the creative transformation company. Nous utilisons le pouvoir de la créativité pour construire un avenir meilleur pour nos collaborateurs, notre planète, nos clients et nos communautés. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wpp.com. 

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com. 

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media : 

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle. 
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle. 
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation. 

A propos d’Openmind : Une marque de WPP Media A Leading WPP Media Brand

Openmind by WPP est un modèle d'agence intégrée puisant dans les talents de l'ensemble de WPP. Il a été créé pour accélérer la transformation européenne de la fonction média de Nestlé. Au cœur de cette solution se trouvent les meilleures capacités avancées de données et de technologie, alimentées par l'investissement de WPP dans l'IA, pour maximiser l'impact de l'investissement média de Nestlé. 

LE RÔLE :
Au sein de l'équipe Above-Market d’OpenMind (WPP), l'International Account Director est un expert média confirmé dédié au compte Nestlé Europe sur la catégorie Café (Nescafé, Dolce Gusto & Starbucks At Home). Véritable consultant média auprès des équipes locales et clients, vous jouez un rôle d'orchestrateur et de facilitateur stratégique sur un périmètre clé allant jusqu'à 26 marchés.

À la croisée des chemins entre la vision stratégique et l'agilité opérationnelle, vous êtes "hands-on", force de proposition, et capable de mener à bien des projets complexes avec une grande autonomie. Ce poste est pensé pour s'intégrer dans une structure d'équipe optimisée pour garantir une réactivité et une excellence de service

RESPONSABILITÉS :

• Pilotage Client & Vision Stratégique : Mener les discussions stratégiques sur les campagnes Coffee, venir en soutien des leads Coffee pour orchestrer les cycles annuels de planification (avec un temps fort d'accélération stratégique d’avril à septembre).
• Coordination Internationale : Assurer la coordination fluide des agences WPP et des équipes locales (jusqu’à 26 marchés), en garantissant la cohérence régionale, la compréhension locale des directives et le succès des lancements multi-marchés.
• Conseil & Stratégie Média : Traduire la vision de marque en stratégies de prioritisation des allocations d'investissements multi channels (« fewer, bigger, better »). Agir en consultant média en produisant des guidelines de comms planning actionnables pour les pays.
• Gestion de la Performance & Reporting : Co-concevoir et animer les QBR, assurer le suivi mensuel des investissements et performances de campagnes (spend reporting, benchmarks) avec les experts digitaux.
• Synergie d'Expertises : Fédérer les équipes spécialistes du réseau (Search, Social, Programmatique/Video & RDM, Data & Tech) pour délivrer une planification média intégrée et innovante.

COMPÉTENCES REQUISES :

• Expérience : Expérience confirmée et solide (4-5 ans minimum) en agence média en conseil & coordination internationale et/ou comms planning est requise. Une expérience préalable avec de grands clients mondiaux de coordination multi-marchés est fortement recommandée.
• Expertise Internationale : Savoir-faire éprouvé en coordination multi-marchés et gestion de parties prenantes dans des organisations matricielles complexes.
• Mindset & Posture : Esprit consultant, pragmatique et autonome. Capacité démontrée à être hands-on pour faire avancer les projets et performer dans une équipe agile.
• Connaissance Sectorielle : Forte maîtrise des enjeux FMCG / PGC et des dynamiques omnicanales (une sensibilité à la catégorie Café / Boissons est un plus).
• Data & Storytelling : Solide culture data pour transformer les métriques de performance en opportunités stratégiques, doublée d'excellentes qualités de présentation et d'organisation.
• Langues : Anglais bilingue / courant impératif (100 % des communications, réunions et livrables au quotidien).

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité. 

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée. 

Nos avantages comprennent: 

  • Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année 
  • Deux jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte  
  • Jours de congé additionnels par pallier de 5 ans d’ancienneté  
  • 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaborateurs souffrant d’endométriose  
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH  
  • Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act  

  • Un Cadre de Travail Inspirant : Chez Openmind, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets passionnants et de collaborer avec des marques renommées. Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque talent peut s'épanouir et se développer.

Process de recrutement :

Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec un membre de notre équipe. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise. 

Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.

Entretien opérationnel : Vous échangerez ensuite avec la Business Partner et la Lead Openmind France.

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process. 

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle. 

Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données politique de confidentialité. 

Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.

title: Account Executive - AI Native, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Us:
AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn,Luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

The Role:

We’re hiring an Account Executive to win and grow Modal’s relationships with AI-native companies: the startups and scale-ups building their products on models from day one. These teams move fast, so our sales cycle does too. Deals often move forward from the very first call, and you’ll usually be talking directly with the founder or technical leader who owns the budget.

You’ll own the full cycle, from sourcing to close to expansion, and you’ll partner closely with our founders, engineering, and product teams. You’ll also help build Modal’s presence in the developer community, because in this market, the best pipeline comes from engineers who already love the product.


The ideal candidate has an engineering background, has worked as a solutions architect or in a similar technical role, and has since moved into selling. You’re as comfortable debugging a cold-start issue with an ML engineer as you are negotiating terms with a CEO.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own a book of AI-native accounts and close new business quickly, often moving from first call to signed deal in weeks rather than quarters.

  • Sell directly to founders, CTOs, and heads of ML who define the ideal customer and hold the budget from day one.

  • Get hands-on in technical conversations: scope workloads, set up quick proofs of concept, and show customers how Modal fits into their stack.

  • Spot expansion early and help fast-growing customers scale their inference, training, and sandbox workloads as their usage takes off.

  • Help build and engage Modal’s developer community through events, meetups, open-source channels, and word of mouth.

  • Bring sharp, structured customer feedback to our product and engineering teams to shape the roadmap.

  • Help define how Modal sells to AI-native companies, including the playbooks, pricing motions, and processes we’ll scale as the team grows.

Requirements:

  • An engineering background, followed by time as a solutions architect, sales engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role, and now experience as a closing seller.

  • Current or recent experience at an AI-native company, ideally selling infrastructure, ML/AI, or developer tools.

  • A track record of selling directly to founders and technical leaders and closing deals quickly in a high-velocity sales cycle.

  • Experience building or engaging a developer community, or a clear point of view on how community drives pipeline.

  • Enough technical depth to go deep on GPUs, inference, containers, and model training with engineers, without needing a sales engineer in the room.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and excitement about building processes from the ground up.

  • Ability to work in person from our office 5 days a week.

Compensation: $300K • Offers Equity

title: Account Executive Cabinets (Axe Paris - Marseille)
descriptionHtml:
Alassio recrute son ou sa Account Executive Cabinets (axe Paris–Marseille) !

En un coup d’œil

  • Contrat : CDI, à pourvoir dès que possible

  • Lieu : Paris ; déplacements fréquents sur l’axe Paris–Marseille ; hybride

  • Périmètre : axe Paris–Marseille

  • Expérience : 3-5 ans minimum en vente full cycle SaaS B2B

 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d’expertise-comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio accélère pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l’accompagnement.

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous cherchons un·e Account Executive Cabinets sur le périmètre Paris–Marseille : un profil commercial qui aime prospecter, comprendre des enjeux métier exigeants et transformer une relation de confiance en signature.

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu développes ton portefeuille de cabinets en full cycle, de la prospection au closing. Tu es responsable de ton pipeline et de tes opportunités, avec l’appui des équipes Product, Tech, Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA).

 

🧭 Tes missions

Prospecter et créer tes opportunités

  • Prendre en charge l’inbound de ton périmètre : qualifier les demandes, mener les découvertes, traiter les sollicitations avec réactivité et assurer des relances structurées

  • Identifier les cabinets à potentiel et construire une prospection ciblée via les canaux adaptés : online, événementiel, mises en relation et rencontres terrain

  • Combiner appels, emails, mises en relation et rendez-vous pour ouvrir de nouvelles conversations

Qualifier, démontrer et conclure

  • Comprendre l’organisation du cabinet, ses usages, ses irritants et ses enjeux de changement de logiciel de paie

  • Qualifier les besoins, les interlocuteurs, le processus de décision et le calendrier du projet

  • Préparer et mener des démonstrations adaptées, en mobilisant les expertises internes lorsque nécessaire

  • Piloter chaque étape du cycle : suivi des échanges, traitement des objections, proposition commerciale, négociation et closing

  • Maintenir un pipeline fiable, avec des prochaines étapes claires et des prévisions commerciales argumentées

  • Préparer une transmission fluide aux équipes Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA) pour que les engagements pris pendant la vente soient compris et partagés

Développer une présence terrain sur ton périmètre

Rencontrer régulièrement les cabinets et leurs décideurs sur l’axe Paris–Marseille, développer ton réseau et représenter Alassio lors de salons et d’événements du secteur comptable et social. Transformer les rencontres en opportunités qualifiées et organiser tes tournées pour conjuguer proximité client et efficacité commerciale. title: Account Executive - Danish Speaker
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses.

We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones.

But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

What will you be doing?

  • Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market;

  • Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

  • Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

  • Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

  • Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

  • Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

  • Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

What we are looking for

  • Fluent in Danish both written and spoken, as if it were your first language;

  • Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

  • Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets;

  • Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

  • Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

  • Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

  • Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

  • Customer-centric mindset;

  • You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

 

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual

  • Final Interview - 30 mins - IRL/Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins IRL

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. Your Mission

The Account Executive (AE) is responsible for consistently generating, qualifying, and executing opportunities that support our customers in the pursuit of becoming more trusted organizations and drive revenue for OneTrust.   • Utilize two-sided discovery & impeccable communication to understand the customers’ needs and articulate valuable solutions 
  • Understand key competitors and their strategies to clearly differentiate OneTrust’s solutions in the marketplace 
  • Establish customer relationships that enable OneTrust to be viewed as a trusted advisor 
  • Manage and optimize a targeted geographic territory 

Your Experience Includes

You are someone with a hunting mentality and consultative approach. You bring curiosity, innovation, authenticity, leadership, and integrity to your work. Extra Awesome

  • Experience in Privacy, Security, Third-Party Risk management, Compliance  
  • Experience directly selling into the Information Security department 
  • CIPP/E or CIPM certified  
  • Trained in Command of Message  

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources  

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

  • OneTrust Careers on YouTube
  • @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an ----- email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from ----- Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a ----- email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to .

Our Commitment to You 

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. 

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Active Directory engineer (parttime 24 uur)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij die Active Directory engineer die een bijdrage wilt leveren aan de toekomst van onze Active Directory en geïnteresseerd en bedreven is in PKI/Encryptie toepassing? Voel jij je thuis in een organisatie waar informatie beveiliging hoog op de agenda staat?

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het operationeel en veilig houden van onze Active Directory omgeving, onder andere door middel van dagelijkse controletaken en onderzoeken van verstoringen. Je vervult een prominente rol in het voorkomen en opheffen van digitale dreigingen en security incidenten.

  • Je beheert & configureert Active Directory group policies conform de beleidslijnen op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging

  • Je beheert en optimaliseert de Active Directory omgeving (accounts, OU’s, groups en policies)

  • Je automatiseert zoveel mogelijk beheerwerkzaamheden met o.a. Powershell, Ansible en Terraform

  • Je werkt gevraagd en ongevraagd aan toekomst-vaste verbeteringen van onze Active Directory omgeving, waaronder forest upgrades en Active Directory redesign

  • Je werkt doorlopend aan remediation activiteiten die kunnen voortvloeien uit baseline scans, risico-analyses en security assessments.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het Team Data&Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). We opereren middels een Agile methodiek, in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage wordt verwacht in het succes van deze werkmethode, dit uit zich oa in het opstellen van kwalitatief goede story’s en Epics, het actueel houden van jouw story’s op het Azure DevOps bord, actieve en constructieve deelname aan events als dag-starts, planning, review en retrospectives. De totale omvang van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur is ongeveer 30 experts die werkzaam zijn in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Data&Webdiensten Team bestaat uit ca 15 collega’s die in Heerlen en Den Haag werkzaam zijn. Plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk en dat is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Je bent gericht op het continu verbeteren: je signaleert, adviseert, voert uit, reflecteert en pakt de regie en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel in samenwerking als op inhoud.

Daarnaast verwachten wij:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als senior Active Directory beheerder van complexe Windows Server omgevingen in een enterprise omgeving.

  • Kennis en ervaring met het configureren en beheren van Active Directory, Group policy en Powershell. Je beschikt over relevante MS certificering.

  • Kennis van kaders zoals ISO27001, BIO, NIS2 en het toepassen van security baselines, zoals CIS.

  • Ervaring met het (periodiek) uitvoeren van verschillende Active Directory back-up/ restore en -recovery strategieën.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

title: AI Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

We are looking for a Data & AI / ML Evaluation Engineer to own the data collection, mining, curation and continuous evaluation foundation for our various AI security products. High-quality models require high-quality datasets and ongoing enrichment and retraining. In this role, you will build automated data ingestion pipelines from surrogate web traffic and open sources, manage dataset curation, labeling workflows, model training and operate our benchmark and evaluation harnesses. This is a data and AI / ML software engineering role focused on building the data infrastructure that trains our proprietary Prompt Injection SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, PII, Content Classification engines and more.

Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Automated, continuous generation and curation of training, evaluation, and false-positive (FP) datasets across web, file, and macro threat surfaces.

  • Standardized, reproducible evaluation benchmarks that guide model improvements before deployment.

  • Automated data pipeline uptime and ingestion throughput from web/file sources.

  • Size, diversity, and labeling accuracy of threat dataset repositories (PI, Shadow-AI, PII, Macros).

  • Mean time to ingest live false-positive/false-negative feedback into training evaluation loops.

  • Accuracy and benchmark coverage across historical vs. newly trained SLMs.

What You'll Do

  • Design and operate automated data collection, mining, and web-scraping pipelines to gather threat samples from surrogate traffic and web sources.

  • Build data processing, annotation, and dataset curation workflows, training and re-training various models, e.g. Prompt Injection (PI) SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, and PII detection.

  • Build mechanisms to capture false-positive (FP) samples from live user/DDR flows and represent / integrate them into model retraining pipelines.

  • Develop automated benchmarking and evaluation harnesses to continuously test model detection quality, runtime performance, and accuracy against baseline models (e.g., Vertex AI).

  • Build automated pipelines for model training for various models.

  • Work closely with research and software engineering teams to turn raw detection telemetry into ongoing actionable model improvements.

Required:

  • 2–4 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or automated QA/evaluation roles.

  • Strong programming proficiency in Python. Adv: C++, SQL.

  • Experience in model training and various ML, AI algorithms.

  • Experience building data pipelines, web scrapers, or automated data processing systems.

  • Familiarity with data structures, storage formats, and database configurations.

  • Methodical approach to dataset labeling, validation, bug logging, and metric tracking.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on experience with ML evaluation frameworks, dataset curation, or annotation tools.

  • Familiarity with text extraction, NLP preprocessing, or document parsing techniques.

  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts (Prompt Injection, Malicious Macros, DLP/PII).

  • Basic experience with cloud storage, object stores, and basic containerization (Docker).

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux.

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

The team you'll join:
AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

What You'll Work On

Help build the future of how companies manage equity.

  • Ledgy Agent. You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.
  • Ledgy MCP. Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.
  • Measuring and improving the agent. You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.
  • Scaling. The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.

You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end
  • You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.
  • You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.
  • You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.
  • You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.
  • You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.

Our Tech Stack

We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.

You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First day: Get the app running locally and make your first commit. Your onboarding buddy helps you get there.

First week:

  • Meet the engineers, product managers, and designers you'll work with.
  • Learn the agent end to end: its tools, skills, MCP surface, and how we evaluate it.
  • Ship a few smaller features.

First month:

  • Meet the wider engineering team and learn how Ledgy works and how customers use it today. This is the background you'll use for decisions later.
  • Make larger contributions and take a bigger part in code reviews.

First 3 months:

  • Drive part of a larger piece of work, such as process, tooling, a new product, or new functionality.
  • Work with Product and Design to prove and deepen the value AI adds to the product.
  • Take part in architecture and long-term decisions.

After the first 3 months:

  • Take a bigger role in shaping where the team is heading. Own key parts of our AI platform and decide where we can add the most value for customers.
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar. Help teams across Ledgy add AI to what they build, whether that means advising, reviewing, or working alongside them.
  • Help shape Ledgy's technical direction, for AI and for everything else we build.

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • Behavioural (45 min): Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

  • Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.

Mandatory:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.

  • Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.

  • A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.

  • The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.

  • Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.

  • Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

  • Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.

  • Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.

  • Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.

  • An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.

  • Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.

  • Experience working in a distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

descriptionHtml:
Sie müssen noch kein Leckageorter sein.

Wenn Sie aus dem SHK-Kundendienst, der Instandhaltung oder dem technischen Service kommen und gerne Fehler suchen, statt täglich dieselben Installationen abzuarbeiten, bietet Ihnen diese Position eine spannende Spezialisierung.

Für ein langfristig aufgestelltes norddeutsches Unternehmen suchen wir handwerklich erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die Schritt für Schritt in die professionelle Leckageortung eingearbeitet werden.

Aufgaben

Bei einem Wasserschaden sind Sie die Person, die der Ursache auf den Grund geht. Sie prüfen das Schadenbild, setzen moderne Messtechnik ein und grenzen systematisch ein, woher das Wasser tatsächlich kommt.

Dabei geht es weniger um das anschließende Reparieren als um kluge Diagnose:

  • Wo liegt die eigentliche Schadensursache?

  • Welche Messung führt zu einem belastbaren Ergebnis?

  • Wo muss ein Bauteil möglichst schonend geöffnet werden?

  • Welche Informationen benötigen Kunde, Versicherung und Sanierungsteam?

Ihre Ergebnisse halten Sie digital mit Messwerten, Fotos und einem verständlichen Bericht fest.

Qualifikation

  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau B2

Erfahrung in der Leckageortung ist willkommen, aber ausdrücklich keine Voraussetzung.

Ihre Einarbeitung

Sie werden nicht nach einem starren Zeitplan allein zum Kunden geschickt. Zunächst begleiten Sie einen erfahrenen Kollegen und lernen Geräte, Messverfahren, Dokumentation und typische Schadensbilder praktisch kennen.

Erst wenn Sie selbst und der Fachbereich sich mit einem eigenständigen Einsatz sicher fühlen, übernehmen Sie eigene Aufträge. Die Einarbeitung dauert so lange, wie sie fachlich sinnvoll ist.

title: Anthropic Research Resident
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required.

What to expect

  • A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Access to Claude models and GPU compute
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check.

Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027.

You may be a good fit if you

  • Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
  • Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time
  • Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer)
  • Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
  • Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

Strong candidates may also

  • Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety
  • Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases

Mentors and research areas

Potential Anthropic mentors include:

  • Sara Price: leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science
  • Ethan Perez: leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning
  • Evan Hubinger: leads the Alignment Stress-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI)
  • Samuel Marks: leads the Scalable Oversight team; background in mathematics
  • Elana Simon: researches the interpretability of language models and biological models; background in biomedical informatics
  • Belinda Li: researches how language models represent the world, users, and themselves; background in natural language processing (PhD, MIT)
  • Jack Lindsey: leads the Model Psychology team; background in theoretical neuroscience
  • Nicholas Carlini: researches adversarial machine learning and AI security; previously at DeepMind and Google Brain
  • Jascha Sohl-Dickstein: works at the intersection of safety and pretraining; background in physics and neuroscience, formerly Principal Scientist at Google Brain

Residents will work on empirical research questions in collaboration with Anthropic's research teams. Areas we are particularly interested in include:

AI safety & alignment

  • Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains.
  • Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.
  • Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.
  • Model Internals and Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures.
  • Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment.
  • AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations.

AI security & frontier red-teaming

  • Stress-testing frontier models to understand the full extent of their current capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity, robotics or cryptography.

ML systems & reinforcement learning

  • Improving how frontier models are trained and building the infrastructure behind that research, from model architecture, optimizers and training data to accelerator simulators, hardware backends and RL environment pipelines.

For a fuller picture of the questions we care about, see our Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions and recent publications from our Alignment, Interpretability and Frontier Red teams.

Logistics

  • Duration: Placements are six weeks, three months or six months, depending on team fit and candidate preferences. Other lengths between three and six months are possible by exception.
  • Location: This application is for a remote UK position, with the option to work from our London office. However, we prefer that Residents work from our San Francisco office, where most of our research staff is based, but remote participation is possible, especially for shorter placements. Most full-time research roles at Anthropic require relocation to San Francisco. Remote participants need to be based in a country where Anthropic can hire.
  • Commitment: Full-time role for the duration of the residency.
  • Compensation: £265,000 to £375,000/year pro-rated for the duration of the residency + benefits
  • Visa sponsorship: We sponsor visas for placements of three months or longer. For six-week placements we encourage remote participation from a country where Anthropic can hire.

Applicants may also be considered for the Anthropic Fellows Program.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£265,000—£375,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Applied AI Developer - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our Applied AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows

  • Modern AI-native development workflow

  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.
