This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Germany.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

    • Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

    • Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

    • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.

    • Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems.

    • Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering.

    • Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs.

    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges.

    • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment.

    • High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

    • Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

    • Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Wir sind AzureAgency - ein vielseitiges, junges und dynamisches Team von Expert:innen aus allen Sektoren der Creator Economy. Wir vereinen Perspektiven von Kreativschaffenden, Kampagnexpert:innen und Künstlermanager:innen zu einem gemeinsamen Ziel!

Aus unserem Büro mitten in Köln betreuen und beraten wir unser Portfolio von namhaften Creator:innen und unterstützen sie beim Aufbau ihrer Karriere.

Was uns einzigartig macht?

Menschlichkeit und Persönlichkeit - wir leben einen einmaligen Zusammenhalt im Team und eine enge, persönliche Beziehung zu unseren Creator:innen und Kund:innen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung der Artist Manager bei der Betreuung von Kund*innen während Kampagnen.
  • Pflege, Anlage und laufende Aktualisierung aller Kampagnendaten im System.
  • Organisation von Terminen, Meetings und Abstimmungen zwischen Kund*innen, Creators und internen Teams (z. B. Strategie, Kreation, Legal, Finance).
  • Überwachung von Zeitplänen, Fristen und Freigabeprozessen, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf zu gewährleisten.
  • Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung und Pflege von Standardprozessen, Workflows und Vorlagen.
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbau und der Pflege langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen durch proaktive und serviceorientierte Betreuung.
  • Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Reports oder Briefings für interne und externe Meetings.
  • Allgemeine administrative Aufgaben zur Entlastung des Artist Managers.

Qualifikation

  • Erste Erfahrung im Assistenz-, Projekt- oder Kampagnenbereich, idealerweise im Marketingumfeld.
  • Sehr gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten, sorgfältiges Arbeiten und ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Teamgeist, um als Schnittstelle zwischen allen Beteiligten zu agieren.
  • Flexibilität und eigenständige, proaktive Arbeitsweise.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Projektmanagement-Software und Office-Anwendungen.

Benefits

  • Ein motiviertes, kreatives und junges Team mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Ein modernes Büro direkt im Herzen Kölns
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Hybrid-Work
  • Kostenloses Urban Sports-Abonnement über unser Firmenfitnessprogramm oder Deutschlandticket
  • Regelmäßige Events mit unseren Creator:innen und Partner:innen
  • Dein Input zählt - in einer sich stetig weiterentwickelnden Branche wachsen auch wir mit und begrüßen deine Ideen und Mitgestaltung
  • Topaktuelle Arbeitsgeräte von Apple

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Assistant Director, Regulatory Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. Today, we manage more than £2.5 billion for a broad range of investors across five key investment strategies: Private Credit, Social Housing, Clean Heat, Energy and Venture. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients. 

There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Places to Work  2025 & 2026'.

If this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on…

The Function & Team

The Compliance team is part of the 2nd line of defence who has responsibility and oversight of the Governance, Risk & Compliance functions within TriplePoint.  The Team is integral to the company's success, ensuring that all business operations adhere to the stringent regulations set by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

Joining the Triple Point Compliance Team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions directly impact the company's operations and overall success.

The team works closely with various departments to ensure that all business activities comply with regulatory requirements, thereby enabling the company to operate smoothly and efficiently. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on the company's growth and to develop professionally within a respected and forward-thinking organisation.

By joining the Compliance team within the GRC function, you will become part of a collaborative and professional team that plays an essential role in supporting the firm’s success. Your contributions will directly influence how the business meets its regulatory obligations, while providing you with broad exposure to the firm’s products, investments and operations. This is an opportunity to strengthen Triple Point’s compliance environment and to play a meaningful role in sustaining the company’s long-term resilience and reputation.  The role reports to theDirector, Regulatory Compliance.

Key Responsibilities

The Assistant Director, Regulatory Compliance will work alongside the Director, Regulatory Compliance as a deputy of a small, focused compliance department, providing technical support and leadership to the team, operating in a dynamic and fast-moving organisation.

The role has two core purposes: to provide strong technical regulatory expertise and practical, commercial advice to the business; and to support the growth of the Compliance team by developing the technical knowledge, skills and confidence of its members. The successful candidate will deputise for the Director, Regulatory Compliance when required.

The candidate will have extensive relevant compliance experience within the investment management or wider financial services sector, and a track record of providing proactive, commercial and value-adding regulatory advice in collaboration with Risk and Legal colleagues.

Compliance Framework and Advisory

  • Support the Director, Regulatory Compliance in developing and maintaining the Group’s Compliance framework, contributing technical and operational insight on best-practice frameworks and monitoring.
  • Provide day-to-day regulatory advice to the business, including at the early stage of initiatives, taking into account products and services, target markets and distribution strategy in support of Triple Point’s growth objectives.
  • Support the review and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures and guidance, ensuring they remain current and fit for purpose.
  • Support the firm’s engagement with regulators, including the preparation of responses to regulatory queries and requests.

Monitoring, Regulatory Change and Reporting

  • Oversee delivery of the compliance monitoring programme, including planning, performing and reporting on reviews, and tracking agreed actions to completion.
  • Monitor regulatory developments, assess their impact and support the business in implementing regulatory change.
  • Assist in the preparation of regular compliance reporting, e.g. the Annual Compliance Officer’s Report, Annual Consumer Duty Report.
  • Contribute to compliance MI and risk data analytics that feed into the Risk & Controls Committee and other governance forums.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting and escalation of issues to the Director, Regulatory Compliance and Senior Management.

Team Development and Technical Capability

  • Act as a technical point of reference for the Compliance team, helping colleagues to build their regulatory knowledge and judgement.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance to Compliance team members on a dotted-line basis, including coaching and quality-reviewing their work, and support the Director, Regulatory Compliance in their professional development and growth.
  • Identify technical skills gaps within the team and help design and deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Help design and deliver compliance training to the wider business.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to embed a strong compliance culture across all business units within the Group.

New products, product life-cycle and financial promotion

  • Assist the business in developing new products including by ensuring adequacy of permission in the context of new solutions.
  • Support the business in the various aspects of existing products’ life-cycle.
  • Oversee the delivery of the firm financial promotion requirements across the firm’s multiple channels, seeking continued efficiency and consistency.

The successful candidate:

  • Will exhibit strong technical and relationship management skills, building trust with colleagues, senior stakeholders and advisers;
  • Should have a curious mindset, be commercial, tenacious and a lateral thinker, who can help develop suitable compliance practices that protect our investors, the business and wider stakeholders;
  • Should have experience of coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to compliance professionals.

Experience

Essential

  • Extensive compliance experience within investment management or the wider financial services sector.
  • Solid technical knowledge of the FCA Handbook, relevant regulatory and/or product framework, including AIFMD and MiFID, and their practical application in a retail context.
  • Experience of delivering compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting and advisory activity.
  • A good understanding of alternative asset classes and financial service compliance, with commercial awareness in problem solving.
  • Strong organisational and communication skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred

  • Experience of coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to compliance colleagues, including in a matrix or dotted-line arrangement.
  • Knowledge of Consumer Duty, financial promotions including in the Restricted and Non-Mass Market Space, SM&CR, FCA’s rules and expectations in the context of retail distribution of products such as AIFs, UCIS, tax-advantaged investments, and services such as discretionary management.
  • Experience of supporting regulatory permission applications or direct engagement with the FCA.
  • A relevant professional qualification (e.g. ICA or CISI) or working towards one.
  • Familiarity with AI tools

Personal Qualities

  • Proactive and self-motivated.
  • Able to see the bigger picture while managing the detail.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to adapt to change and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence others.
  • Generous with knowledge and committed to developing others.
  • High level of professionalism and ethical conduct.
  • Strong commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Why Join us?

  • You’ll join a talented, collaborative team in a connected environment where ideas and initiative are valued.
  • Be part of a growing and innovative team
  • We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and genuine opportunities for growth and progression.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

At Triple Point, high performance means living our values every day:

·       Stay Curious.

·       Be Generous.

·       Take Thoughtful Action.

·       Pull Together.

·       Own It.

In line with our values Stay Curious and Take Thoughtful Action every employee has access to AI tools. We see technology as a co-pilot, helping us improve efficiency and insight while keeping decisions grounded in thoughtful human judgement.

Triple Point offers a wealth of benefits including a contributory pension, hybrid/flexible working and ongoing learning and development opportunities. Check out our comprehensive list of benefits HERE. 

Apply today for further information!

Triple Point is dedicated to providing fair and equal opportunities for all individuals, including both current and potential employees. Discrimination of any kind based on factors such as age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, or marital status is not tolerated by the company.

Our aim is to create a welcoming and diverse work environment where people from all walks of life feel valued and supported. We actively encourage individuals from various backgrounds to apply for job vacancies and become part of our team. 

STRICTLY NO AGENCIES

title: Assistant Store Manager, Neueröffnung Berlin (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Wir bei flaconi sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt Kreativität, Innovation und Wachstum fördert. Sie lebt in all ihren Formen der Schönheit. Unser Team ist ein Mosaik von Einzelpersonen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Kulturen und Lebenswegen, die alle durch eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für Schönheit vereint sind. Unser Engagement basiert auf unseren Grundwerten, insbesondere #trustinpeople. Wir sehen es als unsere Verantwortung an, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich jeder Mitarbeitende ehrlich wertgeschätzt und gehört fühlt und dazu ermutigt wird, seine einzigartigen Perspektiven einzubringen, um ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit zu fördern.

flaconi ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit und begrüßt und ermutigt alle qualifizierten Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten jeglicher Herkunft und Identität zur Bewerbung, unabhängig von ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Rasse, Geschlechtsidentität, Migrationshintergrund, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderungsstatus, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Alter.

Solltest du spezielle Unterstützung während des Bewerbungs- oder Interviewprozesses benötigen – z. B. Live-Untertitelung, mehr Zeit für das Interview oder die Aufgabe in einem anderen Format – lass es uns einfach wissen, damit wir den Prozess entsprechend anpassen können. Wir werden unser Bestes tun, um dies zu ermöglichen.

flaconi baut die Zukunft des Beauty-Retails!

Als Deutschlands führende Online-Destination für Beauty bringen wir unser Markenerlebnis jetzt direkt in die Top-Einkaufsstraßen – und unser Flagship in Berlin setzt dabei neue Maßstäbe.

Als Assistant Store Manager bist du der operativ-strategische Partner unserer Store Manager:innen und das Mastermind der täglichen Umsetzung auf der Fläche. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Laden prozessual makellos läuft, hältst unsere Premium-Standards auch unter Hochdruck aufrecht und bist direkt verantwortlich für das fachliche Coaching unseres Teams, um Spitzenleistungen im Service und Verkauf zu erzielen. Wenn du darin aufblühst, Teams durch fachliche Anleitung in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu inspirieren und für operative Exzellenz sowie funktionale Talententwicklung brennst, ist dies deine Chance, wertvolle Expertise in einer strategischen Rolle auf unserer Fläche zu sammeln.

Deine Rolle

  • Performance Coach: Du agierst als fachliche:r Lead-Trainer:in auf der Fläche und förderst die Fähigkeiten deines Teams in den Bereichen Sales, Service und Produktwissen in jeder Schicht.
  • Operational Excellence: Du überblickst das Daily Business im Store, inklusive Kassenführung, Sicherheit und der strikten, lückenlosen Einhaltung aller operativen SOPs.
  • Customer Excellence: Du löst Kundenanliegen und Reklamationen souverän und lebst dem Team fachlich vor, wie jede Interaktion den hohen flaconi-Standards entspricht.
  • Resource Planning: Du unterstützt die Store Manager:innen datenbasiert bei der Erstellung effizienter Personaleinsatzpläne, um die Verkaufsabdeckung zu maximieren und Personalkosten im Griff zu behalten.
  • Brand Aesthetic: Du sorgst für ein makelloses Visual Merchandising und Sauberkeit im Store, um die Ästhetik unserer Marke perfekt zu repräsentieren.

Dein Profil

  • Fachliche Führung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung, Steuerung und Motivation von Teams im Einzelhandel.
  • Operations-Profi: Mindestens 5–6 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Retail-Operations und im Management komplexer Store-Abläufe.
  • Ausbildung & System-Know-how: Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Warenwirtschaftssystemen (z. B. Oracle BI/SIM).
  • Analytisches Mindset: Extrem strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, operative Probleme eigenständig und datenbasiert zu lösen.
  • Tech & Languages: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office (Excel) sowie verhandlungssichere Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • flaconi-Vibe: Hohe Resilienz im turbulenten Store-Alltag, eine ausgeprägte "Get-it-done"-Attitüde und Leidenschaft für Premium-Beauty.
  • Brand Aesthetic: Du sorgst für ein makelloses Visual Merchandising und Sauberkeit im Store, um die Ästhetik unserer Marke perfekt zu repräsentieren.
  Was wir dir bieten
  • Unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sind uns wichtig: Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag an und übernehmen die Kosten deines Deutschland Tickets
  • Work-Life-Balance: 29 Urlaubstage und die Möglichkeit eines bezahlten Sabbaticals.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen: Wir möchten dich auch in schwierigen Zeiten unterstützen. Dazu bieten wir dir und deinen Angehörigen Beratungsgespräche mit psychologischen Fachkräften an.
  • flaconi Fitness & Health: Vergünstigungen bei Mitgliedschaften und Zuschuss für deine Bildschirmbrille.
  • Gemeinsam an morgen denken: flaconi bezuschusst deinen Sparbeitrag zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit zusätzlichen 20%.
  • Ein komfortabler Arbeitsplatz mit allem, was dazugehört: Hochwertige technische Ausstattung, Obst und Getränke.
  • Weitere Vergünstigungen: Tolle Rabatte in unserem Online-Shop sowie bei Partnerunternehmen, coole Teamevents & Firmenfeiern.

Über flaconi


flaconi ist einer der führenden deutschen Online-Kosmetikhändler mit einem umfangreichen Portfolio von fast 1.000 Marken und 50.000 Produkten. Von Drogerie über Bio-Kosmetik bis hin zu Premium und Luxus decken die Online-Shops in Deutschland, Frankreich, Österreich, Polen und der Schweiz alle Produktsegmente ab und bieten eine vielfältige Auswahl an Produkten für eine einzigartige und tägliche Beauty-Routine. 2011 als eine der ersten Online-Parfümerien gegründet, arbeitet flaconi heute mit mehr als 700 Mitarbeitern aus 60 verschiedenen Nationen in der flaconi-Zentrale in Berlin-Charlottenburg und im Fulfillment-Center in Halle. Gestalte mit uns den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens und bewirb dich jetzt online! flaconi akzeptiert keine unaufgeforderten Lebensläufe aus anderen Quellen (z.B. Personaldienstleister) als direkt von einem Bewerber.

KI-Hinweis

Wir setzen KI-gestützte Tools ein, um einzelne Schritte unseres Recruiting-Prozesses effizienter zu gestalten und zu unterstützen. Diese Tools helfen unserem Recruiting-Team beispielsweise dabei, passende Kandidaten zu identifizieren, Bewerbungen zu priorisieren oder recruitingrelevante Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen.

Die KI trifft dabei keine Einstellungsentscheidungen. Jede Bewerbung wird von Menschen geprüft und bewertet, und sämtliche Personalentscheidungen erfolgen unter menschlicher Aufsicht und Verantwortung. title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.

Descriptif du poste :

En tant qu’Apprenti(e) dans l’équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l’équipe média, l’équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu’avec l’équipe commerciale. 

Vos missions consisteront à:

  • Mettre en avant sur l’application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l’app.
  • Soutenir l’équipe commerciale dans la création et l’exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.  
  • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).
  • Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.
  • Contribuer à l’exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l’application / notifications push...).
  • Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. 
  • Analyser l’impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales

Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. 

Ce qui vous permettra de réussir

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.

Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants

  • Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais
  • Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.
  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.
  • Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.

Voici un lien avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !

La vie chez Deliveroo :

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Associate Director - Credit
descriptionHtml:
Since 2004, we’ve been bringing investment ideas to life and connecting capital with the right people and opportunities. Today, we manage more than £2.5 billion for a broad range of investors across five key investment strategies: Private Credit, Social Housing, Clean Heat, Energy and Venture. These strategies underpin the innovative range of investments we offer to both private (retail) and institutional clients. 

There are 230+ employees at Triple Point, all committed to leaving the world demonstrably better than we found it. That’s why we’re a certified B Corp, signed up to the Principles for Responsible Investment, and were named a Sunday Times 'Best Places to Work  2025 & 2026'.

If this sounds like an environment where you would flourish, then read on…

The Function & Team

The Credit & Risk team sits within the Group Risk & Compliance function and provides independent oversight across the Private Credit platform. Partnering with lending and portfolio management teams throughout the lending lifecycle, the team establishes and maintains the governance, frameworks and oversight that support consistent lending decisions, effective portfolio management and effective restructuring across all of Private Credit's lending strategies.  

Credit & Risk team members work collaboratively across credit underwriting, portfolio monitoring, restructuring, recoveries and assurance, providing specialist expertise across all of Private Credit's lending strategies. 

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Review & Risk Identification

  • Assist with, and ultimately take ownership of, portfolio review processes in partnership with portfolio management teams, ensuring early identification of risk and emerging trends across all lending strategies.
  • Exercise delegated authority for non-material credit requests, escalating appropriately where thresholds are exceeded.
  • Contribute to watchlist and early warning indicator processes, flagging deteriorating credits for further action.
  • Contribute case-level input to Lessons Learnt processes, covering challenged cases, watchlist trends and emerging risk themes.

Credit Underwriting Support & Origination Partnership

  • Partner with origination teams to evaluate new lending opportunities, providingcredit expertise and challenge at the appropriate stage.
  • Review credit papers ahead of submission from time to time, providing a clear recommendation to Credit Committee members.
  • Build strong working relationships with origination and portfolio management teams to ensure credit input is embedded early and effectively.

Portfolio Reporting & Advisory

  • Prepare and present internal reporting materials on portfolio health, performance and emerging trends for senior stakeholders.
  • Provide ad-hoc credit advisory support to portfolio management teams on existing positions as needed.
  • Contribute portfolio-level insight and findings into wider Credit & Risk reporting.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and help implement improvements to credit processes, frameworks and monitoring tools.
  • Drive efficiency through automation, reporting improvements and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Contribute to ad-hoc credit projects and process initiatives where required.

Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience in credit risk, credit analysis or portfolio management within a lending, private credit, or credit advisory environment.
  • Strong financial analysis and credit assessment skills, with the ability to review and challenge credit papers and identify key risks.
  • Experience with portfolio monitoring or review processes, including identifying early signs of credit deterioration.
  • Comfortable exercising judgement and holding delegated authority for credit decisions within defined parameters.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear reporting materials and provide credit recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Educated to degree level.
  • Proven ability to work autonomously, build effective relationships across teams, and constructively challenge origination and portfolio management colleagues.

Desirable

  • Specific experience in private credit, alternative lending or direct lending (as opposed to traditional bank lending).
  • Exposure to mid-market/SME lending; familiarity with wholesale lending structures.
  • Experience with watchlist frameworks, early warning indicators, or provisioning/impairment processes.
  • Experience designing or improving credit risk frameworks, monitoring tools or reporting processes.
  • Experience using or implementing AI-enabled tools in a credit or risk context.

title: Ausbildungsplatz zum Fachinformatiker – Systemintegration (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Stellenbeschreibung

Internet? Kann ich.

Zukunft? Kann ich.
Ausbildung? Kann ich.

Wir sind ropa – ein Internet Service Provider (ISP) aus Schwäbisch Gmünd. Seit über 25 Jahren beschäftigen wir uns mit Telekommunikation, leistungsfähigen Netzwerken und digitaler Infrastruktur.

Du nutzt täglich das Internet – aber weißt Du auch, was dahintersteckt?
Bei uns lernst Du die Technik kennen, die hinter einer zuverlässigen Internetverbindung steckt. Als ISP sorgen wir dafür, dass Menschen und Unternehmen zuverlässig online sind und Du kannst ein Teil davon werden. Und das Beste: Du bist von Anfang an mittendrin!
Von der Netzwerkinfrastruktur und -technik über die Administration von IT-Systemen bis hin zur Analyse komplexer technischer Störungen.
Learning by Doing – so funktioniert Ausbildung bei ropa.
Statt nur zuzuschauen, arbeitest Du an echten Aufgaben mit, bringst Deine Ideen ein und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

  • Netzwerktechnik: Routing und Switching? Verstehe, wie Netzwerke funktionieren und Daten ihr Ziel erreichen.
  • ISP-Infrastruktur: Lerne den Aufbau der technischen Infrastruktur kennen und welche Komponenten für einen zuverlässigen Netzbetrieb notwendig sind.
  • Netzwerkbetrieb und Monitoring: Du lernst, wie Netzwerke überwacht, technische Auffälligkeiten erkannt und Störungen analysiert werden.
  • Systemadministration: Du beschäftigst Dich mit der Einrichtung, Konfiguration und Betreuung von Servern, Betriebssystemen und IT-Diensten.
  • Troubleshooting: Du analysierst technische Probleme, bearbeitest Tickets und arbeitest gemeinsam mit Deinem Team an passenden Lösungen.
  • Kundenanbindungen: Du bekommst Einblicke in die technischen Abläufe – von der Planung bis zur Bereitstellung unserer Dienste.
  • IT-Sicherheit: Du lernst, worauf es beim sicheren und zuverlässigen Betrieb von Netzwerken und IT-Systemen ankommt.

Ausbildungsbeginn: 1. September 2027
Ausbildungsort: Schwäbisch Gmünd
Berufsschule: Aalen
Arbeitszeit: 40 Stunden pro Woche außerhalb der Schulzeiten

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mittlere Reife oder (Fach-)Abitur
  • Begeisterung für IT, Netzwerke und Technik
  • Spaß daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und Probleme zu lösen
  • Teamgeist, Neugier und Eigeninitiative Ein Führerschein der Klasse B ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Profil

Noch kein IT-Profi? Kein Problem!
Ob Du bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Netzwerken oder Linux gesammelt hast oder einfach neugierig auf die Technik hinter dem Internet bist: Entscheidend sind Dein Interesse, Deine Motivation und Deine Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen.

Last but not least - was wir zu bieten haben

Unsere Mitarbeiter sollen jeden Tag gerne zur Arbeit kommen und sich innerhalb des Teams und des Unternehmens gut aufgehoben fühlen. Diesen Anspruch stellen wir an uns selbst als Arbeitgeber.

title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Transfers Europe
descriptionHtml:
At SumUp, we empower small businesses with simple, affordable tools to start, run, and grow. Our Global Bank teams build the financial services that help merchants manage their money and keep their businesses moving.

For merchants, a transfer should feel simple. Behind that experience is a complex network of payment schemes, banks, providers, messages, certificates, reconciliations, and edge cases—all of which need to work together reliably.

Transfers Europe squad is the integration layer connecting SumUp’s internal systems with the financial networks that move money across Europe and the UK. We build and run the backend services behind SEPA and UK transfer flows, helping move money accurately and reliably across external networks.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll take ownership of services that process real money. You’ll work on complex systems problems to ensure seamless integrations as we scale, while seeing a direct connection between your engineering decisions and merchant trust.

If you enjoy understanding how systems behave under real-world conditions while improving them over time, we’d love to hear from you.

Our tech stack includes Golang, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes, supported by a strong observability toolchain with Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also actively use AI‑assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others.

What you’ll do 

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver well‑defined tasks and features, and contribute to larger projects within the team’s domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.
  • Improve service reliability and quality by writing tests, enhancing monitoring, and following established delivery pipelines.
  • Support the operation of the systems you work on by participating in on‑call rotations, incident response, and learning from post‑incident reviews.
  • Apply a backend and systems perspective during refinement, raising questions about risks, dependencies, and edge cases.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and other engineers to deliver end‑to‑end transfer and banking capabilities.

You’ll be great for this role if you

  • Have experience building backend services in a modern environment and supporting them in production.
  • You are proficient in Golang and and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed
  • Are comfortable working with cloud‑based systems, containerized workloads, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Raise well-scoped pull requests, conduct thorough code reviews, and help maintain high standards of code quality and test coverage across the team
  • Understand the fundamentals of system architecture, data modelling, and API design, and are eager to deepen this knowledge.
  • Are curious about how your work fits into the broader system and product experience.
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.

Any of the following would be considered a plus

  • Exposure to banking, payments, or financial systems, especially in regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with production traffic, including participating in incident response.
  • Use of AI‑assisted tools to improve development speed, learning, or code quality.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🩺 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing a vast set of simple and affordable business tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster an inclusivity and continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

title: Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As a Business Development Representative at Dust, you'll be instrumental in generating the qualified pipeline that fuels our rapid growth. This isn't a typical BDR role—you'll be pioneering AI-native sales development, using Dust's own platform daily to transform how prospecting and qualification work. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from 60 to 180 people, working directly with technical leaders and founders at scale-ups and enterprise companies to connect their challenges to Dust's value. This role offers a front-row seat to category creation and a clear path to growth within our GTM organization.

What you'll do

Drive qualified pipeline generation

  • Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through targeted outreach to scale-ups and enterprise companies

  • Conduct cold calls and discovery conversations with technical leaders, founders, and decision-makers

  • Qualify leads by understanding their pain points and connecting business challenges to Dust's value proposition

Own the qualification and handoff process

  • Nurture prospects until they're sales-ready, providing detailed context to Account Executives and Solution Engineers

  • Ensure smooth handoffs that convert to high-quality SQLs with clear next steps

  • Track and manage your pipeline in close partnership with the GTM team

Experiment and optimize the sales motion

  • Collaborate with Marketing and GTM Engineers to test outbound campaigns and double down on what works

  • Define target personas and develop prospecting strategies to access key accounts

  • Use data to refine your approach and continuously improve conversion rates

Be a Dust power user

  • Use Dust agents daily to prospect, qualify, research accounts, and manage your workflow

  • Embody "Work AGI" by transforming your own processes and sharing what you learn with the team

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • 1-2 years of BDR/SDR or sales experience, or demonstrated hunger to break into tech sales with relevant transferable skills

  • Excellent communication skills in English to engage effectively with technical stakeholders; French is a strong plus for European market coverage

  • You know how to grab attention and adapt your message to different audiences

  • Strong coachability. You absorb feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your approach

  • Performance-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets

Attitude

  • Team player who thrives in a collaborative, high-growth environment and actively shares knowledge

  • Self-aware and reflective. You own your results, learn from setbacks, and don't deflect responsibility

  • Strong ownership mentality. You take pride in your work and care about the impact you create

  • Ability to handle rejection with resilience and maintain a positive, curious attitude

  • Natural collaborator who makes the people around them better

Agency

  • Hustle mentality. You see opportunities and act on them without waiting to be told

  • Ownership over outcomes, not just tasks, you drive results end-to-end

  • Resourceful problem-solver who finds ways forward even with limited information

  • Track record of self-initiated projects or going beyond what was asked

  • Comfortable making decisions and moving fast in ambiguous, evolving situations

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Business Strategist - DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies.

The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. Comand AI is at the forefront of the rebuilding of these verticals to serve our countries resilience.

Comand AI core product is a next generation command and control software platform, which allows militaries to operate at machine speed in a communication and GNSS denied context. A few facts to anchor you:

  • €45M raised from seed to Series A, Blossom Capital leading the series A and Saab as a strategic investor

  • Software platform combat proven and deployed in Ukraine

  • A lean team of operators with backgrounds from Palantir, OpenAI and world-class tech experience, alongside unique expertise from the defense sector

  • Live business with governments and defense industry leaders across Europe

  • Paris (HQ), London, Munich and Kyiv subsidiaries

The Role

From the very identification of the capacities that need building to their actual delivery within the hands of our forces, achieving our objective means finding the narrow ways through complex legacy environments, dense ecosystems, concrete partnership engagements.

We are looking for a Business Strategist to build Comand AI’s presence from the ground up. You will identify the right entry points, build trusted relationships across the defense ecosystem, and create the path from first operational engagement to pilot and contract. Working closely with product and forward deployed teams, you’ll turn operational proof into commercial traction and establish Comand AI as a trusted partner in the market.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Build Comand AI’s presence in your market: identify the right units, partners, champions, and procurement pathways, then own the journey from first engagement through experimentation, pilot, and contract

  • Identify and shape strategic opportunities before formal procurement, positioning Comand AI where operational needs emerge

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across the defense ecosystem, from operational units to industrial partners and government stakeholders

  • Navigate long, politically sensitive B2G sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, security clearances, RFIs, RFPs, and public procurement rules

  • Translate Prevail’s technical capabilities into language that resonates with procurement officers, general staffs, and program leads

  • Work closely with the founders, product, and forward deployed teams to turn field validation into commercial traction

  • Collaborate with a Europe-wide team to unlock strategic opportunities with armed forces, partners, and defense organizations

Who We're Looking For

Must-have:

  • Experience selling into armed forces, ministries of defense, or another highly regulated B2G market with long sales cycles

  • A top performing history on your sales team and a clear track record of two or three large-size deals you personally closed

  • Comfortable building a pipeline and a market from close to zero, without a playbook handed to you

  • Technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex software products well enough to translate them into operational and commercial value

  • Empathy for military users and their mission

  • EU citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defense contracts)

  • Fluency in the local language of the market you're covering, plus English

Nice to have:

  • Existing relationships inside defense ministries, armed forces, or NATO-adjacent institutions

  • Prior experience at a defense tech or dual-use startup

  • Background in the military or a related government role

What's In It For You

  • Competitive package (top 0.1% of compensation in Europe: base + equity)

  • Munich-based with field travel to active deployment areas

The Process

  1. First call. A conversation with our Talent team about your background and your motivation.

  2. Meeting our GTM team. Two discussions with members of our GTM team, to explore your experience and the expertise you could bring to Comand AI.

  3. Case study. A business case to prepare, which you'll present and discuss with the team.

  4. Meeting the wider team. A conversation with our Product team, followed by a final discussion with our CEO.

descriptionHtml:
About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.


Role details:
Permanent, full time
Location: London hybrid, or remote within the UK

We’re looking for a sharp, fast-moving, tech-savvy Campaign Manager who lives and breathes the creator economy.

You’ll be working with one of the world’s biggest consumer packaged goods brands, helping bring creator campaigns to life across the UK and wider Europe.

This isn’t the occasional influencer campaign. It’s creator marketing at scale for a CPG brand. Multiple products, new launches every few weeks and hundreds of creators producing content at once. Things move quickly and briefs can land with little warning.

This role suits someone with a couple of years under their belt who is ready to step up, take ownership and learn fast. You don’t need to have done everything before. You do need to be quick, organised and genuinely excited by AI and the tools that are changing how this work gets done. If you’re already using AI to work faster and smarter, you’ll fit right in.

At Kyra, we’re building a different kind of creator marketing company. We combine great people, technology and AI to make creator marketing smarter, faster and more effective. You’ll have access to our own platform, with over 29 million creator profiles, and AI tools to handle everything from casting and outreach to contracts, payments and reporting.

🚀 What You’ll Be Doing

Bring Campaigns to Life

  • Manage multiple creator campaigns from brief through to launch, delivery and reporting.

  • Keep timelines, budgets, content approvals and deliverables moving.

  • Work closely with creators, clients and internal teams to get campaigns out the door.

  • Spot issues early and flag them with a suggested fix.

Make the Numbers Work

  • Build creator pricing around CPV targets and expected performance.

  • Negotiate creator fees and manage budgets.

  • Use data to make better decisions throughout each campaign.

Support Great Client Relationships

  • Be a day-to-day contact for the client’s UK marketing team.

  • Join weekly calls, share updates and keep everyone aligned.

  • Bring ideas and solutions, not just status reports.

Find and Work With Great Creators

  • Discover and cast creators who fit each product, audience and brief.

  • Build shortlists at scale across campaigns.

  • Manage outreach, briefing, negotiation, contracting and content delivery.

  • Keep on top of usage rights, disclosures and approvals.

Work AI-First

  • Run the full campaign journey on Kyra’s platform.

  • Use AI tools like Claude every day to speed up creator discovery, research, analysis, reporting and admin.

  • Find new ways to use AI to cut manual work and move faster.

  • Monitor CPV, reach, engagement and conversion while campaigns are live.

  • Keep campaign information accurate and up to date so the whole team has visibility.

⚡ How We Work

We move quickly, work collaboratively and care about doing great work. Here’s what that looks like in practice:

  • New briefs are picked up within 24 hours, with creator discovery and outreach underway.

  • Blockers are escalated within 3 hours.

  • Risks and performance concerns are raised early, ideally with a suggested solution.

  • Clients and teammates get regular updates without needing to chase.

  • Campaign information is kept accurate in our platform.

  • AI is the default. If a task can be done faster with a tool, we use the tool.

We don’t expect everything to go perfectly. We do expect people to take ownership, communicate openly and respond fast when something needs attention.

🙌 Who We’re Looking For

Someone who understands creator marketing for consumer products. Who knows the difference between a creator with a big following and one who can actually shift product off the shelf. Who enjoys both the creative and commercial sides of the job, isn’t fazed by pace, and reaches for AI and tech before doing something by hand.

title: Care Operations Strategist - End-of-studies internship (1,8K€/month)
descriptionHtml:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents for healthcare providers: they answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, and handle confirmations and reminders, so medical teams can focus on care. Following our $25M Series A, we are a team of 50+ across Paris and New York, working with around 240 healthcare organizations (imaging, ophthalmology, dental and more) across 700+ sites.

Our users are medical secretaries, center directors and practitioners. When something blocks them, they need a clear answer, fast. Support volume grew 5x in 12 months, and we are building a Customer Experience team that keeps up: faster answers, clients who are autonomous from day one, and processes that scale.

You join the CX team, within Operations, as Care Ops Intern, reporting to Sylvain, our CX Manager.

Your mission

Be the first point of contact for our users and make sure every request gets a fast, clear answer. Then make the next request unnecessary: turn recurring questions into guides, videos and Help Center content that make clients autonomous.

Expected outcomes

After 1 month:

  • You know the full client journey, from deployment to support, and who to call on for each topic

  • You handle level-1 Intercom tickets on your own, with growing complexity

  • You own a first recurring mission end to end (e.g. monitoring bot alerts)

After 3 months:

  • You handle complex tickets on your own and escalate bugs with a clear diagnosis

  • You have audited our training content (Vocca Académie) and shipped the first missing guides and videos

  • You bring recurring issues and product signals to Product and Tech every week

At the end of your internship (6 months):

  • A self-serve Help Center live, covering the most frequent requests

  • Onboarding content in use for the secretaries of new clients

  • Key CX processes documented (bug reports, escalations) and handed over cleanly

What you'll own

Customer support (70% of your time)

  • Handle incoming Intercom tickets quickly and clearly

  • Diagnose issues (configuration, Doctolib, bugs) and escalate to the right people

  • Write professional, accessible answers for a non-technical audience

  • Spot recurring patterns and bring weak product signals back to the team

Customer experience resources (20%)

  • Create and maintain clear user guides (Notion, PDF)

  • Produce onboarding videos: scripting, and light editing with AI tools

  • Build a self-serve Help Center that reduces support volume

  • Improve the activation journey of new clients, starting with secretary training

Process and scale (10%)

  • Document existing processes (bug reports, escalations)

  • Identify friction and propose concrete improvements

  • Work across the Product, Ops and Tech teams

This role is for you if

Must have:

  • You are available for a 6-month full-time internship, under an internship agreement (convention de stage)

  • Fluent written French: you write to French medical teams every day

  • You are comfortable with digital tools (Notion, Intercom, Claude), or you learn them fast. No technical background required.

What we'll assess:

  • Client writing: your messages are structured, adapted to the reader (secretary, practitioner, center director) and jargon-free, without losing accuracy

  • Diagnosis and product curiosity: faced with an unknown case, you ask the right questions in the right order and isolate the cause: usage error, configuration or bug

  • Organization and rigor: you prioritize by impact, not by order of arrival, and you close your loops

  • Proactivity: you have already spotted a recurring problem and built something others used: a guide, a FAQ, a template, a small automation

Nice to have:

  • A first experience in customer support, customer success or operations (internship, student job, association)

  • An interest in healthcare or AI

This role is NOT for you if

  • You want to process tickets without asking why they keep coming back

  • You would rather wait for the answer than dig into how the product works

  • You are looking for a role far from clients

Compensation

  • €1,800 per month for end-of-study internship

This role is where you start. If your internship goes well, we'd be very happy to have you join as a full-time employee!

Perks and benefits

  • At least 3 days a week in our offices in Paris (2nd arrondissement)

  • MacBook provided

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company)

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year

Hiring process

  1. Interview with Sylvain, CX Manager (video, 30 min)

  2. Practical case: answer a real, anonymized client request in 15 min, then debrief with Sylvain (on-site, 1h)

  3. Team fit with Julie, Head of Operations (on-site, 30 min)

  4. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Compensation: €1.8K per month

title: Careers Lead
descriptionHtml:
You make sure Pivotal fellows move into the roles where they can do the most to reduce catastrophic risk.

  • Salary: £86,750–£155,500 per year, depending on seniority. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You’ll own the career success of our fellows: where they go next, and how much Pivotal helped them get there. In 2027 that will cover about 170 fellows, plus alumni looking for their next role.

You stay in close contact with hiring managers in AI safety, AI governance and biosecurity, and build strong models of where the talent bottlenecks are (and will be in the future). Together with our Research Managers and their fellows, you develop individual career plans, connect the fellows with the right roles and people, and are honest with them about their options. You’ll also track where fellows go, so that we do better every cohort.

  • Knowledge of the field. Stay in close contact with hiring managers in AI safety, AI governance and biosecurity, and keep a current, written view of which roles the field most needs to fill.

  • Fellow career plans. Work with the Research Managers to find out what each fellow wants and needs, and follow up with individual fellows when their plans are unclear.

  • Placement & networking. Recommend open roles to fellows, and fellows for open roles. Connect the fellows with people they should talk to for advice or potential jobs, informed by the Research Managers' current view of each fellow.

  • References. Build a system so that any organisation that receives an application from a Pivotal fellow or alum can get a high-quality reference from us quickly.

  • Career programming. Career weeks, workshops and career memos, with Research Managers and partners such as 80,000 Hours.

  • Career outcomes. Track where fellows go, and report it.

  • Feedback into selection. Use what you learn about the field's needs to shape outreach and the make-up of each cohort.

Who does well in this role

  • You are well-connected in AI safety, AI governance or biosecurity, or you can build these relationships quickly.

  • You have worked in recruiting, careers advice, talent search or a similar role.

  • You have good judgement about people and about which roles suit them.

  • You want to find out if your process works, and you change it when it does not.

  • You are organised enough to run a system for about 170 fellows a year.

  • Fellows trust you, and you are honest with them about their options.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks from AI. You do not need a research background.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £86,750 – £155,500

title: CDI - Manager AI Builder - Paris
descriptionHtml:
L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle.

Et tout commence par vous.

Mission

En tant qu’AI Builder Manager, vous pilotez des missions et programmes AI Adoption qui font passer l’IA de l’expérimentation à la transformation des métiers. Au contact des dirigeants et des responsables métiers, vous définissez des dispositifs de montée en compétences, de construction d’agents et d’accompagnement au changement. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions : vous en garantissez la qualité, l’impact et la rentabilité, faites grandir vos équipes et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners.

Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. Vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous concevez des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, challengez et construisez des solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et mobilisez les équipes pour faire passer ces solutions du prototype à des usages durables.

Vous accompagnez les organisations dans la transformation des tâches, des rôles et responsabilités, et des compétences à l’ère de l’IA. Vous articulez les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) avec les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), en collaboration avec nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. Votre ambition : faire de l’IA un levier de transformation du travail, avec un impact concret, mesurable et durable sur les équipes et leur performance.

Activités & Responsabilités

I. Analyse & Cadrage

Conduire le cadrage avec L&D, RH, sponsors et métiers: définir populations cibles, priorités, objectifs observables et parcours différenciés.Concevoir une stratégie de démultiplication combinant sessions, contenus digitaux, coaching, champions et transfert aux équipes internes.Piloter un portefeuille de cas d'usage opérationnels: valeur, faisabilité, risque, capacité de build et séquencement des sprints.Organiser les ateliers de discovery et faire arbitrer les points de dépendance, d'accès ou de gouvernance par les interlocuteurs habilités.

II. Développement & Déploiement des Solutions

Piloter budget, planning, staffing, qualité pédagogique et satisfaction ; réaliser les arbitrages nécessaires et faire grandir les équipes.Superviser les assets pédagogiques, animer les sessions à forte visibilité et garantir l'alignement entre exercices, capacités des plateformes et besoins métier.Superviser les solutions low-code/no-code, les standards, les jeux de tests, la documentation et les quality gates adaptés au périmètre technique et aux standards de la practice.Concevoir avec les Analytics Engineers l’architecture de reporting d’un programme, définir les standards de visualisation et de KPIs, coacher les équipes en data storytelling, superviser leurs dashboards et en piloter l’adoption.

III. Adoption & Animation de Communauté

Coordonner la mise en usage, la formation des utilisateurs et le handover client: relais managériaux, communautés, rituels et office hours.Piloter les boucles de feedback, les indicateurs de valeur et, si désigné, le plan de change sur une mission ciblée.

IV. Structuration et Pilotage de la démarche Change

Définir des indicateurs de compétences, d'autonomie et d'usage; restituer les résultats aux sponsors et ajuster la démarche.Contribuer aux avant-ventes, estimations, chiffrages et propositions, en identifiant les extensions pertinentes chez les clients.Qualifier la nécessité d’un co-delivery avec Solutions Engineering ou la DSI, sans empiéter sur leurs autorités techniques.

Profil recherché

Vous vous reconnaissez si… vous aimez piloter des missions exigeantes de bout en bout, faire grandir une équipe et gagner la confiance de dirigeants, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre leurs mains plutôt que leur décrire une vision

5 à 8 ans d’expérience en conseil, transformation digitale, data / IA ou conduite du changement, avec une formation supérieure de niveau licence ou master issue d’un cursus académique d’excellence.Une expérience confirmée de pilotage de missions complexes et de management d’équipes, avec une responsabilité sur la qualité des livrables, les délais, les budgets et la satisfaction client.Une solide maîtrise des usages de l’IA générative et agentique, et un état d’esprit de maker : capacité à concevoir, challenger et faire évoluer des agents et solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et à guider les équipes dans leur construction.Une expérience dans la conception et le pilotage de dispositifs de montée en compétences et de programmes d’adoption de l’IA, ainsi que dans la transformation des processus, des rôles et des pratiques de travail.Une aisance dans la relation avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau, la capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes, faire grandir les consultants et contribuer au développement commercial.Une maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais (oral et écrit).

À propos d’Artefact

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. Envie d'en savoir plus ? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

De la stratégie à la réalisation
Ne pas s’arrêter aux recommandations : participer à la conception et à la concrétisation de solutions IA répondant à de véritables enjeux métiers.Une collaboration entre expertises

Des missions de transformation IA de bout en bout, au cœur des enjeux des grands groupes, avec une vraie autonomie, une équipe à faire grandir et des comptes à développer.

Une trajectoire qui accélère
