title: Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

  • Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

  • Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage

  • Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

  • Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

  • Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle)

  • Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them)

  • Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Required Skills/Experience

  • Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems

  • Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles)

  • Experience with test and validation discipline: unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics.

  • Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

  • Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

  • Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

Desired Skills/Experience

  • Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components

  • Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience

  • Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls

  • Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)

  • Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues

  • Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen: general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.

  • Competency Interviews: programming and code review.

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: domain knowledge & system design.

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

 

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

The role

Laboratories are digitising fast, and demand for our diagnostic AI has outgrown the way we deliver it. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people.

As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next.

This is a senior delivery role. We are looking for someone who has done this before and can take ownership quickly, not someone who will learn project execution on the job. It is not a sales role and carries no sales target.

What you'll own

Delivery of our lab implementations

  • Own each implementation end to end: plan, milestones, dependencies, risks and the committed go-live date.

  • Run several implementations in parallel. Sequence them, decide what moves first when they compete for ML, engineering or customer time, and escalate only what you cannot resolve.

  • Drive technical integration with the lab and its partners (IMS, LIS, scanners, network and security reviews), working directly with our engineers and the customer's IT.

  • Direct the work of our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and of the customer's staff. Get firm commitments, follow them up, and don't accept "not possible right now" without a plan.

  • Accompany the validation each lab runs before go-live. The lab's medical director designs the study; you make sure the setup works, our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and the lab has everything it needs to finish.

  • Raise risks early, with options and a recommendation, rather than after a date slips.

The customer relationship through go-live and beyond

  • Be the lab's main operational contact: run the regular project calls, send the recaps, keep every open item owned and dated on both sides.

  • After go-live, own support for your labs: monitor usage, resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop.

  • Bring structured customer feedback into product planning, and flag expansion opportunities to Sales.

How we deliver

  • Use and improve our delivery playbook, tracking and tooling so each implementation is faster and more predictable than the last.

What success looks like after six months

  • You run our small and mid-size lab implementations independently, with the Head of Diagnostic Products informed but no longer in the day-to-day.

  • Several onboardings run in parallel to plan, with fewer surprises close to deadlines.

  • Customers have one competent contact; our internal teams get clear, prioritised requests instead of ad-hoc escalations.

  • You are taking over parts of our larger, more product-heavy accounts.

Your profile

  • At least 2–3 years delivering projects to external customers, with several clients in parallel and at least one project owned from kickoff to go-live: clinical or diagnostic software, digital pathology, laboratory or medical device rollout, health IT, or comparable B2B delivery.

  • A track record of hitting committed dates in projects with dependencies you did not control. You can describe a project that went wrong and what you did about it.

  • A degree in a life or natural science such as biology, medicine, chemistry or physics, or several years of work in a comparable scientific field. You speak credibly with pathologists and can judge whether a pragmatic shortcut still makes scientific sense.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication. You lead conversations with lab directors, pathologists and IT teams, get commitments from people you don't manage, and raise blockers early. You work credibly with developers: you understand how they work and can challenge their estimates. You don't need to code.

  • Organised and self-driven: you keep many commitments on track without reminders, work in our delivery tools and help improve them, need no hand-holding, and know when "good enough" is the right call.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team.

  • Willing to travel up to 10% of your time: 3–4 trips a year of about a week each, mostly to US customers and scientific conferences.

  • Comfortable with regular late-afternoon or early-evening calls to overlap with US customers.

Nice to have

  • German language skills; experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments.

  • Experience delivering software into a regulated clinical setting or working within a quality management system.

  • Experience setting up or improving delivery processes and tooling in a growing team.

What Mindpeak offers

  • A role with real ownership in a team that is building out its diagnostics delivery right now.

  • The opportunity to build AI systems that power both clinical cancer diagnostics and data-driven drug development.

  • An open, creative work environment with flat hierarchies and quick decision-making.

  • An excellent leadership team that invests in continuous development.

  • A centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbour.

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Digital - French
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You enjoy working at high velocity:
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Customer Success Manager II
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Customer Success Manager II to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help our SMB and Mid Market customers achieve success and maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions and be part of a dynamic and collaborative team as we scale our innovative expense management platform across the UK & Ireland

If you're excited about solving customer challenges, and driving growth through exceptional service and are passionate about Customer Success in the SaaS industry, then this is the opportunity for you!

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our CX Manager and work closely with teams in CX, Onboarding, AM, Sales and Product. Our team of 30 is highly collaborative and dedicated to Customer Experience.

 

What you’ll be doing

As a Customer Success Manager II, your main markets will be UKI customers. You will:

  • Nurture, support and process expansion for any opportunity from the customer base

  • As a customer's trusted product advisor and business consultant advise them on how to create their ideal processes with the tool to optimise their value-add

  • Own the adoption journey of your customer portfolio (after the onboarding phase)

  • Collaborate across teams with different internal stakeholders such as product management, services & solutions, marketing, customer support, etc. to improve the entire customer experience

  • Receive, qualify and triage all inbound communication from all communication channels; email, Intercom (web chat), and/or other performance marketing channels

  • Cultivate key customers to become advocates of Pleo and the Fintech community

  • Manage day-to-day operations and long-term business relationships with our customers

  • Do everything in your power to prevent customers from leaving Pleo through measuring health scores, and product/ feature adoption and acting proactively on those

  • Optimise the product-market-fit by building the bridge between the customer's feedback and our product team

 

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if:

  • You have 5+ years of prior experience in account management or sales or customer success roles

  • You have an open mindset that always looks for the positive. Your customers and colleagues find your energy contagious

  • You truly enjoy helping others move and improve. You love helping your customers scale and grow

  • You love goals and objectives. You don't always need to be given tasks – you create your own tasks while chasing your targets, and it motivates you to reach them

  • You love a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you have different kinds of tasks - from customer calls to meetings with our product team

  • This is a high volume, high velocity role. Being able to think and do things at scale is a huge plus

  • You are a trustworthy person who always ensures that deadlines are reached, promises are kept, and you do what is expected of you

  • You are empathetic. You have a strong ability to feel how others are doing. You are also able to communicate in a very empathetic way and touch people's emotions

  • You are fluent in English

     

Why is this role a good fit for you

 

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy building long-term relationships with SMB and Mid Market customers and taking ownership of their success from adoption through expansion.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment and feel energised by balancing customer conversations, internal collaboration, and proactive problem-solving.

  • You’re motivated by impact and outcomes — helping customers grow, spotting expansion opportunities, and turning feedback into meaningful product improvements excites you.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You’re not motivated by customer-facing work or influencing customer outcomes through proactive engagement and collaboration.

  • You’re uncomfortable with project management or coordinating multiple initiatives at the same time.

  • You’re not motivated by upselling, cross-selling, or optimising the long-term value of your customers’ accounts.

     

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead customer adoption projects to drive impact in helping SMB and Mid Market clients maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Product teams to improve customer experience processes and feedback loops.

  • Grow your skills in relationship management and upselling strategies, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in customer success.

 

The location

Lisbon, Portugal, or London, UK

 

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. A 30-45 minute call with the Hiring Manager

  3. Our Pleo Challenge - an opportunity for you to showcase your ability in the form of a presentation and how you would approach the task at hand

  4. Final Interview - Our Bar Raiser meeting - how would you raise the bar for us?

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a CSM, we received many applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact!

At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome.

What will you do?

Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied.

Product

In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work.

  • Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition;

  • Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working;

  • Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts;

  • Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them;

  • Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development;

  • Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company.

Commercial & marketing support

Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex.

  • Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities;

  • Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS.

This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact.

Your team

You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data.

The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst;

  • Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics;

  • Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude;

  • Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it;

  • Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter;

  • Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders;

  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues;

  • Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus);

We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them.

title: Data, Automatisation & IA – Investissement à impact
descriptionHtml:
L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. INCO Ventures, acteur clé de ce domaine en France, gère et conseille six fonds d’investissement dédiés au financement des entreprises à fort impact social et/ou environnemental. Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€).

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs.

Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement.

Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape.

Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème :

  • L’équipe de gestion

  • Les équipes middle office et conformité

  • Nos investisseurs (LPs)

  • Les entreprises de notre portefeuille

Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplement aux informations dont il ou elle a besoin.

Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement.

Ce stage est autant un projet de construction qu’un projet d’innovation : nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les enjeux métier, de proposer des solutions et de contribuer à leur mise en œuvre.

Ce que vous construirez concrètement

Pendant votre stage, vous contribuerez à :

  • Structurer et faire évoluer plusieurs années de données d’investissement, impact et ESG

  • Participer à la migration de notre socle de données vers une architecture moderne et évolutive

  • Déployer des automatisations permettant de réduire les tâches manuelles et d’améliorer la qualité des données

  • Concevoir les premiers assistants IA internes de la société

  • Créer des outils utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes d’investissement, le middle office et la conformité

  • Participer à la création de portails dédiés aux investisseurs et aux entreprises du portefeuille

  • Contribuer à définir notre feuille de route data & IA pour les années à venir

Vos missions

Les projets seront menés en lien direct avec les équipes d'investissement, d’impact, le middle office et la conformité. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement très transversal, avec une forte autonomie et la possibilité de contribuer aussi bien à la réflexion qu'à l'implémentation des solutions.

Les missions décrites ci-dessous constituent une feuille de route initiale. Elles évolueront naturellement en fonction de l’avancement du projet, de vos centres d’intérêt et des opportunités identifiées ensemble.

  1. Comprendre et structurer notre écosystème de données

Vous participerez notamment à :

  • Cartographier les bases Airtable existantes et leurs usages

  • Comprendre les flux de données entre les différentes équipes

  • Identifier les redondances, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration

  • Participer à la conception du modèle de données cible

  • Contribuer, le cas échéant, à la migration progressive vers Supabase

  • Structurer les données financières, impact et ESG

  • Définir les règles d’accès et de gouvernance des données

  • Documenter les modèles, processus et bonnes pratiques

L’objectif est de construire un socle de données fiable, partagé et durable.

2. Automatiser les processus clés

Une fois les données structurées, vous contribuerez à automatiser les tâches répétitives et à fluidifier les opérations.

Exemples :

  • Collecte de données auprès des participations, relances automatiques

  • Consolidation de reportings

  • Contrôles de cohérence

  • Gestion documentaire

  • Préparation de certains livrables réglementaires

  • Qualification et enrichissement automatique d'opportunités d'investissement

  • Circulation de l’information entre les outils

Vous participerez à la conception et au déploiement de workflows no-code et low-code, principalement via N8N et les APIs des différents outils utilisés par la société.

3. Déployer des usages IA concrets

Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui saura identifier où l’IA peut réellement créer de la valeur.

Vous pourrez notamment travailler sur :

  • Des assistants internes connectés à nos bases de données

  • Des outils de recherche documentaire et de gestion des connaissances

  • L'extraction automatique d'informations depuis des rapports, questionnaires ou documents de due diligence

  • La pré-analyse de dossiers d'investissement

  • La génération assistée de reportings, mémos d’investissement et comptes-rendus

  • Des workflows mêlant automatisation et IA

  • L’exploration de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’investissement, à l’impact ou à la conformité

Vous serez encouragé.e à expérimenter, comparer les solutions disponibles sur le marché et proposer vos propres idées.

4. Construire les interfaces et portails utilisateurs

À mesure que les fondations seront en place, vous participerez à la création des interfaces permettant aux différents utilisateurs d’accéder simplement à l’information. Cela pourra inclure :

Portail équipe de gestion

  • Suivi des participations

  • Reporting portefeuille

  • Outils internes de pilotage

Portail investisseurs (LPs)

  • Consultation des reportings

  • Suivi des indicateurs de portefeuille

  • Diffusion sécurisée des informations réglementaires

Portail participations

  • Collecte de données

  • Suivi des indicateurs financiers et extra-financiers

  • Partage documentaire

5. Accompagner l’adoption des nouveaux outils

La réussite du projet ne dépend pas uniquement de la technologie. Vous contribuerez également à :

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs

  • Identifier de nouveaux cas d’usage

  • Former les équipes aux outils déployés

  • Produire une documentation simple et utile

  • Diffuser les bonnes pratiques liées à la data et à l’IA

  • Réaliser une veille active sur les nouveaux outils et tendances du marché

Pourquoi ce stage est différent

Vous ne rejoindrez pas une équipe technique isolée mais travaillerez directement avec les équipes métiers :

  • Notre Responsable Conformité & Middle Office

  • Notre Chief Impact Officer

  • Nos Directeur.rices d’investissement

Vous serez exposé.e à des problématiques à la fois stratégiques, opérationnelles et technologiques.

Vous participerez à la transformation d’une société de gestion de l’intérieur, avec une forte autonomie et un impact visible dès les premières semaines.

Les outils et processus que vous contribuerez à construire seront utilisés au quotidien par les équipes, les investisseurs et les entreprises que nous accompagnons.

C’est une opportunité rare de développer une expertise à l’intersection de l’investissement, de la data, de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle.

Candidature

Envoyez-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes expliquant :

  • Ce qui vous attire dans ce projet

  • Un outil, une automatisation ou un usage IA que vous avez déjà mis en place (ou que vous aimeriez explorer)

Pas besoin de lettre de motivation formelle.

Nous privilégions les personnes curieuses, pragmatiques et motivées à construire.


Nous recherchons avant tout une personne curieuse, autonome et orientée solutions.

Vous pourriez être la bonne personne si :

  • Vous êtes en école d’ingénieur, école de commerce, université ou équivalent

  • Vous avez une forte appétence pour la data, l’automatisation et l’IA

  • Vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux outils

  • Vous êtes capable de transformer un problème métier en solution concrète

  • Vous savez avancer de manière autonome tout en travaillant en équipe

Des compétences ou expériences dans les domaines suivants seront appréciées :

  • SQL et bases de données relationnelles

  • Airtable, Notion, N8N, Make ou outils similaires

  • APIs et intégrations

  • IA générative et prompting

Mais nous accordons autant d’importance à la curiosité, à la capacité d’apprentissage et à l’esprit d’initiative qu’aux compétences techniques.

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our 3 core practices; Brand experience, Customer experience and Commerce. Within these practices we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a Director, Marketing Analytics & Intelligence to lead analytics and marketing intelligence across a major European automotive account.

This is a senior, client-facing role sitting at the intersection of marketing analytics, consulting and commercial leadership.

This isn’t a traditional technical Data Director position. We’re looking for someone who understands how data, analytics and measurement can help senior marketing leaders make better decisions  and who can turn complex information into a clear strategic and commercial point of view.

You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders across European markets, helping them understand marketing and customer performance, identify opportunities for growth and make more informed decisions through data and insight.

Your experience could span areas such as marketing effectiveness, marketing mix modelling (MMM), media measurement, CRM and customer analytics, digital and web analytics, and broader marketing intelligence. You don’t need to be the technical specialist in every discipline; what matters is your ability to understand how these areas connect and translate them into meaningful recommendations for clients.

Alongside leading the analytics relationship, you’ll play an important role in identifying new opportunities, shaping propositions and growing the partnership across Europe.

What You’ll Do

Lead Marketing Analytics & Intelligence

  • Lead the development and delivery of marketing analytics and intelligence across European markets.
  • Bring together data and insight from across media, CRM, digital, customer and market sources to create a holistic view of performance.
  • Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Help clients understand marketing effectiveness, customer behaviour and the drivers of business performance.
  • Use measurement approaches, including MMM and wider effectiveness methodologies, to help inform marketing investment and decision-making.
  • Identify emerging trends, opportunities and challenges and turn these into meaningful strategic recommendations.
  • Help shape new approaches and capabilities across analytics, measurement and marketing intelligence.

Be a Senior Strategic Partner to Clients

  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as an advisor rather than simply a delivery partner.
  • Understand the business challenge behind the data and determine how analytics and insight can help solve it.
  • Lead senior conversations around marketing performance, customer behaviour, effectiveness and growth.
  • Turn complicated analytical thinking into clear and compelling stories that clients can understand and act on.
  • Bring a strong point of view, challenge existing thinking where appropriate and introduce new ideas and approaches.
  • Balance individual market requirements with a broader European perspective.

Drive Commercial Growth

  • Develop a deep understanding of client priorities and identify opportunities where data, analytics and intelligence can add further value.
  • Shape new propositions, solutions and scopes of work around those opportunities.
  • Support and lead pitches, proposals and senior new-business conversations.
  • Work with wider VML and WPP capabilities to bring the right expertise together around client challenges.
  • Understand the commercial aspects of the relationship, including scoping, financial management and account profitability.
  • Help turn strong client relationships and great analytical thinking into sustainable commercial growth.

Connect Teams & Markets

  • Work closely with local market teams to build a joined-up European approach to analytics and marketing intelligence.
  • Bring together specialists across data, media, strategy, CRM, customer experience and technology to solve complex client challenges.
  • Establish consistent ways of working and share best practice across markets.
  • Connect local insights and intelligence to build a stronger regional perspective.
  • Provide leadership and direction to cross-functional teams working across different disciplines and markets.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who can bridge the gap between analytics and the business someone who understands the data but is equally comfortable explaining what it means, what the client should do next and where the next opportunity lies.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Strong experience within marketing analytics, measurement, marketing effectiveness or marketing intelligence.
  • Significant experience working within the automotive sector, with a strong understanding of its customers, commercial challenges and marketing landscape.
  • Experience across areas such as MMM, media measurement, CRM/customer analytics, digital analytics or marketing effectiveness.
  • The ability to translate complex data and analysis into clear strategic recommendations and compelling client stories.
  • Strong senior stakeholder management and the confidence to advise, influence and challenge clients.
  • A consulting mindset, with the ability to start with a business challenge and determine the right analytical response.
  • Strong commercial awareness and experience identifying opportunities, shaping propositions and growing client relationships.
  • Experience working across multiple markets, ideally within a European or global organisation.
  • Experience bringing together cross-functional teams and different areas of expertise to solve client problems.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • The ability to operate effectively within a fast-moving and complex client environment.

Additional European language skills would be an advantage.

What’s in it for you?

Alongside a generous annual leave allowance and pension, you’ll have access to a wide range of benefits, including:

You’ll also have access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and support for your longer-term career development.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

title: Data Engineer (Detect & Track Distillation)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our ML teams train models on datasets derived from large volumes of raw, unstructured data. Model quality depends directly on data quality, and today that data is handled largely by hand.

As a Data Engineer, operating out of Paris, Lausanne, or Zurich, you will own the data layer that feeds the team's models, from raw field logs or public datasets through curated, versioned, training-ready datasets. You will manage terabytes of raw, unstructured data and turn it into clean, documented, versioned datasets, so that the modelers spend their time designing and training models, not waiting on data loaders or wrangling corrupted files. You join at an early stage with real influence over how field and public data gets processed for deep-learning pipelines.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ingestion Pipeline: Ingest, decode, and store raw, unstructured field data (video and other sensor streams) from field logs into efficient, controlled formats.

  • Multimodal Alignment: Align multiple data streams temporally and spatially so paired data is usable for training.

  • Curation: Transfer both ingested data and public datasets into high-value data, including parsing, filtering, de-duplication and revision.

  • Data & Labeling Requirements: Define which data to gather and what and how to label it, and own the dataset-construction workflow and labeling tooling. Coordinate with the teams responsible for data gathering and labeling.

  • Dataset Construction: Build task-specific datasets for the team’s training and evaluation needs, in collaboration with acquisition, annotation and product teams.

  • Versioning & Lineage: Version datasets and maintain lineage so training runs stay reproducible.

  • Storage & Formats: Store data in efficient, training-ready formats (such as columnar or sharded formats) and manage storage tiering to balance cost and latency as datasets grow.

  • Efficient Delivery: Deliver clean, documented datasets and the corresponding tools for loading to keep training from being I/O-bound, shaping their structure with the modelers.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: A degree in a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical data engineering experience matters more than the specific degree.

  • Data Pipelines at Scale: Built and maintained pipelines for unstructured data at scale (video, images, or sensor data), covering ingestion, decode, storage, curation, and versioning.

  • Engineering: Strong in Python and data engineering, and comfortable optimizing data loaders for common training frameworks (for example PyTorch).

  • Bonus: Multimodal sensor data, labeling or dataset construction for ML, dataset versioning tooling, and distributed data processing tooling.

  • Attributes: Systematic, quality-minded, pragmatic, and service-oriented so the modelers are enabled, with a knack for taming messy data via automation.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Data Science Internship
descriptionHtml:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

  

About the role

 

We are looking for a DS/ML Engineer intern to join our Data Science team. Your mission will at the crossing of R&D, ML Engineering and product, supervised by senior ML engineers. You will work on developing of our existing Deep Learning/Computer Vision pipelines using State-of-the-art algorithms.

  

Your main mission will be to:


• Develop clinical understanding of fetal ultrasound in the anatomical areas you will work on,
• Explore and train different approaches for Detection and Segmentation of anatomical structures and views, and integrate your results in our ML infrastructure (AWS, SageMaker, MLflow),
• Explore the possibility of training Foundation Models for Ultrasound Imaging,
• Run evaluation protocols consistent with the way our models are evaluated during regulatory submissions, and document your experiments so the team can build on them. Publication is possible and encouraged if the results support it.

 


About the profile

 

Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:


• Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science or Data Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,
• Good knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms, and the willingness to explore and work on state-of-the-art algorithms,
• Solid Python and PyTorch/HuggingFace, and comfortable with segmentation and detection architectures,
• Strong interest in computer vision and women’s health. A first experience with medical images is a plus,
• You speak English and ideally French.

title: Data Science Manager
descriptionHtml:
📍London or UK remote | 💰 £100,000 to £130,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Data  

⭐ About Data at Monzo

Data is at the heart of how we make decisions and build products at Monzo. Our Data teams bring together Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics and Machine Learning, working closely with Product, Engineering and other teams across the business.

Our Data Scientists are embedded within product and business areas across Monzo, where they use experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, machine learning and analytics to understand our customers, identify opportunities and influence the direction of our products and strategy.

As a Data Science Manager, you'll lead a team of Data Scientists and other Data professionals within one of these areas, combining people leadership with strategic data leadership and close partnership with senior stakeholders.

🔑 You'll play a key role by...

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and senior leaders to ensure data plays a central role in how we understand problems, make decisions and develop our products.

You'll lead and develop a team of talented Data Scientists, helping them do their best work while setting a high bar for analytical quality and impact. You'll provide strategic direction across complex problems, help teams identify where Data Science can have the greatest impact, and ensure insights translate into meaningful decisions and product changes.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across Monzo. We're big believers in powerful, accessible analytics and empowering teams across the business to answer questions themselves. Around 90% of our day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported by self-serve analytics through Looker, giving our Data teams the space to focus on higher-impact problems.

Your day-to-day

  • Lead, develop and grow a team of exceptional Data Scientists and other Data professionals.
  • Hire, coach and retain talented people while creating an environment where they can develop and do their best work.
  • Set the Data Science direction for your area and identify where data can have the greatest customer and business impact.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders to shape strategy and influence product direction.
  • Bring analytical rigour to complex and ambiguous problems and help teams turn them into clear, actionable opportunities.
  • Ensure teams are using the right analytical approaches, from experimentation and causal inference through to statistical modelling and machine learning.
  • Help connect Data Science work to measurable customer, product and commercial outcomes.
  • Work with Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning and other Data disciplines to ensure teams have the data, tooling and infrastructure they need.
  • Contribute to the wider Data Science discipline at Monzo, helping us continually raise the bar for how we work.

🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...

  • What we're doing at Monzo excites you!
  • You have significant experience managing and developing Data Scientists.
  • You're a strong strategic data leader who uses data to influence decisions and direction.
  • You have experience partnering with senior and executive stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority.
  • You're comfortable working autonomously in a fast-growing and evolving organisation.
  • You have a strong understanding of Data Science approaches including experimentation, causal inference, statistical analysis and machine learning.
  • You're comfortable with tools and languages such as Python and SQL, and understand how to choose the right analytical approach for a problem.
  • You can build credibility with Product, Engineering and senior business leaders and influence without relying on authority.
  • You have strong product judgement and experience using Data Science to shape product development and strategy.
  • You know how to balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making and business impact.
  • You have experience helping Data Scientists develop their technical, product and leadership capabilities.

The interview process

Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!

  • 30-minute recruiter call
  • 45-minute call with the hiring manager
  • 3 x 1-hour video calls with various team members

Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during the process.

What's in it for you

✅ We can sponsor visas

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Rather than hiring for one fixed team, we use the interview process to understand your strengths, interests and development areas, and then align you to the right scope and team at the end of the process, based on your background, interview performance, preferences and current business needs.

Before an offer is made, you’ll have the opportunity to meet the proposed team, either virtually or at our London headquarters, and learn more about the role’s scope and priorities.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll own the analytical direction and measurable impact of a product or business area, while leading and developing a high-performing team of data scientists or machine learning engineers.

Our Data Science Managers work across a range of consumer, product and commercial areas. Depending on the team you join, your work could focus on areas such as customer retention and loyalty, pricing and promotions, discovery and personalisation, or customer acquisition and engagement.

Across all roles, you’ll lead and develop your team, set the analytical direction for your area and decide which problems are worth solving. You’ll ensure data science work translates into better product and commercial decisions, not just analysis.

You’ll remain hands-on while managing a team, partnering with Product, Engineering, Ops, Marketing and Finance as a thought partner. You’ll set the bar for analytical rigour, prioritisation and impact across noisy metrics, real trade-offs and strong stakeholder opinions.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience line managing data scientists and supporting their career development

  • A strong background as a senior individual contributor, with hands-on experience in experimentation, causal inference or applied machine learning

  • Proven ability to identify high-impact opportunities and turn insights into clear strategy and execution

  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where prioritisation and judgement matter as much as technical skill

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll work on real-world problems at global scale, across a three-sided marketplace that is constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more, united by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect:

  • High autonomy to shape strategy and deliver meaningful impact

  • Support to learn and grow through L&D programmes, mentoring and peer learning

  • A strong focus on wellbeing, with benefits that vary by country

  • A place to belong, with a diverse global workforce and active employee communities

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About The Role 

We are seeking a versatile Data Scientist to join the Functional Analytics team. The core mission of our team is to design and develop new functional analytic capabilities or “engines” that integrate directly into Anaplan Applications to solve complex enterprise business problems. 

In this role, you will develop best-in-class ML models and pipelines to drive automated, actionable insights at scale. Beyond core development, you will act as a key technical partner for our customers. You will play a highly visible role in driving customer onboardings, getting hands-on with client data to customize and fine-tune our ML engines so they seamlessly adapt to complex business realities and specific customer needs. 

Your Impact 

  • Customer Onboarding & Engine Customization: Lead the technical deployment of our engines for new clients. Partner closely with customers, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to adapt and customize ML models, ensuring they accurately reflect client-specific business logic, operational guardrails, and unique data nuances.
  • Analytic Engine Development: Design and develop scalable functional analytic capabilities that seamlessly integrate into Anaplan Applications, translating raw customer data into automated, high-value business insights.
  • Advanced Modeling & Timeseries Forecasting: Design, train, and implement robust Machine Learning (LightGBM, XGBoost) and Deep Learning (PyTorch) models specifically focused on complex demand sensing and resolving cold-start forecasting problems.
  • Feature Engineering Pipelines: Build and optimize scalable data pipelines leveraging a hybrid SQL/Python architecture (dbt, Snowflake) to extract rich, localized temporal signals from high-volume transactional retail data.
  • End-to-End Deployment (MLOps): Partner with our engineers to transition your models from prototype into scalable, monitored, and reliable production pipelines using tools like MLflow and Optuna. 

Your Skills 

  • Strong hands-on professional experience in Data Science, successfully building and deploying systems from prototype to production in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong predictive modeling foundation: Extensive experience with traditional ML algorithms, Deep Learning frameworks, and complex time-series forecasting.
  • Experience developing production-grade Python code: High proficiency in Python, Pandas, and modern software practices (testing, clean code, code review, CI/CD).
  • Data & Pipeline Expertise: Hands-on experience optimizing data models and access patterns for modern data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks) utilizing SQL and transformation tools like dbt.
  • Cloud & Data Infrastructure: Experience working with scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and handling columnar data formats like Parquet.
  • MLOps Exposure: Experience with tools and frameworks for training, tracking, deploying, and monitoring models in production (e.g., MLflow, Optuna, Prefect, or Airflow). 

Desirable 

  • Background in supply chain forecasting, enterprise AI, or retail analytics
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field. 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Développeur Python IA
descriptionHtml:
Développeur Python IA (H/F)

Paris/Lille | Secteur Assurance

Pourquoi cette opportunité ?

Parce que vous participerez à la construction de notre stratégie d’intelligence artificielle, que nous sommes en train de définir.
Vous rejoindrez une équipe motivée et talentueuse, dont la mission est d’intégrer l’IA au cœur de nos processus métier.

L’objectif est de répondre aux besoins de nos équipes comme à ceux de nos clients, et d’automatiser certaines tâches à faible valeur ajoutée.

Éléments clés

  • Concevoir des solutions RAG et agentiques appliquées à des cas d’usage métier concrets.
  • Développer et orchestrer des agents tout en assurant la traçabilité des sources et la maîtrise des hallucinations.
  • Contribuer directement au workflow de paramétrage produit KELIA, avec une validation humaine intégrée aux étapes clés.
  • Participer à la mise en production des assistants, de leur API jusqu’à leur intégration dans l’interface web interne.


Ce qu’il faut savoir :

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur Python IA pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D à Paris ou Lille

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions, de la conception jusqu’à la mise en production, en mobilisant différentes approches : modèles de langage (LLM), apprentissage supervisé, clustering et autres techniques de machine Learning.

Un volet important de la mission concerne également le paramétrage produit : l’objectif est d’extraire les informations pertinentes des conditions générales, de proposer un paramétrage, de prévoir une validation par un expert à chaque étape et de produire un fichier directement importable dans KELIA.

Missions principales :

Vous développez en Python des fonctionnalités IA.

  • Ingestion documentaire : extraire le texte et les tableaux des PDF, des pages Confluence, des documents SharePoint et des dépôts GitLab, puis découper, indexer et mettre à jour ces contenus avec des jobs asynchrones.
  • Recherche : recherche hybride (sémantique et mots-clés), filtres par collection et par chemin, reranking, et recherche visuelle sur les pages de documents.
  • Agents et LLM : développer des agents avec LangGraph (routage, recherche, filtrage, réflexion, réponse), écrire et versionner les prompts, citer les sources, et répondre « je ne trouve pas » quand l'information manque.
  • Workflow de paramétrage produit : contribuer à l'agent qui extrait les informations des conditions générales, propose le paramétrage, fait valider chaque étape par un expert et produit un fichier importable dans KELIA.
  • Qualité : maintenir des jeux de tests, mesurer le taux de bonnes réponses, suivre les réponses inventées et vérifier que les résultats sont stables d'un run à l'autre.
  • Coût et latence : suivre la consommation de tokens, le temps de première réponse et le cache, et choisir le bon modèle pour chaque tâche.
  • API : exposer les assistants en API, avec des réponses en streaming, et les intégrer à l'interface web interne.
  • Documenter votre code, écrire des tests et participer aux revues de code.


Ce poste est fait pour vous si:

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 en informatique ou assurance
  • Vous maîtrisez Python 3.11+ et êtes à l’aise avec le développement d’API via FastAPI, Pydantic et le streaming SSE.
  • Vous avez une expérience ou un réel intérêt pour les solutions d’IA générative, les LLM et les architectures agentiques avec LangChain, LangGraph et LiteLLM.
  • Vous connaissez les principes de RAG, de recherche hybride, d’embeddings et de reranking, idéalement avec Qdrant.
  • Vous savez travailler avec des sources documentaires variées et leur ingestion, notamment des PDF, Confluence, SharePoint ou GitLab, avec des outils tels que Docling.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les environnements de stockage et de persistance reposant sur PostgreSQL et le stockage objet S3.
  • Vous accordez de l’importance à l’observabilité et à la qualité des solutions IA, notamment au suivi des prompts, des traces, des logs, des coûts et des performances, avec des outils comme MLflow.
  • Vous êtes sensibilisé aux enjeux de sécurité, d’authentification et de gestion des rôles, notamment avec Keycloak.
  • Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement d’industrialisation moderne utilisant Git, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm et pytest, ainsi que des outils collaboratifs comme Jira et Confluence.


Ce que vous apportez

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Python et de ses bonnes pratiques : tests (pytest), typage, gestion des dépendances.
  • Votre expérience dans l’utilisation des API de LLM et bases du prompt engineering, y compris les sorties structurées.
  • Votre compréhension du fonctionnement d'un RAG : embeddings, découpage, recherche, génération.
  • Une bonne maîtrise du SQL et notions de bases de données.
  • Git et travail en équipe.


Pourquoi nous joindre:

  • Pour contribuer à une stratégie où l’intelligence artificielle est un levier clé de la feuille de route technologique, avec des solutions intégrées au cœur des outils métiers.
  • Pour travailler sur des cas d’usage concrets d’IA générative, de RAG et d’agents LLM, de l’expérimentation jusqu’à l’industrialisation.
  • Pour associer des technologies IA de pointe à une expertise métier forte dans le secteur de l’assurance et créer des solutions à impact réel.
