title: Director, Service Delivery & Excellence, B2B Support
descriptionHtml:
About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

What You’ll Do

1. Position Summary

Our experience operators and suppliers are the product. Every traveler experience on Viator starts with an operator who is seamlessly onboarded, verified, and supported; every Bókun customer decides whether to stay in their first weeks on the platform, and requires ongoing technical support for success and retention.

As Director, Service Delivery & Excellence, B2B, you will lead the end-to-end B2B support organization across Viator Supply and Bókun. Combining Front-Line Service Delivery and Service Excellence into a single mandate, you will modernize support operations—leveraging AI and automation to reduce cost-to-serve while elevating quality, first-contact resolution, and supplier satisfaction across the complete partner lifecycle.

Location: UK (Hybrid - Commutable to Oxford 2-3 days per week)

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy and Planning: Responsible for the development and execution of the B2B support organization in line with Company strategy and OKRs.

  • End-to-End B2B Support Operations: Own front-line operational delivery across Viator Supply (onboarding, product creation/setup, compliance, verification, ongoing support) and Bókun (sign-up support, early customer success, SaaS technical support).

  • BPO Strategy & Vendor Governance: Lead end-to-end BPO commercial relationships across partner sites in North Africa and Asia—managing RFPs, contract negotiations, SOWs, workforce capacity planning, and vendor performance management.

  • AI & Operational Transformation: Identify, design, and ship AI-driven tooling, self-serve capabilities, and workflow automation across in-house and outsourced operations to scale support efficiently.

  • Compliance, Verification & Quality Control: Enforce strict onboarding workflows (business verification, liability insurance, legal compliance) and audit supplier quality metrics to protect platform integrity and traveler experience.

  • Process Excellence & Systems Ownership: Apply continuous improvement frameworks (Lean Six Sigma) to eliminate friction; own the support technology stack with Salesforce at the core.

  • Commercial Contribution & Budgeting: Manage operational headcount, vendor spend, and tooling budgets. Expand proactive quality initiatives and revenue-generating support activities (supplier upsells and SaaS tier upgrades).

  • Collaborate effectively with Key Stakeholders: within the Supply/Bokun organizations and across the organization

3. Requirements & Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years in B2B support, partner operations, or service delivery, including proven leadership experience managing managers.

  • Scale & BPO Management: Proven success leading multi-site operations (100+ FTE) with hands-on BPO vendor management (RFPs, contract negotiations, QA, and governance).

  • AI & Automation Track Record: Demonstrated experience deploying AI or automation tools across support, vetting, or operational workflows with measurable impact.

  • Salesforce & Technology Systems: Strong working knowledge of Salesforce as a support platform (Salesforce Administrator training preferred) alongside contact-center telephony and knowledge systems.

  • Compliance & Workforce Planning: Experience operating in regulated environments with compliance/vetting frameworks; expertise in workforce forecasting and capacity planning across hybrid teams.

  • Budget Stewardship & Travel: Full operational budget ownership (staffing, vendor spend, tooling); willing to travel internationally c. 30% of the time (site visits to North Africa and Asia).

  • Preferred: Travel, hospitality, or SaaS/marketplace industry experience; COPC certification; Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.

4. Leadership Values & Attributes

  • Traveler First: Recognize that supplier operational health directly shapes traveler experience. Practice Behavioral Truth Seeking (prioritizing customer action over anecdotes) and Scientific Validation (utilizing A/B testing over expert opinion).

  • Execution is Our Edge: Drive High-Velocity Execution using the 80/20 rule. Champion AI-First Adoption to automate manual tasks and maintain a fail-fast learning mindset.

  • We Succeed Together: Practice Radical Accountability ("no problem is someone else's problem") and Empowered Ownership by pushing decisions to the lowest level. Lead with high EQ, low ego, and empathetic change leadership.

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

title: Director, SMB and Platform Risk
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

As Director, SMB and Platforms Risk, you will own the first-line risk strategy and operating model for our SMB and platform sellers globally. You'll be based in London and report to the VP, Risk Operations. You will lead onboarding and monitoring teams in Mauritius and Mexico through local team leaders, and a BPO partner.

You will partner with Product, Risk Analytics, Engineering and Commercial to make onboarding and monitoring scalable, measurable and proportionate to risk. We're looking for a programmatic, systems-minded risk leader who can design the operating model and run it day to day, protecting the business while enabling responsible growth.

What You'll Do

  • Set the risk strategy and operating model across the seller lifecycle: onboarding, risk-based tiering, review criteria, monitoring triggers and actions such as reserves, funds controls and termination.

  • Partner with Product, Risk Analytics and Engineering to turn risk needs into clear requirements, decision logic and a prioritised automation roadmap.

  • Define and track the KPIs that balance control, customer experience and cost, including straight-through processing, onboarding time, loss rates and alert precision.

  • Lead operational performance across teams in Mauritius and Mexico through local leaders, setting priorities, procedures, SLAs, quality standards and capacity plans.

  • Scale the operation as headcount grows: stand up additional teams as needed, govern BPO partners, and prioritise automation improvements.

  • Close the loop between cases, losses and fraud patterns so that rules, thresholds, policy and product priorities keep improving.

  • Own first-line control quality and audit readiness, with clear handoffs of risks, issues and remediation to second-line oversight.

  • Represent SMB and Platforms Risk in governance, product and commercial forums, including risk-based pricing and bespoke platform deals. Hold a clear risk position while finding structured paths to yes.

  • Apply AI and LLM-enabled tools to triage, case summarisation, QA and risk insight, with appropriate human review, data protection and audit trails.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep risk expertise in SMB acquiring, with a strong grasp of credit exposure, reserves, fraud and transaction monitoring across the seller lifecycle.

  • Understanding of platform and PayFac models, including ISVs, marketplaces and merchant-of-record structures.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/KYB and CDD, and of how onboarding controls connect to downstream risk.

  • A programmatic mindset: you turn complex risk needs into operating models, requirements and roadmaps, make pragmatic trade-offs, and drive delivery.

  • Proven operational leadership of distributed teams through local leaders, with rigour in capacity planning, SLAs, QA, procedures and control evidence.

  • A track record of building or scaling automated onboarding and monitoring in a high-volume, low-touch environment.

  • Data fluency: you set meaningful KPIs, interpret rule and model performance, and work with analytics teams to improve outcomes.

  • Senior influence with Product, Commercial, Legal, Finance and executive audiences, with the confidence to challenge and find responsible ways to say yes.

  • Ability to travel to our Mauritius and Mexico offices at least twice a year.

Desirable

  • Hands-on depth in KYC/KYB, CDD and card-scheme requirements and controls.

  • Experience managing BPO or third-party operations partners, including performance governance and service-quality improvement.

  • Experience building a monitoring capability or operating model from the ground up in regulated payments or fintech.

  • Experience deploying AI-assisted operations or agentic workflows responsibly in risk, compliance or customer operations.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle bei AYLASHES

Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen, organisierst Projekte und bleibst dran, bis ein Launch steht? Bei AYLASHES entwickeln wir DIY-Wimpernextensions für zu Hause. Jetzt möchten wir unsere Produkte in weiteren Ländern und auf neuen Marktplätzen anbieten – und suchen dich, um diesen Ausbau mit uns voranzubringen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Marktplätzen und Internationalisierung. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketingteam, Agenturen und Logistikpartnern zusammen. Welche Länder und Plattformen wir zuerst angehen, entscheiden wir gemeinsam. Du übersetzt die Prioritäten in konkrete Schritte und hältst die Umsetzung auf Kurs.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neue Länder erschließen: Du koordinierst die Vorbereitung und den Start unseres Shopify-Shops, von Amazon und TikTok Shop in weiteren Ländern – mit klaren Aufgaben, Zuständigkeiten und Terminen.

  • Marktplätze aufbauen und betreuen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern entwickelst du unsere Präsenz auf Plattformen wie Amazon, TikTok Shop, Douglas, ABOUT YOU, Zalando und OTTO weiter. Du prüfst Produktdaten, Listings, Preise und Verfügbarkeit und sorgst dafür, dass offene Punkte erledigt werden.

  • Agenturen steuern: Du erstellst Briefings, koordinierst lokale Marketingmaßnahmen, prüfst Ergebnisse und hältst vereinbarte Termine nach.

  • Den gesamten Launch zusammenbringen: Du stimmst Übersetzungen, lokale Werbematerialien, Versand und Retouren mit den zuständigen Partnern ab. Länder- und Plattformanforderungen klärst du mit den jeweiligen Fachleuten und sorgst mit unserem Lagerteam für funktionierende Abläufe.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast bereits praktische E-Commerce-Erfahrung gesammelt, zum Beispiel bei einer Marke, einem Onlineshop oder einer Agentur, und selbst operative Aufgaben oder Projekte verantwortet.

  • Du hast schon mit Shopify gearbeitet und erste praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einem Marktplatz. Du musst noch nicht jede Plattform kennen.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, setzt Prioritäten und fragst aktiv nach, wenn etwas stockt. Auch Datenpflege und regelmäßige Kontrollen gehören für dich dazu.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch, kannst dich auf Englisch gut mit Partnern abstimmen und hast deinen Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

Erfahrung mit Länderlaunches oder Agentursteuerung ist ein Plus. Entscheidend sind für uns deine bisherige Praxis, dein Zahlenverständnis und die Motivation, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Eine Festanstellung in Vollzeit – 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam und unserer Gründerin Aylin sowie kurze Abstimmungswege.

  • Ein klarer Schwerpunkt auf dem Ausbau unserer Vertriebskanäle und die Möglichkeit, sichtbare Ergebnisse mitzugestalten.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen und Fachpartnern sowie Raum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Lust, mit uns zu wachsen?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deinen möglichen Starttermin. Im Bewerbungsformular interessiert uns außerdem ein konkretes Beispiel aus deiner bisherigen E-Commerce-Arbeit. Ein langes Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Early Career System Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
System Architecture sits within the Hardware organisation at Fractile, responsible for designing the chips and systems that power our groundbreaking AI inference accelerator. That’s everything from chip-level architecture and interconnects, through board design and thermal management, to full system integration and bring-up. At Fractile, we know that world-class system architecture is the foundation every other part of the stack is built on.

About the team and role
The System Architecture team at Fractile defines how our hardware comes together — from chip interfaces and interconnects through to board design, thermal management, and system-level integration — working closely with digital design, verification, firmware and software teams to make sure architecture choices translate cleanly into working silicon and reliable hardware platforms.


As an Early Career System Architect, you’ll support senior architects in defining and refining this architecture, and get hands-on exposure to early prototyping, bring-up, and system testing as ideas become real hardware.

About you
We’re looking for someone early in their career with a strong foundation in digital systems and computer architecture, gained through a degree, internships, or personal projects, who is genuinely curious about how complex hardware systems are taken from concept through to production. You’ll be comfortable working across disciplines — hardware, firmware, and software — and keen to learn fast in a fast-moving environment.

Key Requirements

  • A degree (or final-year study) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field

  • Exposure to system-level design concepts — power, thermal, I/O, memory, or interconnect architectures — through academic projects, internships, or personal projects

  • Some familiarity with digital design flows, gained through coursework, internships, or personal projects

  • Comfortable working across disciplines — hardware, firmware, and software

  • Strong communicator, able to explain technical ideas clearly to others

  • Desirable: exposure to AI acceleration, HPC, or data-centric architectures; hands-on FPGA prototyping or hardware bring-up; familiarity with SystemC or MATLAB

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems.

  • Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments.

  • Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies.

  • Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

  • Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data.

  • Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings.

  • Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent

  • You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments

  • You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity

  • Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus

  • Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: EMC/EMI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated EMC/EMI Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing design recommendations and establishing test policies related to Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) for our spacecraft applications. This role requires a thorough understanding of EMC/EMI principles, spacecraft systems, and industry standards to ensure the reliability and functionality of our spacecraft in harsh space environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design and Development:

    • Provide expert guidance on EMC/EMI design practices to ensure spacecraft systems meet all relevant standards and requirements.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate EMC/EMI considerations into the design phase of spacecraft systems and subsystems.

    • Review and analyze design documents, schematics, and layout plans to identify potential EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Testing and Validation:

    • Develop and implement comprehensive EMC/EMI test plans and procedures for spacecraft systems.

    • Conduct EMC/EMI testing, including pre-compliance and compliance testing.

    • Analyze test data, identify non-conformities, and recommend corrective actions to resolve EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Standards and technological watch:

    • Ensure all designs and test procedures comply with relevant EMC/EMI standards

    • Stay updated with the latest developments in EMC/EMI standards and incorporate them into design and testing processes.

  1. Documentation and Reporting:

    • Prepare detailed technical reports, test summaries, and design documentation related to EMC/EMI activities.

    • Maintain accurate records of all test results, design recommendations, and corrective actions.

  1. Collaboration and Support:

    • Work closely with system engineers, hardware designers, and other stakeholders to address EMC/EMI challenges throughout the product development lifecycle.

    • Provide technical support and training to engineering teams on EMC/EMI best practices and mitigation techniques.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in EMC/EMI engineering, preferably in the aerospace or defense industry.

  • Strong knowledge of EMC/EMI principles, test methods, and mitigation techniques.

  • Experience with EMC/EMI standards, such as MIL-STD-461, CISPR, and DO-160.

  • Proficiency in using EMC/EMI testing equipment, including spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and EMI receivers.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with spacecraft systems and subsystems.

  • Knowledge of signal integrity and power integrity as they relate to EMC/EMI.

  • Experience with simulation tools for EMC/EMI analysis.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Soft skills

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Parallel closed a $20M Series A with Index Ventures, is deployed in 40+ hospitals, and is scaling fast. Founders Paul Lafforgue (Polytechnique, ex-Meta, ex-McKinsey) and Chris Rydahl (who previously built Hublo, Europe's largest healthcare staffing platform) are based in Paris with the team.

Our tech team is 10 people today, all reporting directly to the CTO — and it will double by 2027. A flat structure got us here, now we need managers who stay close to the code to get us there.

The team is organized in streams, each run by a PM and a Stream Owner: Coding, Extraction, and Activity (activity steering, dashboarding, and our assistant products).

Your mission

  • Directly manage the engineers of your stream (AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers): 1:1s, feedback, growth, performance.

  • Own a stream end to end as its Stream Owner: drive its technical direction and delivery with your PM.

  • Be a hands-on leader. Expect roughly 50% hands-on / 50% management — a bit more hands-on in your first months.

  • Be responsible for your squad's tech culture: code quality, rituals, standards, knowledge sharing.

  • Onboard new engineers and be the relay when the team changes hands.

  • Work daily with PMs, Ops and the other Stream Owners to keep priorities aligned.

Outcomes

  • In your first months, you are a trusted Stream Owner: you know your stream's code, clients and roadmap inside out.

  • Your team ships reliably and at pace, and every engineer knows what's expected of them and how they're growing.

  • New hires are productive fast, thanks to the onboarding and culture you put in place.

  • Over time, your role grows beyond one stream: you help shape how the whole tech org scales.

This job is for you if

  • You have 5+ years of experience, including at least 2 years managing an engineering team.

  • You've managed 4–5+ people and owned both their performance and the people side (feedback, growth, tough conversations).

  • Your background is strong full-stack software engineering or data — and you still love building.

  • You've worked in startups or scale-ups and thrive in a fast, high-ownership environment.

  • You see management as a way to have more impact, not as a title: you're happy to own a stream and write code.

  • You are autonomous and pragmatic: done beats perfect at this stage.

  • You are French-speaking.

Hiring process

  1. A quick call with our recruiter (30 min)

  2. A conversation with Chris, our CTO (30 min)

  3. A case study at our Paris office, covering both management and technical judgment. combined with a meeting with Paul, our CEO. (2h in total + preperation)

  4. Reference checks

Why should you join us?

  • Real traction: Seed and Series A closed in under a year, with Index Ventures on the cap table.

  • A problem worth solving: cutting hospital admin gives time back to care teams.

  • A different technical approach: agents that work on existing systems without heavy integration.

  • A team that has done it before: the founders built and scaled Hublo, and worked at Meta and McKinsey. High standards, low ego.

  • Real ownership: you'll be our first Engineering Manager and shape how the tech team scales from 10 to 20+.

  • Competitive salary and equity, premium health insurance (Alan), Swile meal vouchers, latest Apple equipment, and an office in Paris (Strasbourg Saint-Denis).

   

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

descriptionHtml:
Engineering Manager, Rapid Response Assignment - UK

Location: Remote (Cheltenham, UK)

Team: Product & Engineering

Employment Type: Full-Time

About VulnCheck

Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The Exploit Intelligence Company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Rapid Response organization - regionally-based teams in the US, UK, and APAC that keep our customers unblocked around the clock. You’ll manage engineering teams of senior ICs directly, set the technical and operational bar for the group, and make sure work is prioritised correctly across a demanding mix of urgent and long-term needs.

This team sits at the intersection of Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales. Your teams handle urgent pre-sales requests, urgent customer issues, and other customer-driven feature requests, alongside the backend maintenance and integration work that keeps the platform stable. You’ll need to be equally comfortable setting engineering standards, coaching engineers, and triaging competing priorities across time zones. This is a 100% remote role, with preference for candidates located in Cheltenham, UK 

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and grow engineering teams based in the US, UK, and APAC, providing hands-on people leadership, coaching, and career development
  • Set priorities across urgent pre-sales requests, urgent customer issues, customer feature requests, and backend maintenance/integration work, balancing reactive and proactive work

  • Partner closely with Customer Success and Sales leadership to understand customer and deal-critical needs and translate them into engineering plans
  • Partner with Product and other Engineering teams to ensure customer-driven work is integrated into the broader platform roadmap
  • Own the team's engineering quality bar, including code quality, root-cause practices, and long-term fixes over one-off patches
  • Drive hiring, onboarding, and performance management across all three regional teams
  • Establish and refine on-call, escalation, and incident response processes for the team
  • Report on team health, throughput, and customer outcomes to engineering and company leadership
  • Remove blockers for your teams and stay close enough to the technical work to make credible calls under pressure

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience managing software engineers, ideally across distributed or multi-region teams
  • Experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or threat intelligence
  • Prior experience as a senior or staff software engineer, with credibility to engage in technical discussions and unblock your team
  • Experience managing customer-facing, support, sustaining, or reliability engineering teams
  • Proven ability to prioritize and sequence competing demands—urgent customer issues, pre-sales asks, and longer-term maintenance work
  • Experience managing teams across multiple time zones and regions, with strong async communication habits
  • Solid understanding of backend systems, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • A customer-obsessed mindset and a track record of turning technical challenges into strong customer outcomes
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, Sales, Customer Success, and other Engineering teams
  • Experience working with data pipelines, ETL systems, or high-volume data processing is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience managing a customer reliability, sustaining, support, or escalation engineering function
  • Familiarity with CVE, NVD, KEV, or exploit intelligence datasets
  • Experience supporting pre-sales or deal-critical technical requests
  • Background in high-growth or startup environments

What We Offer

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and valued. VulnCheck offers benefits designed to meet a wide range of needs and lifestyles, tailored to your country of employment:

  • Generous, flexible time off
  • Retirement/pension plan contributions (e.g., 401k with match in the US; local pension schemes elsewhere)
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Remote-friendly environment with flexibility
  • Support for home office costs (phone & internet)
  • Ongoing professional development, coaching, and learning resources
  • Opportunities for career advancement within a fast-growing team

Specific benefit details vary by country and are confirmed during the offer process.

Why Join Us

Built on over two decades of cybersecurity experience, our team of experts understands the intricacies of vulnerabilities, their exploitation in the wild, and how to leverage this data to build more effective cybersecurity products that produce better outcomes for organizations.

VulnCheck gives organizations a tactical advantage by providing best-in-class exploit & vulnerability intelligence information. We have a sense of duty to protect the critical infrastructure we rely on including medical devices, power grids and telecommunication networks. We were founded in 2021 in Lexington, Massachusetts.

VulnCheck has a transparent, collaborative, and supportive culture - we are looking for people who have a growth mindset, are curious and innovative. Our team is smart, but humble, hardworking, and supportive.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.
The opportunity We are looking for an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) to help us scale our engineering team. Because we have EPMs almost since the beginning of Pigment, the role is already well-known. Our team is central to the engineering organization, perceived as a force multiplier by all the other engineers. We are constantly on the lookout to improve how we work. We like to try new ideas, whether it is to accelerate delivery, structure the organization or develop a unique culture. By joining our passionate, close-knitted team, you can have an impact in many different ways and learn in a team that is both young and fast-growing! Here is what the day-to-day of an EPM looks like at Pigment: Deliver: You make a difference every day in the engineering team(s) you are working with, as you enhance clarity, direction, scope, and keep all the parts together with other roles (such as Product Managers). Typically an EPM accompanies 1 to 3 teams in their delivery, ranging from technical projects (e.g. scalability and performance, SRE) to more functional ones (e.g. bringing automations to our product). Scale: You contribute to the engineering instances wherever you can bring added value. For instance, you can contribute to maintaining a healthy release pipeline, participate to incident response, oversee improvements to our monitoring and alerting practices…You also lead initiatives of various sizes to tackle the needs and issues that arise when growing as an organization. For instance, suggest evolutions to roles and responsibilities, better organize knowledge management, or work on large-scale projects related to quality management and production stability. Federate: You contribute to the general well-being of the team, upon opportunity and based on affinity, for example as an organizer of regular instances (all-hands meetings, newsletters…), hackathons, team building activities, and any other idea related to the promotion of Pigment culture internally and externally. You also contribute to Pigment hiring and branding initiatives. The team As a team, we have a mission statement and a roadmap that we maintain over time. We are open to different styles and we rotate responsibilities and projects on a regular basis between us. We regularly exchange on our challenges in “co-development” sessions and sound new ideas to one another. You will also grow as an individual thanks to a career ladder and a culture of on-going feedback. Explore Our Tech Blog: If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture, and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog! Who you are We expect demonstrated experience in helping technical teams build and run in a fast-paced environment, with the right touch of processes and empowerment of individuals. Technical project/product management, engineering management, quality engineering, and production-related roles are typically the kind of roles where such an experience is demonstrated, but we are open to a diversity of backgrounds. Experience as a software engineer is a plus but not required. The position does not involve coding. You should be able to read and understand code and read / comment / challenge a technical design. To help you better understand the role, here are the qualities we are looking for in an EPM: Resourcefulness: you like to be dropped in a new context and come up with your own solutions Change management: you are a people person and you convey change smartly and courageously Diligence: you are curious and connect the dots in ways no one else can, you strive to reach alignment through shared understanding, clarity, and direction Integrity: you lead by example, inspire others, and always play “first team” The position doesn’t involve people management. Fluency in English (French not required) Folks from underrepresented minorities: science shows that you are less likely to apply if you feel that you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites. descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to semiconductor organisations across the Netherlands. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with semiconductor equipment makers, chip designers and manufacturers, and the specialist suppliers around them. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the semiconductor and high-tech sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to semiconductor stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities across hardware and software engineering, R&D, manufacturing, supply chain and field service. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with semiconductor decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the semiconductor sector. Navigate complex, global, engineering-led organisations to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to semiconductor procurement cycles, R&D and capex budgeting, and supplier qualification processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyse semiconductor market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within hardware and software engineering, design and verification, R&D, manufacturing and quality, supply chain and procurement, and customer support and field service. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for semiconductor applications
  • Navigate complex semiconductor stakeholder ecosystems including executives, engineering and R&D leadership, IT and security teams, digital transformation functions, legal and compliance, and procurement offices to build consensus
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from users and conveying semiconductor market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for semiconductor clients
  • Continuously refine the semiconductor sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimise sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 8+ years of B2B sales experience in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles within semiconductor, high-tech or advanced manufacturing organisations, ideally in the Netherlands or wider Benelux, and securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and engineering use cases
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate large, global, engineering-led organisations and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, engineering and R&D leadership, and IT departments
  • Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements within high-tech procurement frameworks, including supplier onboarding, IP protection, security and data governance reviews
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various technical and business audiences, from engineering and R&D leads to senior executives
  • Deep understanding of semiconductor buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points, including the IP sensitivity, export control and supply chain pressures the industry operates within
  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the semiconductor market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
  • A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for semiconductor and high-tech use

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£330,000—£380,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Enterprise AI Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed
  • Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies
  • Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals
  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
  • Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes
  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 
  • Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.
  • AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.
  • Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.
  • Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.
  • Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

descriptionHtml:

As SkyNRG grows, applications such as SAP Public Cloud, HubSpot, and our Inventory Management System are becoming increasingly important to our operations. We are looking for an Enterprise Applications Manager to take functional ownership of this landscape and ensure our systems effectively support the business.

You will connect business needs with IT solutions, translating requests into clear requirements and coordinated improvements. Working across Commercial, Operations, Maintenance, HSE, Finance and QA, you will create structure, improve adoption and act as the main point of contact for our enterprise applications.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Take functional ownership of SAP Public Cloud, including EAM and HSE, HubSpot, IMS, and other enterprise applications.

  • Translate business processes and needs into clear requirements, functional designs, user stories and test scenarios.

  • Manage functional support, incidents and change requests, coordinating with external partners and vendors where necessary.

While this role does not have direct reports, you will coordinate external implementation partners and application vendors. You will also work closely with the wider IT team to ensure our enterprise applications are reliable, secure and aligned with business priorities.

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You feel comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, take ownership, and thrive when things are still developing.

title: Enterprise Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Enterprise Solutions Architect with deep expertise in life science R&D and enterprise software systems to partner with Benchling's customers in driving the biotech revolution forward.

The Enterprise Solutions Architect serves as a strategic advisor and technical leader for our enterprise customers, translating their IT strategy into tailored Benchling solutions. This role encompasses guiding organizations through digital transformation, leading technical implementation projects, overseeing solution architecture, and establishing best practices and data architecture standards to ensure long-term success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

  • Lead end-to-end implementation projects from discovery through successful go-live and adoption.

  • Provide ongoing strategic guidance, best practice education, and product engagement recommendations to maximize customer value realization.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements, identify opportunities, and translate business needs into technical solutions in partnership with internal engineering, product, and solutions architecture teams.

  • Coordinate with Professional Services, Product, and Customer Success teams to orchestrate complex, global enterprise deployments.

  • Support Sales and Marketing in technical deal strategy, and engage with Engineering, Product, and Solutions Architecture teams to resolve complex technical challenges.

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of global enterprise processes, product capabilities, and best practice frameworks.

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

 Required

  • 5-10+ years of combined experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry roles and scientific software implementation.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Information Management, or related field (advanced degree preferred).

title: Environment Artist
descriptionHtml:
About Techtive Games

Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating Ardem, an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded.

We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5.

In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights.

One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. If you know from hundreds of hours in the genre why a base location feels right, why a ruin tells a story, or why clutter placement can make or break immersion, you already understand half the job. That's also why we'd love it if you share your Steam profile with your application — not as a gate, we're just genuinely curious where your gaming interests lie and how much they overlap with what we're building.

We value creativity, ownership, and personal growth. Rather than working through rigid ticket pipelines, our team members are encouraged to actively shape systems, improve workflows, and grow together not only on Ardem, but on future projects as well.

If you love building worlds players want to get lost in — and you've survived a few of them yourself — we'd love to hear from you.

Tasks

On a day to day basis, you will:

  • Create high-poly and low-poly models for environmental objects — with a clear focus on architecture: modular building kits, structures, and props

  • Overhaul and optimize our existing asset kits: consolidate materials, reduce poly counts, and bring everything to a consistent, performant standard

  • Create assets for bespoke landmark locations — the kind of places players remember

  • Design with modularity and reusability in mind, so our world artists can build more with less

  • Rework existing vegetation and natural assets to a cleaner, more maintainable standard where needed

  • Work from photo reference and concept art to hit a believable, grounded look

  • Produce clean, efficient UVs and game-ready assets that respect the technical limitations of a large open world

  • Work closely with World Art, Level Design, and Tech Art to ensure requirements are met

  • Help troubleshoot and fix problems as they arise, from a visual, technical, and production perspective

Requirements

  • Previous experience on professional game projects

  • A portfolio with clear examples of your own asset production — not just set dressing or kit-bashed scenes. On team pieces, tell us exactly which parts you made yourself; we do check.

  • Solid experience building modular asset kits, and a real understanding of how worlds are constructed from them

  • Strong modeling skills and experience in a major 3D package (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max)

  • Sculpting experience with software like ZBrush

  • Good understanding of the PBR material pipeline

  • Solid grasp of baking and texturing using the Substance Suite and Photoshop

  • Basic knowledge of shader creation

  • Ability to resolve issues from a visual, technical, and production perspective

  • Strong communication skills — you can articulate ideas and questions across departments, and give and receive constructive feedback

  • We’d appreciate a link to your Steam profile, so we can get a feel for where your interests lie and where they overlap with ours

  • Fluent spoken and written English

Bonus Skills

  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine 5

  • Knowledge of foliage creation

  • Experience with procedural workflows (e.g. Houdini)

  • Experience working on open world games

  • Experience working in an indie or small team environment

Working Model

  • Fully remote

  • Freelance, with a full time option for candidates based in Germany

  • Flexible working hours with a strong focus on ownership and trust

  • Direct collaboration within a small, focused team

Benefits

  • Work on Ardem, a highly anticipated survival game — and help set a new benchmark for the genre you love

  • Small team with high impact, results-driven mindset and fast decision-making

  • High ownership and creative freedom — shape the world, don't just fill tickets

  • Flexible working hours (results > green dots)

How We Hire

  1. First interview — We talk about Techtive, Ardem, and the role, and get a high-level picture of your skills and how you work.

  2. Art test — If the first conversation goes well, you'll receive a small art test: a basic brief with a few guidelines and some inspirational screenshots from Ardem. Everything you build should work as part of a larger environment — we're not looking for isolated beauty shots that would fall apart in an actual game world. There's no fixed deadline, but we'll ask you to track roughly where your time went.

  3. Second interview — We go through your art test together: your decisions, your process, and where you spent your time.

  4. Culture fit — The final conversation is less about craft and more about people: how you like to work, what you expect from a team, and whether we actually fit each other. We're a small, fully remote crew — who you are matters as much as what you build. The practical side (contract, conditions, start date) gets sorted here too.

We know an art test is a real time investment, and not everyone can afford that easily — we don't take it for granted. It's the fairest way we've found to judge actual craft over a polished portfolio, and it's the basis for a much better conversation in round two.

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
