Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

What You Will Do

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

  • A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

  • You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

  • You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

  • Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

  • 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

  • Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.

Nice to have

  • Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

  • Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

  • Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Finance Officer - International Aid
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

OLAM AID e. V. ist eine unpolitische, internationale Hilfsorganisation mit Sitz in Berlin, die sich den sich entwickelnden Bedürfnissen von Krisen- und Konfliktbevölkerungen widmet. Unsere Mission ist es, Gemeinschaften beim Übergang von der Krise zur Erholung, Rehabilitation und nachhaltigen Lebensführung zu unterstützen. In unseren Projekten im In- und Ausland verbinden wir psychosozial Unterstützung, Empowermentarbeit und humanitäre Hilfsgüterlieferungen. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf gefährdeten Gruppen und Minderheiten. Unser engagiertes, multikulturelles Team arbeitet täglich daran, nachhaltige Perspektiven für Menschen in Notsituationen zu schaffen.

Ihre Aufgaben

Als Finance Officer wirken Sie aktiv bei der ordnungsgemäßen Durchführung aller Finanz- und Buchhaltungsaktivitäten sowie bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Finanzstrategie mit. Sie arbeiten eng mit der Geschäftsführung, den Programmleitungen sowie internationalen Länderbüros und Partnerorganisationen zusammen:

  • Buchhaltung & Zahlungsverkehr: Aktive Mitwirkung bei der ordnungsgemäßen Durchführung der monatlichen Buchhaltungsaktivitäten (Erfassung von Einnahmen und Ausgaben, Beleg- und Rechnungsprüfung, Kontenkontrolle) sowie Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Banküberweisungen im Online-Banking-System.
  • Finanzstrategie & Beratung: Einbringung in die Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer langfristigen Finanzstrategie für die Hilfsorganisation, Mitwirkung bei der Festlegung von Finanzzielen, der Analyse von Finanzrisiken und der Identifizierung von Optimierungspotenzialen.
  • Budgetierung & Finanzplanung: Erstellung von Budgets für verschiedene Programme, Projekte und den Gesamtverein gemäß strategischen Zielen sowie Durchführung finanzieller Prognosen und Cashflow-Analysen zur Sicherstellung ausreichender Mittel.
  • Internationale Finanzsteuerung & Partner-Controlling: Überwachung des Finanzmanagements und der Mittelverwendung in internationalen Länderbüros und Projektstandorten. Überprüfung und Konsolidierung finanzieller Berichte lokaler Partnerorganisationen sowie Vorbereitung von Partner-Audits.
  • Geber-Compliance & Fördermittelmanagement: Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller relevanten Finanzvorschriften und Verwendungsrichtlinien nationaler sowie internationaler Fördermittelgeber (z. B. Auswärtiges Amt, BMZ, EU/ECHO, UN-Organisationen) und Unterstützung bei Mittelabrufen.
  • Finanzberichterstattung & Audit-Unterstützung: Verantwortung für die Erstellung regelmäßiger Finanzberichte und -analysen für das Managementteam, Überwachung der finanziellen Leistung der Organisation sowie Zuarbeit bei der Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen.
  • Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit & Prozessoptimierung: Übernahme von Verantwortung für die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit im Finanzbereich. Initiierung und Moderation von Abstimmungsprozessen mit anderen Abteilungen (Programm, Beschaffung, Verwaltung) zur Entwicklung praxisnaher Richtlinien und einheitlicher Abläufe.

Ihr Profil

  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), Controlling oder einem verwandten Fachbereich.
  • Berufserfahrung: Berufserfahrung als Finance Officer oder in einer vergleichbaren kaufmännischen Position, vorzugsweise im Non-Profit-Sektor (NGO/NPO) oder im Bereich der internationalen Entwicklungsarbeit und humanitären Hilfe.
  • Fachkenntnisse: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Finanzplanung, Budgetierung, Finanzberichterstattung sowie Vertrautheit mit den rechtlichen und regulatorischen Anforderungen für NGOs und Hilfsorganisationen.
  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzdaten zu interpretieren.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Arbeitsweise & Soft Skills: Teamorientierte und interdisziplinäre Arbeitsweise, ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie hohe Zuverlässigkeit (gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft bei Bedarf).

Was wir bieten

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Direkter Beitrag zur Hilfe für Menschen in Not, zur Bewältigung humanitärer Krisen und zur nachhaltigen Entwicklungszusammenarbeit weltweit.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Zusammenarbeit mit vielfältigen Kulturen in einer global tätigen Hilfsorganisation.
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Unterstützung durch Schulungen, Weiterbildungen, Konferenzen und Workshops zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
  • Teamarbeit & Atmosphäre: Arbeit in einem engagierten, fachlichen Team mit offener Zusammenarbeit, Wissensaustausch und modernen Co-Working-Möglichkeiten im Herzen von Berlin.
  • Vergütung: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt entsprechend Erfahrung und Qualifikation im NGO-Sektor.

title: Financial Analyst (d/w/m)
descriptionHtml:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge

As Financial Analyst, Planning & Reporting Systems, you will build and maintain our planning and reporting models and dashboards, make sure data flows correctly from our source systems, and ensure the numbers the business relies on are accurate and consistent.

Alongside this, you will support core FP&A work such as forecasting, variance analysis and month-end reporting. The role reports to the Senior Director of FP&A and works closely with FinOps, Data and business stakeholders.


Your responsibilities

  • Build and maintain models in our planning platform, including dimensions, hierarchies and mapping tables, in line with the agreed model design

  • Build product P&Ls and product dashboards, and prepare the monthly reviews with commercial product owners

  • Monitor data flows from our ERP, HR and other source systems into the planning platform, and resolve issues together with FinOps and Data

  • Run monthly reconciliations between the planning platform, the general ledger and reported figures, and document the checks

  • Support the transition of planning and reporting workflows into the planning platform, in close collaboration with the FP&A team

  • Support FinOps on the interface between planning and consolidation, so management and statutory views reconcile

  • Maintain access rights, version control and model documentation

  • Support and train budget owners in using the platform for their planning and reporting

  • Automate recurring reports and workflows, using AI tools where they remove manual work

  • Support core FP&A processes when needed: monthly reporting, forecast updates, variance analysis and management materials

  • Deliver ad-hoc analysis on product performance to support commercial decisions

Your profile

  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, controlling, finance systems or a similar analytical finance role, ideally in a fast-growing or subscription-based business; alternatively, a background as implementation consultant for Pigment, Anaplan or similar planning tools

  • Hands-on experience building models or reports in a modern planning tool (e.g. Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive); Pigment experience is highly valued

  • Solid understanding of financial statements and accounting principles, with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis

  • Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of SQL; experience with ERP, consolidation or BI tools (e.g. NetSuite, LucaNet, Looker) is a plus

  • High attention to detail and care for data quality: you notice when a number does not tie, and you find out why

  • Hands-on use of AI in finance work (e.g. LLM assistants, AI features in finance and planning tools), and the curiosity to adopt new tools as they mature

  • Clear communicator, able to explain numbers to non-finance stakeholders

  • Structured, independent and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI

Help bring applied AI into the real world by building Python and LLM-powered solutions for defence customers, owning client relationships and turning real operational needs into software that works.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Forward Deployed team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Applied AI Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll work at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI and customer delivery. You’ll collaborate directly with defence customers to understand their challenges, build LLM-powered solutions, and take ownership of projects from first requirements through to deployment. Our solutions are built to work in real operational environments, so you’ll also test and demonstrate them with customers in the field, not just at your desk.

This is a hands-on role where you combine coding with client engagement, helping shape both the solutions we deliver today and the opportunities we develop for tomorrow.

What You’ll Work On

  • Applied AI Development: Build, test and integrate applications in which LLMs and other AI technologies play a central role, to solve practical customer problems. Python is our main language, but we care about the right solution, not the language. Turn emerging capabilities into usable software that can be deployed in real operational environments.

  • Customer Discovery & Project Ownership: Work directly with customers to understand their workflows and to distinguish between what they ask for and what they actually need. Own your projects from scoping and realistic planning through development, testing and delivery. Coordinate with the Forward Deployed Team, handle changing requirements and keep customers informed.

  • Field Testing & Troubleshooting: Test our solutions under realistic conditions, at our facilities in Erding but also at customer sites, training areas and exercises together with the armed forces. Observe how users actually work with the software, investigate issues on the spot and adapt quickly, so that you can show something better the next day.

  • Customer Integrations: Develop and adapt our codebase to specific client requirements and integrate new functionality into existing systems, while keeping solutions maintainable and reusable for future customers.

  • Demonstrations & Delivery: Prepare and run technical demonstrations, gather feedback and iterate. Make sure that what we build works in practice, not just in a demo.

  • Relationship Building: Become a trusted technical point of contact for your customers. Identify emerging needs and potential follow-on projects.

Your Profile

  • You have experience in a client-facing technical role, such as technical consulting, professional services, applied AI engineering or software implementation. You’re comfortable discussing requirements, explaining technical decisions and working directly with customers.

  • You take ownership of problems and follow them through, from understanding customer needs to delivering a working solution.

  • You bring strong software development skills and a solid grasp of software architecture. You can write, debug and improve code yourself rather than relying solely on high-level AI tools or prototypes. Python experience is a plus, but we’re more interested in how you build software than in which language you use.

  • You speak German at a fluent or professional level and can confidently work with customers in German-speaking environments.

  • You think on your feet, adapt when requirements change and work through unfamiliar technical or operational challenges without needing every step laid out for you.

  • You’re curious about how customers operate and can translate ambiguous problems into practical solutions. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and focus on what delivers value.

  • You want to work in defence and apply AI to real operational challenges, and you’re excited to join exercises and field tests with our customers.

  • You enjoy hands-on development but are equally comfortable presenting a demo or discussing a problem with a customer.

  • You’re comfortable working on-site in Munich and travelling regularly, primarily within Germany.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Defence Experience: You have previously worked with defence or military customers and understand their operational environments, procurement processes or ways of working.

  • Applied AI & LLMs: You have built and delivered LLM-powered applications or integrated AI capabilities into production software, ideally in response to specific customer needs.

  • Customer Relationship Development: You have grown existing customer relationships, identified new opportunities and helped turn initial projects into longer-term partnerships.

  • End-to-End Solution Delivery: You have taken a solution from an ambiguous customer problem through scoping, implementation, demonstration and deployment, adapting your approach as you learn more.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let’s get to know each other and talk about your experience, motivations, and what you’re looking for next.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min): We’ll explore your experience in more detail, give you a clearer picture of the role and its needs, and discuss technical fit.

  3. Coding Exercise: A practical coding assessment to understand how you approach technical problems.

  4. Technical Interview / Case Study (1 hr): We’ll dive into your experience with applied AI, Python, LLMs, client integrations, and solving real-world problems.

  5. Team Lunch / Dinner: An opportunity to meet more of the team and get a feel for how we work together.

title: Forward Deployed Finance Engineer, Private Credit
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work.

Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work.

This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows.

You may be asked to travel around 2–3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time.

What You'll Do

Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with direct lenders, opportunistic and specialty finance managers, BDC managers, and insurer credit arms throughout the pre-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding lenders through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with credit teams to build screening, underwriting, and credit committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats.

The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. It continues post-close into compliance certificate review, covenant tracking, amendment and waiver analysis, and quarterly portfolio reporting, so value compounds after the first deal. Along the way, Finance Engineers bring credit-team feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey.

What You Have

  • 6+ years on the investment or underwriting team at a direct lender, private credit fund, BDC manager, or insurer private credit arm, with demonstrated ownership of live deal work: screening, underwriting, diligence workstreams, modeling, structuring, and drafting credit committee materials. Asset-based and specialty finance backgrounds are welcome. Leveraged finance, restructuring advisory, or rating-agency experience before the principal side is welcome, but principal-side deal execution is required.

  • Strong command of the documents and data that drive a credit decision — lender presentation and CIM, QoE and data pack, model, credit agreement and intercreditor, compliance certificates — and an instinct for where the numbers and the paper disagree.

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling, comfort with prompting and agentic AI workflows, and a builder's instinct for turning a repeated manual process into a repeatable automation. Python, SQL, or experience building internal tools is a plus.

  • Executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility from analysts and associates through to partners and credit committee members.

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills — comfortable leading a live demo, facilitating a workshop, or holding your own in a technical conversation about a covenant package or an underwriting assumption.

  • Deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform investment work, paired with a practical, solutions-oriented mindset and bias toward action.

  • Track record partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results, with curiosity for testing approaches and optimizing for customer outcomes.

  • Customer-facing or commercial experience (LP or investor relations, capital formation, banking coverage, business development) and/or hands-on experience using AI tools in an investment setting are pluses.

title: Founding Business Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

We're hiring a Founding BDR to build Lovable's business development motion from the ground up. The job is to find, qualify and open the right accounts using a mix of your own outreach and the automation and AI agents you build to run alongside it. You'll own a pipeline number, work closely with our Account Executives globally and build a lot of your own tooling on Lovable itself. This is also how we develop AEs: perform here and you'll be running your own deals within 12 to 18 months. There's no playbook yet, so you'll be helping to write it.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.

We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognised on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

  • Evidence you can generate pipeline. That could be as a BDR or SDR, a founder, in sales or revenue ops, or by building something that found its own customers. We care about the outcome more than the job title, and we'll ask to see it.

  • You already use AI and automation tooling (LLMs, Clay, n8n or similar) to research, personalise and sequence outreach, and you have opinions about what works and what doesn't.

  • You'd rather automate a repetitive workflow than keep doing it by hand, and you can show us something you've built.

  • Comfortable running outbound into named accounts and getting past the first contact to the people who actually make the decision.

  • Disciplined about qualifying out. A fast, well-reasoned no is a win for the business, and you don't chase volume for its own sake.

  • Able to explain a technical product in business terms to both technical and commercial buyers.

  • You set your own priorities, manage your own pipeline and hold yourself to account.

  • You want to become an Account Executive and are prepared to earn it.

  • Fluent English. A second European language (German, French, Spanish, Italian) is useful.

  • Experience with Lovable, developer tools or a product-led growth motion is a strong plus.

What you'll do

  • Design and run outbound systems: signal-based targeting, AI-assisted research, personalised sequences and automated workflows. Measure what converts and improve it every week.

  • Build internal GTM tooling on Lovable, such as enrichment flows, qualification agents and meeting-prep automations. The tooling you build is what the team after you will run on.

  • Qualify inbound demand quickly and thoroughly, and convert the right leads into well-prepared first meetings for the AE team.

  • Multi-thread into target accounts to reach economic buyers and technical decision-makers, not just the first person who replied.

  • Own a pipeline number and report clearly on how much comes from your own outreach versus automation, so we can scale both.

  • Work with the Account Executives you support on account plans, meeting prep and keeping deals moving between touchpoints.

  • Qualify out early and clearly when an account isn't a fit, so the team's time goes where it will pay off.

  • Feed what you're hearing from the market back to Sales, Marketing and Product to sharpen messaging and positioning.

Where this role goes

This is a development role with a defined path to Account Executive. We expect the people who join as BDRs now to form our next AE team.

  • Structured coaching from day one: weekly call reviews with experienced AEs and your manager, and a curriculum that covers discovery, demo, commercial negotiation and deal management.

  • The expectation that you progress to running your own deals within 12 to 18 months, based on performance rather than tenure.

  • As the first BDR at Lovable, real influence over how the role, the playbook and the tooling are defined for everyone who follows.

How we work

  • Based out of our London office Monday to Thursday, with the option to work from home on Fridays.

  • You'll work alongside a highly experienced team of Account Executives and your manager who will coach and support you day to day.

  • You'll have unlimited access to Lovable and whatever AI tooling you need to do the job, and the freedom to build what doesn't exist yet.

  • We'll measure you on pipeline created and meetings that convert, and on how much of that you've made repeatable for the people who come after you.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English. It's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

  • We treat all candidates equally. If you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Founding Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
The opportunity

Tax advisory runs on structured data, recurring work and clear rules, and almost none of it has been rebuilt with modern software. What decides who gets there first is real case data and engineers who build next to the people doing the work.

Vogel advises several thousand mid-sized companies and acquires established advisory firms, developing them further on one shared base. On top of the systems we buy, we build our own software: a data layer above DATEV, the tools our advisors use every day, and agents that take over recurring work. What counts is daily use, on data that is audited and closed.

As one of our first engineers, you build across the whole stack: data pipelines, backend, the interfaces advisors use and the agents on top. You take a problem from the first conversation with an advisor to software that runs every day. We are hiring our CTO in parallel, who will own the architecture and lead the team. You work directly with Moritz Vogel.

What you'll do

Tools advisors use

  • Sit with tax advisors and accountants on real cases, find where the work gets stuck, and turn it into software they use the next day. Your benchmark: an advisor would miss it if it were switched off.

  • Build interfaces, dashboards and internal tools, from the first prototype to something that runs without you.

  • Ship small and often: a tool in daily use beats a perfect plan.

Data and integration

  • Build the pipelines that move data out of DATEV and our other systems into our own data layer every night, checked from the first day.

  • Define every figure exactly once, so a number means the same thing in every tool and report.

  • Connect the systems each acquired firm brings, so one more firm never means one more integration project.

Agents and automation

  • Build agents that take over recurring work, with a clear line between what the model judges and what is calculated deterministically.

  • Make every result traceable by version, source and decision, so a certified professional can sign off on it.

  • Evaluate against closed, audited cases, not against test data.

Questions you'll answer

  • Which recurring task in an accounting team is the first one worth taking off people's hands, and how do you prove it?

  • How do you build fast now without leaving a mess for the next engineer?

  • When is a prototype ready to run on real data every day, and who signs off before it does?

What success looks like

  • 3 months: Your first tool is in daily use by an advisory team, and the nightly data load runs with checks.

  • 6 months: Several tools and the first agents run in regular operation. You own one area end to end, and others build on your code.

  • 12 months: You own a part of our software with its own users, and new engineers learn from your standards.

Where it leads: from engineer to owning a product area, as a senior engineer or by leading a team, decided by contribution, not by years served.

What you bring

  • A degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering or a related field from a strong university such as TUM, or an equally strong record of your own projects.

  • You have shipped software that other people used, at work, as a working student or in your own project.

  • You write production code in at least one language, ideally Python or TypeScript, and you are at home with SQL and relational databases.

  • AI is your everyday tool: you write, review and test code with it, and you know where it goes wrong.

  • You want breadth across data, backend, interface and agents, and you work in German and in person, because our advisors and clients do.

  • You learn from practitioners, and you set the highest standard in everything you ship, not because someone checks, but because mediocrity bothers you.

A plus, not a requirement

  • One to two years as an engineer in a young startup or scale-up, or a working-student role where you owned something real.

  • Knowledge of accounting, tax or DATEV, or data pipelines and agents you have run in production.

  • No conventional CV required: a mathematician or physicist who builds, an information systems graduate with a real engineering track, or the founder of a small product. We assess contribution, not labels. The range shown is not room for negotiation but a profile scale: the lower end stands for starting right after university, the upper third for someone who already carries the standard work of the role on their own. A different background starts at a different market price and converges on the role's level after twelve months of proven performance.

What this role is and what it isn't

  • Building on a running business, not a greenfield. DATEV runs and clients do not wait. What you build has to work next to daily operations.

  • An operating company, not a software vendor. The users are our own teams. What we build and in which order is decided together with management; you shape how.

  • Breadth, not a specialist track. If you want to perfect one layer for years, this is the wrong role.

Why join us

  • Real data and real users from the first day. Decades of audited, closed work, and advisors who use what you ship the same week.

  • Leverage through acquisitions. Every firm that joins Vogel runs on what you build.

  • Close to the decisions. You work directly with management and see what gets built and why. Hierarchical in decisions, flat in communication, autonomous in execution. Performance is celebrated, not hidden, without politics and without consensus theater.

  • Substance behind you. A profitable, growing business. No funding round decides whether your work continues.

The FAQ below is in German, as is our working day.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

title: Founding Enterprise BDR | France
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. The product is real; the French playbook is still being written. We are outsiders here, and we will earn our place through better conversations, sharper execution, and customers who see the difference.

We are outbound first. As our founding BDR in France, you will start conversations rather than wait for them. You will find the right companies, reach the people who own customer operations, and create qualified opportunities for the team. You will also help decide which messages, channels, and routines deserve to become our French sales playbook.

What you'll do

  • Build targeted account lists and find the people with a real customer interaction problem to solve.

  • Prospect every day through calls, email, LinkedIn, and thoughtful experiments. The phone is a core part of this role.

  • Run sharp first conversations: understand the workflow, volume, owner, urgency, and reason to act; then hand over opportunities with context the AE can use.

  • Test messages and sequences, measure what turns into useful conversations and qualified pipeline, and improve quickly.

  • Bring what prospects say back to the France team, product, and marketing, and use those insights to improve targeting and messaging.

What makes you a great fit

  • You do not need sales experience. Your background could be the military, firefighting, competitive sport, or something else entirely. What matters is your discipline, coachability, rigor, and ability to keep going through rejection.

  • You speak clearly, listen closely, are curious about how businesses work, and are willing to learn a technical product. You are comfortable picking up the phone.

  • You care about the quality of the opportunity, not just the number of meetings on a calendar.

  • You take feedback directly, own your results, and keep moving when the answer is no.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You speak and write excellent French, work comfortably in English, are based in Paris, and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You need inbound leads, a finished script, or detailed direction before you can start.

  • You avoid the phone or repeated outreach.

  • You resist coaching or let a string of no's stop you from trying a better approach.

  • You value meeting counts over understanding whether a prospect has a real problem and reason to act.

The reality of the role

You will be one of the first people building telli's presence in France. There is no mature local demand engine or perfect script to inherit. Outbound is the core of this role, and some ideas will fail. You will make a lot of calls, learn fast, and help turn an early market into a repeatable business. If that sounds like the best challenge of your career, we want to meet you.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you open doors. Show us how you prepare, earn a first conversation, ask and listen, follow up, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the discipline and judgment you would bring to building pipeline in France.

Compensation

€60,000–€80,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), with a 50% base salary and 50% variable compensation at target, plus equity. We will discuss the equity terms during the hiring process.

title: Founding Legal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

Working directly with Grubel’s founding team, you will shape our research, development, and product: Translate complex legal processes into agentic workflows, evaluate our systems for legal soundness and utility, and work with customers to set our product and engineering standards. You need not write code, but you’re passionate about understanding our technology deeply. Working in a fast-moving team at the intersection of AI research, legal practice, and technology excites you.

What you’ll work on

  • Designing realistic tasks, datasets, and evaluation rubrics for training and evaluation of our legal AI systems

  • Translating complex legal processes into agentic workflows together with our researchers and engineers

  • Evaluating system outputs for legal accuracy, usefulness, and failure modes

  • Leading enterprise pilots and implementations

  • Supporting customer discovery, demonstrations, and go-to-market initiatives

You may be a good fit if

  • You have law degree and strong academic record

  • You have experience practicing law—whether at a law firm, in-house, or in another legal setting

  • You are proactive, self-directed, and comfortable taking broad ownership at an early-stage company

  • You are curious about how AI systems work and comfortable working closely with researchers and engineers

Logistics

  • Munich or Tübingen. We value working together in person, prefer candidates based near one of our offices, and expect at least one day per week in the office. We plan to establish a Zurich office in 2027.

  • Full time employment

  • Competitive salary plus a stock option grant in Grubel, Inc., our US parent company.

title: Founding Product Designer

About the company

Our client is building a personal wealth agent. It's a new category: family office, wealth manager and private bank in one. The company raised a €12M pre-seed led by Headline, with Atomico and GFC.


What you'll do

  • Shape the product from zero to MVP. We ship a proof of concept every week. The first MVP lands in December, the second in January. There are no product managers. The core flows and the way the product feels are yours to set.

  • Define how our users interact with agents. By voice and through interfaces that generate themselves. And how the agent earns enough trust to move users money.

  • Prototype and ship in code. You build your designs with coding agents and ship them with the iOS engineers. The code is the deliverable.

  • Stay close to users, every week. You're in the user conversations. You turn what you hear into what you build, and you push back when a brief isn't ready.

  • Craft the details. Flows, interaction design, and visual polish, down to the micro-interactions and signature patterns.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years designing end-to-end on tier-1, design-led, mobile-first consumer apps.

  • A design engineer. You build with coding agents to multiply your output, not to replace craft.

  • Obsessive about small details. You sweat the 1px difference and care about every transition and haptic.

  • You start from the user's problem and make trade-offs explicit.

  • You've taken on more scope, faster than your peers.

  • Curious, self-directed, and excited by the ambiguity of building from zero.

Even better if you…

  • Have worked in fintech or wealth.

  • Have designed agent chat or generative UI.

  • Have taken a product from 0 to 1 at an early-stage company.

How we work

  • Customer obsession. Everything starts with one question: who are we building it for? If we don't know who they are and what they need, we go and talk to them. Then we build with conviction.

  • Speed. We ship and iterate every week. Something great today beats something perfect next month. Intense, but healthy.

  • High bar. There's always more work than people, and we set the bar high on purpose.

  • Ownership. Real ownership from day one.

  • In person. Five days a week in the office. HQ is in London, and Paris hires travel to London.

Interview process

  • A 20-minute screening call with the CPO: front-end projects, product thinking and how you use AI.

  • A culture fit conversation with a co-founder.

  • A case study on solving a product problem with design and engineering. It may be skipped for some profiles.

Why join

  • A new category. Looking after your wealth should be as routine as looking after your health.

  • A real problem. People with $1–20M need far more than investing and savings: taxes, inheritance, children's education, starting companies, cash flow.

  • Unsolved design problems. How people interact with an agent, and how it earns the trust to move their money. There are few precedents to copy.

  • Career growth. One of the first two designers, with a path to Head of Design.

  • A team with a track record. The CEO has built two unicorns, and the team built a consumer social app used by more than 10M people every day.

  • Competitive pay. £100K to £150K base plus equity, both set by level.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du baust Features am liebsten komplett, von der Go-API bis zur Next.js-Oberfläche? Du willst Code schreiben, den Praxen am nächsten Tag nutzen, statt Tickets in einem Konzern abzuarbeiten? Dann komm zu MediPulse!

Healthcare is broken. Das wollen wir ändern, und dafür suchen wir Dich!

Über MediPulse

Ärzt:innen führen ihre Praxis wie ein mittelständisches Unternehmen: mit Personal, Investitionen und Kreditlinien. Gesteuert wird sie trotzdem im Blindflug. Das Honorar der KV steht erst Monate nach Quartalsende fest, die BWA kommt Wochen zu spät, und der Überblick entsteht mühsam in Excel. Engpässe zeigen sich erst, wenn sie längst eingetreten sind.

Das ändern wir. MediPulse verbindet Praxisverwaltungssystem und Bankkonten und zeigt Umsatz, Kosten und Liquidität tagesaktuell, aufgeschlüsselt nach KV, HZV und Privat, nach Standort, Arzt und Ziffer. Über 300 Arztpraxen und MVZ steuern damit heute ihre Praxis, 2025 hat uns die ENTSCHEIDERFABRIK mit ihrem Startup- und Digitalisierungspreis ausgezeichnet. Unser Ziel: Jede Praxis in Deutschland weiß jeden Tag, wo sie wirtschaftlich steht.

Wir sind ein kleines Team in München, mit Leuten von McKinsey und BCG, einem Arzt im Gründungsteam und Entwickler:innen mit durchweg 5+ Jahren Erfahrung. Wir arbeiten schnell und mit viel KI, übernehmen Verantwortung für das, was wir bauen, und bleiben dabei bodenständig.

Deine Mission

Als Full-Stack Engineer entwickelst du MediPulse über den ganzen Stack: im Backend mit Go, im Frontend mit Next.js. Du baust die Wege, auf denen Abrechnungsdaten aus den unterschiedlichsten Praxissystemen und Kontodaten aus den Banken bei uns ankommen, und die Oberfläche, mit der Ärzt:innen daraus Entscheidungen treffen. Du verantwortest Projekte von Anfang bis Ende und triffst technische Entscheidungen mit.

Woran du arbeitest

  • Schnittstellen: Abrechnungsdaten aus Praxisverwaltungssystemen zuverlässig einlesen – zwölf Systeme sind angebunden, weitere folgen
  • Datenverarbeitung: Abrechnung und Kontobewegungen so aufbereiten, dass Praxen ihre Zahlen nach KV, HZV und Privat, Arzt und Ziffer in Sekunden sehen
  • KI im Produkt: Kontobewegungen automatisch kategorisieren, Liquidität vorhersagen und Praxen vergleichbar machen
  • Frontend: Auswertungen und Dashboards in Next.js, die eine Praxismanagerin ohne Schulung versteht
  • Qualität: Performance, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit – wir arbeiten mit sensiblen Daten und shippen trotzdem mehrmals pro Woche

Mit wem du arbeitest

Du arbeitest mit Jonas, unserem Tech Lead – approbierter Arzt und Entwickler –, und einem Entwicklerteam, das durchweg 5+ Jahre Erfahrung mitbringt. Du arbeitest von Tag eins mit Leuten auf Augenhöhe.

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Go – oder mit einer anderen Sprache und Lust, Go richtig zu lernen
  • Du fühlst dich in TypeScript und React zuhause, idealerweise mit Next.js
  • Du kennst dich mit APIs, Datenbanken und der Verarbeitung größerer Datenmengen aus
  • Du schreibst sauberen, wartbaren Code und kennst modernes Tooling (Git, CI/CD)
  • Du arbeitest gern mit KI-Werkzeugen beim Programmieren und achtest trotzdem auf Qualität
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse

Unser Stack

  • Backend: Go
  • Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript

Was wir bieten

  • Büro direkt am Marienplatz und ein Team, das eng vor Ort zusammenarbeitet
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Raum für Home-Office
  • Moderne Hardware deiner Wahl (z. B. MacBook) und Zugang zu den KI-Werkzeugen, die du brauchst
  • Fitnessabo (Wellpass) und attraktive Corporate Benefits
  • Direkter Draht zu echten Nutzer:innen und sichtbarer Impact ab Tag eins
  • Viel Verantwortung und die Chance, unser Produkt von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Du kannst es kaum erwarten? Wir auch nicht!

Spar dir das klassische Anschreiben – wir wollen sehen, was du baust. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und, wenn du magst, dein GitHub, Portfolio oder ein Projekt, auf das du stolz bist. Den Rest klären wir im Gespräch. Wir freuen uns, loszulegen!

title: Functioneel applicatiebeheerder Backend Platform
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij mee aan betrouwbaar functioneel beheer voor applicaties die onze collega’s dagelijks nodig hebben?

Wie ben jij

Je vindt het leuk om je vast te bijten in applicaties en processen en neemt technische kennis mee. Wanneer een gebruiker met een vraag of probleem komt, wil jij niet alleen weten hoe je het oplost, maar ook begrijpen waar het vandaan komt.

Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen business en IT. Je kunt met een gebruiker praten over een bedrijfsproces en vervolgens met technische collega's of een leverancier bepalen wat er nodig is om een probleem op te lossen of een verbetering te realiseren.

Daarnaast kijk je verder dan je eigen applicatie. Je begrijpt dat systemen steeds meer met elkaar verbonden zijn en houdt daarom rekening met afhankelijkheden binnen de gehele keten.

We vinden het belangrijk dat je:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur met een relevante opleiding;

  • ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer of een vergelijkbare functie;

  • affiniteit hebt met bedrijfsprocessen en informatiesystemen;

  • gebruikersvragen en problemen kunt analyseren en vertalen naar effectieve oplossingen;

  • ervaring hebt met het testen en implementeren van wijzigingen;

  • oog hebt voor de samenhang tussen applicaties, processen en IT-ketens;

  • ervaring hebt met Agile werken;

  • initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en proactief handelt;

  • helder communiceert en gemakkelijk samenwerkt met gebruikers, IT-collega's en leveranciers.

Ervaring met applicaties of processen binnen Finance, Verzekeringen of HR is een pré. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan CODA, Crescendo, QIS of AFAS. Je hoeft ze zeker niet allemaal te kennen. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer en je nieuwe applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen snel eigen kunt maken.

Wat ga je doen

Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben jij een belangrijke schakel tussen gebruikers, de business, IT-teams en leveranciers. Je zorgt ervoor dat applicaties en IT-diensten betrouwbaar functioneren en dat gebruikers goed worden ondersteund. Je werkt aan zowel de dagelijkse operatie als aan de verdere professionalisering van het beheer. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis, ervaring en de behoefte binnen Backend Platform kun je bijvoorbeeld werken aan applicaties binnen Finance, Verzekeringen of HR.


Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • functioneel beheren en ondersteunen van één of meerdere bedrijfskritische applicaties;

  • behandelen en analyseren van functionele vragen, incidenten en verstoringen;

  • bewaken van de goede werking en continuïteit van applicaties;

  • analyseren van gewenste wijzigingen en bepalen wat deze betekenen voor de applicatie en de omliggende keten;

  • afstemmen met gebruikers, leveranciers en IT-collega's over problemen, oplossingen en verbeteringen;

  • ondersteunen bij het realiseren en implementeren van wijzigingen;

  • voorbereiden, coördineren en uitvoeren van functionele en ketentesten;

  • bewaken dat wijzigingen correct en beheerst in gebruik worden genomen;

  • signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen, applicaties en het gebruik daarvan verder te verbeteren;

  • vastleggen en delen van kennis over applicaties, processen en werkwijzen.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan professioneel en toekomstgericht applicatiebeheer.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, eigenaarschap en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen IT, architectuur, security en waardestromen.

  • De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern.

  • Ruimte om mee te denken over marktontwikkelingen, automatisering en de inzet van AI binnen Unive en IT.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Jaarsalaris van € 51.777 tot € 71.907 bruto per jaar op basis van 38 uur, inclusief vakantiegeld en dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning;

  • Dienstverband van 32 tot 38 uur per week;

  • Standplaats Zwolle of Assen, met hybride werken in overleg met het team;

  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • Goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling;

  • Thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die dicht bij haar leden staat. Als IT-organisatie werken we aan een wendbaar, betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstgericht IT-landschap. Schaalbare technologie, goede processen, standaardisatie en continu verbeteren zijn daarbij belangrijk. Binnen IT Kern werken verschillende teams aan het beheren, ondersteunen en doorontwikkelen van applicaties, platformen, infrastructuur, netwerkdiensten en securityoplossingen. Deze IT-diensten zijn essentieel voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening aan leden en voor de ondersteuning van onze collega’s. Samen bouwen we aan een moderne IT-organisatie waarin we betrouwbaar functioneren, waardestromen goed worden ondersteund en vernieuwing gecontroleerd en toekomstbestendig kan plaatsvinden. Je komt terecht in een team waarin samenwerking, eigenaarschap en plezier in het werk belangrijk zijn. We werken met collega’s die graag verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen om het applicatie- en IT-landschap iedere dag een stukje beter te maken.

Omdat we zoeken naar mensen die perfect bij ons passen houden we de werving en selectie graag in eigen hand. Wij maken daarom geen gebruik van diensten van uitzendbureaus en/of werving & selectiebureaus.

title: Google Cloud Data Platform and Security Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will review the security and set up of Google Cloud data platforms as part of technology due diligence, for clients who are selling, buying or investing in software companies. Buyers want to know that client data is kept apart, that access is tightly controlled and logged, and that the security claims in a company's SOC 2 or ISO 27001 evidence hold up in practice.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work with our technology due diligence lead, who brings your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Review how Google Cloud projects, BigQuery datasets and storage are organised, and how each client's data is kept separate.

  • Check IAM roles, service accounts, network controls, secrets and encryption keys.

  • Check logging, monitoring and alerting, including who can reach production data and how that access is recorded.

  • Test security claims against the company's SOC 2, ISO 27001 or client security questionnaire evidence.

  • Review backup, recovery and how the platform copes as data and users grow.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years designing, running or securing production platforms on Google Cloud.

  • Hands on knowledge of BigQuery, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Logging and Cloud KMS.

  • A current Google Cloud Professional certification is a strong plus.

  • Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience with health or other regulated data, or with due diligence work, is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £600 to £750 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: Graduate Product Designer 2027 (London)
descriptionHtml:

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

There's a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love.

As a Graduate Product Designer, you'll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos, or Customer Experience & Integrity. You'll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people.

  • You'll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship.
  • You'll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you'll quickly grow to own design end-to-end.
  • You'll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders.
  • You'll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human.
  • You'll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won't just shape your own projects - it'll shape how design is practiced across the team.
  • You'll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration.
  • You'll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation.

What You'll Need to Thrive

We're looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here's what you'll need to join us and thrive in the role:

  • You're in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027.

  • AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience.
  • You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly.

title: Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert, to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. Working at the intersection of research and software development you will translate state-of-the-art research into reliable simulation capabilities that support device design and development.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Research the literature on state-of-the-art approaches to graphene device modeling and simulation

  • Work with commercial TCAD and multiphysics simulation tools

  • Translate physical models from scientific literature into robust, maintainable Python code

  • Develop and extend models for graphene-based photonic devices, incorporating new physical effects and functionalities

  • Calibrate, validate, and refine models using experimental characterization data

  • Collaborate closely with various teams, prioritizing modeling activities in line with team and company goals

  • Document your work clearly and contribute to shared software-development practices

Your Qualifications

  • PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Strong foundation in solid-state physics, semiconductor physics, and mathematics

  • Proficient in modeling techniques and methodologies for semiconductor physics

  • Proven ability to translate scientific literature and mathematical models into simulation code

  • Experience with TCAD development

  • Proficiency in Python and Git

  • Experience solving partial differential equations, particularly for charge and heat transport

  • Experience with graphene and photonics

  • Experience with commercial simulation tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or Ansys Lumerical is a plus

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry
