title: Growth Account Executive, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

Most sales roles chase new logos. This one unlocks the revenue already inside Telnyx's customer base — and there's a lot of it.

As a Growth Account Executive (Expansion), you'll take commercial ownership of established Telnyx customers after their first 12 months, identifying and closing new revenue opportunities across our product portfolio, from Voice AI and programmable communications to messaging, connectivity, and AI infrastructure.

You'll own an assigned portfolio of existing customers, identify untapped opportunities, build relationships with new stakeholders, and drive expansion from prospecting through close.

This isn't traditional account management. You're not here to simply maintain relationships or renew contracts. You're here to grow accounts by introducing new products, expanding into new business units and geographies, and helping customers build more with Telnyx.

You're not farming. You're hunting inside the base.

What You'll Do

  • Own and grow your accounts. Take commercial ownership of an assigned portfolio of established customers, developing strategies to drive incremental recurring revenue.
  • Find untapped opportunities. Analyze customer usage, product adoption, business models, and growth plans to identify opportunities for cross-selling, upselling, and geographic expansion.
  • Hunt within existing accounts. Run targeted, personalized outbound campaigns to engage new stakeholders, departments, and decision-makers within your customer portfolio.
  • Own the expansion sales cycle. Lead discovery, qualify opportunities, develop commercial proposals, negotiate terms, and close expansion deals.
  • Sell across the Telnyx product portfolio. Identify opportunities spanning Voice AI, SIP trunking, programmable voice, messaging, WhatsApp Business, global numbers, wireless, and AI infrastructure.
  • Build strategic relationships. Develop connections with technical buyers, business leaders, and economic decision-makers to uncover new use cases and accelerate adoption.
  • Drive measurable revenue growth. Own an incremental MRR target, focusing on commercially attributable, profitable expansion rather than organic usage growth alone.
  • Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Hunter AEs during account transitions and partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to execute expansion strategies.
  • Own your forecast. Maintain accurate opportunities, account plans, and forecasts in Salesforce, ensuring clear visibility into pipeline health and commercial progress.
  • Bring customer intelligence back to Telnyx. Share market insights, product feedback, and emerging customer requirements to help shape our roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

What You Bring

  • Experience in B2B technology sales, ideally as an Account Executive, Growth AE, or in a commercially focused business development role.
  • A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting rather than relying exclusively on inbound demand.
  • A hunter mentality and the commercial curiosity to identify opportunities that aren't immediately obvious.
  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience navigating multiple stakeholders and building relationships with both technical and commercial decision-makers.
  • The ability to independently manage opportunities, develop business cases, and move deals through a structured sales process.
  • Strong account research and strategic thinking skills, including identifying whitespace and opportunities for cross-selling.
  • Comfort discussing technical products with developers, engineering teams, operations leaders, and executives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience managing pipeline and forecasts.
  • A proactive, accountable mindset with a genuine desire to own and deliver revenue results.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in CPaaS, UCaaS, telecom, cloud infrastructure, AI, or developer-focused technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with Voice AI, SIP trunking, programmable communications, WhatsApp Business API, or messaging infrastructure.
  • Previous success in an expansion, cross-sell, upsell, or account-growth role.
  • Experience selling multiple products or solutions into the same organization.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or another structured qualification methodology.
  • Experience working with international or multinational customers across Europe.

Why This Role Matters

Telnyx customers are already building on our infrastructure, but many are only using a fraction of what our platform can offer.

A customer using us for SIP trunking might be a strong fit for Voice AI. A business operating in one country might be ready to expand across Europe. These opportunities don't always arrive as inbound requests. Someone needs to uncover them, build the business case, and turn them into revenue.

That's where you come in. You'll work on a warm base with real relationships, real usage data, and real expansion potential. The upside is there. You just have to go and find it.

You'll be measured on the incremental revenue you create, not simply the accounts you inherit.

Why Telnyx

  • Real technology, built in-house. We own our global network and build our communications and AI infrastructure, giving you a differentiated platform to sell.
  • A broad portfolio with real cross-sell potential. From global connectivity and programmable communications to Voice AI and AI infrastructure, there's always another customer challenge we can solve.
  • Profitable and independent. Join a company focused on sustainable growth and long-term investment in its technology.

title: Growth & Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Warum gibt es diese Rolle - und warum jetzt?

Lovebetter wächst in eine neue Phase. Wir haben eine klare Mission, starke Inhalte, eine etablierte Marke und zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, noch mehr Männer zu erreichen und nachhaltig zu wachsen.

In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unterschiedliche Marketingkanäle aufgebaut, Partnerschaften entwickelt und wertvolle Erfahrungen gesammelt. Jetzt wollen wir diese Aktivitäten noch besser miteinander verbinden, neue Wachstumschancen erschließen und unsere Ideen schneller in die Umsetzung bringen.

Dafür suchen wir dich.

Als Growth & Marketing Manager bist du eine zentrale operative Kraft in unserem Marketing. Du verbindest kreatives Denken mit analytischem Verständnis, entwickelst eigene Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Kampagnen, Tests und Ergebnisse werden.

Diese Rolle ist bewusst breiter als ein klassischer Marketingjob. Du wirst nicht nur einen einzelnen Kanal betreuen, sondern in ganz unterschiedlichen Bereichen mitarbeiten, eigenständig Verantwortung übernehmen und neue Themen vorantreiben.

Du musst dafür nicht alles bereits können. Entscheidend ist, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst, lösungsorientiert denkst und Lust hast, Dinge selbst in die Hand zu nehmen.

Wofür Lovebetter steht

Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren.

Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Mission mitgestalten möchte, Verantwortung übernimmt und versteht, dass wirkungsvolles Marketing Kreativität, analytisches Denken und konsequente Umsetzung verbindet.

Deine Mission als Growth & Marketing Manager

Du machst Lovebetters Marketing vielseitiger, effizienter und wachstumsstärker.

Du entwickelst Marketingideen, setzt Kampagnen um, betreust bestehende und neue Wachstumskanäle und erkennst anhand von Daten, was funktioniert und wo wir besser werden können.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem CMO, unseren Content-Produzenten, Agenturen und externen Partnern zusammen.

Du übernimmst eigenständig Projekte – von der ersten Idee über die operative Umsetzung bis zur anschließenden Auswertung. Dabei bewegst du dich selbstverständlich zwischen kreativen, analytischen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Besonders wichtig: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand für jede Herausforderung eine Lösung vorgibt. Du recherchierst, probierst aus, eignest dir neue Fähigkeiten an und findest Wege, Dinge umzusetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marketingkampagnen entwickeln und umsetzen: Du planst und realisierst kanalübergreifende Marketingmaßnahmen, entwickelst kreative Ansätze und begleitest Kampagnen von der Idee bis zur Erfolgsauswertung.
  • Neue Wachstumskanäle erschließen: Du identifizierst neue Möglichkeiten, unsere Zielgruppe zu erreichen, recherchierst Potenziale, entwickelst erste Tests und hilfst dabei, erfolgreiche Ansätze systematisch auszubauen.
  • Ambassador Marketing und Kooperationen vorantreiben: Du entwickelst unser Ambassador-Programm weiter, recherchierst und gewinnst passende Partner, betreust Kooperationen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Beziehungen messbare Marketingmaßnahmen entstehen.
  • Content und Creatives mitgestalten: Du entwickelst Themen, Hooks, Texte und Kampagnenideen, erstellst Briefings und arbeitest mit unseren Content-Produzenten an Inhalten für unterschiedliche Plattformen und Marketingkanäle.
  • CRM und E-Mail-Marketing betreuen: Du setzt Newsletter und Kampagnen um, entwickelst Segmentierungs- und Reaktivierungsansätze und unterstützt dabei, bestehende Kontakte gezielter anzusprechen.
  • Marketingperformance analysieren und optimieren: Du behältst relevante KPIs im Blick, analysierst Kampagnen, Content und Funnels, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen daraus ab.
  • Websites und Landingpages weiterentwickeln: Du übernimmst kleinere Anpassungen an unseren digitalen Angeboten und unterstützt bei Tests und Optimierungen. Wenn du dafür ein neues Tool wie WordPress lernen musst, arbeitest du dich eigenständig ein.
  • Marketingprojekte und Partner koordinieren: Du hältst laufende Projekte zusammen, koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben zuverlässig und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
  • KI und Automatisierung sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Content, Analysen und operative Aufgaben und entwickelst Ideen, wie wir unsere Marketingprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern können.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Abwechslung statt Silodenken: Du arbeitest nicht ausschließlich an Content, Performance oder Analytics, sondern lernst unterschiedliche Marketingdisziplinen kennen und verbindest sie miteinander.
  • Eigenverantwortung statt langer Abstimmungswege: Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen vorzubereiten und Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben.
  • Kreativität trifft Zahlen: Du kannst neue Kampagnenideen entwickeln und anschließend anhand konkreter Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, ob sie erfolgreich waren.
  • Lernen gehört zum Job: Du musst nicht jedes Tool und jeden Marketingkanal bereits kennen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die sich Herausforderungen stellen und neue Fähigkeiten selbstständig aufbauen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CMO: Du erhältst Einblicke in strategische Marketingentscheidungen und bist eng an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketings beteiligt.
  • Persönliche Entwicklung und Perspektive: Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben und hast die Möglichkeit, mit der Weiterentwicklung von Lovebetter zunehmend Verantwortung für größere Projekte, Prozesse und perspektivisch auch Menschen zu übernehmen.

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

  • ein Marketing, in dem gute Ideen schneller in konkrete Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden
  • ein Ambassador- und Kooperationsprogramm, das kontinuierlich wächst und messbare Ergebnisse liefert
  • neue Marketingkanäle, die strukturiert getestet, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden
  • bessere Kampagnen und Inhalte durch die Verbindung von Kreativität und datenbasierten Erkenntnissen
  • optimierte Funnels, CRM-Kampagnen und digitale Kontaktpunkte, die mehr qualifizierte Leads erzeugen
  • effizientere Prozesse durch Eigeninitiative, Automatisierung und den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI
  • ein Marketing-Team, das schneller, selbstständiger und wirkungsvoller arbeitet

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.

Erzähl uns lieber:

  • welche Marketingprojekte oder Kampagnen du bereits eigenständig umgesetzt hast
  • wann du dich zuletzt in ein völlig neues Thema oder Tool eingearbeitet hast und was daraus entstanden ist
  • wie du kreative Ideen entwickelst und herausfindest, ob sie tatsächlich funktionieren
  • welche Aufgaben du schon übernommen hast, obwohl du sie vorher noch nie gemacht hattest
  • und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetters Marketing mit Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungskraft auf das nächste Level bringen kannst

Stellenanforderungen

Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

  • du bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt und idealerweise Kampagnen oder Projekte eigenständig umgesetzt hast

title: GTM
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

GTM

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: From £120k base salary plus equity and commission (£200k+ Realistic OTE)

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our partners use Deducta to deliver major transformations, and winning them takes a consultative sale with senior executives. This role owns customer acquisition end to end, from opening relationships with C-suite and VP-level leaders to signed partnership. You'll report to the leadership team.

You'll have significant autonomy to lead sophisticated enterprise deals, work directly with client data in our platform, and build the business cases that win them. You'll carry a quota and be accountable for closing new business. As the commercial function grows, you'll be a leader in it, setting the standard for how we sell and shaping the repeatable motion behind it.

What you'll do

  • Customer acquisition: Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and engaging senior executives through to close.

  • Pipeline generation: Map target accounts, open relationships with senior stakeholders and build a pipeline of enterprises where Deducta can deliver outsized value.

  • Business cases: Build quantified business cases and materials that translate Deducta's capabilities into the outcomes decision-makers care about.

  • Complex deals: Lead multi-stakeholder deals, run product demonstrations, work with client data in the platform, and coordinate product, engineering and delivery to keep momentum.

  • Pipeline discipline: Make next steps, risks, decision-makers and deal status explicit across every opportunity.

  • Closing: Carry a quota and close new enterprise business, negotiating commercial terms and guiding deals through procurement and legal to signature.

Success in this role means:

  • Quota attainment: You consistently hit your number by creating and closing high-quality enterprise opportunities where Deducta can deliver meaningful value.

  • Deal momentum: Complex deals move forward with clear next steps, strong executive sponsorship and fewer stalls or surprises.

  • Trusted before signing: Prospects understand the business case for Deducta and see us as a credible partner before they sign.

  • Repeatable motion: You help make the commercial motion more repeatable, and others learn from how you sell.

Who you are

We're looking for a commercially minded, high-agency seller with a proven track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals. You'll combine structured problem solving and analytical depth with the drive to win sophisticated enterprise customers.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Executive presence: You can sit across from a CPO or CFO, earn their trust and build a relationship that lasts beyond the deal.

  • Commercial judgement: You read an account, understand what matters to each stakeholder and find the best path to a decision.

  • Analytical instincts: You work directly with client data and turn the analysis into a clear, compelling business case.

  • Programme management: You coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder processes and follow through without a pre-existing playbook.

  • Product fluency: You run product demonstrations and work in the platform yourself rather than relying on others.

  • Drive to win: You have the hunger to create opportunities, sustain momentum and close business, with a record of hitting or exceeding quota.

  • Nice to have: Entrepreneurial experience, experience mentoring or leading others, or prior startup or high-growth go-to-market experience.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

Compensation: £120K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • £200k+ Realistic OTE

title: Head of Business Development, Investor Network
descriptionHtml:
We're hiring a business development leader to take over the team that builds and runs our investor network: six associates, one number, and a direct line to both co-founders.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

  • Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

  • Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

  • Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

  • Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every month, and every member getting founders that fit at the pace they asked for.

  • Work with our client success team on each client's plan, so what your team works on matches what the client expects, and with our founder relations team, who build relationships with top founders long before they become clients.

  • Spot the constraint that holds the team back and fix it, with a process or together with our engineers, which takes someone who knows which problem is worth solving.

  • Bring the two co-founders the weekly numbers, investor calls, newly active members, introductions sent, founder calls and referrals, and what you are changing because of them.


What you bring

  • You have run a sales, business development or investment team of five or more for at least two years, the number you carried was the team's, and you can name what the team achieved under you and who you promoted.

  • People respected you and still wanted to work for you, without you needing to be liked. You give straight feedback and you hold the standard when it is uncomfortable.

  • Ego and politics are not part of how you work. You talk about the team's results before your own, and your last team would say the same about you.

  • Systems are how you think. You have built the CRM discipline, the reporting or the playbook that others then ran on, and you can find the one constraint in a team and remove it.

  • Incentives and retention make sense to you. You know what makes the right behavior pay and what makes a team stick together, and you have the retention to show for it.

  • You play the long game. You would not squeeze one month at the cost of the next three, and you go for quality over quantity with investors and founders alike.

  • The investor world is one you know well enough to coach. You have sold high ticket to senior buyers, raised capital, or built an investor or executive network yourself, and years in venture capital or at a fund are a plus on top of the team you led.


Backgrounds we expect to see are high ticket competitive sales, consulting, banking and investment teams. This is not the seat for a great dealmaker who has never led a team, our associate role is the right application for that, and investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund is a different job from this one.

What good looks like

  • By day 30 you have familiarized yourself closely with the associate work and what we expect from it.

  • Ninety days in, the weekly rhythm runs on your numbers and every associate has a written plan they measure themselves against.

  • Every month the network has more active members and every client's introductions went out on fit and on time.

  • Every quarter one constraint is gone from the team's way, through a process or through engineering.

  • After a year the associates have grown, and the relationships with investors and founders are stronger than they were, since everything here is built to compound over years.


Compensation and how we work
US$200K to US$300K+ total compensation, base plus a bonus on the team's results. Fully remote, your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. The best AI tooling is paid for, so the admin runs itself and your hours go to people. You work next to our client success lead, our founder relations team and our engineers, each of them running their own lane.

How to apply
Hit apply, which takes you to a short form with four questions. The two co-founders read every application. The process from there is a first call, final conversations with both co-founders, and three references.

No ego is the first rule here, the team's result comes before anyone's name, the co-founders included. And everything is built to compound, so every relationship and every number should be stronger next year than it is now.

Compensation: $200K – $300K

title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of Compliance Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

As Head of Compliance Monitoring, you'll own Lendable's risk-based compliance monitoring programme and lead the team that delivers it. You'll provide independent second line assurance that the business meets its legal and regulatory obligations, and evidence the outcomes customers actually receive rather than the processes behind them.

You'll report to the Head of Compliance (SMF 16, Compliance Oversight) and deputise for them, including at Board meetings and sub-committees. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has built a second line monitoring function in a UK FCA regulated consumer credit firm and wants the autonomy to shape one in a fast-growing fintech. The role is not itself a Senior Manager Function.

What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Own the compliance monitoring plan and methodology, refreshing it annually and in-year in response to emerging risks, regulatory change, MI, complaints and FCA publications

  • Maintain a monitoring universe covering PRIN and the Consumer Duty, CONC, SYSC, DISP, SMCR, MCOB, the Consumer Credit Act, financial promotions and UK GDPR

  • Scope and deliver thematic and BAU reviews across the customer journey, including affordability (CONC 5), financial promotions (CONC 3), arrears and forbearance (CONC 7), vulnerability, fees and charges and complaints handling (DISP)

  • Test the design and operating effectiveness of first line controls, and provide second line assurance over first line quality assurance

  • Issue clear, evidence-based reports setting out findings, root cause, risk ratings and owned actions, then track remediation to closure and validate that it worked

  • Escalate actual or potential customer harm promptly, and assess it for redress and for notification to the FCA under Principle 11 and SUP 15

  • Produce monitoring MI for the Head of Compliance, executive management and the Board, and present it at committees

  • Support FCA supervisory engagement, information requests and skilled person (s166) reviews, and coordinate coverage with Internal Audit, Risk and first line QA

  • Bring data protection into scope, testing UK GDPR and DPA 2018 compliance alongside the Data Protection Officer

  • Lead, coach and develop the compliance monitoring team, planning resource against the plan and building capability through data, analytics and better tooling

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable compliance monitoring experience within a UK FCA regulated firm, including designing, owning and delivering a risk-based compliance monitoring programme

  • Experience of leading, managing and developing a team

  • Consumer credit experience, with a strong working knowledge of CONC and the Consumer Credit Act

  • Strong working knowledge of the FCA Handbook, in particular PRIN and the Consumer Duty, SYSC, DISP and SMCR, and of FCA expectations of a second line monitoring function

  • Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

  • Ability to write clear, concise, evidence-based reports and to present findings credibly to senior management, the Board and its committees

  • Sound judgement and personal resilience, with the independence and confidence to challenge the business constructively and to escalate where necessary

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver a plan across competing priorities

Highly desirable

  • Internal audit experience gained in a third line function, and/or a relevant professional qualification (for example IIA, ICA or CISI)

  • Secured lending experience, from either a second or third line perspective, including knowledge of MCOB

 

Interview process

  • Screening stage: a 15 minute remote cognitive exercise and a 30 minute interview with the Talent Partner

  • 40 minute interview with a Compliance Business Partner (remote)

  • Final onsite interview:

    • 45minute interview with the Head of Compliance

    • 30 minute interviews with CRO

    • 30 minute interview with a product MD

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Head of Corporate Communications (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
FASTR Energy gehört zu den führenden Energiedienstleistern und Stromversorgern in
Deutschland. Das Unternehmen wurde 1989 in Aachen gegründet und hat
heute seinen Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf sowie Niederlassungen in Berlin,
Hamburg, München und Leizpig. Aus einem ursprünglich familiengeführten
Unternehmen ist ein dynamischer Energiepartner geworden, der sich im Mai
2025 durch die Partnerschaft mit KKR auf einen klaren Wachstumskurs
begeben hat. In einer spannenden Transformationsphase gestalten wir
aktiv die Zukunft der Energieversorgung – mit einer klaren Vision: Als
Dekarbonisierungspartner der Immobilienwirtschaft leisten wir einen
entscheidenden Beitrag zur Energiewende in Deutschland.

Die Rolle

Als Head of Corporate Communications (mögliche Standorte Düsseldorf, Berlin, München oder Hamburg) verantwortest du die Kommunikation eines Unternehmens in einer prägenden Phase: FASTR ist als bundesweiter, integrierter Energiedienstleister für die Immobilienwirtschaft, Kommunen und Stadtwerke neu aufgestellt und wächst. Du baust die Kommunikationsfunktion strategisch auf und aus, gibst ihr Struktur und Handschrift und machst die Positionierung des Unternehmens nach innen und außen erlebbar.

Das ist ausdrücklich keine ausführende Kommunikationsrolle. Du gestaltest von Grund auf – mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung, unternehmensweiter Sichtbarkeit und dem Mandat, Themen zu setzen statt sie nur zu begleiten.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Du entwickelst die Kommunikationsstrategie des Unternehmens und führst interne wie externe Kommunikation zu einem konsistenten Auftritt zusammen.

  • Du verantwortest die Kommunikation gegenüber Kunden ebenso wie gegenüber Bewerbenden und Mitarbeitenden und sorgst dafür, dass alle Zielgruppen dieselbe Marke erleben.

  • Du berätst die Geschäftsführung als Sparringspartner in Kommunikationsfragen, übersetzt Strategie und Positionierung in klare Botschaften und bringst Themen aktiv ein.

  • Du machst technisch und regulatorisch geprägte Themen der Energie- und Immobilienwirtschaft für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen verständlich und positionierst das Unternehmen als verlässlichen Partner gegenüber Wohnungswirtschaft, Kommunen, Stadtwerken und institutionellen Investoren.

  • Du entwickelst in enger Abstimmung mit HR das Employer Branding von FASTR und machst uns als Arbeitgeber sichtbar – von den Karrierekanälen bis zur internen Kommunikation.

  • Du verantwortest die Presse- und Medienarbeit, baust Beziehungen zu relevanten Medien und Multiplikatoren auf und positionierst das Unternehmen zu den Themen der Energie- und Immobilienwirtschaft.

  • Du steuerst und erweiterst die Kommunikationskanäle – von LinkedIn bis zur Fachpresse – und entwickelst Formate, die zur Positionierung des Unternehmens passen.

  • Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit von Corporate Communications und Sales Marketing und verantwortest die digitalen Marketingkampagnen – von Content über Social Media bis Performance Marketing – zur Unterstützung von Markenbekanntheit und Leadgenerierung.

  • Du schaffst die Grundlagen einer skalierbaren Kommunikationsfunktion: Prozesse, Guidelines, Standards und Strukturen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.

  • Du führst ein kleines Team an der Schnittstelle von Kommunikation und Marketing, entwickelst es weiter und verzahnst beide Bereiche eng.

Das bringst du mit

Erforderlich

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Unternehmenskommunikation, davon nachweislich in einer gestaltenden oder aufbauenden Funktion.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, komplexe, erklärungsbedürftige Sachverhalte klar, präzise und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.

  • Erfahrung in der B2B- und Stakeholder-Kommunikation, idealerweise in einem technisch, industriell oder infrastrukturnah geprägten Umfeld.

  • Strategisches Denkvermögen kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, Themen selbst operativ umzusetzen.

  • Sicheres, souveränes Auftreten gegenüber der Geschäftsführungsebene – du schaffst Klarheit und vertrittst deine fachliche Haltung überzeugend.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Presse- und Medienarbeit.

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitenden sowie die Bereitschaft, ein Team aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Von Vorteil

  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Medien und Fachöffentlichkeit.

  • Erfahrung in Marken- oder Integrationsphasen, etwa bei der Zusammenführung mehrerer Organisationen unter einer gemeinsamen Marke.

  • Erfahrung darin, eine neue oder sich entwickelnde Markenidentität kommunikativ zu tragen.

  • Nähe zu erklärungsbedürftigen Branchen wie Energie, Infrastruktur oder Immobilienwirtschaft.

  • Erfahrung im Employer Branding und Personalmarketing, idealerweise in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Marketingkampagnen (z. B. Content-, Social-Media- und Performance-Marketing) sowie im Zusammenspiel mit Sales Marketing.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Eine Aufbau- und Gestaltungsrolle mit echtem Mandat statt vorgegebener Routinen.

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und Einfluss auf die Außen- und Innenwahrnehmung des Unternehmens.

  • Ein Unternehmen in einer aktiven Wachstums- und Integrationsphase, in der Kommunikation strategisch gebraucht wird.

  • Die Möglichkeit, eine Kommunikationsfunktion nach eigenen Vorstellungen zu prägen und mit dem Unternehmen wachsen zu lassen.

  • Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Hinter deinen Botschaften stehen echte Anlagen, echte Kunden und ein Thema, das gesellschaftlich zählt.

  • Eine solide Basis: über 25 Jahre operative Erfahrung, rund 1.100 betriebene Heizzentralen und ein Investor im Rücken, der unser Wachstum trägt.

  • Ein Team im Zusammenwachsen: Aus drei Unternehmen wird eine Marke – und du prägst mit, wie sich das nach innen und außen anfühlt.

Warum diese Rolle?

Solche Ausgangslagen sind selten: eine etablierte operative Basis von über 25 Jahren, eine frisch geschärfte Marke und ein finanziell solide getragenes Wachstum. Wenn du Unternehmenskommunikation nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten und sichtbar Wirkung erzielen möchtest, findest du hier den Rahmen dafür – mit Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag und dem Gestaltungsspielraum, eine Funktion von Grund auf zu prägen.

descriptionHtml:
Born in 1971, the roots of Mulberry are in Somerset, England. For more than fifty years, Mulberry has been a British lifestyle brand, internationally acclaimed for quality and design capturing the Mulberry Spirit.
Sustainability has been part of the Mulberry ethos since the brand's inception, in recognition of our purpose-driven approach, in 2024 we proudly achieved B Corp Certification.
Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited.
If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team.

Mulberry is looking for an experienced Head of Data to establish and lead our enterprise data capability.

This is a pivotal new role with the opportunity to shape how data is architected, governed, managed and used across Mulberry. You will define our data operating model, establish clear ownership and governance, build a cross-functional data community and create the foundations for trusted, accessible and valuable data across the business.

Working closely with senior business leaders and Technology, you will act as the single point of accountability for Data Enablement across Mulberry, ensuring our approach is driven by business priorities and delivers measurable value.

Alongside establishing the organisational capability, you will help shape Mulberry’s future technology data capability. This could involve evolving our existing Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery environment or moving towards an alternative solution. The role will ensure that our business needs, operating model and long-term ambitions inform those choices.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Define and implement Mulberry’s enterprise Data strategy and operating model, including ownership, governance, stewardship and decision rights.
  • Establish a pragmatic Data Governance framework, covering definitions, quality, lineage, metadata, standards and accountability.
  • Create and lead a cross-functional Data Community, establishing Data Owners and Data Stewards across key business areas and equipping them with the guidance, training and practical tools needed to fulfil their responsibilities.
  • Act as the enterprise point of accountability for Data Enablement, bringing together business and Technology priorities.
  • Lead the business direction of our Data Foundations programme and help transition it into a sustainable, long-term capability.
  • Establish common definitions, authoritative data sources and trusted enterprise measures, reducing multiple versions of the truth and manual reconciliation.
  • Work with Technology to define the business requirements and guiding principles for our future data architecture and platform.
  • Develop a prioritised Data roadmap focused on delivering tangible commercial and operational value.
  • Build data literacy and enable greater, appropriately governed self-service across the organisation.
  • Create the foundations required for future analytics, automation and AI opportunities.
  • Work with relevant Legal and Technology stakeholders to embed appropriate data classification, access, retention and lifecycle controls, with clear ownership of data risks and remediation.

About you

You’ll combine strong Data expertise with commercial judgement and the ability to lead enterprise-wide change.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Significant experience in Data leadership, Data Governance, Data Management or enterprise Data transformation.
  • Experience building or materially evolving a Data operating model, rather than simply managing an established function.
  • Strong knowledge of Data Governance, ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage and metadata.
  • Experience establishing accountability across multiple business functions and building the internal and external capabilities needed to deliver data outcomes.
  • A strong commercial mindset, with the ability to translate business challenges into clear Data priorities and outcomes.
  • The confidence to influence senior leaders and constructively challenge both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Sufficient understanding of modern cloud Data platforms to help shape technology decisions without needing to be the technical architect.
  • Experience developing Data strategies and investment roadmaps.
  • Clear, engaging communication skills and the ability to make Data understandable to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of GCP, BigQuery or comparable cloud data platforms.

Experience within retail, luxury, consumer goods or manufacturing would be advantageous.

What success looks like

Within your first year, you will have established:

  • A clear and functioning enterprise Data operating model.
  • Active Data Owners and Data Stewards across priority areas.
  • A strong cross-functional Data Community.
  • Common definitions and governance for critical enterprise data and KPIs.
  • Improved visibility of Data quality, lineage, ownership and risk.
  • A prioritised Data roadmap linked to measurable business outcomes.
  • A clear future technology Data capability and supporting organisational model.
  • Greater trust in and use of Data for decision-making across Mulberry.

Why this role matters

This is not a traditional reporting, BI or technical Data role. It is an opportunity to build an enterprise capability from the ground up.

Data is increasingly critical to how Mulberry makes commercial and operational decisions, and to how we develop our future technology and AI capabilities. The Head of Data will play a central role in creating the ownership, governance, capability and culture needed to unlock that opportunity.

Culture

  • Embrace and demonstrate the Mulberry values and behaviours: honesty, dynamism, and a community-oriented spirit.
  • Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues.
  • Act as an ambassador for Mulberry and communicate positively about the brand.

Sustainability

  • As a certified B Corp, we are committed to using business as a force for good. You’ll be encouraged to incorporate environmentally and socially responsible practices into your work, supporting our Made to Last strategy across Climate, Circularity, and Community.
  • Help foster a culture where diversity is celebrated and every individual feels valued, respected, and included. Champion equity, empathy, and understanding in all interactions - internally and externally.

What we can do for you

As well as the opportunity to play an important role in Mulberry’s future, you’ll have access to a range of benefits, including:

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous staff discount and access to staff sales
  • Your birthday off
  • Pension contributions and life assurance
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Two paid volunteering days per year
  • Access to Help@Hand wellbeing support, including remote GP appointments, mental health support, physiotherapy, personal training and retail discounts
Mulberry is an equal opportunities employer and we are passionate about hiring and developing the best talent. All hiring decisions are made only on the basis of qualifications, skills or experience and as they relate to the particular role. If you need us to make any adjustments to our application or interview processes to enable you to be at your best, please email us at -----

title: Head of Engineering, Cards
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM:

Cards is one of the largest revenue lines at Tide. The domain owns everything that happens on the card: issuing and processing across the UK, EU and India, each with its own processors, card schemes and regulators.

This includes prepaid, debit, multi-currency and team cards, alongside products such as Apple Pay and Google Pay tokenisation, 3DS, card controls and settlement.

The teams are cross-functional, working closely with product, design, commercial and operations. Engineering comprises three teams, with engineers based in Bulgaria, Lithuania and India.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will lead the engineering organisation across the UK, EU and India, shaping the next phase of the Cards platform.

With the core platform transformation largely complete, your focus will be on:

  • Product and member experience: Partnering with Product and Design to improve card experiences, including tokenisation, payment journeys, team controls and reducing false declines.
  • AI-led engineering: Embedding AI coding agents across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, delivery speed and quality.
  • Platform and commercial ownership: Completing the transition from our legacy processor, strengthening partner relationships and driving improvements in cost efficiency and unit economics.

You will set the technical direction, develop engineering leadership and ensure the platform remains reliable, scalable and commercially sustainable.

As Head of Engineering, Cards, you will:

  • Lead and develop engineering managers and senior engineers across distributed teams.
  • Define the technical strategy and architecture for the Cards domain.
  • Drive reliability, scalability and cost efficiency across card issuing and processing.
  • Embed AI-assisted and agentic development practices across engineering teams.
  • Partner with Product, Design and Commercial teams to prioritise and deliver the roadmap.
  • Own technical relationships with card processors and schemes, including integrations and certifications.
  • Strengthen engineering capabilities, particularly at Staff and senior IC levels.
  • Collaborate with other engineering leaders across Payments on shared infrastructure.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for an experienced engineering leader with a strong technical foundation and a track record of leading large, distributed engineering organisations.

Experience and background

  • Experience leading engineering managers and large engineering teams.
  • Strong experience in cards, payments or banking, with a deep understanding of card issuing, processing and card scheme operations. Experience on either the issuer or processor side is a strong plus.
  • Experience building and operating distributed engineering teams across multiple locations.
  • Proven ability to improve engineering delivery, productivity and quality.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Commercial and Finance leaders on business outcomes and unit economics.
  • Experience managing third-party technology providers and strategic partnerships.

Technical expertise

  • Strong understanding of microservices, event-driven architecture and cloud-native systems.
  • Experience with relational databases, distributed systems and large-scale transaction processing.
  • Ability to challenge architectural decisions and engage in technical and production-level discussions.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and their application across the software development lifecycle.

Leadership

  • Ability to set technical direction and drive execution through engineering leaders.
  • Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • A strong focus on developing engineering talent and building high-performing teams.

OUR TECH STACK: 

Java and Spring Boot microservices running on AWS, with PostgreSQL as our primary datastore. We use SNS/SQS for asynchronous and event-driven messaging. Observability is Coralogix. CI/CD runs through GitHub with automated testing and security scanning. Mobile is Flutter, web is Angular.

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

  • Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

  Disclaimer   It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
  • Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
  • Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
  • Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

title: Head of Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one - who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

What You'll Do

As Head of Engineering, you will lead Radiant's engineering organisation and be accountable for its execution, technical quality, reliability, and scalability.

You'll lead software engineering, platform security engineering, and architecture: an organisation of 30-35 engineers today, growing to 150 to 200+ as Radiant expands internationally. You'll partner closely with Product, the Customer team, Infrastructure, SRE, Operations, the PMO, and the wider technology leadership team.

This is a senior leadership role focused on building a high-performing engineering organisation capable of delivering and operating complex AI infrastructure at scale. You'll stay close to the work through design review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hire and scale the engineering organisation, building a strong leadership layer across Engineering Managers, Principal Engineers, and senior technical leaders.

  • Own engineering hiring, performance, leadership development, succession planning, and organisational health.

  • Design and evolve the engineering organisation as the company scales across teams, sites, and regions.

  • Own the engineering strategy, operating model, and execution in alignment with company and product objectives.

  • Translate business priorities into clear technical plans, sequencing, investment decisions, and delivery commitments.

  • Establish clear ownership, decision-making, and accountability across engineering teams.

  • Drive predictable, high-quality delivery, identifying risk early and intervening where execution drifts.

  • Ensure systems are designed and delivered to be production-ready, reliable, observable, maintainable, and supportable.

  • Strengthen collaboration with infrastructure, SRE, and operations, including effective handover and incident learning.

  • Set and uphold standards across architecture, engineering quality, security, scalability, and operational maturity.

  • Own the roadmap jointly with Product: Product owns what is built, and you own how and when.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for critical technical, architectural, and delivery decisions, brokering decisions between peers and escalating to the CTO when needed.

  • Improve engineering maturity and processes while avoiding unnecessary bureaucracy or loss of delivery momentum.

  • Represent engineering in executive and partner discussions, and join customer escalation reviews with the Customer team.

Your Profile

  • Significant experience leading and scaling engineering organisations of 20+ engineers through multiple stages of growth.

  • Experience managing managers, with a strong track record of hiring and developing Engineering Managers, senior engineers, and technical leaders.

  • Proven experience evolving a smaller engineering group into multiple teams with clear ownership, leadership, and consistent delivery.

  • Experience designing organisational structures, team boundaries, and operating models for increasing scale and complexity.

  • Demonstrated success improving delivery predictability, engineering quality, throughput, and organisational effectiveness.

  • Strong technical background across modern software engineering, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure-heavy products.

  • Experience owning production systems where reliability, observability, scalability, and operational readiness are critical.

  • Comfortable working closely with Product, Infrastructure, SRE, Operations, and Commercial teams.

  • Experience operating across multiple teams, locations, or time zones.

  • Able to communicate technical risk, trade-offs, and opportunity clearly at executive level.

  • Experience with cloud or infrastructure platforms, scaled SaaS, AI/ML platforms, or infrastructure-heavy technology businesses is strongly preferred.

How You Work

  • You move fast and correct course quickly.

  • You challenge openly, then commit.

  • You address underperformance within weeks, with clear coaching and firm deadlines.

  • You keep process light and standards high.

What You Bring

  • Engineering leadership: You build strong teams, strong leaders, and clear accountability.

  • Execution: You create predictability and drive complex programmes through to completion.

  • Technical judgement: You can guide architecture and challenge senior engineers without becoming a bottleneck.

  • Systems thinking: You understand organisations, platforms, and operating models as interconnected systems.

  • Operational mindset: You expect engineering output to be reliable, supportable, and production-ready.

  • Organisational design: You know when structures, processes, or ownership models need to evolve.

  • Calm leadership: You remain decisive under pressure and make clear trade-offs when required.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for engineering outcomes, organisational health, and long-term capability.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: a conversation with our Talent team, then interviews with our CTO and leadership team.

title: Head of Engineering, Platform (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

We are looking for a full-time Head of Engineering to help us build a securities Platform for financial institutions, the first API of that kind in Europe.

You will lead the Platform Tribe, which comprises three teams. These teams are responsible for critical domains such as Infrastructure, Reliability and Development Tooling and shared libraries, all of which are essential for Upvest’s Investment API.

 

The Platform Tribe exists to give every engineer at Upvest the fastest, safest path from idea to production. We own the foundations that make great engineering possible: the infrastructure teams build on, the tools they build with, the shared libraries that let them move fast without reinventing the wheel, and the observability and reliability practices that keep our systems trustworthy at scale. We measure our success not by what we ship, but by how much faster and more confidently every other engineering team can ship — because when the platform is invisible, it's working.

What you’ll do:

  • Own and shape the tribe's roadmap with real autonomy over what we build and why.

  • Partner closely with product tribes to understand their needs and translate them into platform priorities.

  • Work with modern tools and technologies, with real influence over our technical direction and stack.

  • Directly influence the reliability, velocity, and quality of every product we ship.

What you bring:

  • Ability to bridge strategic "why" with engineering solutions, actively discussing tradeoffs and proactively suggesting ideas, demonstrating a strong product engineering mindset.

  • Strong interest in Upvest's product domains and a proactive desire to understand the business use cases Upvest enables for clients.

  • Experience in leading and growing larger engineering teams in a technical leadership capacity.

  • Prior experience within the Fintech domain.

  • Strong technical expertise and hands-on experience in developing highly scalable, distributed, asynchronous, and resilient platforms.

  • Strong work ethic and principles such as pragmatism.

  • A security-focused mindset and a high sense of taking ownership.

It's great if you have:

  • Experience with API-first and SaaS applications.

  • Experience building and running microservice-based event driven distributed applications.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.

 

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Head of Field Engineering, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

You'll build and lead Field Engineering in EMEA from our London office. In EMEA you'll lead both motions: Solutions Architects, who win new business in presales, and Forward Deployed Engineers, who get customers to production and grow them after the sale. You're measured on revenue: new business won and existing accounts retained and expanded across the region.

You'll be one of our first leaders in the region, so this is a player-coach role. You hold the same technical bar as the SAs and FDEs you'll hire, and you'll be hands-on in deals and customer integrations while you build the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Build Field Engineering in EMEA: hire, onboard and lead SAs and FDEs, and split into dedicated SA and FDE leaders as the team grows

  • Own the technical win on new business in EMEA, in partnership with the regional Sales leaders

  • Own post-sales technical success: onboarding to production, adoption, consumption growth, and early detection of churn and contraction risk on EMEA accounts

  • Stay hands-on: run discovery, demos, POCs and competitive evaluations on key deals, and step into critical customer integrations

  • Generate pipeline with Marketing in EMEA: webinars, technical content, events and meetups

  • Run the global operating model locally: SA to FDE handoffs, account health reviews, escalation paths, and the product feedback loop

  • Represent EMEA customers in product and roadmap conversations, ranking gaps by the revenue that depends on them

Requirements

  • A hands-on engineering background: you can build demos, review production integrations and run rigorous evals yourself, at the same technical level as the team you'll hire

  • 6+ years in technical customer-facing roles, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, technical consulting or forward deployed engineering, including 2+ years leading teams, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company

  • A track record of winning technical evaluations, and experience getting customers live after the sale

  • A track record of building a team or a region from an early stage

  • Clear communication with CTOs, engineers and executives across EMEA markets

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA and to our San Francisco HQ

You might excel if you...

  • Have opened or scaled a new region for a US-based technology company

  • Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

  • Have owned or co-owned a revenue number as a technical leader

  • Speak one or more additional European languages

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is an in-person opportunity in London.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer.
