title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
descriptionHtml:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

descriptionHtml:
Du machst unser Wachstum steuerbar.

TEILE entwickelt und produziert High-End-Lautsprecher, DJ- und Audio-Equipment sowie Merch – Design-Objekte mit kompromisslosem Klang. Eine Brand, die man nicht nur hört, sondern auch tragen will. Unsere Systeme spielen in Clubs, auf Festivals, in Bars, Hotels und Restaurants.

Hinter TEILE steht eine weltweite Community mit sehr hoher Reichweite. Du wirst die Person, die TEILE steuerbar macht. Du bringst den Blick eines CFO mit und baust trotzdem gern selbst – vom ersten Forecast bis zur Datenpipeline.

Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CEO und dem Gründerteam zusammen und machst KI von Anfang an zum Kern unserer Steuerung: automatisierte Reportings, datenbasierte Entscheidungen und smarte Prozesse statt manueller Routinen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance & FP&A aufbauen: Planung, Forecast, Liquidität und Reporting – mit einer Steuerungslogik, die mit uns skaliert.

  • Profitabilität sichtbar machen: Deckungsbeiträge pro Produkt, Kanal und Projekt – von der Werkstatt bis zum Webshop.

  • Finanzierung begleiten: Darlehen, Working-Capital-Finanzierung und Investoren-Unterlagen.

  • Eine Datenbasis für alle: Shop-, Marketing-, Produktions-, Vertriebs- und Finanzdaten in einer Plattform zusammenführen (z. B. Shopify) – Dashboards statt Excel-Silos.

  • AI-First denken: Abläufe in Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain und Customer Service automatisieren

  • Tech-Landschaft verantworten: Tools auswählen, Systeme verbinden, externe Dienstleister steuern.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Finance, Controlling oder FP&A – idealerweise in einem produzierenden Unternehmen mit physischen Produkten

  • Du hast Planung, Controlling und Reporting schon einmal selbst aufgebaut – nicht nur übernommen

  • Ein Plus: Hintergrund bei einer Big-4-Gesellschaft (PwC, KPMG, EY, Deloitte)

  • Datenaffinität: BI-Tools, Data-Warehouse-Logik, gern SQL – du baust selbst mit

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung

  • Strategisch denkend, hands-on, pragmatisch – du brauchst kein großes Team, um zu liefern

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Ebenfalls ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Shopify und D2C

Das erwartet dich

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum – du baust deinen Bereich von null auf

  • Direkter Draht zu CEO und Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Ein Produkt, das man hört: High-End-Sound zwischen Club, Festival und Wohnzimmer

  • Starkes Wachstum, neue Kanäle, internationale Projekte – und die Perspektive, ein eigenes Team aufzubauen

Arbeitsmodell

title: Head of GTM & Revenue Operations
descriptionHtml:
THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing, whether you are looking to buy, sell or lease. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

Our team of 600 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in!


THE ROLE

Carwow has just brought its Sell My Car and Get Your Car commercial teams together into one team serving one dealer network. Those dealers buy cars from drivers through Sell My Car and sell cars to drivers through Get Your Car. As Head of GTM & Revenue Operations, you'll design how that team runs: the process, the tooling, the analytics and forecast the business trades on, and the automation that takes the admin away from the day-to-day. The commercial number here depends on how dealers behave on our marketplace each day as much as on the sales pipeline, so this is RevOps with more moving parts than most, and a rare chance to build it from close to the ground up.

The commercial team is around 60 people today, working alongside around 100 in operations, and we plan to scale our commercial operation significantly next year. You'll start with a small team and a clear mandate to build the function the business needs, making the case for investment with the VP's support. There's real room to grow, for the team and for you.

You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations, and you're accountable for the commercial forecast, the sales process and the Salesforce roadmap. The commercial teams own the selling and the relationships and the tech org builds and runs the platform; you work closely with all of them. After a year, success looks like a forecast the business trusts and trades on, one Salesforce and one process across both products, and a clear read of where deals are lost so enablement aims at the right things.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Working with the commercial organisation, sales leadership, workforce management, the trading leads and the central analytics and data teams, you will:

  • Design the operating model: one go-to-market process, pipeline and dealer view across Sell My Car and Get Your Car, with the capacity and headcount plan to match, built with Workforce Management.

  • Shape targets, comp and territories: design them with commercial leadership so each person's number ties to the business outcome.

  • Own the forecast: build a forward-looking commercial forecast on marketplace and pipeline drivers that feeds trading, reconciles to Finance, and gives leadership a clear weekly view of where the number is heading.

  • Own the Salesforce roadmap: one platform for the whole commercial team, with the workflows, sales-engagement tooling and dashboards people actually use, delivered with the tech org.

  • Build in AI and automation from the start: take manual work out of forecasting, reporting and the commercial teams' day, so they spend their time with dealers.

  • Find where performance is lost: use the data to diagnose where reps and teams fall short, from ramp time to call quality to lost deals, agree with sales leadership where training should focus, and measure whether it worked.

  • Build the team and run change: hire and shape the function, and run the commercial PMO so cross-functional programmes land on time with clear owners.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be a perfect match for everything here, so please apply if you're close to the brief. If you meet most of the essentials, we'd like to hear from you.

The essentials:

  • You've led a revenue-operations, commercial-operations or GTM-operations team in a marketplace, growth or B2B sales business

  • You've built a forecast that leadership relied on, and you can explain what drove it when it missed

  • You know Salesforce well as a system of record: you can shape the data model and process, and work with a platform team to deliver it

  • You've designed targets, comp, territories and capacity plans that tie to business outcomes

  • You've grown a team from a small base, hired well and set a clear bar

How you'll work (we'll explore these in interview):

  • Credible with senior people: you make a well-evidenced case, hold it under challenge, and raise the hard truth early

  • Fluent with AI: you use it to work faster and help a team adopt it

Nice to have:

  • Marketplace, two-sided platform or automotive experience

  • Hands-on Salesforce admin or certification, SQL, and sales-engagement tooling such as Groove or Outreach

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Phone screen with a member of the Talent Team

  • First round interview with the hiring manager focussed on prior experience

  • Second round made up of a case study presentation on a revenue-operations problem (we'll send the brief in advance and give you time to prepare)

  • Situational/company values interview with senior members of the leadership team

  • Final round interview with a member of the Exec team

We want everyone to do their best thinking, so if you'd like any adjustments to the process, just let us know.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office, 2 remote

  • Competitive salary

  • Matched pension contributions

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, rising to 30 days after 3 years and 35 after 10 years, with the option to buy 3 additional days

  • 1 day of leave for your wedding, and 1 day when you move house

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, plus fertility treatment and pregnancy loss support

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance

  • Learning and development budget

  • Regular team and company social events

  • Refer-a-friend bonus scheme

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

title: Head of Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.
  • AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.
  • Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission

Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains.

You will:

  • Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures.
  • Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements.
  • Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure: topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability.
  • Own our on-premise infrastructure operations: data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices.
  • Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems.
  • Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure, including GPU workloads and compute clusters.
  • Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms.
  • Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads.

Who we are looking for

We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

You might be:

  • a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;
  • an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;
  • a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;
  • a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have

  • Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as:
    • networking;
    • SRE/reliability;
    • database administration;
    • telecom/voice infrastructure;
    • hardware/on-premise infrastructure.
  • Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains.
  • Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering).
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you stay close to technology, understand technical details and lead through context and expertise.
  • Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work onsite in Paris.

Nice to Have

Experience with:

  • Telecom or carrier infrastructure.
  • Voice platforms or real-time communication systems.
  • PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis operational experience at scale.
  • Dark fiber, peering and advanced networking.
  • Kubernetes in production.
  • GPU infrastructure.
  • Incident command and post-mortem culture.

About You

You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles.

You solve problems before being asked.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems.

You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices.

Why join us

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact.

Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity.

Work on infrastructure that cannot simply be outsourced.

From telecom networks and hardware to distributed systems and AI workloads, you will solve problems where architecture and engineering decisions matter.

Build something from an early stage of maturity.

You will help establish the operational discipline, processes and team structure needed for the next phase of growth.

Work directly with technical leadership.

You will report directly to Sergey, our CTO, who is deeply involved in infrastructure and technical decisions while giving infrastructure leaders the ownership to drive changes.

Recruitment Process

  1. Intro call with Talent AcquisitionUp to 1h — alignment on experience, expectations and motivation.

  2. Two technical conversations with Sergey, CTOFocused on:

  • infrastructure strategy;
  • technical depth;
  • architecture decisions;
  • operational leadership approach.

  1. Meeting with the infrastructure teamOnsite or online session focused on collaboration, problem-solving and engineering culture.

  2. Final conversation with CEO

Logistics

📍 Paris, France
🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed
🏠 Relocation support available

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already done this exact role in this exact environment.

The strongest candidates are often engineers who grew into leadership by taking ownership, solving complex problems and going beyond their formal responsibilities.

If you have built and operated complex infrastructure, enjoy solving ambiguous technical challenges and want to shape a critical engineering domain — we would love to talk.

title: Head of Marketing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Varify Software GmbH

Varify ist die europäische A/B-Testing-Plattform: Festpreis, unbegrenzter Traffic, datenschutzkonform. Über 2.700 Teams weltweit testen mit uns, und unsere AI-Features haben verändert, wie schnell aus einer Idee ein Experiment wird. Das Produkt ist weiter als unsere Außendarstellung. Genau das sollst du ändern.

Deine Rolle

Du übernimmst Marketing bei Varify als Ganzes: Du legst fest, wofür wir stehen und welche Kanäle wir bespielen, und du setzt selbst mit um. Das ist keine reine Führungsrolle. Du schreibst Messaging, baust Landingpages und planst Kampagnen gemeinsam mit dem Team.

title: Head of People Operations
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

  • You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

  • You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

  • You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

  • AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and think in systems. You have the operational depth to manage complex multi-country employment realities, and the leadership to develop hub teams that genuinely own their work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

Lead the Hub Model

  • Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

  • Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

  • Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

  • Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

  • Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

  • Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

  • Own the OKR cascade: every hub has OKRs that roll up through the function; you're accountable for making that cascade real, not formal

  • Define what success looks like in each location — local service standards, local processes, local roadmap

Partner with Domain Leads

Clear interfaces are the model, not the exception:

  • Workplace & Experience — deploy global programs and standards locally; coordinate on facilities, office improvements, and events beyond the local scope

  • Payroll — ensure multi-country payroll accuracy and surface local issues early

  • People Tech — maintain HRIS data quality and drive system adoption across hubs

  • Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

  • Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.

Build the Team

  • Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

  • You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product

Our mission for you

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

Your team

You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.

Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.

Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

Who we are looking for

Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.

Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.

Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.

Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.

Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.

AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.

Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.


90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • You deeply understand trawa's business and product

  • You have established your philosophy of running Product & Tech teams’ delivery

  • You shape new quarterly roadmap and OKR plans for your teams

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • You have assembled the company around your product vision for the entire customer journey

  • Your vision for the customer journey comes to live - first key metrics are moved

  • Your teams follow your rhythm of value delivery in fast measurable iterations

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: This is a rare opportunity to own product end-to-end at a company where product is the business. You won't be managing a feature backlog — you'll be shaping a platform that spans energy trading, real-time asset steering, and enterprise software. Few product roles in Europe offer this combination of complexity, commercial impact, and speed.

Responsibility & Support: You'll join the leadership team with direct impact on company strategy. We support you through regular leadership sessions, cross-department leadership initiatives, and experienced mentors who want to see you succeed.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

descriptionHtml:
Standort: Berlin

Anstellungsart: Vollzeit

Geplanter Start: Q1/Q2 2027

Über Midas Midas ist die führende Plattform für Investmentprodukte. Das 2024 von Dennis Dinkelmeyer (ex Goldman Sachs), Fabrice Grinda (FJ Labs) und Romain Bourgois (ex Ondo Finance) gegründete Unternehmen hat eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. USD abgeschlossen und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter RRE, Framework Ventures, Creandum, HV Capital, Strobe Ventures, Ledger Cathay und Coinbase Ventures. Bis heute hat Midas Emissionen im Volumen von über 4 Mrd. USD ermöglicht und 45 Mio. USD an Erträgen ausgeschüttet.

Midas baut ein neues Geschäftsfeld auf: ein Cash-Management-Produkt für KMUs, die ihre überschüssige Liquidität auf unverzinsten Bankkonten parken. Über Midas legen Unternehmen ihr Betriebskapital mit wenigen Klicks in hochliquide, Ertrag bringende Investmentprodukte an – voll digital, tagesaktuell verfügbar und nahtlos in die tägliche Treasury-Praxis integriert. Das Produkt ist im Stealth-Modus und der Launch ist für Anfang 2027 geplant. Für den Launch stellen wir das kommerzielle Gründungsteam ein.

Die Rolle Als Head of Sales leiten Sie den Sales Desk von Midas in der DACH Region und verkaufen jeden Tag selbst. Sie tragen eine persönliche Quote und bauen ein Team aus Account Executives auf.

Ihre Kernaufgaben

  • Eigener Vertrieb & Pipeline-Generierung: Sie tragen vom ersten Tag an volle Eigenverantwortung für Ihren gesamten Sales-Cycle – von der eigenständigen Pipeline-Generierung und aktivitäts starken Outbound-Akquise über Bedarfsanalyse-, Demo- und Abschlussgespräche mit Geschäftsführern und CFOs bis hin zum Closing und der Neukundengewinnung.

  • Aufbau und Führung des Desks: Sie stellen Full-Cycle Account Executives ein, arbeiten sie ein und führen sie vorbildhaft in der eigenverantwortlichen Pipeline-Entwicklung. Sie schreiben das Sales Playbook für systematischen Outbound-Vertrieb, definieren Aktivitäts- und Conversion-Standards, führen Pipeline-Reviews durch und sorgen für strikte CRM-Disziplin. Zudem etablieren Sie ein regelmäßiges Forecasting, liefern klare Performance-Updates an das Management und unterstützen Ihr Team aktiv durch strukturiertes Field Coaching.

  • Conversion und Onboarding: Sie verantworten die Qualifizierung anhand unserer Ticket-Schwelle, die Demo, die Begleitung durch den KYC-Prozess und die Erstzeichnung. Gemeinsam mit Produkt bauen Sie Reibungspunkte im Onboarding ab.

  • Feedback-Schleife: Sie spiegeln die Rückmeldungen aus dem Markt an die Gründer und das Produktteam zurück: Einwände, Wettbewerber, Pricing, Reibungspunkte im Onboarding.

  • KPIs & Tooling: Sie etablieren messbare Vertriebs-KPIs (Outreach-Volumen, SQLs, Demo-Conversion-Rates, Time-to-Close, AUM-Wachstum) und nutzen moderne Sales-Tools (z. B. Hubspot/Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) zur effizienten Steuerung der Pipeline.

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Sie verfügen über nachweisbare Erfolge im B2B-Vertrieb von Finanz- oder Bankenprodukten an deutsche CFOs und Geschäftsführer

  • Sie haben ein Sales Desk aufgebaut oder geführt, und haben Vertriebsmitarbeiterin auf Junior- bis Mid-Level eingestellt und eingearbeitet

  • Sie sind Closer und Coach zugleich: Sie setzen in ihren eigenen Terminen den Maßstab und machen die Menschen um sich herum besser

  • Builder-Mentalität: Sie bauen gern Pipeline auf, bevor das Produkt live ist, und arbeiten auch ohne fertiges Playbook

Was wir bieten

title: Head of Technical Operations
descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Technical Operations Team 👋

Technology and Data is where Trainline invests most as we build on our position as Europe’s most downloaded travel app. Innovation is at the heart of how we work, and we keep challenging ourselves to move faster, raise quality and manage cost wisely, while making the most of emerging technology trends. The Technical Operations team brings together budget, resourcing, vendor and performance information to give a clear view of where we invest, what we get back and where we can go further.

As Head of Technical Operations, you will be a trusted partner to senior leaders across Technology, Data, Finance and Product. You will shape the insights and recommendations that guide investment and efficiency decisions across the whole portfolio. You will own the technology budget, capacity planning and external vendor relationships, and lead a team of skilled professionals. Working closely with Directors, VPs and executive leaders, you will turn complex information into clear, compelling stories that help everyone move forward together.

In this role as the Head of Technical Operations, you will...🚄

  • Own and manage the Technology budget, working with teams across the department to align spend with our strategic goals and make sure we use our money wisely across teams, tools and initiatives

  • Lead headcount and capacity planning in collaboration with Engineering, Product and Talent, supporting workforce planning and our hiring roadmap so that teams have the right people at the right time

  • Manage relationships with external technology vendors and partners, leading contract negotiations, performance reviews and renewals, while continually improving the value we get for our spend

  • Build and maintain dashboards and operational measures that give clear visibility of delivery progress, incidents and team efficiency, turning data into insight that helps leaders make faster, better-informed decisions

  • Partner across Technology and Data to form clear views and recommendations on how we improve efficiency and get the most from our investment, including where to reallocate spend, reduce waste and speed up delivery

  • Track the benefits we gain from our investments and share what we learn, so that future decisions are even stronger

  • Build trusted relationships with Directors, VPs and executive leaders across Technology, Data, Finance and Product, crafting clear narratives that bring complex financial and operational data to life and encourage confident decisions and action

  • Lead, support and develop your team, creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work

We’d love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Significant experience in a senior technology operations or technology programme management role, with a record of leading teams and delivering results in a complex environment

  • A solid understanding of budget management and financial modelling within a technology setting

  • Experience managing vendor relationships and negotiating contracts that deliver good value

  • Hands-on experience using dashboards, tools and key performance measures to give technology teams clear visibility of how they are performing

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a talent for explaining data through clear, engaging stories

  • The ability to build trust and influence Directors, VPs and executive leaders, shaping narratives that lead to decisions

  • A commercial, curious mindset, with the confidence to form a point of view and make clear recommendations on investment and efficiency

  • Ideally, experience in a high-volume digital or consumer business such as travel, e-commerce or fintech, and familiarity with Agile ways of working in cross-functional teams. We warmly welcome transferable experience from other sectors

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

descriptionHtml:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role

As Head of Technical Program Management for Applied AI, you will drive and own all project execution, customer outcomes, and delivery excellence across LILT’s Applied AI practice

for the world's leading AI labs. Serving as builder and coach, you will lead the people, operations, and systems behind every Applied AI engagement — multilingual and multimodal training data, evaluations, and benchmark programs — and make sure each one ships on time, on budget, and to the highest quality bar. You are responsible for constructing LILT’s technical program management capabilities from the ground up while actively developing, mentoring, and elevating a high-performing team. Operating at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and industrial-scale execution, you hold total accountability for every customer engagement —ensuring every deliverable across your entire team meets the highest standards of precision, speed, and technical rigour.

This is an operator's role: you will balance high-stakes operational ownership with a builder and coach mindset. You will manage and run a high-volume, high-velocity delivery organization: Technical Program Managers, project managers, and the expert and vendor workforces behind them. You bring equal passion to building the operational systems and cadence, capacity models, quality systems, and execution frameworks that power our AI lab deliverables, and coaching your team to operate as high-agency "CEOs" of their respective customer portfolios, , all while staying close enough to the work to step into a critical program or a customer escalation when it matters. You are technically fluent enough to partner with researchers and engineers, but your edge is turning complex, ambiguous customer requirements into reliable, repeatable delivery. While you empower your team to drive day-to-day execution, the buck stops with you for overall portfolio health, customer retention, program SLAs, and delivery outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-end Practice Ownership: Serve as the single point of accountability for customer outcomes across all Applied AI programs — technical delivery, project work and timelines, quality SLAs, margin, and customer satisfaction. You own top-line program success metrics, quality SLAs, delivery timelines, and customer satisfaction across all Applied AI projects.

  • Lead and scale the delivery team: Recruit, mentor, and scale a world-class team of TPMs and project managers. Set clear goals, coach for ownership, unblock across complex technical and operational challenges, and build a team that runs complex programs independently.

  • Run delivery operations and capacity planning at volume: Own capacity planning, staffing, and resource allocation across programs. Turn shifting customer demand into reliable production plans and delivery forecasts that protect speed and margin.

  • Build the delivery operating system: Standardize intake, scoping, kickoff, quality control, reporting, and close-out. Turn individual program learnings into repeatable playbooks, systems, processes, and dashboards.

  • Strategic Customer Partnership & Escalations: Act as executive partner and delivery sponsor for key frontier AI lab relationships. Proactively co-develop benchmark transcreations with customer research leads. Lead escalations, run business reviews, and help shape scope, pricing, and timelines with Sales.

  • Own quality: Partner with Research to standardize quality control across delivery, including embedded calibration, gold sets, inter-annotator agreement, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, model eval pipelines and root-cause analysis into every customer program, ensuring that quality issues are proactively controlled and mitigated.

  • Manage the expert and vendor workforce: Work with Expert Supply and Operations to qualify, manage, and engage multilingual contributors and vendors, with clear performance and cost metrics.

  • Cross-functional Workflow Design and Execution: Design, build, and optimize scalable program frameworks for text, image, video, and audio modalities. Turn complex technical requirements into seamless operational realities, bridging Sales, Engineering, Research, Product, Production, and Engineering to scope and build project workflows that are designed optimally, launched quickly, and executed smoothly

Qualifications

  • Accountable Mindset & Ownership: Proven track record as the final owner of large-scale, mission-critical technical portfolios, with direct accountability for project delivery, customer outcomes, and SLA adherence. Demonstrated experience architecting mitigations for AI-specific operational risks (e.g., dataset contamination, domain drift, quality decay, and SLA vulnerabilities).

About the Role



As an HPC Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in high-performance computing, software development in C/C++ or Rust/Python, backed by a minimum MSc in HPC, Scientific Computing, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with SLURM, AI workloads, advanced algorithms, parallel computer architectures, Linux, network protocols in high performance computing.   • Securing Heterogeneous Environments: Designing security for complex, hybrid platforms integrating cloud, AI/ML workflows, and on-premise, bare-metal hardware.

Requirements

title: Implementation Manager DACH
descriptionHtml:
Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

 

Your impact

As Implementation Manager, you'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, guiding merchants from handover through testing to go live. You'll run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, set go live dates, keep progress on track, and coordinate testing and feedback along the way. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, product and engineering, as well as with merchants directly, keeping everyone aligned as deals move toward launch.

This function is newly formed, so you'll have real influence over how the role and its processes take shape, bringing in your own experience rather than following a fixed playbook. The role is also more technical than it might first appear: you'll get close to the real world edge cases and issues that surface once a solution meets implementation reality, giving you hands on technical exposure without needing a payments or engineering background going in.

Your work protects revenue by keeping live dates on track, and it supports how Mollie scales delivery more broadly, building a structured, dedicated integration phase for its biggest deals. You'll report to Jan-Jaap van Helden.

 

What you'll ship

  • Own the post sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, from handover through testing to go live

  • Run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, setting go live dates and keeping progress on track

  • Organise and track testing, raising issues and feedback as they surface

  • Coordinate across sales, product and engineering colleagues, as well as with merchants directly, to keep everyone aligned

  • Keep agreed go live dates on track, since delays mean missed revenue

  • Maintain documentation and playbooks that make delivery predictable and scalable

     

What you'll bring

  • Up to 3 years of experience in ecommerce or payments, in a similar role

  • Strong organisational and structuring skills, with solid project management ability

  • Genuine technical interest and the ability to understand technical concepts such as APIs, since this role gets close to the edge cases that surface once a solution meets reality

  • An ownership mindset, taking charge of the implementation process rather than reacting to it, while staying flexible within agreed roles and processes

  • Honest, open communication style with a genuine, trustworthy manner, including a strong track record collaborating with pre-sales teams and handling conflict at handover

  • Payments or ecommerce experience, or familiarity with the ecosystem, is a strong plus though not required

 

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

We're now growing our consumer business and building new services for self-employed people and freelancers. To support that, we're looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to run creator campaigns for Taxfix and Steuerbot.

Most people find taxes stressful. Hearing from a creator they already trust that they got money back in one evening is more convincing than an ad. That's why creators are a big part of our marketing. We run the channel in-house with a significant yearly budget and use it both to bring in new users and to build trust in our brands. The hard part is doing both at once: getting new users at a good cost while keeping the content credible for the creator's audience.

This role reports to the Influencer Marketing Lead and focuses at first on our two German brands, Taxfix and Steuerbot.

What you'll do

  • Run and scale creator campaigns from start to finish: find creators, reach out, negotiate, brief them, review content, take it live and report on results.

  • Negotiate deals that make sense for both sides. Push back on first prices and agree on terms like view guarantees or performance-based pay.

  • Build long-term relationships with creators and their managements, and decide how we work with them across both brands.

  • Run frequent hypothesis-driven experiments. We put strong emphasis on asking the right questions, good experiment design, and generating actionable data and interpretations. You own large parts of creator and influencer experimentation.

  • You continue to expand our creator database and context layer, allowing you to work very data and insight driven, and enabling AI agents to work alongside or for you equipped with the right data and context.

  • Automate the repetitive parts of your job with n8n, Claude Cowork/Code and GitHub, so research, scoring and reporting run on their own and you can spend your time on higher value work with creators, negotiations, content and strategy.

  • Seasonal campaign planning across multiple platforms, formats and creator sizes.

What you'll bring

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience running influencer campaigns on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, at a brand or an agency.

  • You’re highly curious about the creator economy and thrive on turning complex, ambiguous challenges into practical solutions in a high-agency role.

  • You’re an effective and confident negotiator who always strives to get the best deal and who’s not shy to walk away from a deal.

  • You’re highly analytical and very comfortable with processing and critically interpreting data sets, with an eye for detail.

  • You are on the path of becoming an AI builder with first basic to advanced workflow automations or other agentic solutions under your belt with measurable impact.

  • You’re experienced in general in how to work with LLMs and agentic solutions effectively, including when to critically review their outputs.

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder with both, internal stakeholders and external managements and creators. You’re fluent in German and English.

If you come from performance marketing, growth, affiliate or creator operations and have worked with creators, apply anyway. We'd like to hear from you.

title: Information Security Officer
descriptionHtml:
Your next mission

Shield critical radar innovations from sophisticated threats. Lock down our infrastructure – keeping our airspace defence rock-solid.

As our Technical Information Security Officer, you lead the technical defence protecting our defence-grade radar systems and intellectual property. You partner closely with IT, DevOps, and Development to design controls, roll out Zero Trust, and secure emerging AI workflows.   • Emerging threat mitigation: Spot and neutralise AI threat vectors like prompt injections and automated exploits. Guard company intellectual property against unintended exposure via public models.

  • Defence and radar connectivity: Build multi-layered security measures for remote radar management and data links. Protect radar systems deployed and operating within active conflict zones.

title: Intern AI & Management Consulting (Value Engineering)
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

As an Intern in AI & Management Consulting you join our Value Engineering team to focus on driving and closing opportunities by identifying and selling the value Celonis can bring to customers. Our Value Engineers (VE) are the trusted advisor for customers and work on the intersection of technology and business. Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions to critical business problems.

The Role:

Value Engineers are the trusted advisors for our prospects and customers and leverage product expertise and business acumen to solve our prospects’ and customers’ most pressing challenges You will gain experience in executing proof of value projects and take part in technical/business discussions with stakeholders. By creating customer-based business cases, you support the strategic business development activities for the French market.

The work you’ll do:

  • Analyze data from our customers to increase transparency in business processes
  • Understand the pain points of our customers and translate them into actionable use cases in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
  • Quantify financial impact of use cases implemented in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform and prepare management ready presentations
  • Present findings together with your team in front of customers’ C-level and decision makers
  • Leverage Celonis data modeling and AI capabilities to uncover process inefficiencies, generate insights, and deliver high impact, data driven value propositions to clients.
  • Pitch the Celonis AI value proposition and vision to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy
  • Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen

The qualifications you need:

  • Student in the field of Technology & Management, Industrial/ Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Business Administration, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program. 
  • Strong communication skills and interest in interacting with potential customers
  • Experience in consulting and highly interested in data analytics
  • Knowledge in SQL or related database query languages
  • Analytical mindset and the ability to work in a structured manner and quickly comprehend new topics
  • Availability from October onwards for 6 months (full-time)
  • Effective communicator and fluent in English and French
  • The internship is possible in Paris or Madrid

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

title: Internship
descriptionHtml:
About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

We build software that connects the energy market to thousands of physical assets, and we own almost all of it ourselves. You’ll be directly responsible for building the product, on real projects rather than intern projects.

  • Own real engineering projects end to end, from working out the problem to shipping it.

  • Work on our own stack, with AI as part of how you build every day.

  • Work directly with commercial teams, because the hard problems here are not purely technical.

 

Exciting challenges

  • Own an entire challenge. Recent interns built forecasting functions around seasonality and temperature and owned the build-out of a data analytics pipeline and a liquidity risk monitoring system.

  • Work where the market meets the physical world. Market events have to reach thousands of devices correctly, and the rules change while the assets are already running. Nobody hands you a defined task.

 

Who you are

  • You’ve excelled at something. You can point to an achievement that took unusual discipline and sustained effort. We want to understand what you accomplished and the work it took to get there.

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership. You’ve taken responsibility for a project, product, or initiative and seen it through. You can explain your decisions and show the result.

  • You go where the complexity is. You want to understand the hard part of a system well enough to solve it.

 

References

Vera Lavrova

 

Why join us?

As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive.

Building a power company from scratch brings complex, rewarding challenges and the chance to solve Europe’s energy crisis for the long term. You’ll learn from people with exceptional depth in their fields, challenge each other’s thinking and take responsibility from the start.

descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Your Mission with us

Do you want to learn how to run successful campaigns with some of Europe's most exciting influencers and build lasting partnerships?

We are looking for an intern for at least six months in Influencer & Content Creator Marketing. You will support our creator marketing team in bringing our vision of a healthier life through innovative probiotics to more people. Working alongside a dynamic and motivated team, you will help grow our brand Kijimea in the Italian and Spanish market through authentic influencer collaborations across all different creator levels and creative social media campaigns.

 

Your Tasks

  • You support the identification and outreach of suitable influencers and content creators, with a focus on the Italian and Spanish market.

  • You stay in close contact with influencers and content creators, coordinate their content, and maintain long-term relationships.

  • You help prepare and conduct negotiations and draft cooperation agreements.

  • You contribute creative campaign ideas, help implement them with the team, and analyze performance (reach, engagement, ROI).

Your Profile

  • You can support our team as an intern for at least six months onsite in our office in Gräfelfing (near Munich).

  • You have an affinity for social media and enthusiasm for influencer marketing. Ideally, you already have initial experience in marketing or with influencers/creators - knowledge of the Italian and Spanish market (media and brand landscape, influencers, consumer behavior) is a strong advantage.

  • You work in a structured, data-driven way and with great attention to detail

  • You communicate confidently with external partners and thrive in a fast-paced and analytical environment

  • You speak Italian and English fluently (C1 or higher) and Spanish at conversational (B1-B2) level. German and other European languages is an advantage

 

Our Promise

We offer you a varied, demanding job with exciting tasks and wide scope for shaping your role! With us, you will find short decision-making paths, responsibility from day one, and the freedom to try new approaches. You will join a highly motivated team and a real sense of purpose: with your personal contribution, help give millions of people a new lease on life.

title: Internship - Junior Venture Analyst
descriptionHtml:
About Marble

Marble is a climate tech venture studio. We partner with scientists, engineers, and operators to create companies solving hard climate problems in the world's largest industries.

Our first 15 companies are building transformative products across energy, industry, agriculture, and climate resilience. 100% have been successful in raising follow-on to date. We are looking to partner with exceptional individuals to create our next venture.

About The Role

We are hiring a Junior Venture Analyst intern to join the Marble team and support the market and commercial exploration of key opportunity areas in climate tech.

You will work directly with Partners, senior team members, and brilliant founders on a mission to turn the tide on the climate crisis. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with some of the brightest and most mission driven individuals you’ll meet!

You will be immersed into the worlds of climate and deep tech venture creation. Expect direct exposure to the many aspects of running a climate tech studio: developing new opportunity theses, supporting founders on strategy and fundraising, running customer reserach, and forming a view on which companies are worth building.

This internship is a great fit for a student with a passion for climate tech and venture, with prior exposure in fast-paced environment where they had to own work, navigate ambiguity, and help shape key decisions (e.g. startups, scaleups, VC, corporate dev, consulting, etc.)

Location: HQ in Paris, Station F

Language: English fluency required. French fluency preferred.

Period: 6-month internship starting as soon as possible

Responsibilities

Founder & company-building support. You'll partner with our Founders in Residence as they turn a technical idea into a real business. That starts with validating their assumptions through market research — forecasts, policy drivers, competition maps, key insights — and goes further into helping them shape business-model options, go-to-market and expansion strategy, roadmap, and fundraising plans. This is effectively strategic consulting: you have a direct say in how an innovation becomes a company, and you diligence each opportunity with full objectivity — do you genuinely believe this will be a fund-returner for Marble?

Opportunity & thesis research. You'll work alongside the venture team as they develop new theses and decide where Marble should build next. Your job is to bring the business lens to that work — sizing markets, mapping the competitive landscape and market structure, identifying the real gaps, and pressure-testing whether an opportunity is genuinely venture-scale. You are the commercial and investor eye in the room.

Fundraising Operations. Support Partners on fundraising for our second startup studio vintage, as well as potential new vehicles. This includes: investor research (e.g. HNWIs, Family Offices, Fund of Fund, other LPs), data room material preparation, CRM updates, meeting scheduling and follow-ups, etc.

Customer development. You'll help run our structured outreach to connect with leading experts and gather insight through interviews, and you'll build out the customer pipeline as we push to "sell" the vision as far as it will go.

Portfolio & studio support. On an ad-hoc basis you'll support portfolio companies after spin-out, with, for instance, their first external fundraise post-Marble. You will also contribute to the studio operations that shape how Marble builds going forward, by notably drafting guides and templates used by founders regarding their commercial and financial deliverables while in program.

Across all of them, you'll turn your work into clear deliverables — memos, decks, and spreadsheet models (including light financial modeling such as cap tables and projections) — that feed directly into real decisions.

Requirements

This internship is a unique opportunity for a entrepreneurial individual who’s excited to operate in a fast-paced, high-context environment

  • You are studying for a Master’s degree at a top engineering, business school, or university

  • You already had exposure (e.g. internship, school project, etc) to startups, strategy consulting, VC or corporate development.

  • You are fluent / native in English, and ideally in French as well.

Your ability to learn on the job is more important than ticking every single box. However we would especially love to hear from you if:

  • You’re passionate about climate tech, startups, industry, energy, venture creation. You are familiar with the key trends and relevant ecosystems.

  • You’re organized, responsive, and can manage many moving parts without dropping the ball.

  • You’re a strong communicator and take pride in creating clean, structured deliverables.

  • You’ve done basic financial modeling and are comfortable working with cap tables and business plans.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks with a "learning by doing" attitude.

  • You excel at using modern software and AI products to increase your work leverage, such as Claude, Gemini, Notion, Slack, Airtable, Google Suite, etc. Familiarity with CRMs and specialist AI tools (e.g. Lemlist, Exa, Clay, etc) is a welcome plus.

What We Offer

  • €1,600 monthly internship stipend

  • Office located at Station F in Paris. Flexible remote days are possible

  • 5 days off

  • Meal vouchers (Swile), 50% transport refund

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • High ownership, rapid learning curve, and meaningful scope

  • A chance to help build the next generation of Marble companies

We believe that a diverse group of minds is key to solving the climate crisis. We encourage women and people of colour to apply. Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply for an opportunity unless they feel they meet every single qualification. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and mission-driven cohort. If you’re excited about the programme but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with what you read on our website, we encourage you to apply anyways!

Compensation: €0 – €1.5K per month
