descriptionHtml:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, or atmospheric sciences.

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

Apply with the button on this page. Links to papers or code are welcome.

title: ML Ops Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our ML teams build and optimize the models at the core of our autonomy stack. As a team scales, the workflow the models run on needs to move from a manual, organically grown setup onto a controlled, automated, and reproducible footing.

As an MLOps Engineer, operating out of Paris, Lausanne, or Zurich, you will own that machinery, across training and evaluation pipelines, CI, experiment tracking, and reproducibility, so that models are trained, benchmarked, and compared in a controlled and repeatable way. You free the modelers to focus on models rather than infrastructure, and you set the standard the team builds on.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Training & Evaluation Pipelines: Build and maintain the reproducible training and evaluation pipelines the modelers run on, along with the pipeline templates and tooling they build on. The verdict on model quality stays with the modelers.

  • CI & Reproducibility: Bring CI to ML work and make runs genuinely comparable across code, config, and models.

  • Model Registry: Maintain a model lifecycle registry, from sandbox to production.

  • Experiment Tracking & Logging: Keep results comparable and traceable across the team.

  • Test Automation: Help wire on-device and hardware-in-the-loop test runs into automation and collect the results.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: A degree in a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical pipeline, CI, and reproducibility experience matters more than the specific degree.

  • MLOps Experience: Built and maintained ML pipelines, CI, and experiment tracking in a real production or research setting, ideally taking a manual flow and making it controlled and reproducible.

  • Engineering: Strong in Python and software engineering for infrastructure.

  • Bonus: Experience wiring pipelines to on-device or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

  • Attributes: Systematic, reliability-minded, and service-oriented so the team is enabled, pragmatic, and good at reducing friction.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Office Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

Overview

We're looking for someone hungry to learn to join us as our Office Manager!

You'll get an inside look at how a high-performing tech startup operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth startup moving and who have a passion for making things run smoothly around them.

Your day-to-day will involve hands-on support across logistics, workflows (onboarding, offboarding, IT), office administration and socials, events and internal operations. Beyond this, you'll have the opportunity to assist with projects wherever an extra set of capable hands is needed, including exposure to finance and other internal teams. Along the way, you’ll gain practical insight into startup life and how different functions collaborate with one another.

This is a rare opportunity to learn first-hand from a uniquely high-performing team as we scale a category-defining tech startup at speed.

What You Can Expect

  • Operational Cadence: You’ll help handle the admin, workflows and logistics that free up our leaders to focus and enable the entire business to move faster. You'll be part of running our onboarding, offboarding, contracting, scheduling, and administrative workflows - so being good with technology is a big plus!

  • Beating heart of keeping the office culture running: you will help maintain our office environment (weekly food orders, office moves and fit-outs, managing our service providers for cleaning and reconfiguration) and plan our regular London socials and events.

  • Wide exposure: You'll assist with administrative projects across all of Operations, whether it's helping out with month-end bookkeeping or regular payment runs, or helping the sales team plan their quarterly kick-offs.

  • Learn by doing: Get involved in a range of tasks - help with onboarding, audits, events, socials, merch and scheduling. Where we have our company monthly meetings, you will also get exposure to IT and AV to make our hybrid events a great experience.

  • Momentum: You’ll get a front row seat to what it's like to scale a company just as we enter a phase of high growth, with the systems, challenges, and excitement that come with it.

About you

We’re looking for someone curious, proactive, and ready to roll up their sleeves. You might be a recent grad, early in your career or pivoting from a different field - what matters is your energy, problem-solving mindset, organisational skills, and desire to learn.

  • You’re organised, resourceful, and detail oriented: you like systems, details, and getting things done well. you get a lot of satisfaction from knowing that all the I's are dotted and the T's are crossed. you take satisfaction from knowing that things are ordered and up-to-date

  • You’re technical for a non-technical person: you you can figure out how to do stuff with new tech tools pretty easily

  • You’re exceptional at time management: you can comfortably manage changing priorities and are able to switch gears with ease and aren't thrown off by people making regular requests at the last minute

  • You’re humble: we're seldom the stars of the show in operations, and parts of the job are not as glamorous! You take satisfaction in a job well done without needing to feel you own the limelight

  • You’re good with people: you’re just as comfortable chatting to a senior leader as you are with a new hire - you'll be one of the first people that a lot of our new joiners meet.

  • You're excited about startups: not just as a job, but as an environment where you can learn quickly, contribute meaningfully, and build the kind of hands-on operational expertise that only comes from being at the centre of a fast-growing company.. You adapt quickly, handle ambiguity, and keep things moving forward.

  • You're based in London or nearby: this is an in-office role in Victoria.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem.

Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit.

Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken.

Dit ga je doen

Jouw onderzoek:

Je maakt een inventarisatie van bestaande en nieuwe, innovatieve instrumenten en methoden, en/of je formuleert succesfactoren voor één specifiek instrument (een best practice). Samen met jou en je begeleiders bepalen we de precieze afbakening.

Je onderzoek is onderdeel van het project Kwartiermaker water- en bodemsysteemanalyses (Interprovinciaal Overleg en het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat). Mogelijke resultaten zijn een bijdrage aan de analyse en toolbox van het kwartiermakerschap, een publicatie over best practices, of een instrumentenkoffer voor waterschappen, provincies en het ministerie van IenW.

Je bent daarmee onderdeel van het kwartiermakerverhaal, maar blijft niet bij één project. Voor je onderzoek kun je ook putten uit andere lopende trajecten van ons team, zoals het Deltaprogramma Ruimtelijke Adaptatie (DPRA). Daar spelen vergelijkbare vragen over hoe je samenwerking tussen overheden en regio’s echt werkend krijgt. Zo haal je extra inzichten en praktijkvoorbeelden op en zie je hoe verschillende dossiers elkaar versterken.

Naast je eigen onderzoek werk samen met een team van ervaren adviseurs aan maatschappelijke dossiers voor ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en drinkwaterbedrijven:

  • Aansluiten bij werksessies en de reflectiekring: je ziet hoe bijeenkomsten met bestuurders, beleidsmakers en wetenschappers worden gestructureerd en werkt de uitkomsten uit tot heldere syntheses.

  • Analyseren en schrijven: je voert interviews uit, analyseert beleidsdocumenten en schrijft mee aan rapportages en publicaties.

  • Initiatief nemen: je werkt mee aan inhoudelijke kennissessies en netwerkevenementen om het watercluster van Berenschot op de kaart te zetten.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je maakt deel uit van het team Duurzame Leefomgeving; een groep van 22 bevlogen adviseurs met specialisaties in ruimtelijke ordening, planologie en bestuurskunde. Dit team is onderdeel van de adviesgroep Energie en Leefomgeving, waarin zeventig adviseurs samenwerken aan diverse vraagstukken in de fysieke leefomgeving. Je werkt in wisselende projectteams om iedere opdracht optimaal te bemensen, waarbij we naast het inhoudelijke vraagstuk ook governance, organisatie-inrichting, veranderopgaven en regionale samenwerking meenemen in onze advisering.


Dit neem je mee

Je bent een nieuwsgierige en analytisch sterke student die maatschappelijke vraagstukken weet te verbinden met onderzoek en praktijk.

Daarnaast:

  • volg je een masteropleiding in de richting van planologie, watermanagement, omgevingswetenschappen of een vergelijkbare studie

  • heb je affiniteit met vraagstukken rondom water, klimaatadaptatie, ruimtelijke ordening of publieke samenwerking

  • beschik je over sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden

  • werk je zelfstandig, maar zoek je actief de samenwerking op

  • beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling. Studenten van Wageningen University & Research, Rijksuniversiteit Groningen, Universiteit van Amsterdam, TU Delft en Radboud Universiteit worden nadrukkelijk uitgenodigd om te reageren.

Dit bieden we jou

  • Een uitdagende onderzoeksstage voor 5 tot 6 maanden.

  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis).

  • Intensieve begeleiding door ervaren adviseurs en inhoudelijk experts.

  • De mogelijkheid om een directe bijdrage te leveren aan actuele maatschappelijke opgaven.

  • Een waardevol professioneel netwerk binnen ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en kennisinstellingen.

  • Een stage waarin onderzoek en praktijk nauw met elkaar verbonden zijn.

  • De kans om ervaring op te doen in een dynamische adviesomgeving en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen als onderzoeker en adviseur.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma. Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

The Day Ops Manager is a critical role at our depots. As the Day Ops Manager, you are accountable for site performance during your shift—end-to-end across under-the-roof and on-the-road operations.

For on-the-road, you will manage and lead driver set-off in the morning while proactively supporting drivers and their service levels throughout the day. In the depot, you will oversee any daytime under-the-roof activities and bridges required from the previous day/week, as well as forward labour planning.

You will lead a team of Coordinators and you will need to have the highest standards of professionalism and discipline, leading by example in every moment. This is an on-site role embedded in the day-to-day operations.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Lead shift during rotation - managing Shift Managers, Coordinators, Fleet Specialist - to deliver exceptional OTR & UTR day-time performance.

  • Receive handover from Night Manager, deliver handover to mid-Shift Manager.

  • Be the GM’s primary support & deliver strong handovers

  • Lead & inspire, & develop and performance manage, team on OM’s shift rotation.

  • OTR:

    • DSP management - DSP Capacity, Account management relationships, and performance management.

    • HIVED Partner Driver Capacity and pool management (Plan vs Actual).

    • HIVED Partner Driver service level management

    • Legal compliance (hours on road, breaks, safety checks).

  • UTR:

    • Labour planning for week-ahead & night.

    • Managing day activities, e.g. sortation as relevant, preparation for sortation.

  • Succession planning for week ahead + 6-week glance for their side of the week, & peaks.

  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives & Develop standards and operating procedures.

What you’ll be accountable for 🤝

  1. All on-road activities, including driver capacity, driver compliance, overall site performance (SLA, Delivery Success).

  2. All in-depot day-to-day and planning activities including people (labour pool, engagement, leadership succession planning), safety (auditing and near miss/incident reporting), quality (SLA, set-off/on-time dispatch), and cost (labour planning D+1/W+1/TPH).

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 4-8 years’ experience leading fast-paced OTR / dispatch / last-mile operations.

  • Strong command of driver operations, route execution, and dispatch accuracy.

  • Hands-on shift leadership with ability to manage 30–100+ staff via supervisors. Ability to lead and coach team.

  • High urgency, strong communication, strong escalation habits.

  • Comfortable solving real-time operational pressure during peak windows.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Competitive market-related salary. Including the opportunity to work overtime when required.

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays. If you're on on 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

  • Cycle to work scheme

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - We leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - kindness requires us to be fair, consistent and work together to move HIVED forward.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started.

  • 💰 We Are Resourceful - Resources are scarce and our business depends on our ability to use resources wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

title: Opto-Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

We are looking for an Opto-mechanical Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and play a critical role in the design, integration, and manufacturing of opto-mechanical systems for our photonic products. This role will sit at the intersection of mechanical design, optics, and manufacturing, helping us translate optical designs into robust, manufacturable hardware.

You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. You will be expected to troubleshoot mechanical and optical integration issues, iterate on designs quickly, and help establish repeatable, production-ready opto-mechanical solutions. Fresh graduates with strong relevant project, internship, or academic experience are welcome to apply.

What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

  • Model and analyse optical systems and tolerances using Zemax

  • Translate optical design requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs

  • Perform tolerance analysis to ensure optical alignment and performance across manufacturing variation

  • Build and test prototypes to validate opto-mechanical designs against optical performance targets

  • Support fibre-to-chip and free-space alignment integration for photonic assemblies

  • Work closely with manufacturing team and vendors to ensure designs are suitable for production and assembly

  • Investigate and resolve mechanical or thermal issues affecting optical performance (e.g. misalignment, drift, stress-induced effects)

  • Create and maintain design documentation, drawings, and version-controlled files

  • Collaborate with suppliers on machining, coatings, and assembly processes

  • Support root cause analysis for opto-mechanical failures identified in test or field use

What we're looking for

  • Proficiency in SolidWorks for mechanical design and drafting (2+ years of hands-on experience)

  • Experience with Zemax or similar optical design/simulation software (2+ years of hands-on experience)

  • Solid understanding of optics fundamentals (alignment, tolerances, beam propagation, focusing)

  • Some industrial, internship, or substantial project experience in opto-mechanical, mechanical, or optical engineering

  • Ability to perform tolerance stack-up analysis for optical and mechanical systems

  • Comfortable working hands-on in laboratory and prototyping environments (hands-on lab /manufacturing experience)

  • Strong troubleshooting mindset with a practical, iterative approach to engineering

  • Ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional engineering teams

  • Able to travel to vendor sites to transfer knowledge and troubleshoot problems.

Even better if you have

  • Experience with photonic or semiconductor packaging and assembly

  • Familiarity with fibre alignment, free-space optics, or laser-based systems

  • Experience with thermal or structural analysis (FEA) as it relates to optical performance

  • Exposure to manufacturing or production environments

  • Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing, and its application to precision optical assemblies

  • Familiarity with material selection for optical and thermal stability

We are open to candidates from Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or related technical disciplines. Fresh graduates with strong relevant experience through projects, internships, or research are encouraged to apply.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across optics, mechanics, and manufacturing, with direct influence on how advanced AI hardware is designed and built.

You will also have access to cutting-edge equipment, collaborative engineering teams, and the chance to help shape opto-mechanical design capability from the ground up.

title: Organic & AI Search Manager
descriptionHtml:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The Role:

The way people find information is changing. Search now includes AI-generated answers, large language model (LLM) citations, and zero-click journeys. People often get an answer without visiting a website, so how a brand is understood and cited matters as much as where its pages rank.

We’re looking for an Organic & AI Search Manager to help Paddle show up well in those answers. You’ll shape how Paddle is understood, cited, and recommended by both people and machines. Ranking pages is part of that. Being cited and recommended is the rest. You’ll work across organic strategy, AI discoverability, and content, partnering closely with our Brand, product marketing (PMM), and Growth teams so the content we create is easy to find, trust, and surface in AI-generated answers.

  • Link organic and AI visibility to commercial goals, and influence pipeline through the content and topics we prioritise

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

title: Partner Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our AI-native financial platform gives modern, global companies automated accounting, real-time reporting and financial flows that move at the speed of the business. In a short time we've become the operating core for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot.

The largest finance transformations don't start with a demo. They start with a Big 4 firm or a technology partner putting Light through its paces on behalf of their clients. Come help us win those rooms and make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The role

TLDR: Be the technical lead when Big 4 firms and technology partners evaluate Light, and turn those evaluations into strategic enterprise deals.

Before a Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG practice recommends Light to its clients, or a tech vendor builds Light into its offering, they test us hard: scripted scenarios, self-paced proof-of-value windows, architecture and security reviews, then a readout to their partners. You run that cycle end to end. You'll work directly with our founders, Partnerships, Sales and Product, and as an early member of the team you'll write the playbook every future partner evaluation follows.

What you'll do

  • Run partner evaluations end to end. Turn a partner's test scenarios into scripts, environments and success criteria; run self-paced proof-of-value windows with weekly check-ins; lead the final readout.

  • Be the technical voice in the room. Run tailored demos and deep dives for Big 4 advisory and audit teams, CFO-office practices and vendor architects. Own objections on integrations, data migration, security, controls and audit trail.

  • Map Light to complex finance. Translate multi-entity, multi-currency, consolidation, revenue recognition and statutory reporting requirements into how Light handles them, and say clearly where it doesn't yet.

  • Enable partners to sell and deliver Light. Build demo environments, playbooks, reference architectures and certification content so partner teams can run Light without us in the room.

  • Close strategic deals. Partner with Sales and Partnerships on joint account plans, enterprise scoping and solution design through to signature and handover to Implementation.

  • Feed the roadmap. Bring patterns from every evaluation back to Product and Engineering, and build AI-powered tooling that makes the next evaluation faster.

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Pre-Sales lead for ERP or finance software (vendor side preferred), or in a Big 4 ERP / finance transformation practice.

  • A strong accounting foundation: close, consolidation, intercompany, multi-currency, revenue recognition and controls. You can hold your own with a Big 4 partner or a group controller.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Workday) and real implementation projects: data migration, integrations, APIs.

  • A track record of running structured evaluations, RFPs or proofs of concept with large or demanding buyers, and winning them.

  • Executive presence and crisp writing. You make complex things simple, in a demo, a workshop or a one-page readout.

  • Genuinely AI-native. You've changed how you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow.

Bonus points

  • Ex-Big 4 (advisory or audit) and a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent).

  • Experience in a partner or alliances SE role, building channel enablement programs.

  • Exposure to IFRS and local GAAP across several European markets, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 security reviews.

  • You've configured AI agents in production or built your own tools with them.

Probably not for you if: you've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed, or you prefer a polished demo script to a hard question from an auditor.

title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
descriptionHtml:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you’ll be doing
We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.

  • Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.

  • Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.

  • Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.

  • Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.

  • Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.

  • Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.

  • Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.

  • Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction.

  • Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win.

  • [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training.

     
 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role

You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract.

What you'll be doing

People Operations

  • Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle.

  • Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution.

  • Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early.

  • Own payroll input end to end: collate, calculate and submit each month, including bonuses and comp changes. Manage the provider and partner with Finance on reporting and year-end.

  • Own benefits end to end as the main contact for providers, systems, data and employee advice, keeping policies and materials current.

  • Cut manual effort across the lifecycle by building AI-native workflows, so every routine people process is automated by default, then coach the business to use them. Own continuous improvement across People Ops.

  • Partner with IT on joiner and leaver access automation, and on cost and data audits.

Office Management & Socials

  • Run the office environment and vendor relationships, including routine upkeep like weekly snack orders and post. Cover health and safety as a trained First Aider and Fire Marshal, and provision hardware fast.

  • Own the company social calendar and rituals, from bi-weekly Flock o'Clock (working closely with the CEO) to quarterly Town Halls and larger events, keeping them engaging and on budget.

What you'll need

  • Hands-on People or HR Operations experience, ideally in a fast-moving scale-up, with real ownership of end-to-end processes. CIPD or equivalent experience required.

  • Hands-on payroll input and benefits administration. HiBob experience is a plus.

  • Strong HRIS skills across workflows, automations and integrations, plus confident data and spreadsheet ability.

  • Real evidence of building with AI: workflows or tools you've shipped and use, not ones you've only read about.

  • Exceptional organisation and judgement. You spot what needs doing and get ahead of it, you build the credibility that lets you influence without leaning on authority, and you treat confidential matters with discretion.

  • A quick, first-principles learner who is comfortable with pace, ambiguity and autonomy.

  • Working knowledge of UK employment law, compliance and people governance.

  • Low ego and high standards. You care most that the work is right and well run.

Benefits

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

title: Ph.D. Researcher. Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps
descriptionHtml:
Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology

About the Position

The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).

This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.

Key objectives include:

  • Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.
  • Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.
  • Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.
  • Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.

The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.

Applicant Profile

Mandatory requirements:

  • Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.
  • Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.
  • Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.
  • Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.
  • A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.
  • Documented experience in practical research work.
  • Strong skills in academic English writing (peer-reviewed papers, reports, or equivalent).

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

  • Monthly stipend of €1,650
  • Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
  • Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
  • Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Application Details

  • Expected start date: September, 2026

Application package must include: 

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);
  • Academic transcripts ;
  • A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals;
  • 2 recommendation letters;

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR: This is not a regular engineering job. We're looking for exceptional builders who help us design and ship systems that define how the world's largest companies operate in the age of AI.

WHY CONDUCT
The world's largest companies are slowed down by the software they run on. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs IT complexity and unlocks entirely new levels of speed, output, and ambition. We believe this is a generation-defining mission.

Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $60M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct - we value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we will make sure this is the place you do yours too.

WHO WE HIRE
We are relentless builders, and we're looking for people who share that obsession with shipping to customers.

As our founding Platform Engineer, your role is to build and scale a reliable, resilient, observable, performant and secure platform that makes our product engineers faster. We care about outcomes: you should be excited by building the foundations that let us ship a killer product fast, not by hard infrastructure problems for their own sake (though you'll have plenty of those).

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have owned infrastructure - networks, databases, deployments - through a period of real scale at a fast-growing startup or scale-up.

  • Treat infrastructure as code by default (Terraform or similar) and stay on top of the latest platform tooling

  • Simple, well-reasoned system design. Solutions that solve the problem and ship fast, rather than the perfect setup on a six-month roadmap

  • Have informed, strong opinions on the big calls - like whether to stay on Postgres or move to something like Supabase or PlanetScale

  • Understand how AI changes infrastructure - LLM gateways, caching, flaky providers, agent sandboxes, durable execution. You don't need to be an AI researcher, but you've played with the tools and have a point of view

  • Build clean abstractions and paved paths that other engineers actually want to use

We look for exceptional talent, regardless where you spike. Experience level matters less than the quality of your thinking and the evidence of what you've shipped; building and scaling platforms with modern tooling, rather than just maintaining them.

We hire the best to join our team in London, wherever they come from (we sponsor visas and provide relocation support!). We're convinced diverse teams ship better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Everything that sits below the product code. Today that work is shared across the team; you'll own it, with the autonomy to set the direction, decide what matters most, as well as scope and prioritise work yourself with the backing of the broader engineering team. As our engineering team grows fast, every improvement you make compounds across everyone building Conduct.

  • Deployment: fully automated, repeatable deployments of the whole platform, so we can stand up new regions - starting with the US.

  • Enterprise-grade security: customer-provided encryption keys, network boundaries and tenant isolation that hold up to the scrutiny of the world's largest companies

  • Bringing core services in-house: running durable execution, vector search and agent sandboxes inside our own infrastructure rather than renting them as a service

  • Data: scaling and tuning our databases, and owning where our data layer goes next

  • Developer experience: a fast, reliable local setup, preview environments from any branch, and build tooling and CI that keep up with a growing team

  • Observability: end-to-end tracing, structured logging and alerting that product engineers can self-serve

  • AI infrastructure: our LLM gateway, model routing, cost monitoring and resilience to flaky providers

OUR STACK
Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers—fast—without compromising on quality and engineering.

Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you're strong, we're sure you'll pick it up fast.

Here's our setup:

  • Azure, managed with Terraform: everything as code, with multi-cloud integrations for LLM providers across AWS, GCP and others

  • Kotlin and TypeScript services in a containerised monorepo, with CI/CD on GitHub Actions

  • Temporal and PortKey: durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing at the core of our platform

  • Postgres for our data layer, with TurboPuffer for vector search

  • Agent sandboxes running on Daytona and other providers

  • OpenTelemetry and Honeycomb for observability

title: Platform Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.


Why We Need a Platform Security Engineer Now

Omnea takes security seriously. In an era where exploits and supply chain attacks are being discovered and conducted faster than ever before, it’s vital that we stay on the cutting edge of keeping our systems and our customers’ data safe.

 

Hardening our systems is only part of the solution. As we scale out to more industries with their diverse security requirements, we want another individual who can help us attain and maintain higher levels of compliance certification.

 

What We're Looking For

We're hiring at both Level 3 (Senior) and Level 4 (Staff). For calibration, candidates typically bring 5+ years of platform engineering experience in high-growth, cloud-native SaaS environments, but we care more about impact than years. We’re looking for that “T”-shaped skillset where the candidate’s depth is in Cloud Security.

 

Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have a product engineering background but caught the bug for security and cares deeply about enabling people to work fast, safely. Finally, we’re looking for someone who sees security as an enabler and force-multiplier and answers questions with a “Yes, here’s how we do it securely” attitude as opposed to the flat “No” security teams are too often renowned for.

 

What You'll Do

  • Implement and take ownership of our Security roadmap. Working with the Platform Lead, a successful candidate will steadily take ownership over the Platform Security Roadmap, leading implementations and experiments to level up Omnea’s security posture.

  • Own Security Tooling. From safe-chain plugins to SAST/DAST tooling, we want someone who’s keen to get stuck in, onboard, and evolve our tooling to ensure our posture stays at the bleeding edge.

  • Deliver Compliance Programs. Omnea plans to tackle multiple additional compliance certifications to enable the business to serve some of the most regulated industries on the planet. You’ll have a massive hand in making sure we’re up to those standards.

  • Collaborate with our DevX streams. Omnea ships fast, and we want to ship even faster. Making sure we can enable that safely and securely will become your wheelhouse.

  • Implement hardening patterns. See an area where code security could be improved? Let’s do it, and do it in a way that can be scaled out across the entire codebase and easily implemented by the rest of the engineering staff.


What Can You Expect?

  • A strong team. You'll join a platform team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will push you to do your best work.

  • Modern, cloud-native stack. Everything serverless and IaC-driven (AWS, Pulumi, TypeScript end-to-end).

  • Continuous delivery. We deploy multiple times a day. Your work determines how fast and safely the whole engineering org ships.

  • Scalability challenges. As we 10x revenue, you'll be a part of evolving our infrastructure to defend against new security threats and keep us one step ahead.

  • Customer impact. Delivering on our compliance goals and successfully handling audits.

  • Massive ownership. You own problems end-to-end, from brainstorming through to production.

  • Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.


About You

  • Platform engineer & builder. You design reliable infrastructure and write clean production code (TypeScript or similar). You've built and maintained CI/CD pipelines, IaC, and security gates at scale.

  • Cloud-native. Deep knowledge of AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, IAM, networking), or equivalent cloud-native experience. You understand serverless and its trade-offs.

  • Security as an enabler. You think about engineers and business as your customers. You automate toil, improve feedback loops, and care deeply about making other people productive.

  • Commercially minded. You understand that infrastructure & security exist to serve the product and the business. You make trade-offs with that in mind.

  • Bias for action. You iterate quickly, ship pragmatically, and automate everything.

  • Culture carrier. You coach teammates, share knowledge freely, and keep calm when things break.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Pulumi or similar IaC frameworks.

  • ISC2 (any level) certification.

  • Experience running SaaS compliance programs (ISO:27001, SOC 2 Type II).

  • Open-source contributions to security, infrastructure, or developer tooling projects.

title: Praktikum Campaign Management (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:

Unser Team im Bereich Patient Solutions betreut gesponserte Präventionskampagnen auf Doctolib – immer mit dem Ziel, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Über die Doctolib Patient App sowie die mobilen und Desktop-Versionen erreichen wir sie genau in dem Moment, in dem sie sich mit ihrer Gesundheit beschäftigen. Während Deiner Tätigkeit bei uns wirst Du:

Dein Profil

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

title: Pflichtpraktikum HR - Digitalisierung & Personio-Optimierung (m/w/d) im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien
descriptionHtml:
Was wir tun
"Eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen"

Mit dieser Zielsetzung hat sich VISPIRON ENERGY eine strategische Position im Zukunftsmarkt der erneuerbaren Energien erarbeitet. Das ursprünglich auf Photovoltaikparks spezialisierte Unternehmen legte im Jahr 2017 den Fokus auf die Vernetzung regenerativer Energiesysteme und konzipierte das Ökosystem ENERGY WORLD. Regenerative Energieerzeuger, Verbraucher, Speicher und Hochleistungsladesäulen werden in diesem Ökosystem vernetzt und intelligent bewirtschaftet. Wir decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

Hierzu arbeiten die hochspezialisierten Unternehmen VISPIRON ENERGY, VISPIRON EPC und SEtrade als Einheit zusammen und decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

Sind wir ein Match?

Du

  • hilfst gern Menschen und liebst Tools, die den Alltag leichter machen.
  • Vertraulichkeit ist für dich kein Buzzword: Du bewahrst Geheimnisse, statt sie zu erzählen.
  • organisierst und optimierst gern: To‑dos, Termine, Unterlagen bringst du in Ordnung.
  • kommunizierst offen und freundlich: Faire und wertschätzende Personalarbeit ist für dich eine Selbstverständlichkeit.hast Lust, die Energiewende mit uns voranzubringen.

Wir

  • arbeiten seit 20 Jahren täglich daran, die Abhängigkeit von fossilen Energieträgern zu beenden.
  • wollen eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen.
  • glauben an das Potential unserer Mitarbeiter:innen.
  • sind Pioniere und haben neue Technologien entwickelt.
  • sind neugierig, leben eine offene Fehlerkultur und teilen unser Wissen.
  • setzen innovative Geschäftsmodelle nachhaltig um.

Aufgaben

Job Results (Aufgaben)

  • Personio HR Core zum Herzstück machen

Erkunde die Möglichkeiten, die dieses Tool bietet, und mach Personio zu deinem Projekt! Du konzentrierst dich zunächst voll und ganz darauf, das Maximum an Effizienz aus dem Tool herauszuholen. Dafür überführst du fehlende Mitarbeiterdaten aus dem Altsystem, prüfst und ergänzt Felder und schaffst eine saubere Datenbasis. Du erstellst praxistaugliche Vorlagen (z. B. Onboarding-Checklisten, Bestätigungen und Verträge) und konfigurierst Workflows, Reports, Berechtigungen sowie Abwesenheiten sinnvoll. Dein Know-how hältst du in verständlichen Tipps & Tricks fest und bereitest kurze How-tos für HR und Teamleads auf. Ziel: Personio ist zu 100 % nutzbar, spart spürbar Zeit im Tagesgeschäft und macht unsere HR-Prozesse transparent.

  • Mein GPT als perfekter HR-Helfer

Du setzt „Mein GPT“ gezielt für HR ein und baust eine digitale HR-Assistenz auf. Dafür entwickelst du klare Prompts für wiederkehrende Aufgaben, optimierst Vorlagen wie Stellenausschreibungen, E-Mails und Onboarding-Informationen und sorgst so für schnellere und konsistente Ergebnisse. Dabei behältst du die Qualität im Blick: Du prüfst Inhalte sorgfältig, achtest auf eine passende Tonalität und stellst sicher, dass Datenschutz und Vertraulichkeit jederzeit eingehalten werden.
Ziel: KI unterstützt unser HR-Team sinnvoll im Arbeitsalltag und schafft mehr Zeit für die Themen, die wirklich zählen.

  • Kommunikation & Employer Branding mitgestalten

Zeig, wer wir als Arbeitgeber sind, und gestalte unsere Kommunikation aktiv mit. Du unterstützt sowohl die interne als auch die externe Kommunikation, entwickelst Inhalte für unseren Social-Media-Auftritt und unsere Karrierewebsite und erstellst ansprechende Grafiken und Materialien mit Tools wie Canva. Außerdem wirkst du bei internen wie externen Veranstaltungen mit und bringst deine Ideen ein, um unsere Arbeitgebermarke weiterzuentwickeln. Ziel: Unsere Kommunikation ist fair, transparent und sorgt dafür, dass wir intern wie extern weiterhin als attraktiver Arbeitgeber wahrgenommen werden.

Qualifikation

Deine Kompetenzen

  • Background: Laufendes Studium im Bereich Personal/HR, Psychologie, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder vergleichbar. Wichtig ist dein echtes Interesse an People-Themen und Prozessen.

  • Persönlichkeit: Neugierig, teamorientiert, hilfsbereit und vertrauenswürdig. Du hörst zu, fragst nach und willst Kolleg:innenwirklich weiterhelfen. Diskretion ist für dich selbstverständlich.

  • IT & Tools: Sicher im Umgang mit MS Office. Große Lust, Personio tief zu verstehen und hands-on zu konfigurieren. Affinität zu KI-Tools (z. B. „Mein GPT“) und Spaß daran, effiziente Prompts und kleine Automatisierungen zu bauen.

  • Kommunikation: Klar in Wort und Schrift, sehr gutes Deutsch; gutes Englisch von Vorteil. Du formulierst adressatengerecht — von kurzen Mails und Anleitungen bis zu Karriereweb-Texten.

  • Kreativität & Branding: Freude an Employer Branding und Content wie z. B. smarte Social-Media- Posts, Bilder/Slides mit Canva, authentische Firmeneinblicke auf unserer Karriereseite.

  • Organisations- und Prozesssinn: Du denkst in sauberen Daten, sinnvollen Feldern und schlanken Workflows. Qualitätssicherung und Datenschutz behältst du im Blick.

  • Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 5-6 Monate Zeit um im Rahmen eines Hochschulpraktikums dein erlerntes Wissen einzusetzen

  • Plus: Erste HR-Erfahrung (Praktika/Werkstudent), Organisation/Projektaufgaben oder Marketing/ Employer Branding.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

  • Wirkung: Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass Projekte wie unser Energiepark Egling Realität werden – und damit zur Energiewende und zu einer enkeltauglichen Zukunft.
  • Team & Kultur: Sei du selbst und wachse mit uns (Wissenstransfer). Du wirst von einem freundlichen und leistungsstarken Team aus Energieexpertinnen und Experten mit langjähriger Unternehmenszugehörigkeit herzlich empfangen, die ihr tiefes akademisches und praktisches Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Arbeitsumgebung: Wir pflegen eine offene Arbeitskultur, in der Ideen und Initiativen gefördert werden.
  • Wir bieten dir einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit betriebsinterner Kantine und Barista
  • Der Umwelt zuliebe stellen wir eine Fahrradinfrastruktur für alle Mitarbeiter und Mitarbeiterinnen zur Verfügung (Dusche, überdachte Stellplätze & Werkstatt).
  • Benefits: Du bekommst Zugang zu unserem Firmen-Carsharing (Pkw, E-Bike, E-Autos), frisches Obst, Bezuschussung zum Essen in der Kantine, MVV-Zuschuss, Tischtennisplatte und Kicker. Die Poolfahrzeuge können auch privat genutzt werden.
  • Teambuilding: Du kannst an regelmäßigen Firmenveranstaltungen wie Kick Off, Sommerfest, Grillen im Sommer, Wiesn, Eisstockschießen und Weihnachtsfeier teilnehmen.
  • Standort: Unser Büro befindet sich in München und ist öffentlich gut erreichbar.

Warum brauchen wir dich im Team?

Unser Wachstum entsteht durch Menschen, die gerne hier arbeiten. Mit deiner Art hältst du diese Energie hoch: Du bis Teil eines fairen, effizienten und verlässlichen HR, damit Recruiting rund läuft, Onboarding wirklich ankommt und Prozesse einfach funktionieren. So bleibt unser Kununu‑Score  von 4,6 kein Zufall. Vor allem schaffst du eines: mehr Zeit für das, was zählt — Menschen.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Strukturen zu schaffen und mit Weitblick zu handeln, trägst du in dieser Rolle maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Mission – eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen – bei.

title: Pre-Sales Solution Consultant (People Analytics)
descriptionHtml:
Pre-Sales Solution Consultant (People Analytics)

Who We Are

One Model is seeking a passionate Pre-Sales Solutions Consultant to help us scale our market presence in EMEA and bridge the gap between deep HR data capability, Workforce Intelligence, AI Measurement and Transformation,  and strategic business value.

With customers and staff around the world, One Model offers a complete workforce intelligence platform along with a cutting-edge AI Impact evaluation tool.  Our products feature cloud-hosted data orchestration and advanced visualization and analytics tools all controllable via AI interfaces. Our platforms enable companies to unlock the real value of their HR and AI usage  data from the lens of the workforce.

This isn't your standard, script-reading sales demonstration role. We aren't looking for a "demo expert" who only knows which buttons to click, nor are we looking for someone with extensive People Analytics or HR experience.

The ideal fit: You are a proven pre-sales consultant who loves being a part of the sales process. You are eager to learn about HR, Workforce Intelligence, and AI Organizational Transformation,  and are ready to incorporate that knowledge into the demonstration process. In other words, you’re going to learn about Workforce Intelligence and AI Transformation,  and combine that with your demonstration expertise so you can confidently present how our products support Workforce Intelligence, AI Transformation, and Technical teams in their mission. 

What You’ll Do

As a critical partner to our sales team, you will showcase the business value, scalability, and strategic impact of One Model products to prospective enterprise customers:

  • High-Impact Demos: Prepare for and deliver live, dynamic product demonstrations tailored to the specific organizational and HR and AI transformational and measurement challenges of prospects.
  • Tailored Use Cases: Create custom content, metrics, and data mockups in the products to showcase specific HR scenarios (TA, Comp, L&D, retention, and AI Impact and measurement use cases, etc.) .
  • RFP & Functional Support: Partner with Account Executives (AEs) to navigate complex RFPs, write functional descriptions of product capabilities, and handle ad-hoc product queries.
  • Content Creation: Record engaging product videos to showcase features and drive market excitement.

Project Work: Engage in projects designed to support the sales team and reinforce our pre-sales activities. Event Engagement: Attend local and regional events, delivering demonstrations on-site, speaking to audiences about the value of One Model products, and interacting with prospects as part of the sales process. 

About You

  • Pre-Sales Expertise: You are an experienced HR, Workforce Intelligence, and/or AI transformational software pre-sales professional who can learn a platform quickly, demonstrate with authority, and adjust your flow quickly to prospect questions and demands. You are able to quickly learn our products and basic people analytics concepts so that you can establish yourself as a knowledgeable trusted advisor in the sales process. 
  • Gets it Done: You get it done, quickly and correctly.  You aren’t afraid to jump into the deep end and absorb as much as you can as fast as you can. You know each demonstration is an opportunity to grow and improve. 
  • Not Afraid to Sell: You understand that this role is a critical part of the sales process and as such, you are able to build excitement about the One Model products and clearly explain its value proposition.
  • Natural Charisma & Presence: You are an exceptional communicator who commands a room or a web call. You genuinely enjoy meeting new people, building rapport quickly, and reading an audience to adjust your presentation style on the fly.
  • The Storyteller & Translator: You can develop a people analytics mindset, but your real superpower is translation. You can confidently discuss advanced analytics, metrics development, and system adoption with CHROs, HR leaders, AI Transformational Officers just as easily as you can discuss data logic with IT and Technical Buyers buyers.
  • Thrives in Momentum: You are adaptable, comfortable with a fast-paced scale-up environment, and can manage your time effectively when juggling multiple priorities.
  • What This Role Is NOT: This is a consultative, high customer-facing pre-sales role, NOT a backend data analytics or engineering position, nor is it a post-sales consulting role. This is not an applied People Analytics role, nor does it involve coding or data architecture work. 
  • Location: We are a remote organization, supporting our employees to work from home. Ideally, you will be located near London, but we will consider candidates in the UK, followed by candidates in continental Europe. 

Schedule: Hours of operations may vary depending on business needs. This role does provide some support for Account Executives located in the Eastern Time Zone in the US. As such, there will be situations where you will be expected to respond to Slack messages and support calls into the evening hours (London time). 

Want to skip the line and guarantee your application gets reviewed?

The "Show Us Your Spark" Video Challenge:

While this video is optional, candidates who submit a video will be heavily prioritized and fast-tracked straight to the interview round. We are looking for people who can command a room, so this is your chance to stand out.

We don't want a long, dry, feature-by-feature software demo. Instead, record a quick 2-to-3-minute video (using Loom, Zoom, or your phone) answering one of the prompts below:

  • The 2-Minute Pitch. Pitch us your favorite app or tool on your phone right now. You have 2 minutes to make us want to download it immediately.

The Golden Rule: Keep it under 3 minutes. If it feels like a dry, robotic corporate slide-read, you're doing it wrong! We aren’t grading your video editing or lighting; we are looking for your natural charisma, clarity, and ability to keep an audience engaged. Have fun with it.

How to Submit Your Video:

Please email your video file or link (Loom, YouTube, Drive, etc.) directly to ----- with the subject line: [Your Name] - Solutions Consultant Video Entry. Ensure your standard application is also submitted through our job board.

We Support You As An Individual By

  • Fostering a friendly, inclusive, respectful workplace culture.
  • Supporting flexible work options, including 100% remote work and flexible hours.
  • Coaching and development through our "Growing Together" conversations.
  • Generous compensation, benefits, and professional mental health support (EAP).

At One Model, we see the immense value of a diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply for the role even if you don't think you check every single box.

Base Salary Range£100,000—£115,000 GBP

title: Principal Electrical Commissioning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Principal Electrical Commissioning Engineer, you will be Volta's technical authority for electrical commissioning. You will set the standards that decide whether electrical systems on every DSX site are safe, resilient and ready to carry AI workloads.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, your standards will govern every site, contractor and commissioning agent we use, and you will make the final technical call on electrical acceptance questions that affect safety, reliability or time to market.

What you will do

Electrical commissioning standards
