descriptionHtml:
Über Protofy

Wir sind Protofy, die Outcome Agency aus Hamburg, und entwickeln seit über 10 Jahren digitale Produkte, Plattformen und KI-Systeme, die messbar wirken. Technologie ist für uns kein Selbstzweck, sondern ein Business Case, den wir in Umsatz, Effizienz und Wachstum übersetzen.

Deine Rolle

Als technische*r Lead führst Du engagierte Teams und sorgst dafür, dass auch komplexe Projekte pragmatisch, sorgfältig und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden. Wir entwickeln Websites und Mobile-Apps für Branchen wie E-Commerce, Wissensmanagement und Sport. Unsere Projekte laufen drei bis neun Monate oder werden als Produkte langfristig weiterentwickelt. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin mit und hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Architektur.

Den Entscheider*innenunserer Kund*innen begegnest Du auf Augenhöhe: Du leitest Architekturworkshops eigenständig und unterstützt uns bei Pitches. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Produkt Designer*innen und Product Owner*innen verantwortest Du Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Deployment von Features.

Neue Technologien erschließt Du hands-on und machst sie für das Team nutzbar. Außerdem gestaltest Du professionelle Standards in der gesamten Organisation mit, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Entwicklung. Den Großteil Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du selbst im Code, daneben übernimmst Du Führung, Kundenkontakt und Themen der Organisation.

Deine typische Woche

  • Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner*in für die Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen und berätst sie strategisch

  • Du unterstützt Pitches, erarbeitest Slides und technische Konzepte und präsentierst sie

  • Du führst Projekte technisch ganzheitlich, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment

  • Du entwirfst neue Funktionen mit Produktmanager*innen und UX-Designer*innen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit Deinem Team um

  • Du baust neue Themen und Technologien hands-on im Projekt auf, z. B. neue Shopsysteme, Frameworks oder Cloud-Provider

  • Du begleitest Dein Team, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst Deine Kolleg*innen durch Tech-Mentoring

  • Du gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse pragmatisch mit, insbesondere KI-gestützte Entwicklung (Tools, Workflows, Qualitätssicherung)

  • Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick: Du schätzt Aufwände, achtest auf Budgets und unterstützt das Projektmanagement

  • Du entwickelst die gesamte Organisation aktiv mit

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Web- oder App-Entwicklung

  • Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung als Tech Lead bzw. in der technischen Führung von Teams

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Verantwortung mittelgroßer Projekte (500+ Personentage)

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Application Architecture und begleitest Teams dabei, Anwendungen auf der grünen Wiese aufzusetzen

  • Du kannst Projekte ganzheitlich technisch führen

  • Du behältst auch in intensiven Projektphasen einen klaren Kopf und gehst gelassen mit Unsicherheit um

  • Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung über Deine eigene Arbeit hinaus und lernst gern Neues

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch

Deine ersten Monate bei Protofy

In deinen ersten Wochen wirst du dich in unsere bestehenden Projekte und Architekturkonzepte einarbeiten und erste Features für unsere Kund*innen umsetzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit dem Team aus und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für die technische Ausrichtung von unser Kund*innen. Dann übernimmst du Verantwortung und steigst in Pitch Prozesse mit ein. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen auf Anhieb erfüllst, aber Lust hast dich schnell weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Bei uns bekommst Du 30 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Wann und wo Du arbeitest, gestaltest Du flexibel: im Büro, im Homeoffice oder komplett remote in Deutschland. Firmenlaptop und passendes Home-Office-Setup gibt’s von uns dazu.

Wir investieren in Deine Weiterbildung und in Dein Wohlbefinden. Für Deine Zukunft sorgt die betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Dazu kommen du das Deutschlandticket Premium komplett finanziert.

Und weil Arbeit auch Spaß machen soll: Wir feiern regelmäßig zusammen bei Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Getränke und Snacks gehen auf uns. Dein Hund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen.

Vergütung

Unser Gehaltsrahmen für diese Position liegt bei EUR 77.500–90.000€ im Jahr.

title: Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Note: We will begin reviewing applications from 5 October 2026 and will continue to consider them on a rolling basis until the role is filled. First-round interviews are expected to take place in mid October, with the process anticipated to close by the first week of November. Timelines are indicative and may change.

LOCATION: London, UK preferred. EU considered.

Most high-stakes moments in AI over the coming years will involve frontier company insiders having and raising concerns: within companies, to regulators, or through other pathways.

Those insiders tell us they face enormous uncertainty along the “concern raising” path -- from detecting concerns to whether and how to voice concerns with maximum impact and minimal risk, which even legally protected whistleblowing can carry.

To date, no organization has dedicated itself deeply to delivering the best strategic, frontier-AI-specific guidance to these individuals, their supporters, and their attorneys (our partners). We exist to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure.

Tasks

About the role

You will own all of AIWI's technology: architecture, implementation, deployment, security, and maintenance. Delivery will be hands-on and you will manage a budget for executing items defined on your roadmap.

You will work closely with the founders and our Head of Security, and translate requirements from our operations, research, and advocacy teams into working systems. The work is demanding, sensitive, and consequential; conviction in our mission is essential.

Areas of Ownership

  1. Internal tooling. We operate in a highly sensitive environment. Many commercial SaaS products, and hosted AI models in particular, do not meet our security and data sovereignty requirements. You will build and operate our self-hosted, primarily OSS stack end to end: A secure CRM tailored to our needs, state-of-the-art self-hosted AI models and agent systems integrated into knowledge management, call recording, communication tooling, other OSS software we self host, and in-house development of news tracking solutions. If you are excited about designing architecture that allows air-gapping and decentralized access, this role is for you.

  2. External-facing technology. You take offerings from prototype to production end-to-end: Zero-knowledge proof solutions for anonymous coordination, interactive scenario simulators, or automated legislation trackers. Projects can span months or require rapid 3-day delivery. You will also oversee the tech-side of our website. Your solutions will directly drive the impact and safety of AI whistleblowers.

This means you will frequently handle multiple projects simultaneously. You will be the first non-volunteer engineer working on AIWI dedicated technology. Across all areas, security is foundational. You will work closely here with our Head of Security.

Requirements

  • Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI safety and whistleblower protection.

  • 10 years in software engineering with DevOps experience in fast-moving settings.

  • Excellent proficiency across systems-, backend- and web-development; proficiency with systems languages (Rust, Go, C, C++ etc.) required.

  • Experience with JS/TS, HTML, CSS, web frameworks required.

  • Python for AI and Data pipelines required.

  • Excellent project management abilities and communication skills especially towards non-technical colleagues.

  • Strong grasp of CI/CD, security hardening, cloud and self-hosted infrastructure.

  • IaC experience (Ansible, OpenTofu, etc.) required.

  • Experience deploying and integrating existing AI models and tooling (self-hosted open-weight models, agent frameworks, APIs where appropriate) — this is systems integration, not ML research or model training.

  • Ability to rapidly execute and ability to distinguish between levels of QA and security required for different projects.

  • Rigorous approach to threat modeling and operational security. You do not have to be a security expert as you will be working with our Head of Security — but should bring a strong mindset and strong foundational knowledge.

Benefits

Package

  • GBP £70,000 - £90,000 commensurate with experience

  • Up to 9% on UEL pension contribution

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public bank holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Professional development budget

  • A home office or equipment stipend for hybrid staff

  • Wellness budget

  • Paid for co-working space in London

  • Flexible scheduling; occasional out-of-hours work required

Why join?

  • Work as part of an ambitious team committed to a high leverage intervention: A single whistleblower disclosure can move the world if handled well. We get up every morning to make it go well.

  • Work on a vast breadth of technological challenges and varying project sizes.

  • Ownership and responsibility from day 1.

  • Chance to define your personal career development.

  • Coaching by an AIWI board member and serial entrepreneur/CTO as well as close collaboration with an extremely experienced Head of Security.

Who you'd be joining:

AIWI is an independent non-profit launched in late 2024. We are ~4 team members today and are scaling to ~15 within the year, spread across the Bay Area, DC, and London. Joining now, you will significantly shape what the future of AI insider support looks like. We are funded until 2029.

Examples of our work to date:

  • Policy: We pushed for and shaped the EU AI Office's channel, the world's first AI whistleblowing channel. In the US, we support the federal AI Whistleblower Protection Act and have provided expert research input on implementing SB 53's incident reporting mechanisms through a research coalition, which we helped set up. Read our work in Tech Policy Press, the Institute for Law & AI, and Transformer, and see our AI Whistleblowing Law Best Practice Guide.

  • Insider education & support: Our online campaigns have reached thousands of company employees. We produce guides (available upon request), online courses, and help establish connections to our great partner attorneys and support (e.g. on legal advice and defense funding).

  • Advocacy: Anthropic published its whistleblowing policy and OpenAI strengthened theirs following our Publish Your Policies Campaign.

  • Network: We closely collaborate with the world's leading whistleblowing and AI organizations.

Our ambition is to ensure that each insider disclosure is maximally impactful and safe for the person making the disclosure. Joining us means dedicating yourself to achieving that goal with us.

Hiring process:

  1. Application review

  2. Intro call (15 min): Jenny, Head of People & Ops

  3. Get-to-know + Pairing assessment call (30 min + 1 hour): Max, Technology Advisor

  4. Finish coding assignment at home: ~1 hour

  5. Final interview** (1 hour): competency-based, plus meet Karl (Founder) or Jenny

  6. References

* This interview slot is 1.5 hours, if you pass the first 30 minutes of call, we go straight to a code pairing exercise. Once complete, Max may ask you to finish task.

** Ideally, we would like to meet you in our London office.

Referral program:

We provide a reward of £4,000 for successful referrals upon completion of a 6-month employment period. Allocation will occur based on a successful applicant's attribution in the case of multiple referrers.

How to apply:

  • Apply by submitting your application via Join.com.

  • We will begin reviewing applications on a rolling basis from 5 October.

  • The first round is set to take place in mid October.

  • Therefore, anticipated close date is early November.

Work authorization:

  • For London-based roles, we can sponsor UK visas.

Equal Opportunity:

AIWI is an equal opportunities employer, in line with the UK Equality Act 2010. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to a workplace free from discrimination.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
500M+ downloads. 80M+ monthly users. A decade of building – and we’re still accelerating.

Flo is the world’s #1 health & fitness app worldwide on a mission to build a better future for female health. Backed by a $200M investment led by General Atlantic, we became the first product of our kind to reach a $1B valuation in 2024 – and we’re not slowing down.

With 7M paid subscribers and the highest-rated experience in the App Store’s health category, we’ve spent 10 years earning trust at scale. Now, we’re building the next generation of digital health – AI-powered, privacy-first, clinically backed – to help our users know their body better.

The job

Principal Infrastructure Engineer

More than 80 million women open Flo every month to understand their bodies and their health. Every one of those sessions runs on infrastructure we build, and the data behind it is as personal as data gets. Keeping that fast and private at this scale is the job.

Velocity runs the platform that every Flo engineer builds on: Kubernetes on AWS, the data stores behind our services, and the golden paths that let product teams ship without needing to be infrastructure experts. We treat our internal developers as our customers. You will:

  • Own the foundations: Design and run the Kubernetes and data infrastructure behind 80 million monthly active users, and make it boring in the best sense.
  • Turn expertise into self-service: Take what you know about running clusters and databases well, and build it into the defaults so product teams get it for free.

What You Will Do

  • Kubernetes at scale: Architect and evolve our EKS estate: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, networking, autoscaling, workload isolation, and the Helm and Terraform that deploy onto it.
  • Data infrastructure: Shape how our services use PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka. Set the patterns for provisioning, access, backup, failover and capacity, so teams aren't solving these problems one service at a time.
  • Golden paths: Build self-service tooling and Terraform modules that give product teams autonomy without sacrificing stability or security.
  • Reliability: Lead resilience work, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery testing and a sustainable on-call rotation.
  • Privacy at scale: Support the infrastructure behind privacy features such as our TIME-recognised "Anonymous Mode", and keep us SOC2, ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified while handling some of the most sensitive data there is.
  • Observability: Make sure metrics, logs and traces tell us something is wrong before our users do.

What You Bring

  • Experience: Many years in infrastructure, platform, SRE or DevOps roles running high-traffic, distributed systems in production. You have operated at Principal or Staff scope, setting direction across teams as well as delivering.
  • Kubernetes depth: You have run Kubernetes in production for real workloads, ideally EKS. You can explain what happens between kubectl apply and a pod serving traffic, and you have debugged it when it didn't.
  • Data infrastructure awareness: You understand how PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Kafka behave under load and when they fail: connection limits, replication lag, hot partitions, consumer lag, retention. You don't need to have been a DBA, but you know what good looks like and when to ask for help.
  • AWS and infrastructure as code: Strong AWS knowledge and fluent Terraform. Coding experience in Go or Python is a plus.
  • Communication: A doc-first habit, and the ability to bring distributed product teams with you.

AI first: you will have seen the impact AI automation is having on development teams and the software delivery lifecycle, and have strong ideas on how infrastructure should support it.

Bonus Points

  • Hardening infrastructure for high-compliance or security-sensitive environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI).
  • Running managed data services in AWS (RDS, Aurora, MSK, DynamoDB) at scale, including migrations and major version upgrades.
  • Scaling consumer platforms with millions of concurrent users.
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, CKA or CKS.

Why Join Flo?

  • High impact: Flo is used by 1 in 4 women aged 18–44 in the US, and has raised $200M to build what comes next.
  • Autonomy: We hire experts and trust them to deliver.
  • Modern stack at scale: EKS, Terraform, Kafka, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and Sentry, serving more than 80 million people a month.
Annual Salary Range (ranges may vary based on skills and experience)£130,000—£150,000 GBP

How we work

We’re a mission-led, product-driven team. We move fast, stay focused and take ownership – from brief to build to impact. Debate is encouraged. Decisions are shared. We care about craft, ship with purpose, and always raise the bar.

You’ll be working with people who take their work seriously, not themselves. It takes commitment, resilience, and the drive to keep going when things get tough. Because better health outcomes are worth it. 

What you'll get

We support impact with meaningful reward. Here’s what that looks like:

  • Competitive salary and annual reviews
  • Opportunity to participate in Flo’s performance incentive scheme
  • Paid holiday, sick leave, and female health leave
  • Enhanced parental leave and pay for maternity, paternity, same-sex and adoptive parents
  • Accelerated professional growth through world-changing work and learning support
  • In-person collaboration and work in a hybrid model, with 3 days per week spent in the office
  • 5-week fully paid sabbatical at 5-year Floversary
  • Flo Premium for friends & family, plus more health, pension and wellbeing perks

Diversity, equity and inclusion

Our strength is in our differences. At Flo, hiring is based on merit, skill and what you bring to the role – nothing else. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, communities and identities. Read our privacy notice for job applicants.

What You'll Do

As a Principal Software Engineer - Networking, you will help set the technical direction for Radiant's networking software, and lead the design and delivery of the systems that build, automate, and operate the fabric connecting our GPU clusters.

You'll work across high-performance cluster fabrics, network automation, Managed Networks, and multi-tenant isolation. You'll partner closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, storage, and security teams, and with customers whose workloads depend on the network.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on making our networks fast, reliable, and fully software-driven, through architecture, code, and the standards other teams build on.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Radiant's networking software, and lead its design and implementation.

  • Design and build the control plane that provisions, configures, and automates our cluster fabrics and Managed Networks.

  • Translate product and customer requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with Product.

  • Own network performance, isolation, and reliability for AI training and inference workloads.

  • Lead integration of networking with compute, Kubernetes, storage, security, and observability.

  • Drive operational excellence with SRE and Infra Ops, including automation, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, design and code review, and technical standards.

 

Your Profile

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale network software or software-driven networks.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Fabrics: RDMA, InfiniBand, RoCE, Ethernet at scale, congestion control

  • Networking: routing, switching, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, overlays and underlays

  • Automation: network-as-code, configuration management, APIs for network devices

  • Multi-tenancy: isolation, segmentation, network security

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as NVIDIA networking, SONiC, Cumulus, or similar.

  • Understanding of how network design affects AI training and inference performance.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Comfortable working directly with customers on highly technical problems.

 

What You Bring

  • Networking domain expertise: Understand how the network shapes workload performance, from the fabric up to the application.

  • Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems that are hard to change once built.

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how your area interacts with compute, networking, storage, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

 

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

 

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Exercise → Final.

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

title: Principal Transformation Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Valiantys

Valiantys is a global leader in consulting and services for the Atlassian ecosystem, helping businesses transform their IT operations and business processes. With a focus on driving operational excellence, innovation, and agility, we empower organizations to achieve their goals through tailored solutions for Atlassian tools and adjacent technologies. Joining Valiantys means becoming part of a growing company driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and respect for individuals, where every contribution helps shape the digital future of businesses.
Job summary

As a Principal Transformation Consultant, you will be responsible for managing key client relationships, ensuring the successful delivery of consulting engagements, and driving business growth. You will act as a strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, helping them navigate complex transformation initiatives, including large-scale cloud migrations and technology modernisation programmes, while expanding the firm’s footprint within the accounts you manage.

A core aspect of the role is consultative-led selling: identifying client needs through deep discovery, shaping compelling value propositions, and converting those into tangible engagements. You will blend strategic advisory with commercial acumen, playing a leading role in both winning and delivering transformation work. You will report to the Transformation Consulting Director

Things you will be working on

Client partnership & engagement delivery

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for client stakeholders across transformation initiatives, building trusted advisor relationships at C-level and programme director level.
  • Understand clients’ business goals, technology landscape, and transformation drivers, aligning solutions based on the Atlassian stack and related technologies.
  • Lead and support delivery teams to ensure smooth execution, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction across complex, multi-workstream programmes.
  • Contribute to the coordination and success of transformation projects—including cloud migrations, platform consolidation, and enterprise toolchain modernisation—focusing on measurable business value.

    • Technology & Transformation

  • Bring experience of enterprise technology environments, with a strong understanding of cloud platforms, migration methodologies, and the technical and organisational challenges of moving from on-premise to cloud at scale.
  • Guide clients through migration readiness assessments, architecture considerations, and transition planning for digital platforms.
  • Stay current with evolving Atlassian capabilities, cloud-native tooling, and wider enterprise technology trends to ensure our advisory is credible, differentiated, and forward-looking.
  • Bridge the gap between technical delivery teams and business stakeholders, translating complex technology decisions into clear strategic narratives.
  • Knowledge of AI solutions and use cases.

    • Consultative-Led Selling & Business Development

  • Lead consultative selling efforts: conduct structured discovery with clients, identify pain points and opportunities, and shape proposals that connect directly to business outcomes.
  • Own and drive account growth strategies for assigned accounts, identifying upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities through ongoing client engagement.
  • Collaborate closely with the sales team using MEDDPICC-aligned qualification to progress opportunities from identification through to close.
  • Develop compelling Statements of Work, business cases, and go-to-market assets that position Valiantys’s transformation capabilities clearly and credibly.
  • Support strategic planning and proposal efforts, contributing commercial and technical insight to pricing, scoping, and risk assessment.

    • Solution Design & Value Creation

  • Co-develop transformation offerings in collaboration with internal practices (e.g. AI, Cloud, ITSM, Agile at Scale).
  • Translate business and IT requirements into clear value propositions, project scopes, and transformation roadmaps.
  • Contribute to building reusable approaches, templates, and frameworks (e.g. for ITSM transformation, AI, cloud migration, PPPM maturity) that codify Valiantys’s methodology.

    • Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Act as a mentor and sparring partner for consultants at all levels, contributing to knowledge growth, capability development, and team performance.
  • Share market intelligence, client insights, and delivery learnings internally to enhance offering development and delivery practices.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, professional rigour, and client-centricity across the UKI consulting team.

    • Do you have what it takes to be a Transformation Principal?

    Essential Experience & Skills

  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in consulting, professional services, or transformation delivery roles, with significant exposure to business and IT transformation programmes.
  • Proven experience leading or playing a senior role in enterprise cloud migration or technology modernisation initiatives.
  • Demonstrable track record in consultative selling, shaping opportunities through discovery, building client business cases, and converting advisory engagements into revenue.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, including cloud platforms (Atlassian Cloud, AWS), DevOps toolchains, and ITSM/PPPM disciplines.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders (Director, VP, C-level) and to influence decision-making at that level.
  • Experience managing and growing client accounts with a clear contribution to revenue targets.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, comfortable leading workshops, steering committees, and executive briefings.
  • Adaptable and proactive, thriving in dynamic environments where you balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving.

    • Desirable

  • Experience working within or alongside the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management) or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or similar structured sales qualification methodologies.
  • Experience with Agile at Scale frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, or bespoke) and their application in large enterprise settings.
  • Exposure to managed services or Total Care-style ongoing client engagements.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Atlassian, ITIL, PMP, SAFe, cloud platform certifications).
  • Ability to shape Valiantys AI Strategy based on actual Customer Outcomes and Use Cases.
    • Location & Working Arrangements

    This role is based in the United Kingdom. We are opened to remote working across the UK with regular travel to client sites and the London office as required.

    Some travel within the wider EMEA region may be expected.


    Why Join Valiantys?
    Join a fast-growing, innovation-driven organization where transformation is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our team, you’ll help shape the future of Developer Experience transformation by working with global enterprises to optimize software delivery. You'll collaborate closely with top-tier experts in IT consulting, business transformation, and DevEx, all within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment that values impact, creativity, and continuous improvement.

    Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

title: Principle Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSIONAt Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes with industry leading products and platforms developed through an AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle.ABOUT USRedwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

CORE VALUES

  • One Team. One Redwood
  • Make Your Own Weather
  • Obsess over Customer Success
  • Work the Problem
  • Be Curious
  • Own the Outcome
  • Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader and strategic influencer shaping Redwood’s RunMyJobs platform. You will drive high-impact technical decisions, own complex system designs, and lead initiatives that span teams and domains. Your work will translate business needs into scalable, resilient full-stack solutions that meet both functional and non-functional requirements. 

In this fast-paced, agile environment, you will lead projects from concept through delivery, collaborating closely with product, design, engineering, finance, and customer success teams to ensure alignment and success. You will set the standard for engineering excellence by mentoring engineers at all levels and championing a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technical rigor.

A key part of this role is to ensure development teams follow best practices, coding standards, and technical requirements. You will provide hands-on technical guidance and architectural direction, including code and design reviews, while creating and maintaining design and code standards. Understanding, communicating, and enforcing Redwood’s software architecture strategy will be fundamental. 

You will proactively identify critical technical challenges related to quality, scalability, observability, and performance. By spotting early risks in architecture or implementation, you help prevent issues before they affect delivery or user experience. Leveraging data analysis, code reviews, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, you ensure that solutions are robust, efficient, and scalable, driving Redwood’s platform forward with confidence.

You will work directly with the Engineering manager for your teams and collaborate closely with Redwood’s Architecture team to ensure technical alignment, consistency, and strategic direction across the platform. As a key member of the engineering leadership group, you will influence architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of our engineering strategy.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical ownership and no direct people management responsibilities.

Your responsibilities will also include:

  • System Architecture & Design: Lead the design and implementation of large-scale distributed systems, focusing on resilience, low-latency, and fault tolerance within the Java ecosystem.
  • Prompt Engineering for SDLC: Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques to maximize the efficacy of generative AI tools for writing comprehensive unit/integration tests, drafting technical documentation (Javadoc, API specs), and generating code refactoring suggestions.
  • CI/CD and Observability: Oversee and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (CI/CD, Kubernetes/Docker) in a cloud environment (AWS/Azure/GCP), leveraging AI tools for proactive anomaly detection and monitoring.
  • Collaborating with the product management team to define, design, and implement new functionality that enhances Redwood's software solutions.
  • Diagnosing and resolving complex technical challenges and system issues to ensure platform reliability.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. You should have over eight years of software development experience, with at least three to five years in a senior or staff software engineer role. This position requires proven experience in workload automation, job scheduling, and orchestration technologies.

  • Deep proficiency in Java (11/17+), with strong experience in modern frameworks and libraries.
  • Strong background in microservice architecture, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) and RESTful API design.
  • Experience with frontend technologies including ReactJS, MobX, and TypeScript.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, data modelling).
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with tools like Git, GitHub, Jira and Bamboo from Atlassian.
  • Proficiency in testing frameworks such as JUnit, Jest and Playwright with a focus on driving quality automation and testability by design.
  • Commitment to engineering best practices, including code reviews, static analysis and continuous quality improvements.
  • AI Tool Fluency: Demonstrated ability to proficiently use AI-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, CodeWhisperer) in a production environment.
  • Code Judgment: Proven track record of evaluating and overriding AI-generated suggestions that are technically correct but architecturally flawed or non-compliant with security and performance best practices.
  • Prompting Proficiency: Experience writing clear, contextual, and effective prompts for generative AI to produce usable code, tests, or documentation.
  • Adaptability & Learning: High degree of curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new AI tools and techniques that continuously reshape the development workflow.
  • Domain & Architectural Focus: The capacity to abstract away from low-level coding details to focus on high-value business logic and systemic architectural integrity.

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

We’re looking for a world-class product designer who’s obsessed with craft & excited about AI. You’ll join +60 builders shipping one of Europe’s biggest consumer AI products, shaping how millions of students learn.

Why Knowunity?

We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns.

Why now?

Design is the single highest-leverage investment at Knowunity right now. You’ll be at the center of that shift.

We’ve built a product millions of students love, powered by an engineering team that ships & learns extraordinarily fast. Now we’re going all-in on craft. The kind of UI excellence, motion design, and systematic thinking that turns a loved product into a world-class one.
We just brought on a new Head of Design. We’re building a design system from the ground up. And we’re working with Ragged Edge (the agency behind the Transferwise & Granola rebrands) on a major brand evolution.

You won’t be maintaining someone else’s vision. You’ll be shaping it from the start.

Who you are

Your portfolio matters more than your years of experience. Show us work that moved metrics & delighted users:

  • Craft-obsessed: The details are the design. You push back until the bar is raised.

  • AI enthusiast: From prototyping to research to shipping. You see AI tools as a multiplier, not a threat.

  • Systems thinker: You care about scaling quality across a product, not a pretty Figma library. Code-first design systems, AI-powered design reviews, whatever works at speed & scale.

  • Simplifier: Education is messy. AI is unpredictable. You turn complicated user journeys into experiences that feel obvious.

  • Biased to action: You move fast by default. Prototypes over presentations, experiments over endless debate.

  • Builder: You like getting your hands dirty. Bonus if you’ve shipped a side project end to end, or opened a merge request.

  • Team-first: Direct feedback, no preciousness, no territory. Engineers prototyping features? More builders means better outcomes.

  • Curious: New tools, new patterns, new ways of thinking. You stay up to date & experiment continuously because you want to, not because someone told you to.

What you'll do

Raise the bar on everything students see, touch & feel. Make the Knowunity product undeniably world-class.

  • Set the standard: UIs students want to screenshot & details they feel, but can’t name. Your work is the reference point.

  • Scale it: Curated references, stellar components & sharp reviews. Make it easy even for vibe-coding PMs to hit the standard.

  • Pioneer AI-native design: AI changes how we research, ideate, ship, as well as what we ship. You’ll figure out both, from AI-assisted workflows to AI-native product experiences.

  • Idea to production, fast: Work directly with C-level & engineering. Concept on Monday, shipped on Wednesday, live for a million students on Thursday.

What we offer

Not for everyone. Everything for the right ones:

  • Impact at scale: Your work reaches millions of students daily. Future generations will know what you build.

  • Elite team, real ownership: +60 exceptional people. Direct access to C-level & founders. You own entire areas from conception to delivery.

  • Compensation & equity: Competitive salary paired with meaningful equity in a company with genuine unicorn potential.

  • Benefits: 28 days annual leave, 40 days work from anywhere, personal development budget, mental health support, Urban Sports Club, monthly retail vouchers, team & company events.

Next steps

Click “Apply for this job” and submit your CV and LinkedIn profile. We move fast.

  1. Intro call: Get to know each other, see if there’s mutual excitement.

  2. 5 minute Loom: walk us through something you’re proud of. A feature you shipped, an app you vibe-coded. Your pick.

  3. Deep-dive call: Unpack your Loom case with our head of design/CPO, discuss your experience & perspective.

  4. On-site day: Meet our CEO, CPO & the team. Work together, get a real feel for the culture. We’ll cover travel.

We encourage applications from exceptional talent regardless of traditional background requirements.

Knowunity is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, ethnic origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or marital status. Please don't include photos or age in your application.

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers!

In this role, you'll:

  • Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature.
  • Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma).
  • Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing.
  • Contribute to Wave's design system and component library.
  • Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective.
  • Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions and in conversation with PMs.
  • Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution (Wave uses Claude for mobile prototyping with Android apks).

Key details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso.
  • You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team (Wave covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you'll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. You're highly encouraged to visit market counties more often! We also provide a yearly stipend of $1,200 USD to meet with coworkers every year.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to $187,000 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
    • 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
    • Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching

Requirements

  • Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping with LLMs on Android mobile apps
  • Fluency in English. French language skills are a plus.
  • At least 6 years of end-to-end in-house experience, with a consumer focus on product design with mobile apps.
  • Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with an eye at removing friction from flows
  • Attention to detail and high level of visual craft
  • Strong illustration and animation skills. We use After Effects and Lottie at Wave but anything that can be converted to a Lottie file works
  • Ability to deliver high-quality designs with speed and polish
  • Bias towards action. Identify UX improvements without waiting for the perfect conditions
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to think through complex interaction design as well as thinking about tradeoffs of each solution
  • Curiosity for understanding and unpacking customer behaviors and needs
  • Experience balancing business goals, customer needs, and technical tradeoffs, while explaining your point of view to the team

You might be a good fit if you

descriptionHtml:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $6M in annualized revenue. We're hiring our first product engineer focused on growth. Wherever the biggest lever is, that's where you build.

  • Run conversion experiments across the whole funnel: landing pages, calls to action, signup, onboarding, paywalls, packaging, and pricing

  • Ship on the core product when that's where the growth lever is, especially product-native loops: shareable creations, templates, embeds, referrals, and public pages that give creators a reason to spread Neural Frames for us

  • Run programmatic SEO experiments without creating low-quality pages, index bloat, or content that exists only for search engines

Requirements

  • You're a product engineer who can independently ship production experiences with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, and you sweat the details that make pages convert: speed, layout, copy, polish

descriptionHtml:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets.

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.

title: Product Manager Energy Markets & Flexibility (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective.

By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Your mission

  • Conceptualization & Expansion of Energy Market Solutions: Development and operational establishment of scalable models for balancing group management (BKM), direct marketing, and flexibility optimization for our C&I and enterprise customers with multi-site portfolios
  • Tech & Market interface: Close collaboration with our software and product teams to further develop our virtual power plant (Heartbeat AI Enterprise) – defining functional requirements for aggregation, dynamic flexibility bands, and schedule setpoints
  • Partner & Trading Management: Selection, integration, and ongoing management of external BKM and trading partners (e.g., algorithmic intraday trading companies, aggregators, transmission system operators)
  • Multi-Use Operating Models: Design of prioritization and operational logic for commercial battery storage systems (e.g., balancing UPS/backup priority, grid-charge-optimized peak shaving, and spot market arbitrage)
  • Risk & Schedule Management: Monitoring forecasting quality, balancing energy costs (reBAP), and schedule notifications to minimize financial risks in the balancing group
  • Regulatory Framing: Ensuring and implementing relevant energy industry regulations (e.g., mixed storage guidelines / MiSpeL, MaBiS, Redispatch 2.0) in customer contracts and system workflows
  • Sales Support: Support during enterprise customer pitches, creation of economic models, and design of revenue-sharing concepts (profit-split)

Your profile

  • Completed degree in energy economics, industrial engineering, electrical engineering, business administration, or a comparable qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in balancing group management (BKM), at a direct marketer, flexibility aggregator (VPP), or in short-term power trading (EPEX SPOT Day-Ahead / Intraday)
  • Sound understanding of the deployment and monetization of large-scale and commercial battery energy storage systems (BESS) as well as PV systems in the C&I segment
  • Solid knowledge of the German regulatory framework (StromNEV, EnWG, MaBiS, MiSpeL) and market communication processes
  • High affinity for software, IoT architectures, and API-driven data flows between edge gateways, VPP platforms, and trading systems
  • Strong analytical mindset, entrepreneurial drive, and structured problem-solving skills
  • Persuasive communicator at eye level with enterprise customers and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
  • Business fluent in German and English, both spoken and written

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳

Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action.

We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets.

Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide.

If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you.

What will I be doing? ‍‍👩‍💻👨‍💻

We’re looking for a mission-driven Product Manager to join our Product function and help scale the value of Sylvera’s live products. You’ll take products that have found market fit and make them great - taking them from 1 to 2, rather than 0 to 1.

This is a high-impact role. You’ll be trusted to own your areas and expected to execute autonomously, and we’ll invest in you to set you up for success. You’ll join our product guild, and learn from passionate and experienced colleagues who are enthusiastic about sharing knowledge.

Specific responsibilities will include:

  • Focus on one or more product areas at a time within a defined problem space, across the Sylvera B2B SaaS platform, iterating on existing products to unlock their full value

  • Talking to customers regularly and running discovery to understand their workflow deeply, from finding the problem through to launching the solution, and monitoring its impact

  • Using product data and customer insight to find what holds users back, and proposing the improvements that matter most in high impact areas

  • Working closely with engineering, design and data teams to build, and marketing and sales to launch improvements at pace.

  • Engaging and partnering with stakeholders across the business - the changes you’ll make will have a high impact, so you’ll bring people’s ideas and input together to build better product experiences

  • Partnering with commercial colleagues to grow revenue and usage by helping users get more value from Sylvera’s data

  • Supporting larger strategic initiatives alongside the wider product team

We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚

  • Has experience as a Product Manager, ideally on a B2B SaaS product

  • Has worked closely with customers and run their own discovery through to delivery

  • Is data-driven, using analytics and customer insight to make decisions, with a track record of iterating on live products

  • Is naturally curious and loves learning new domains - no carbon market experience needed, but we’d expect you to proactively learn about the world our customers operate in

  • Is comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and can adapt quickly as the picture becomes clearer.

  • Enjoys working with people across a business, listening to different views and turning them into clear product decisions, rather than taking pre-defined requirements

  • Ideally has worked on data products, or has a strong appreciation of how value is derived from data and how to build SaaS experiences that maximise it

  • Is a self-starter who thrives in constantly evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience

  • Cares deeply about the climate

We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Benefits 💰

  • Equity in a rapidly growing startup

  • Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance

  • Unlimited annual leave

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Local bar tab at the end of the month

  • Weekly drinks in the office

  • Catered lunch once a month in office

  • Monthly Deliveroo/equivalent allowance once a month

Location 🌍
London. We work flexibly whilst encouraging people to come in regularly to our great office in Old St

Our Values 🙌

Own it: We make new mistakes. We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures.

Stay curious: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us.

Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges.

Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run.

Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed our customer expectations. If we’re serving our customers to the fullest, we can help direct more investment into real climate impact.

What if you’re a partial fit? 🌱

We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description.

Equal employment opportunity 🌈

Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

AI note-takers 🤖

We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

title: Product Manager On-Ramp & Swap (100% remote)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether Wallet is our self-custodial wallet, built to bring USDT and XAUT directly to the people who rely on Tether every day, especially in markets where access to stable money and savings is hardest. For that to work, getting into these assets has to be simple, fast and affordable. Our goal is to give every Tether Wallet user the best option to exchange any local currency or token into USDT and XAUT, wherever they are.

In this role, you will define and own the strategy for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT across our target markets. You will work hand in hand with our expansion teams to map the payment landscape in each market: which payment methods people actually use, which card schemes and bank rails dominate, and which on-ramp and swap providers can serve them. Based on that, you will identify the best partner for each market and bring them on board as a service partner of Tether Wallet.

This role sits at the intersection of product, payments and partnerships. You will own the outcome end to end, from the first partner evaluation through integration and the in-app experience to the conversion numbers after launch. If you enjoy turning a fragmented global payments landscape into a buy button that just works, we want to hear from you.

Key responsibilities:

  • Buy & Swap Strategy: Define and own the strategy and roadmap for buying and swapping into USDT and XAUT in Tether Wallet, covering fiat on-ramps, card payments, local payment methods and token-to-token swaps.

  • Market & Payment Landscape: Work with our expansion teams to build a deep understanding of each target market, including dominant payment methods, card schemes, bank transfer and instant payment rails, mobile money, local regulation, and the on-ramp and swap providers active there.

  • Partner Evaluation & Selection: Define clear evaluation criteria such as market and payment method coverage, fees and FX spreads, approval and conversion rates, KYC experience, settlement speed, reliability and compliance standing, and use them to select the best on-ramp or swap partner for each market.

  • Partner Onboarding: Lead selected partners from evaluation to go-live as service partners of Tether Wallet, coordinating with Legal, Compliance and Business Development on due diligence, commercial terms and contracts.

  • Integration & Delivery: Translate partner capabilities and APIs into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with engineering and design to deliver a seamless in-app buy and swap experience.

  • Routing & Optimization: Define the logic that decides which partner and payment method a user is offered based on country, currency, amount, price and availability, so every user gets the best available option.

  • Performance & Partner Management: Define and track KPIs across the buy and swap funnel, such as conversion, payment approval rates, KYC drop-off, total cost to the user and volume by market and partner. Use the data to improve the experience, manage partner performance and incidents, and regularly review whether each market still has the right partner.


Mandatory:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in the financial industry (banking, payment service provider, FinTech)

  • 3+ years of product management experience in DeFi or crypto industry

  • Good understanding of crypto wallets and DeFi features, including token swaps, DEX aggregators and on-chain transaction flows.

  • Good understanding of global payment systems and credit card schemes (e.g. Visa, Mastercard), including authorization, 3-D Secure and chargebacks, as well as local payment methods such as bank transfers, instant payment rails and mobile money.

  • Hands-on experience with fiat on-ramp, off-ramp or swap providers, or with integrating third-party payment providers and gateways into a consumer product.

  • Proven experience evaluating, selecting and onboarding external partners, and managing their performance after launch.

  • Working knowledge of KYC/AML requirements and how they affect user onboarding and conversion.

  • Technical enough to read partner API documentation, assess integration options and work closely with engineering teams.

  • Data-driven: experience defining funnel KPIs and using data to improve conversion and make partner decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partners, expansion teams and engineers across time zones in a remote environment.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

  • Experience with enterprise software, release management, support operations, or product analytics is helpful. Legal experience is not required.

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

title: Recruiter, Commercial
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Your mission

Our market moves fast, and so do we. As our business continues to scale, we're looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Commercial Recruiter to take ownership of hiring across the DACH region.

You'll be the driving force behind building our commercial powerhouse — attracting and securing exceptional talent across Sales, Account Management and Business Development.

From the initial hiring kick-off to the final signed contract, you'll own the entire recruitment journey. You'll partner closely with business leaders, shape hiring strategies, identify outstanding talent and turn ambitious growth plans into reality.

This isn't just about filling vacancies. It's about building the people, teams and capabilities that will define our next chapter.

If you love moving fast, building relationships and making great hires happen, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll do

  • Own the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, offer, close.

  • Hunt passive talent via LinkedIn, referrals, events and direct approach.

  • Interview in German and English and deliver sharp shortlists, fast.

  • Close: negotiate offers, beat counter-offers, keep candidates warm until day one.

  • Advise hiring managers on market, salaries and timelines, and push for quick decisions.

  • Track everything in Ashby and report on pipeline and time-to-hire.

You'll thrive here if you have

  • Drive and ownership. Every open role is yours until it's signed.

  • Curiosity. You test new channels, tools and outreach, and keep what works.

  • Hunger to learn. You want to grow fast with a scale-up where things change weekly.

What you bring

  • Fluent German (C1 or native) and strong English

  • Experience in recruiting (agency or in-house), ideally commercial or sales roles

  • Proven direct sourcing and closing skills

  • Bonus: start-up or scale-up experience, an energy or B2B background, Ashby know-how.

Why Andercore

  • Impact: your hires directly drive our growth

  • Growth: steep learning curve, close to leadership, and a scope that grows with you.

  • Team: driven, international, and we celebrate wins together.

Hiring process

Intro call → Hiring manager interview → Case study → Meet the team → Offer

Ready to Hunt?
