title: Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa
descriptionHtml:
Regional Director of Operations, UK, Europe and Africa

Kenyon International Emergency Services, part of the TrustFlight Group

Bracknell, United Kingdom | Full time, permanent | Competitive salary and benefits package

When the worst happens, families need someone they can trust. Lead that response.

When an aircraft is lost, a ship is in distress or a community is struck by disaster, families are suddenly facing the hardest days of their lives. They need answers, they need to be treated with dignity, and they need to know that the people they have lost are being cared for. For more than a century, Kenyon International Emergency Services has been the organisation that airlines, governments and major companies call on to make sure that happens.

We are looking for a senior crisis leader to direct that response across the UK, Europe and Africa. This is a role for someone who has stood in the room when it mattered, who leads with calm authority, and who believes that how an organisation treats the bereaved and the injured says everything about its character.

About Kenyon

Kenyon provides emergency planning, family assistance, humanitarian support and recovery services to clients around the world, drawing on a network of more than 2,500 trained responders who can be mobilised at short notice into any jurisdiction. Our clients rely on us to keep their promises to the people affected by an incident, and we hold ourselves to that standard every day, not only on the day of an activation.

Kenyon is part of the TrustFlight Group, an aviation safety and compliance technology business. That gives Kenyon something unusual in this sector: a world class technology team working alongside it, and a genuine commitment to using AI to make crisis response faster, better informed and more humane. Our values are simple and we mean them: integrity, and a customer first attitude in everything we do.

The role

Kenyon operates a two hub leadership model. You will lead the Bracknell hub, with regional accountability for operational delivery, readiness, contracted offices and relationships across the UK, Europe and Africa. Your peer, the Regional Director of Operations in Vancouver, leads the Americas and Asia Pacific. Together you share accountability for the readiness and quality of Kenyon’s response worldwide.

Senior Incident Director for activations

Senior on call duty is shared between the two Directors on a fixed twelve hour rota, with a structured handover at each change of duty, so that cover is continuous around the clock and neither Director works through their own night. Your window runs from approximately 06:00 to 18:00 UK time.

When an incident arises during your window, wherever in the world it occurs, you take up the role of Senior Incident Director. You will have the authority to set the deployment posture, commit responders and stand the organisation up or down without further approval. Where a client requires it, you will deploy as their strategic point of contact, leading the response on their behalf at the most demanding moments an organisation can face, including mass casualty, government led and politically sensitive events.

Major activations are infrequent, and Kenyon holds its capability through a surge based model rather than a large permanent workforce. Your judgement of regional readiness, kept current every week of the year, is what makes that model work.

What you will lead

· Regional readiness and response. Maintain and continuously measure activation readiness across the UK, Europe and Africa, and develop the procedures, protocols and contingency plans that underpin it.

· Your team and offices. Line manage the Regional Operations Manager in Bracknell, run the Bracknell hub and its regional operations as one regional function, and hold contracted offices to defined standards through quarterly reviews and an annual assessment.

· Protecting those we serve. Make sure the information of casualties, families and clients is protected with the same care during and after an activation as on any other day.

· The responder network. Work with the Responder Manager to keep the network vetted, trained and available across the region, including building language capable responders across Europe and Africa. Own the global standards for responder vetting, training currency, deployment conduct and post incident review, ensuring they are consistently applied across both hubs.

· AI and digital quality assurance. Work with the Vancouver Director and TrustFlight Group technology team to define and evaluate AI enabled quality and operational reporting tools, including an AI internal auditor supporting ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 22300 evidence gathering, gap identification and audit trail maintenance. Ensure these tools meet group information security, data governance and ethical standards.

· Global operational standards. Work with the Vancouver Director to compare regional procedures, share lessons learned and adopt improvements across both hubs, ensuring consistent service quality while recognising regional operational requirements.

· Relationships that matter. Build trusted working relationships with government agencies, emergency services, aviation authorities and clients across the region, and provide the operational insight that informs board level reporting.

Why join us

· Work that matters. Few roles offer the chance to lead a service whose sole purpose is to bring order, care and dignity to people at the worst moment of their lives.

· Real authority. A senior seat on the Kenyon leadership team, reporting to the Managing Director, with decision making authority during activations.

· A sustainable model. A shared rota designed so that no Director carries standing 24/7 availability, because sound judgement depends on rest.

· Room to build. The opportunity to shape Kenyon’s growth across the UK, Europe and Africa, while leading the development of global quality, certification and responder standards and helping shape how AI strengthens operational assurance across Kenyon.

In your cover letter, tell us about an incident you have led and what it taught you about caring for the people affected. Applications will be treated in strict confidence.

Kenyon International Emergency Services and TrustFlight are equal opportunity employers. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process for anyone who needs them. This position is employed by Kenyon International Emergency Services Limited.


What you will bring

· At least ten years in operational crisis management or emergency response, including five or more in a leadership role.

· Experience leading large scale or complex incident responses in international environments, ideally including direct responsibility for strategic command.

· A track record of managing contracted service providers against defined performance standards.

· Experience working within a quality management framework in a regulated or standards led environment, and alongside board level governance.

· The composure, judgement and compassion to lead when the stakes are highest, and the humility to put the needs of affected families first.

· Willingness to travel internationally at short notice, including to the United States and across Asia Pacific.

· Eligibility to live and work in the UK.

It would be a real advantage if you also have

· Professional fluency in Spanish, or another principal European and African language.

· Familiarity with the ISO 22300 series, including ISO 22320, or equivalent certification experience.

· Experience overseeing a 24/7 contact centre operation.

· Practical experience commissioning AI or automation tools in an operational setting.

· Knowledge of the aviation, maritime, energy or government crisis response markets in the Europe and Africa.

title: Partner Success Manager (w/m/d) - Fintech SaaS Scale-Up
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. title: Principal Software Architect
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams

Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions.

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture.

  • Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope.

  • Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control.

  • Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached.

  • Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning.

  • Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met.

  • Representing Wayve with partners: Lead technical discussions with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by clear interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams and decision records.

  • Leading across teams: Coordinate architects and engineering teams, negotiate competing priorities, resolve or escalate conflicts early, and mentor architects and senior engineers to build a shared architecture culture.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You bring substantial experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software or vehicle systems, particularly at the software–vehicle interface. Typically, you’ll have 12+ years of relevant experience, including architecture ownership for a complete product or multiple programs.

  • You can define clear product boundaries, ownership models and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems.

  • You understand vehicle electronics and embedded software constraints, including ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics and production vehicle software environments.

  • You’re familiar with automotive communication protocols and electrical/electronic architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP or AUTOSAR.

  • You’ve worked with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and can navigate their requirements, standards and integration constraints.

  • You’ve established and run requirements processes across multiple teams or programs, translating ambiguous needs into clear, traceable and verifiable system and software specifications.

  • You can move confidently between system-level architecture and implementation details, making sound technical decisions under uncertainty and maintaining consistency as programs evolve.

  • You’ve led architecture work across teams and influenced senior stakeholders without direct authority, building support and handling competing priorities constructively.

  • You communicate complex technical ideas clearly through specifications, diagrams and reviews, and enjoy mentoring others.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Deep-dive technical interviews

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - IoT (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 165 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

 

Senior Backend Engineer - IoT (all genders)

 

***Please note, this position is remote within Germany only***

Do you want to develop a product that is used worldwide? Do you have high standards for continuous discovery, usability and clean code? Do you challenge decisions and ideas against current requirements to ensure continuous improvement? If you answered “YES!” to these questions, we want to talk to you!

As a Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d) you will join a talented product team dedicated to developing and maintaining the Toniecloud IoT services. Your focus will be on continuous discovery, usability, quality and security, ensuring a top-tier experience for our millions of users worldwide.

In the IoT and Control stream, you will play a central role in ensuring the seamless integration of our IoT products. You will empower our users by providing them with intuitive tools to set up and customize their devices to suit their unique needs.

 

What you'll do

  • You take charge of developing and maintaining our Toniecloud IoT services, ensuring they meet the needs of millions of users

  • Play a key role in our Toniecloud ecosystem, which includes:

    • A robust django backend platform offering RESTful and GraphQL APIs

    • An IoT messaging stack that processes technical diagnostic data from millions of Tonieboxes around the globe

  • Maintain our commitment to reliability, ensuring our services are available 24/7, 365 days a year, and helping us achieve our 99,99% SLA

  • Collaborate within a cross-functional, stream-aligned team, where you’ll champion technical excellence to deliver seamless, always-on services. You’ll also work closely with the Product Manager and team members to ensure a fantastic user experience within the app (enabling parents to set up and configure their Tonieboxes and Tonies, enabling unlimited joy for our little listeners)

What You Bring

  • You have been a passionate software engineer for many years and are excited to continue improving your skills

  • Track record in building or maintaining backends for IoT products

  • You are fluent in at least two programming languages, one of them is Python – and you can quickly adapt to new languages when needed

  • Experience with Django is essential

  • Your code is lean, well-structured and easy to understand. You avoid unnecessary complexity from the outset and have a knack for solving complex problems with simple solutions

  • You are familiar with database systems (ideally PostgreSQL) and use ORMs thoughtfully and efficiently

  • Linux is your preferred environment and working with Git and GitLab is part of your daily routine

  • Your work style is characterized by agility, teamwork, independence and creativity, especially when exploring new solutions

  • APIs (REST or GraphQL) are like your native language

  • You are comfortable communicating in English in a professional work environment

  • You must be currently based in Germany.

  • Last but not least: you are enthusiastic about our product and want to join us on our exciting journey!

 

Why Join Us?

  • Global teamwork: We work together across departmental and national borders on our vision of bringing the Toniebox to every child's room in the world.

  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code, but to everything else as well. Because you can only give your best when you feel truly comfortable.

  • Language learning and relaxation made easy: Improve your communication skills with the Babbel language learning app and find relaxation through our access to the Calm meditation app.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire tonies range.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faiths and genders. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Canada
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

This role is an existing vacancy

##LI-SK1 #LI-Remote #USEAST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – Contract (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting.

  • Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing.

  • Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation.

  • Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported.

  • Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug.

  • Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface.

  • Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

  • Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end.

  • You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS.

  • You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech.

  • You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar).

  • You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.

  • You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • You are available to start at short notice.

  • Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

title: (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
descriptionHtml:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality React Native apps for iOS and Android with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, and validate the resulting changes through code review, automated tests, and checks on real devices.
  • Own the full mobile lifecycle: architecture, implementation, automated testing, release management, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Integrate native capabilities (push notifications, deep links, biometric auth, camera/sensors); write and maintain native modules when needed (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Drive mobile performance and reliability (startup time, bundle size, memory, battery) and meet accessibility best practices.
  • Set up and evolve mobile CI/CD (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions/Bitrise), internal testing (TestFlight/Play Console), and release pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features, and to improve our current platform.
  • Connect AI-assisted development workflows to design and engineering tools via MCP, for example to access Figma specifications and components, check implementations against designs, and automate repetitive coding and validation tasks. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, especially in a regulated healthcare environment, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Contribute to a platform that powers multiple regulated digital health products across indications like IBS, GERD, and upcoming expansions.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on React Native and shipping production apps.
  • Expert with React Native and TypeScript, React Navigation, state management, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library; Detox a plus).
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • Proven track record delivering to App Store and Google Play, including handling certificates/provisioning, in-app updates, and staged rollouts.
  • Solid understanding of mobile security and privacy: secure storage, keychain/keystore, certificate pinning, data minimization, and PII handling.
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD and release automation (Fastlane, GitHub Actions or Bitrise), and tools like Sentry.
  • Product mindset: you’ve worked in product-centric teams, collaborated closely with non-technical stakeholders, and care deeply about UX and accessibility.
  • Bonus: experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments; native iOS/Android development (Swift/Kotlin)


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. title: Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

 

About This Role

We're hiring a Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales) to be the technical partner to the engineers and enterprises building on LiveKit.

You'll work alongside an account executive to understand what a customer is trying to build, design the right architecture, and bring it to life with live demos and proofs-of-concept — guiding teams from first conversation to production.

This role is ideal for someone who loves to build, is energized by talking with other engineers, and takes pride in turning a hard technical problem into something that just works. Real-time voice and video is visceral — latency, quality, and reliability are felt, not read about — so the best conversations include something live. You'll collaborate closely with our Sales, Engineering, Product teams to win technical decisions and to make sure what you hear in the field informs how we build.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • love to build and solve the most challenging customer problems with LiveKit

  • have a curious mind with a continuous desire to learn and improve

  • enjoy demoing and presenting, whether to a room or engineer, to a CTO or at a conference

  • have a team first mentality, seeking to lift others around you as you progress in your career

 

What You'll Do

  • Partner with an account executive as the technical lead on strategic deals — from discovery and architecture design through demos, POCs, and technical decisions

  • Advise customers on cloud architecture and deployment across self-hosted and LiveKit Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Build live demos and reference applications — voice agents, video pipelines, telephony integrations — tailored to each customer's use case, and reusable by the wider team

  • Scope and run proofs-of-concept against clear, shared success criteria, guiding customers all the way to production

  • Reason with customers about connectivity, infrastructure, and end-to-end latency to design for scale and reliability

  • Create technical content — blog posts, guides, webinars, and conference talks — that helps developers and enterprises build with LiveKit

  • Act as the technical enabler for your region's pod, and share field insight with Product and Engineering to help shape the roadmap

 

Who You Are

  • 4+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role (or equivalent hands-on engineering experience with strong customer instincts)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — you can architect, deploy, and debug real applications

  • Comfortable with the modern deployment toolchain: containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and networking fundamentals (load balancing, DNS, firewalls/NAT)

  • Able to reason about connectivity, infrastructure, and latency end to end — how architecture, network path, compute, co-location, and model choice shape the AI agentic experiences of today

  • Strong programming ability in at least one of our core SDK languages — Python, TypeScript/Node, or Go

  • A clear communicator who can demo, present, and write for technical audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of real-time media protocols and their latency/quality trade-offs (WebRTC, RTP/SRTP, WebSockets)

  • Familiarity with the AI voice stack: STT/TTS providers, LLM integration, speech-to-speech models, turn detection, and telephony/SIP

  • Experience speaking at meetups or conferences, or a track record of technical writing or open-source contributions

 

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

title: Strategic Account Executive, EMEA (100% hunting role)
descriptionHtml:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. Sonatype is accelerating the future of agentic software development. As developers and AI agents build faster than ever, enterprises need a new level of control, visibility, and confidence at the moment software is assembled. Our Nexus One platform helps development, security, and platform teams govern the components, dependencies, models, and artifacts that power modern applications without slowing innovation down.

We are uniquely positioned to lead this next era. Sonatype operates both Maven Central, one of the world’s largest public open source registries, and Nexus Repository, a top-ranked enterprise repository used by thousands of organizations and over 70% of the Fortune 100. With over 1 trillion downloads annually across our ecosystem, we have unmatched visibility into how software is published, consumed, and propagated. That insight helps our customers make smarter decisions earlier, reduce rework, avoid security surprises, and ship AI-powered software with greater speed and confidence.

We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to accelerate Sonatype's growth across one of the most commercially significant and competitive enterprise technology markets.

This is a pure new-logo acquisition role for an accomplished enterprise hunter who thrives on creating opportunities, displacing established competitors and winning complex, high-value enterprise business.

As artificial intelligence transforms how software is developed, organisations are facing unprecedented challenges around open source security, software supply chain integrity, developer productivity and governance.

Sonatype operates at the intersection of these challenges, helping some of the world's largest organisations build and deploy software securely through industry-leading software supply chain intelligence and an integrated platform spanning repository management, application security and malware prevention.

The territory presents an opportunity for a commercially ambitious seller to develop strategic enterprise relationships, challenge established technology providers and build a significant new-business pipeline.

You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise prospects, with a clear mandate to identify, develop and close new-logo opportunities.

This is not an account management position, nor is it a role designed around managing an inherited customer portfolio.

Your success will be defined by the new customers you acquire, the competitive opportunities you create and the revenue you generate.

You will be expected to operate confidently against an annual quota, bringing the commercial discipline, enterprise sales experience and competitive intensity required to deliver sustained performance.

We're particularly interested in speaking with consistently high-performing enterprise sellers who have achieved President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition and can demonstrate repeated success in complex, competitive technology markets.


Our role in detail:

Territory Development & Strategic New-Logo Acquisition:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise territory strategy across prospect accounts.

  • Take full accountability for new-logo acquisition, building and converting a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities.

  • Identify and prioritise strategic prospects based on enterprise size, software development complexity, security maturity, competitive landscape and commercial potential.

  • Build sophisticated account plans identifying organisational structures, executive stakeholders, buying committees, incumbent technology providers and potential entry points.

  • Generate significant self-sourced pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, executive engagement, targeted account-based campaigns and strategic networking.

  • Establish relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VP Engineering, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering and Application Security leadership.

  • Engage enterprise prospects before formal buying processes begin, helping customers recognise challenges and opportunities they may not yet be actively addressing.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Channel and executive leadership to develop coordinated account acquisition strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to position Sonatype's broader software supply chain platform through compelling customer-specific business cases.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline coverage, opportunity qualification, deal progression and forecasting.

    • Competitive Displacement & Enterprise Deal Execution:

    Competitive displacement will be a significant component of this role.

    We are looking for someone who understands the enterprise cybersecurity, DevSecOps and developer tooling landscape and is confident challenging established technology providers.

    You will be expected to:

    • Identify enterprise accounts using competing or incumbent software supply chain, repository management and application security technologies.

    • Develop account-specific competitive displacement strategies based on customer challenges, technical requirements and business outcomes.

    • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, including organisations such as JFrog, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, Checkmarx and Veracode.

    • Understand where Sonatype's intelligence, security capabilities, platform breadth and preventative approach provide meaningful customer differentiation.

    • Lead sophisticated enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, proofs of value, procurement and executive decision-making.

    • Develop strong economic buyer relationships and build compelling financial, operational and security business cases.

    • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to establish clear qualification, decision criteria, competitive positioning and mutual action plans.

    • Navigate complex negotiations and commercial discussions while maintaining strong customer relationships.

    • Build internal and external champions capable of influencing enterprise purchasing decisions.

    • Demonstrate the judgement to qualify out opportunities where genuine customer value or a viable purchasing path cannot be established.

      • We want a seller who knows how to win when the customer already has a solution, not someone who only succeeds when there is no competition.

      Industry Knowledge & Technical Credibility:

      This role requires a strong understanding of the market in which Sonatype operates.

      You should be comfortable discussing how modern enterprise organisations develop, secure and deploy software, and how AI is changing the speed and complexity of those processes.

      You will:

      • Understand the commercial and technical challenges associated with open source software, software composition analysis, DevSecOps and application security.

      • Engage confidently with technical and executive buyers around software supply chain risk, developer productivity, governance and security.

      • Position Sonatype's platform capabilities across Nexus Repository, Firewall, Lifecycle and related solutions.

      • Understand how software supply chain intelligence can help organisations identify vulnerable components, prevent malicious packages entering development and make better risk decisions.

      • Translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led selling.

      • Recognise opportunities to position Sonatype as a strategic enterprise platform rather than a standalone point solution.

      • Stay informed about emerging technology, AI-assisted development, competitive market movements and evolving enterprise security requirements.

        • Channel & Cross-Functional Enterprise Selling:

        Enterprise sales success requires the ability to bring the right expertise together around the customer.

        You will:

        • Build productive relationships with regional channel partners, systems integrators and enterprise solution providers.

        • Identify partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities that support new-logo acquisition.

        • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop effective technical validation strategies and proofs of value.

        • Partner with Marketing on account-based campaigns, executive engagement and targeted enterprise outreach.

        • Engage executive sponsors where appropriate to support strategic opportunities.

        • Coordinate internal resources effectively while retaining clear ownership of the commercial outcome.

        • Share competitive intelligence, customer insights and market feedback to improve Sonatype's broader enterprise go-to-market execution.

          • Role Outcomes:

          Success in this role means establishing a high-performing, predictable new-logo acquisition engine across the assigned territory.

          You will be expected to:

          • Deliver against an annual new-business quota.

          • Consistently originate and close new enterprise customer opportunities.

          • Build a sustainable, self-generated enterprise pipeline.

          • Win strategically important competitive displacement opportunities.

          • Establish relationships with senior technology and security decision-makers across priority accounts.

          • Increase Sonatype's presence within major enterprise organisations.

          • Demonstrate strong enterprise deal qualification, commercial judgement and forecast accuracy.

          • Build effective relationships with Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel partners.

          • Create repeatable territory development and enterprise acquisition practices that support long-term growth.

            • What Success Looks Like:

            First 30 Days — Understand, Assess & Prioritise

            You will develop a deep understanding of Sonatype's technology, competitive positioning, customer value proposition and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

            You will assess your assigned territory, identify priority accounts, evaluate competitive incumbents and develop relationships with the wider Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel teams.

            You will begin building an evidence-based view of where the strongest new-logo opportunities exist.

            First 60 Days — Build the Acquisition Strategy

            You will have developed a prioritised territory plan, identifying target accounts, executive stakeholders, competitive displacement opportunities and clear outbound engagement strategies.

            You will be actively building relationships with prospective customers, generating qualified pipeline and coordinating account-based activity with the wider go-to-market organisation.

            Your opportunities will reflect clear customer challenges, credible buying processes and measurable business value.

            First 90 Days — Demonstrate Commercial Momentum

            You will be independently driving enterprise pursuits, demonstrating meaningful self-generated pipeline creation and establishing relationships with key decision-makers.

            You will be progressing opportunities through technical validation, commercial discovery and structured enterprise qualification.

            Your territory plan, pipeline coverage and forecasting will provide leadership with confidence in your approach to delivering against quota.

            First 12 Months — Deliver High Performance

            You will have established a sustainable enterprise acquisition engine and demonstrated the ability to deliver against a quota circa $1.5-2m.

            You will have acquired new enterprise customers, progressed competitive displacement opportunities and built a strong forward-looking pipeline.

            You will be recognised for your commercial judgement, proactive hunting mentality, enterprise customer credibility and ability to win complex opportunities.

            Who You Are:

            You are an accomplished enterprise technology sales professional with a demonstrable track record of acquiring new customers, exceeding ambitious revenue targets and winning in highly competitive markets.

            You are a hunter by nature, motivated by opening doors, creating opportunities and winning business that would otherwise remain with a competitor.

            Essential Experience & Capabilities

            Proven Enterprise New-Business Performance

            • Demonstrated success carrying and achieving substantial enterprise new-business quotas, ideally around $2 million annually or at a comparable level of commercial complexity.

            • A track record of consistent quota attainment and strong new-logo acquisition.

            • Evidence of personally originating, developing and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

            • Ability to quantify pipeline creation, average contract values, competitive wins and revenue performance.

              • Consistent High Performance

              • A history of operating among the strongest performers within your sales organisation.

              • President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition is particularly attractive.

              • Evidence of sustained performance across multiple sales periods, rather than reliance on one exceptional transaction or favourable territory.

                • Competitive Enterprise Selling

                • Proven experience winning business against established technology providers.

                • Ability to develop differentiated competitive strategies and challenge incumbent solutions.

                • Strong negotiation, executive engagement and commercial deal leadership skills.

                  • Enterprise Territory Development

                  • Experience developing a geographic or named-account territory through proactive outbound activity.

                  • Strong account prioritisation, stakeholder mapping and territory planning.

                  • Ability to generate your own pipeline rather than relying predominantly on inbound demand.

                    • Technical & Industry Understanding

                    • Strong familiarity with cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application security, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or adjacent enterprise technology.

                    • Confidence engaging technical and executive stakeholders in complex buying environments.

                    • Ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial value.

                      • Sales Methodology & Commercial Discipline

                      • Experience applying structured enterprise qualification methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

                      • Strong forecasting, opportunity management and pipeline discipline.

                      • Ability to manage complex enterprise opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations and procurement processes.

                        • Preferred Experience:

                        We would particularly welcome candidates with experience from:

                        • Software supply chain security and software composition analysis.

                        • Application security and DevSecOps platforms.

                        • Repository management and developer infrastructure.

                        • Enterprise cybersecurity and cloud-native security.

                        • Enterprise platform selling and competitive displacement.

                        • Global 2000, Fortune 500 or similarly complex enterprise customers.

                        • Working with channel partners and enterprise systems integrators.

                        • Selling across the technology and enterprise ecosystem.

                        • Consumption-based, platform-led or land-and-expand commercial models.

Things that we are proud of

  • 2025 AI Compliance Solution of the Year - AI Breakthrough Awards

  • 2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology

  • 2024 Industry Leader in Forrester-Wave for Software Composition Analysis (2024 Q4 report)

  • Risiken & Chancen: Sicherstellung einer strukturierten Identifikation und Bewertung technischer und wirtschaftlicher Projektrisiken und -chancen

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Leiter Angebotsbearbeitung sowie mit Ausschreibung/Vergabe, Einkauf, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Projektleitung und Management

  • BIM & Digitalisierung: Weiterentwicklung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen BIM-Modellierung und Kalkulation sowie schrittweise Verbesserung modellbasierter Kalkulationsprozesse

  • Prozessentwicklung: Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung von Kalkulationsmethoden, Kennwerten, Vorlagen und digitalen Arbeitsabläufen, insbesondere in RIB iTWO

  • Verhandlungen: Fachliche Unterstützung bei Bietergesprächen und Auftragsverhandlungen

  • Kalkulationskompetenz: Sicheres Verständnis von Mengen, Leistungen, Kostenstrukturen, Nachunternehmerleistungen sowie technischen und wirtschaftlichen Projektrisiken

  • Digitale Kompetenz: Sehr gute Kenntnisse moderner Kalkulationsprozesse. Erfahrung mit RIB iTWO sowie modellbasierter Kalkulation / BIM ist von Vorteil

title: Technical Quality Assurance Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Technical QA Manager is responsible for the technical direction, governance and continual improvement of quality engineering across the organisation’s delivery areas.

The role defines and maintains the overarching test strategy and ensures that quality engineering practices are practical, risk-based and integrated throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

The Technical QA Manager provides direct technical leadership and support to QA Champions and Test Automation Engineers. The role ensures that team testing strategies, automation approaches, quality standards and release evidence are aligned, measurable and consistently applied.

The purpose of the Technical QA Manager role is to:

· Define, communicate and maintain the organisational test strategy and supporting quality engineering standards.

· Enable QA Champions to define and operate effective team and product-area testing strategies.

· Provide technical direction to Test Automation Engineers on automation strategy, framework design, coding standards, CI/CD integration, reusable components, maintainability, diagnostics, test data and execution reliability.

· Ensure automated test execution is embedded into delivery pipelines and provides fast, reliable and actionable feedback.

· Align functional, integration, regression, non-functional and release validation with product, technical and delivery risk.

· Strengthen developer ownership of testing while providing appropriate governance, coaching and assurance.

· Ensure AI-generated testing assets and automation code are reviewed critically before use.

· Defining expectations for pipeline triggers, test execution, quality controls, test-result publication, diagnostic information and failure feedback.

· Ensuring pipeline automation is reliable, maintainable and proportionate to product and release risk.

· Improve release confidence through clear, evidence-based quality and automation reporting.

· Reduce avoidable rework, escaped defects, flaky tests and dependency on manual regression testing.

The Technical QA Manager should be able to:

· Define and implement comprehensive, risk-based test strategies across multiple delivery areas.

· Translate organisational quality objectives into practical engineering standards.

· Demonstrate practical integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

· Define effective pipeline execution, result visibility and failure-feedback approaches.

· Provide credible technical leadership on modern test automation frameworks.

· Work effectively with Playwright or equivalent test automation technology.

· Review and guide maintainable automation code.

· Understand automation developed using C#, Java or an equivalent object-oriented language.

· Understand functional, integration, regression, API, user-interface and relevant non-functional testing approaches.

· Assess the suitability of automation at different levels of a system.

· Review automation framework design, test architecture and reusable components.

· Evaluate automation maintainability, test data, environment dependencies and execution reliability.

· Identify flaky, duplicated, low-value or overly expensive automated tests.

· Analyse quality and automation evidence to identify systemic risks and improvement priorities.

· Understand risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.

· Coach and influence QA Champions, Test Automation Engineers, developers and delivery stakeholders.

· Communicate technical quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

· Challenge weak requirements, ineffective controls and poor automation practices constructively.

· Use AI-assisted testing capabilities critically, with appropriate review, traceability and governance.

The successful candidate should have:

· Strong experience in software quality assurance, test automation and quality engineering.

· Experience providing technical leadership across complex software delivery environments using kaban methodology.

· Demonstrable experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.

· Demonstrable experience improving the reliability and feedback value of pipeline-based automated testing.

· Proven ability to define, implement and govern testing strategies.

· Experience supporting other quality roles in applying testing strategies within delivery teams.

· Practical experience with a modern automation framework.

· Preferable experience with Playwright and Selenium.

· Practical coding capability in an object-oriented programming language.

· Experience designing, building or significantly improving maintainable test automation frameworks.

· Experience reviewing automation architecture and test-code quality.

· A good understanding of functional, integration, regression and release testing.

· A good understanding of software delivery lifecycle and release governance.

· A good understanding of risk management, risk identification and risk-based testing.

· A proactive and improvement-focused approach.

· The confidence to challenge poor quality or automation practices constructively.

Desirable experience includes:

· Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines.

· Experience configuring automated test execution within build and deployment pipelines.

· Experience publishing and interpreting automated test results within CI/CD tooling.

· Experience implementing pipeline quality controls.

The Technical QA Manager should be measured on:

· Adoption and effectiveness of organisational testing strategy.

· Quality and consistency of team and product-area testing strategies.

· Effectiveness of support provided to QA Champions.

· Effectiveness of technical direction provided to Test Automation Engineers.

· Reliable automated test execution within CI/CD pipelines.

· Faster, clearer and more actionable quality feedback to delivery teams.

· Increased useful automated coverage in areas of meaningful product risk.

· Reduced flaky, duplicated and low-value automated tests.

· Improved maintainability of automation frameworks and test code.

· Reduced dependency on repeatable manual regression testing.

· Reduced escaped defects and avoidable rework.

· Improved developer ownership of testing and quality.

· Improved compliance with agreed Definition of Done expectations and release control processes.

· Clear and evidence-based release-readiness reporting.

· Timely escalation of significant quality and automation risks.

· Improved collaboration between QA Champions, Test Automation Engineers and developers.

· Demonstrable improvement in release confidence and testing effectiveness.

· Success should not be measured only by the volume of tests automated. Measures consider automation value, reliability, risk coverage, feedback speed, maintainability and model.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
descriptionHtml:
Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm.

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse


Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

  • Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH)

  • Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich)

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit

  • Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse

Wunsch

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur

title: Resource Planner – Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Resource Planner – Data Analyst

Full-time - £31,930.00

Vets Now, part of inspiring vet care, are the UK’s leading provider of emergency pet care, providing a trusted service to more than 1700 veterinary practices, – from dedicated out-of-hours clinics and 24/7 pet emergency hospitals.

Our Client Care Service Team sits within the Customer Hub, supporting pet owners across the UK and connecting them with our daytime veterinary clinics. We're looking for a Resource Planner – Data Analyst to play a key role in ensuring we have the right people, in the right place, at the right time to deliver an excellent service.

Role: Resource Planner – Data Analyst

Location: Dunfermline Contact Centre. You must be able to reliably commute to the office.

Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00am - 16:00pm - fully office based

Planning, Predicting and Making Things Happen

Reporting to the Contact Centre Manager, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day workforce planning and rota coordination requirements of our contact centre. Using our Workforce Management system, you'll build and maintain rotas, coordinate staffing levels to meet daily demand, manage annual leave thresholds and accurately process leave requests to support effective resource planning.

You'll also be responsible for maintaining workforce planning information, monitoring resource utilisation and preparing statistical reports and performance indicators. Working with historical contact data, you'll identify trends and patterns, forecast future demand and consider factors such as marketing campaigns and changing customer behaviours to help predict staffing requirements.

Your analytical skills will be essential in turning complex data into meaningful insights. You'll produce accurate, comprehensive reports on contact centre performance and forecasting, highlighting opportunities and presenting findings to management and key stakeholders to support informed operational and strategic decisions.

The Skills Behind the Numbers

You'll bring strong Microsoft Office skills, excellent analytical ability and confidence working with data to identify trends and develop practical solutions. Experience with workforce management systems would be beneficial, alongside the ability to pick up new systems quickly.

You'll also be highly organised, detail-focused and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships across all levels of the business are essential, alongside a positive, proactive approach to problem-solving.

What You’ll Get in Return

We believe in rewarding our team members not just with a competitive hourly rate, but also with benefits that support wellbeing and work-life balance:

* Your birthday off – paid * Health cash plan via Simply Health * Pension contributions: 5% employee / 3% employer * Up to 50% off pet care for your own pets * Death in service cover – two times annual salary * Access to our employee wellbeing programme * Company sick pay and enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption leave

Be part of a team, where every conversation matters – Apply Now

If you're ready to join a purpose-driven company where your role makes a real difference to pets and their owners, we’d love to hear from you.
