title: Senior Amazon Content Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About Us
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

Tasks

What You’ll Be Doing

Content Audits & Quality Assessment
● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

Content Strategy Development
● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

AI & Agentic Discoverability
● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

Testing & Performance Monitoring
● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

Creative Briefing & Review
● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and
marketplace advertising content.
● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

Client Management
● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

Quality & Output Review
● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

AI-Enabled Working
● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

Requirements

What You Bring to the Role

● Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

● Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

● Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

● Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

● Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

● Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

● Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

● Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

● Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.

● Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.

● Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

● Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

Desirable

● Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.

● Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

● Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

● Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

Benefits

What We Offer
● Competitive salary and benefits
● Hybrid Working Model
● Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
● Continuous learning & career development
● The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Senior Engineer - IAM and Workplace Technology
descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll join Tech as a Senior Engineer. Tech owns identity and access, IT and workplace technology for the whole company. Today it's a Workplace Tech engineer and an IAM engineer, and you'll be the most senior engineer on the team.

This is a hands-on role. You'll work the access and IT queue with the team, and you'll lead the technical work that shrinks it: the automation, the identity platform and the roadmap. As Primer grows and the team grows with it, there's room for the role to grow too, including into leading the team for the right person.

Tech is an enablement team. It sits alongside Security Engineering, not inside it, and owns the request queue and the tools that keep everyone at Primer productive. Primer is growing fast, and access requests are growing even faster. Our job is to make getting the right access quick, safe and mostly automatic, so people can get on with their work and our security engineers can get back to security.

What you'll be doing

  • Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality.

  • Lead the technical roadmap for Tech and deliver it, starting with SCIM day-1 provisioning, Okta, automated access reviews and device enrolment.

  • Automate the routine. Use identity tooling, scripting, workflow automation and AI to take repetitive access requests off people's plates.

  • Run joiner, mover and leaver processes so new starters have what they need on day one and access is removed promptly when it should be.

  • Keep access controls audit-ready. Work with Security and GRC on access reviews, least privilege and evidence for PCI DSS and SOC 2.

  • Partner with Security Engineering on the calls that need them, such as privileged access and policy exceptions, and handle the rest within Tech.

  • Mentor the other engineers on the team, review their work and share what you know.

  • Track and report on how the queue is doing: volume, turnaround, and how much automation is taking off it.

What we're looking for

  • Senior-level experience in IT, IAM or corporate engineering at a fast-growing tech company

  • Hands-on with an identity provider (Okta preferred; Entra ID, Google Workspace or similar also welcome), including SSO, SCIM and lifecycle management

  • A track record of automating manual IT and access work, with scripting, workflow tools or APIs

  • Experience with SaaS administration and endpoint management (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Intune)

  • Good judgement about access: you understand least privilege and know when something needs a security review

  • Experience owning projects end to end and helping others on the team level up

  • Clear, friendly written communication. Much of the job is helping colleagues across the business

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

  • Experience running access reviews and providing audit evidence

  • Using AI tools to speed up support and operations work

  • Experience scaling an IT function through a period of fast headcount growth

You may not like it here if...

  • You're looking for a management role. This is a hands-on senior engineering role.

  • You'd rather follow an established playbook. A lot of this is being set up for the first time, and you'll be the one defining how it works.

  • You prefer to fix requests one at a time rather than remove the reasons they come in. We measure success by how much of the queue disappears.

  • Shifting priorities frustrate you. We're a growing company and the team's focus will change as we scale.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

As a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of security controls that protect our internal networks, workforce identities, endpoints and corporate systems. You will be working globally with security teams across US, EU and APAC, delivering against our goals and objectives - reducing risk and maturing controls.

As a Senior, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will define technical direction, make architectural decisions, and deliver complex security initiatives end-to-end. You will be expected to balance risk reduction with usability, ensuring controls are robust without impeding employee productivity.

This role focuses on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint security (EDR), Network Security, logging and detection engineering, and secure SaaS enablement. You will work closely with IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering and business stakeholders to embed security as a default practice across the organisation.

Security controls will be aligned to recognised frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Control Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain core corporate security controls, including phishing-resistant MFA, Just-In-Time (JIT) access, strict role-based access control (RBAC), zero-trust architectures, device and identity bound proofing and modern network isolation.

  • Tooling Ownership: Serve as the technical owner for a broad suite of corporate security systems, managing deployments, configurations, and API integrations for tools across the corporate environment.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead and implement the technical strategy for Endpoint Device trust, Data Loss Prevention, Intellectual property storage, and SaaS application security. Alongside wider corporate security technical controls.

  • Automation & Engineering: Write scripts and build tools to automate security workflows, incident response tasks, and audit evidence collection for compliance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with IT and business operations to integrate security tools into everyday workflows. Guide non-security teams to adopt secure baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) as standard practice.

  • Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years’ experience in Security Engineering, Corporate Security, Detection & Response, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace).

  • Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products

  • Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP)

  • Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform)

  • Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).

  • Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling.

  • Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic.

  • Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance.

  • Ability to write production-quality automation scripts.

  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms.

  • Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments

  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance.

  • Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development.

  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC).

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Field Marketing Executive - UKI
descriptionHtml:
Who we are?

Silverfin is a cutting-edge cloud software solution built by accountants, for accountants.

Founded in 2013, Silverfin was created to solve the frustrations of manual, error-prone processes in analysing financial data and compliance. From day one, we’ve been a cloud-first platform with an open API architecture, leveraging structured data to transform how accountants work.

Our mission is simple: to enhance and support the accountancy profession through AI and automation, ensuring accountants remain relevant and respected in the future of finance.

In 2023, Silverfin became part of the Visma Group, joining one of Europe’s leading providers of cloud software. This partnership strengthens our ability to innovate and expand our impact within the accountancy industry.

Today, Silverfin is trusted by over +1000 firms across 19 countries. Our clients include all of the Big 4 accounting firms, as well as leading global networks like BDO, PKF, Baker Tilly, Grant Thornton, and Moore.

Headquartered in Ghent, with offices in Mont-Saint-Guibert (BE), London (UK), Luxembourg (LU), and Gouda (NL), we’re a team of over 200 people - including a diverse remote engineering team working across multiple time zones - all working together to drive innovation in accounting.

How would you support our success?

Your role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Field Marketing Executive to join our team in the UKI.

Your focus area will include a mix of marketing and event activities. You will be supporting events, digital, customer and partner marketing, and other field marketing activities in UKI, from our office in London. The position also includes occasional off-site event coordination mostly during office hours.

That means organising events with project boards on Monday.com, messaging, creatives, stakeholders and budgets will be a very important responsibility in this role, next to regular marketing campaigns to our audience of accounting practices in the region.

As part of this journey, you'll be in sync with a fantastic team of 15 marketing team members across UKI, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg & Denmark. You’ll report to our Senior Manager Global Field Marketing, based at our head office in Ghent, Belgium. Your main focus region is the UKI. We provide a permanent contract on a full-time basis.

Silverfin moves fast with a constant flow of activities for both users and prospects, not to mention our incredible team. We also prioritise the well-being of our people, offering a range of initiatives. Envision yourself joining our international Marketing team and a diverse, motivated team, and growing along with Silverfin.

Your responsibilities

  • Collaborate with your BU stakeholders to define and refine the marketing plan for the UKI.

  • Work closely with the global marketing demand generation team based in Ghent. This team of specialists leads the execution of global targeted marketing campaigns aimed at generating leads and increasing demand utilising a variety of channels, including email, social media, PPC, and content marketing.

  • Work closely with the UKI sales team to ensure they have the marketing materials including assisting in the creation of sales enablement tools such as presentations, brochures, and case studies.

  • Plan, organise, and execute both hosted and 3rd party events from concept to completion. This includes venue selection, vendor management, promotional activities, and post-event analysis.

  • Measure and report on the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and events, using data to support decisions and improve future marketing strategies.

  • Liaise with product, sales, customer success and marketing teams to ensure cohesive brand messaging and optimise campaign success

  • Manage internal and external creative agencies to produce content such as video, copywriting, stand building etc.

  • Manage the marketing budget for the UKI with expenses and allocation of budget spends

  • Focus on ABM methodology using our existing framework and infrastructure, which is supported by the whole marketing department;

    • Improve account engagement in the UKI and account penetration in your target accounts for Tier 1 and 2 using a one-to-few approach. Expand the account-level ABM score with regional partners who provide engagement and buyer intent data. This complements the demand generation team, which runs a one-to-many digital strategy for Tier 3 and 4 accounts.

    • Report on ABM KPIs: account engagement, coverage across the buying committee, meetings booked, pipeline influenced and sourced, win rate and deal velocity

    • Showing ABM impact to senior leadership with clear, data-backed narratives

    • Testing, learning and improving programmes based on results

What will support your success?

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor/Master in Marketing

  • Proven marketing experience in B2B SaaS (5+ years)

  • But even more important is your eagerness to deliver results and proactive attitude.

Attitude and personality-related traits

We’re looking for someone who can work autonomously, has a pragmatic approach, and is eager to deliver results. You’re also happy to travel occasionally to our head office in Ghent for training, workshops and meetings with your manager and most of the global marketing team.

Skills and knowledge

  • Essential:

    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to write clear, persuasive copy for a UKI professional audience

    • Strong planning & prioritising skills. Organised (KANBAN), punctual (Deadlines), and meticulous (Quality).

    • Salesforce: create campaigns, dashboards, and reports for your campaigns

    • Hubspot - follow up on emails, landing pages, segmentation

    • Tools like “Monday”, “Slack”, “Google Drive/Docs/Sheets”, “Canva”, “Eventbrite”, “Wordpress”

    • Event management of in-person events

  • Big Plus:

    • Comfortable running webinars/podcasts

    • Experience in devising & executing a marketing plan + budget

    • Experience with ABM programmatic and 1 to few

We care for you

Be part of something bigger - Join a growing SaaS company that’s now proudly part of Visma, Europe’s leader in mission-critical cloud software.

A connected team - Take part in regular team activities, retreats, and offsites to keep our culture thriving.

Grow with us - Take advantage of career development opportunities and a personal training allowance to support your growth.

Time to recharge - Enjoy our company-wide Wellbeing Days off each month (reviewed annually).

Flexibility with connection - We have a hybrid setup, with a minimum of two days a week in the office. However, we understand that life can be unpredictable, so we offer flexibility to accommodate unexpected events. Our offices in Belgium (Ghent and Mont-Saint-Guibert), the UK (London), the Netherlands (Gouda), and Luxembourg provide great spaces to collaborate and connect.

Fair compensation - Receive a competitive rewards package with benefits tailored to your role.

How we work

At Silverfin, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We're committed to elevating talent by creating an environment where we can all thrive together.

We have a unique culture with our values ​​as the backbone:

Who we are -Authentically human

How we think -With a growth mindset

How we act -Bravely, side by side

How we win -By doing what we love

At Silverfin we make our own way. We are constantly looking for new and innovative ways to move forward. Continuous learning and development is encouraged to support your personal and professional growth.

At the same time, this opens up many new opportunities that allow our people to grow with Silverfin, and often faster than with other companies. So many ambitious team members have already found their way to a new challenge within Silverfin.

We want you to reach your full potential. To get you there, we don't want to think in boxes and over-structure things. So your options are not limited to 1 team or 1 career track. Your talent, motivation and potential play a crucial role in evolving across the teams into new roles.

title: Senior Implementatiemanager Sociaal Domein    |   Gemeente Den Haag
descriptionHtml:
De opdracht

Van veranderkundig advies naar daadwerkelijke verandering. Daar ligt jouw opdracht. Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht. Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen.

Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat plannen niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete veranderingen in werkwijzen, processen, gedrag en samenwerking.

Je:

· brengt regie, structuur, tempo en doe-kracht in de verander- en implementatietrajecten;

· ontwikkelt en begeleidt implementatieaanpakken die bijdragen aan duurzame verandering;

· hebt sterke veranderkundige vaardigheden en het vermogen om gedrag, cultuur en leiderschap bespreekbaar te maken;

· hebt bewezen implementatiekracht: je weet veranderingen te vertalen naar concrete acties, resultaten en borging;

· hebt ervaring met transitievraagstukken en het begeleiden van organisaties in verandering;

· adviseert over risico's, aanpak en passende veranderinterventies;

· stimuleert bewustwording, dialoog, eigenaarschap en samenwerking;

· maakt verschillende perspectieven en patronen zichtbaar en bespreekbaar;

· ontwikkelt praktische tools en werkvormen die de verandering ondersteunen;

· bewaakt voortgang en resultaten en stuurt bij waar nodig.

Je weet daarbij effectief te schakelen tussen denken en doen, richting geven en ruimte bieden, tempo maken en reflecteren.

Naast de twee veranderopgaven ben je in de lead voor de pilot rondom implementatie- en transitiemanagement, waar deze opdracht de input voor levert voor de afdeling Opgaven & Ontwikkeling. Op basis van je ervaringen binnen de twee teams (WMO en JGZ) breng je in kaart welke expertise, rollen en capaciteit nodig zijn om dergelijke veranderopgaven in de toekomst goed te ondersteunen. Jouw formele opdrachtgever is één van de managers van het team Organisatieontwikkeling voor dit deel van jouw opdracht.


Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent een stevige, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte professional die complexe veranderopgaven kan doorgronden én realiseren. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen management en medewerkers, creëert draagvlak en bent organisatiesensitief. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van organisatieontwikkeling, verandermanagement en implementatiemanagement.

We zoeken iemand die veranderkundige scherpte combineert met implementatiekracht en management en teams helpt om de verandering zélf te realiseren. Iemand die begrijpt wat nodig is om mensen mee te nemen in verandering, maar die tegelijkertijd zorgt voor structuur, voortgang en realisatie. Een professional die helpt richting te geven aan een verandering én ervoor zorgt dat deze daadwerkelijk wordt geïmplementeerd en duurzaam wordt verankerd binnen de organisatie.

Je beschikt over:

· WO werk- en denkniveau;

· minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring met project-, implementatie- en/of verandermanagement;

· aantoonbare expertise in organisatie- en veranderkunde;

· ruime ervaring met het begeleiden van management en teams bij verandering;

· ervaring met het vertalen van adviezen naar concrete interventies en uitvoering;

· uitstekende advies-, begeleidings- en communicatievaardigheden;

· analytisch vermogen, overtuigingskracht en organisatiesensitiviteit;

· het vermogen om effectief te opereren binnen een complexe, politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving.

Ervaring binnen een gemeente, publieke organisatie, consultancy en/of het sociaal domein is een pré. Kennis van Wmo en/of JGZ is eveneens een pré.

Informatie

Start: december 2026

Aantal uur: 36 uur per week

Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlening

Locatie: Den Haag

Vorm: Detachering (niet geschikt voor zzp)

Geïnteresseerd?

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor woensdag 3 november 12:00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

Contact

Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Edgar Groenendijk, Senior Adviseur Interim Management

title: Senior logistiek medewerker Zwolle
descriptionHtml:
Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou als senior logistiek medewerker in Zwolle.

Je werkt mee op de vloer en helpt ervoor te zorgen dat onze operatie veilig, efficiënt en volgens planning verloopt. Daarnaast ondersteun je collega's en vervang je de Teamleader logistiek waar nodig.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken in ons nieuwe depot. Bij DPD draait de operatie 24/7. Daarom werk je in een vast rooster met middag- en nachtdiensten:

  • 01:00 - 09:30 uur (nacht/ochtend)

  • 13:30 - 22:00 uur (middag/avond)

De nachtdiensten zijn meestal van dinsdag t/m zaterdagochtend. De middagdiensten werk je voornamelijk van maandag t/m vrijdag. Werktijden kunnen soms iets afwijken door de drukte in de operatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker combineer je uitvoerende werkzaamheden met een coördinerende rol. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer, bewaakt de voortgang van het proces en ondersteunt de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse aansturing van het team.

  • Laden, lossen, scannen en sorteren van pakketten.

  • Collega's begeleiden en ondersteunen.

  • De voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid bewaken.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Een hands-on, zelfstandige werkhouding.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Bereidheid om middag- en nachtdiensten te werken.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  1. Kennismaking: we leren elkaar beter kennen tijdens een eerste gesprek.

  2. Assessment: je maakt een online assessment thuis.

  3. Tweede gesprek: we bespreken de resultaten en gaan verder in op de functie.

  4. Aanbod: is er een match? Dan doen we je een aanbod.

Vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Our humble expectations

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Manager External Reporting
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

Volta is building AI-ready data centre infrastructure across the UK, Norway, Germany, Spain and the US, and is preparing for a US public listing following a Series A led by a16z and Altimeter. We will register on Form S-1 and report as a US domestic filer on Forms 10-K and 10-Q. Building the external reporting infrastructure - US GAAP consolidated financial statements, SEC-standard disclosures and a close process that can sustain a quarterly filing cadence - is one of Finance's defining projects over the next 12 to 16 months.

As Senior Manager, External Reporting you will own group consolidation and external reporting end to end: consolidating the group's UK, US and European entities, running the ASC 830 translation mechanics, preparing the US GAAP financial statements and footnotes, drafting the S-1 and the periodic filings that follow, and building the tie-out discipline expected of a registrant.

You will report to the VP Accounting and work alongside the Director of Technical Accounting, who owns accounting positions and policy. You will be central to S-1 preparation and to Volta's first audited financial statements.

This is a build role, and in the first year a hands-on one. There is no team beneath the role today. You will prepare the statements, write the footnotes and run the tie-out yourself, with support following as the function scales. If you are looking to direct the work rather than do it, this is not the right role.

The role is scoped to grow. As the reporting team builds beneath it and the filing cadence reaches steady state, we expect it to progress to Director.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the group consolidation across the UK, US and European entities, including intercompany elimination and ASC 830 foreign currency translation

  • Prepare US GAAP consolidated financial statements with full footnote disclosure, for audit and for filing

  • Draft SEC disclosures to registrant standard - the S-1 financial statement sections, MD&A support under Reg S-K Item 303, and the 10-K and 10-Q filings that follow - working with the Director of Technical Accounting, the VP Accounting and the wider team

  • Own the tie-out process: every number in the statements agreed to support, referenced and reviewable

  • Build the disclosure checklist and the annual and quarterly reporting calendar from scratch, and design a close timetable that meets a 10-Q filing deadline

  • Coordinate audit deliverables through first-year fieldwork and completion, and through the quarterly review cycles that follow

  • Sign off the US GAAP group numbers that feed the statutory bridge, working alongside the Statutory Reporting Manager who prepares the local IFRS accounts

  • Own the consolidated actuals that management and board reporting are built from, and review non-GAAP measures and their reconciliations

  • Select and implement disclosure management and inline XBRL tagging, required from the S-1 onwards

  • Support Reg S-X significance testing and Article 11 pro forma preparation as the site and joint venture portfolio develops

  • Shape and, in time, lead the reporting team as the function scales

What You Bring

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/CPA or equivalent) with 6 to 8+ years' experience, including preparing US GAAP consolidated financial statements and footnotes

  • Hands-on experience drafting or auditing SEC filings (S-1, 10-K, 10-Q) - registrant side or Big Four

  • Strong command of US GAAP disclosure requirements and of multi-entity, multi-currency group consolidation, including foreign currency translation under ASC 830

  • Working knowledge of Reg S-K and Reg S-X

  • Meticulous tie-out and documentation discipline

  • Experience taking external auditors through a full year-end cycle, and ideally through quarterly reviews

  • Proven ability to build a process from nothing rather than operate one that already exists

  • Willingness to do the work personally before there is a team to delegate it to, and the judgement to know when to start building that team

  • IPO readiness or first-time registrant experience an advantage

  • Comfort with deadline pressure and shifting priorities in a pre-IPO environment

    REQ-25

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Accessibility

title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.

What you’ll do

  • Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.
  • Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.
  • Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.
  • Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.

You are...

  • An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.
  • Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.
  • A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.
  • Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.

You have...

  • 5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.
  • Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.
  • Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.
  • Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.
  • Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.

Nice to have...

  • Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.
  • Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.

You'll get…

title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk Assurance
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech.

  • Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility.

  • Lead second-line assurance across ITGCs and IT application controls, cloud infrastructure and database management, CI/CD and change enablement, IAM and privileged access, API and automated data pipeline integrity, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

  • Build an automation-first assurance engine using AI agents, automated workflows, and custom Python and SQL scripts for continuous control testing, evidence retrieval, and remediation validation.

  • Establish automated finding lifecycle and remediation governance, surfacing control failures to engineering leads and validating fixes without drawn-out re-audit cycles.

  • Design and execute control frameworks for generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, machine learning models, and automated decision engines.

  • Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon.

  • Translate complex technology risk into clear recommendations for engineers, senior executives, and board-level risk committees, drawing on frameworks and expectations including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, DORA, MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week.


What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity.

  • Big Four background.

  • Experience building and testing risk controls.

  • A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams.

  • Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures.

  • Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security.

  • Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling.

  • Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity.

  • Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners.

  • Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Preferred

  • Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines.

  • Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company.

  • People management experience.

  • Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

  • Experience integrating GRC platforms, BI dashboards such as Tableau or Looker, and continuous compliance monitoring tools.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications.


You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.


Learn more about your team

Risk is part of Regulatory & Compliance at Airwallex.

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer - Aircraft Prototype (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Manufacturing Engineer – Aircraft Prototype & Industrialisation, you will be responsible for ensuring manufacturability and efficient build-up of Vaeridion’s aircraft prototypes. You will drive design-for-manufacturing (DFM), support the design release process, and develop the tooling, jigs, and assembly concepts required for prototype manufacturing.

You will play a key role in bridging design and operations, ensuring that aircraft structures, systems, and assemblies can be built safely, efficiently, and with high quality. Your work will directly enable the successful planning and execution of aircraft prototype assembly.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

Design for Manufacturing & Design Release

· Drive DFM activities across aircraft structures, systems, and assemblies

· Work closely with design and systems engineering teams to ensure manufacturability, robustness, and scalability of designs

· Support and challenge design release decisions from a manufacturing perspective

· Ensure designs are aligned with assembly constraints, tooling concepts, and production readiness

Assembly Planning & Industrialisation

· Plan and define assembly sequences, workflows, and build concepts for aircraft prototype manufacturing

· Develop build plans for complex assemblies, including structures, systems, and propulsion components

· Support rapid iteration cycles typical for prototype development while maintaining process stability

· Ensure efficient integration of all aircraft components into a complete prototype

Tooling, Jigs & Fixtures Development

· Design, specify, and implement tooling, jigs, and fixtures required for assembly and integration

· Work closely with design and support teams to develop robust and reusable tooling solutions

· Ensure tooling supports safe, repeatable, and high-quality assembly processes

· Oversee procurement, build, and commissioning of tooling where required

Manufacturing Process Development

· Develop and continuously improve manufacturing and assembly processes for aircraft prototypes

· Define work instructions, process documentation, and best practices

· Ensure processes are efficient, scalable, and aligned with future production needs

· Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across manufacturing activities

Cross-Functional Coordination

· Act as key interface between design, manufacturing, and test teams

· Support integration activities by resolving manufacturability and assembly challenges

· Collaborate with engineering disciplines to ensure smooth transition from design to build

· Coordinate with suppliers and external partners as required

Health, Safety & Compliance

· Ensure all manufacturing processes and tooling meet safety and regulatory requirements

· Support risk assessments, safe operating procedures, and compliance activities

· Promote and uphold a strong safety culture across all work areas

 

Your Profile:

Education

· Degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or a related field

Years of experience

· Proven experience in manufacturing engineering, ideally in aerospace or similarly complex industries

· Strong experience in DFM, industrialisation, and assembly planning

Hard Skills

· Strong understanding of aircraft structures, systems, and assembly processes

· Experience in design for manufacturing (DFM) and design release processes

· Experience in development of tooling, jigs, and fixtures for complex assemblies

· Knowledge of low-volume, high-complexity manufacturing environments (prototype or aerospace)

· Experience with manufacturing process development, documentation, and industrialisation

· Familiarity with CAD tools and PLM systems is a strong plus

· Experience with applicable rules, regulations, harmonised norms, and industry standards (e.g. aerospace manufacturing standards)

· Familiarity with electric propulsion systems and high-voltage components is a plus

Soft Skills

· Strong ownership and structured, solution-oriented working style

· Excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities

· Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Language Requirements

· Fluent in English (German is a plus)

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

Location: Southwark, London

In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers.

  • Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers.

You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Care

You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. Over time, you can expect to take on greater responsibility for shaping strategy and leading larger teams, influencing Flora Food Group's growth across multiple markets.

title: Senior Network Administrator (UK)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Network Administrator (Palo Alto / Aruba)
London (On-site) | £70,000 - £85,000 + pre-IPO stock options

Please note: Active UK SC clearance (DV preferred), or eligibility to obtain SC.

Own the secure network behind a UK defence programme, from architecture through to day-to-day operations.

CHAOS Industries is a defense technology company, founded in 2022, that has raised $1 billion from investors including 8VC, Accel and Valor Equity Partners. You’ll own the design, security and uptime of the network that supports critical national security missions.

What you’ll do

  • Design, deploy and maintain secure networks across classified and unclassified environments
  • Run Palo Alto firewalls (PAN-OS, Panorama, GlobalProtect) and Aruba switching, wireless and ClearPass
  • Implement segmentation, zero-trust and policy enforcement
  • Monitor performance, troubleshoot complex issues and support incident response
  • Handle vulnerability remediation, RMF/STIG compliance and system accreditation (ATO)

You’re a fit if you have

  • 8+ years in network administration in enterprise or DoD environments
  • Hands-on Palo Alto experience (NGFW, Panorama, VPNs, threat prevention)
  • Hands-on Aruba experience (switching, wireless, ClearPass NAC)
  • Strong TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs and VPNs
  • Experience in classified environments (SIPR/NIPR or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with RMF, NIST 800-53 and STIGs
  • Active UK SC clearance (DV preferred), or eligibility to obtain SC

Nice to have

  • PCNSE or higher
  • Aruba certifications (ACMP, ACDX, etc.)
  • Network automation (Python, Ansible, APIs)
  • Cloud networking (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government)
  • Zero Trust / SASE, Zscaler ZIA / ZPA or similar
  • High-availability or mission-critical systems background
  • Defence contractor or rapid-deployment experience

What you get

  • Private medical, dental and vision, 100% paid by the company for you and your dependents
  • 5% pension match
  • Pre-IPO stock options, relocation assistance and annual bonuses (coming soon)
  • Fully stocked kitchen
