title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We’re looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Senior Partner Manager (Strategic Partnerships) to build and scale Perk’s partner ecosystem across Europe, with a particular focus on the DACH region.

This is a commercial role with a clear objective: build partnerships that generate qualified sales pipeline and revenue for Perk. You’ll identify and recruit the right partners, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and turn those relationships into a repeatable growth channel. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing while owning partner relationships from initial outreach through launch, activation, and ongoing performance.

The ideal person combines a builder’s mindset with strong commercial instincts. You’re comfortable opening doors, creating something from scratch, and earning the trust of senior stakeholders. You’re ambitious, persistent, and focused on measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential referral, reseller, technology, and strategic alliance partners across Europe, with a particular focus on DACH.

  • Generate pipeline and revenue: Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, turning partnerships into a meaningful and repeatable growth channel for Perk.

  • Create joint go-to-market strategies: Build plans with priority partners across target accounts, campaigns, events, referrals, and co-selling motions.

  • Own the commercial relationship: Lead partner conversations from initial outreach through business case development, negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing growth.

  • Activate and enable partners: Give partners the product knowledge, sales materials, training, and support they need to confidently position Perk and identify opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing: Ensure partner-generated opportunities are effectively routed, prioritised, and converted, while creating scalable ways for our commercial teams to work with partners.

  • Measure and improve performance: Set targets, forecast partner pipeline and revenue, identify what’s working, and continuously improve our partnership strategy and playbooks.

  • Bring new opportunities to Perk: Stay close to market and product developments and identify new partner models that can accelerate growth or create meaningful value for our customers.

What We’re Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

  • Track record: Proven success in partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or business development, ideally within SaaS, fintech, travel technology, or another B2B technology environment.

  • ERP and finance technology ecosystem: Hands on experience working with ERP, accounting and finance automation vendors and their partner ecosystems (e.g Netsuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, Xero, Datev).

  • Commercial performance: A history of building partnerships that generate measurable sales pipeline and revenue against targets.

  • Builder mentality: Comfortable developing new partner relationships and go-to-market motions from scratch rather than simply managing an established programme.

  • Executive presence: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to build relationships and negotiate with senior and C-level stakeholders.

  • Commercial judgment: Able to assess which opportunities are worth pursuing, structure mutually valuable partnerships, and focus time on the relationships most likely to produce meaningful results.

  • Cross-functional mindset: A low-ego, team-first approach and the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other teams.

  • Ownership: Independent, ambitious, persistent, and comfortable being accountable for outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our hub.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel regularly across Europe for partner meetings, conferences and events.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Fokus Google Ads / SEA
descriptionHtml:
Ihre Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest unsere Werbe-Accounts und entwickelst die Kampagnenstruktur für lokale und deutschlandweite Nachfrage weiter.

Du arbeitest hands-on in den Accounts, stimmst dich strategisch direkt mit unserem Head of Marketing ab und steuerst das Budget ROI-getrieben.

  • Du baust eigenständig ein passendes Reporting, welches zeigt, was unsere Werbe-Ausgaben an Aufträgen bringt und wie effizient.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Vertrieb zusammen, damit klar ist, welche Anfragen wirklich zu den Aufträgen führen welche wir wünschen.

Ihr Profil

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Google Ads und hast Accounts mit relevantem Budget selbst verantwortet, inhouse oder in einer Agentur.
  • Du kennst Lead-Generierung aus der Praxis und weißt, warum ein günstiger Lead nicht automatisch ein guter Lead ist.
  • Du bist sicher in Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen und Smart Bidding.
  • Du setzt Tracking selbst auf und findest Fehler selbst: Google Tag oder Tag Manager, GA4, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions.
  • Du hast schon Offline-Conversions oder Enhanced Conversions for Leads aus einem CRM an Google angebunden oder eng begleitet.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Meta Ads und Lust, den Kanal bei uns aufzubauen.
  • Du rechnest gern: Du kannst begründen, ab wann zusätzliche Ausgaben sich nicht mehr lohnt.

Pluspunkte, aber kein Muss: Server-Side Tagging, Meta Conversions API, Microsoft Advertising, Erfahrung mit beratungsintensiven Dienstleistungen mit hohem Auftragswert, erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem, wenn dich die Rolle reizt und der Kern passt.

Warum wir?

Bei CERTA beginnt ein Großteil der Aufträge mit einer Suche bei Google oder Bing. Bezahlte Suche ist für uns deshalb teil unseres Kerngeschäfts. Somit hat deine Arbeit direkten Einfluss auf unser Wachstum und unseren Erfolg.

Du bekommst Gestaltungsspielraum. Du bist die erste Person, die bei uns Performance Marketing als eigenen Bereich verantwortet. Entscheidungen triffst du direkt mit dem Head of Marketing und der Geschäftsführung, ohne lange Abstimmungsschleifen.

Du bekommst klare Verantwortung. Du steuerst Kanäle und Budget mit eigenen Entscheidungsbefugnissen. Diese halten wir dir zum Start schriftlich fest, damit von Tag eins klar ist, was du selbst entscheidest.

Du bekommst eine Perspektive. Performance Marketing soll bei uns ein eigener Bereich werden, neben unserem Marketing-Team für SEO, Visuals und Landingpages. Wenn die Ergebnisse stimmen und das Wachstum es trägt, baust du mittelfristig ein kleines Performance-Team auf. Der erste Schritt ist eine zusätzliche Person für Paid Social oder Tracking und deine Rolle als Lead Performance Marketing. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

title: Senior Product Engineer (Software) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Roger is the operating system for dental practices. We automate the work dental teams shouldn’t be doing by hand – from treatment plans to patient communication to revenue optimization – and we plug directly into the practice management systems (PMS) that German practices already run on. We’re early, well-funded, and moving fast.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer who wants to own a product area end to end: understand the practice’s problem, decide what to build, ship it, run it, and improve it with real usage data. Not tickets. Outcomes.

We call the role Product Engineer on purpose. You work directly with product, design, and practices, and you’re accountable for whether what you built actually solves the problem – not just for whether the code merged.

What you’ll build
Everyone works across the whole product; people build deeper expertise in some areas, but who works on what can change quickly. Over a typical quarter you’ll touch things like:
• PMS integrations – connecting Roger to the practice management systems German practices run on, so our workflows sit on top of live practice data instead of beside it
• Treatment plans and cost estimates (HKP) – turning a manual, error-prone paper process into something a practice team gets right the first time
• Patient communication – recalls, reminders, and follow-ups that practices today handle by phone, fax, and sticky note
• Revenue and billing workflows – helping practices bill what they actually did, correctly and on time
• The Roger apps – web and Flutter clients that practice staff use all day, every day

Whatever your area, you’ll own it from the first conversation with a practice to the dashboard that tells you whether it worked.

What we expect
• Own outcomes, not tasks. You define scope, timelines, and success criteria for your area, and you align stakeholders around them
• Make technical decisions and stand behind them. Architecture, trade-offs, what to build versus buy – you decide, document why, and course-correct when the data says so
• Know the system, not just your service. Roger is one product. You keep enough context across PMS integrations, data model, and clients to make decisions that hold up outside your corner
• Raise the bar continuously. Testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability – you leave every area better than you found it
• Shape how we work with AI. Our tooling and practices are still evolving. You contribute to them actively rather than waiting for a playbook
• Enable others. Code reviews, knowledge sharing, pairing – a senior here makes the people around them better

How we work
AI-native engineering, honestly described. Most of us run several coding agents in parallel, all day. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Reviewing it, testing it, and deciding what not to ship is. So here’s what that actually means for you:
• You write specs and plans before you prompt. Skipping design thinking is where projects fail – not the AI
• You review agent output with the same rigor as any PR. If you can’t explain what a module does, it doesn’t ship
• You test relentlessly. A solid test suite is how you turn an unreliable agent into a reliable system
• Your fundamentals are strong enough to evaluate, correct, and improve whatever AI produces – architecture, security, performance
• You know the spectrum: when a throwaway prototype is fine and when full engineering discipline applies
• You expect to spend as much time reviewing and validating as writing. If that sounds like a downgrade, this isn’t the right team. If it sounds like leverage, read on

Patient data is not a detail. Roger handles health data (GDPR Art. 9) and sits inside practices bound by professional secrecy (§ 203 StGB). Data minimization, access control, EU processing, and a clear head about what may go to which model provider are part of the engineering bar here – not a compliance checkbox someone else owns.
Small team, short paths. You talk to practices, to product, and to the people who answer the phones for our customers. Decisions get made in a conversation, not a committee.

Who you are
• Senior-level, with significant experience shipping and operating production systems – you’ve been paged for your own code
• A track record of owning projects end to end: from a vague problem statement through delivery to production and iteration
• Used to working cross-functionally with product, design, data, and non-technical stakeholders – and comfortable talking to end users directly
• You think beyond your own code: business context, user needs, and product goals shape what you build
• You take ownership without waiting for instructions, make decisions under ambiguity, and escalate when it matters
• You communicate openly and clearly, in writing and in person, with technical and non-technical people alike
• Our stack is Ruby on Rails, Go, and Dart/Flutter. Deep experience in at least one of these helps; strong fundamentals matter more than any specific language
• Bonus, not required: experience in healthcare, dental, or another regulated domain; or with integrating into legacy on-premise systems

Location, language, and setup
• Location: You live in Germany and can be in our Berlin office regularly. The role is hybrid: 2–3 days a week on site, the rest remote
• German: Business-fluent German (C1 or better) is required. You’ll talk to practices, read PMS vendor documentation, and work with German regulatory and billing concepts daily. Our team language is English
• Eligibility: You already hold the right to work in Germany.
• Working hours: Full-time

Why Roger?
• The opportunity is absurd. A market worth billions that still runs on fax machines and phone tag
• Real leverage. You’ll be one of 6 engineers. Your area is yours – your decisions shape the product, not a committee’s
• Hard, interesting problems in a space most tech companies ignore: legacy integrations, regulated data, real-world workflows with real-world stakes
• Engineers who care about craft. We argue about architecture, not politics
• Compensation: €75,000 – €95,000 base salary depending on experience, plus equity participation and benefits: Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, 30 days’ vacation and Hrmony (50€ in-kind compensation).

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own outcomes end to end: framing the problem, shaping the smallest version that moves it, shipping it in collaboration with other teams, and proving whether it landed with our clients.

We are currently scaling our Product offering so you’ll be joining an established team made up of product, insurance and technical experts to meet the demands of our growing client pipeline.

This opportunity would be ideal for a Senior Product Manager who has worked in a scale-up previously, and wants to take on genuinely challenging problems in specialty insurance. descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise Products to shape how we position, launch, and scale our enterprise products like Vibe and Studio.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of product, technology, and go-to-market strategy. You’ll translate complex product capabilities into clear, differentiated value propositions that resonate with enterprise decision-makers, technical buyers, and practitioners. You’ll define how we take our products to market, build repeatable messaging and enablement frameworks, and equip our commercial teams to articulate why Mistral is the right partner for organisations adopting AI at scale.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, Developer Relations, and Communications, you’ll influence both how our products evolve and how we bring them to market. You’ll help establish the foundations for scaling our enterprise platform business in a rapidly evolving and highly competitive AI landscape.

What you will do

Product positioning and messaging

  • Own positioning and messaging for Mistral’s enterprise products, translating technical capabilities into differentiated value propositions for enterprise customers.

  • Develop compelling narratives that connect platform functionality to business outcomes, technical requirements, and customer priorities.

  • Tailor messaging to different audiences, from CIOs and technology leaders to developers, AI engineers, and business stakeholders.

  • Define our competitive positioning against proprietary AI platforms, hyperscalers, and emerging alternatives, articulating the value of Mistral’s open-weight models, flexibility, and deployment options.

  • Build a consistent messaging architecture across products, use cases, customer segments, and go-to-market channels.

Go-to-market strategy and product launches

  • Lead go-to-market strategy for new enterprise platform capabilities, from launch planning and audience definition to positioning, activation, and post-launch optimisation.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to understand the roadmap, identify market opportunities, and translate product developments into compelling customer propositions.

  • Identify high-value enterprise use cases and customer segments, developing repeatable GTM plays that support adoption and commercial growth.

  • Establish clear launch frameworks, working cross-functionally to align Product, Sales, Solutions, Marketing, Communications, and Developer Relations around priorities and execution.

  • Measure launch effectiveness and product adoption, using customer feedback and performance data to refine positioning and GTM strategy.

Sales and field enablement

  • Partner with field teams to identify recurring customer objections, competitive dynamics, and barriers to adoption, feeding these insights back into product and marketing strategy.

  • Build repeatable frameworks that help commercial teams communicate platform value consistently across industries, markets, and buyer personas.

Content and customer storytelling

  • Develop a content strategy that brings Mistral’s enterprise platform capabilities to life through product narratives, technical explainers, demonstrations, customer stories, and thought leadership.

  • Work with Content, Communications, Developer Relations, and Solutions teams to create credible, technically grounded content that resonates with enterprise buyers and practitioners.

  • Turn customer implementations and emerging use cases into compelling stories that demonstrate measurable business value.

  • Support integrated campaigns and demand generation initiatives with clear messaging, audience insights, and content tailored to the enterprise buying journey.

  • Ensure our content connects technical differentiation to the practical realities of deploying and scaling AI in enterprise environments.

Market intelligence and customer insights

  • Develop a strong understanding of enterprise AI adoption, platform buying behaviour, competitive offerings, and emerging customer needs.

  • Gather insights from customers, prospects, Sales, Solutions, and partners to identify unmet needs, adoption barriers, and opportunities for differentiation.

  • Build a clear view of the competitive landscape, translating market intelligence into actionable recommendations for product positioning, roadmap priorities, and GTM investments.

  • Identify emerging enterprise AI use cases and market segments where Mistral can establish a differentiated position.

  • Track the impact of positioning and GTM initiatives through relevant measures, including product adoption, pipeline influence, sales enablement effectiveness, and launch performance.

What we're looking for

  • Deep experience in product marketing, ideally within enterprise software, AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or other technically complex products.

  • A proven track record of developing differentiated product positioning and messaging that translates technical capabilities into clear customer and business value.

  • Experience leading product launches and building go-to-market strategies for enterprise technology products, from early positioning through adoption and commercial scale.

descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs, you run program management between our GTM organization and Product & Engineering. 

You are the connection point between both sides. You bring them together early on upcoming changes, align on what those changes mean for customers & partners, and determine what support customers need and which internal teams have to be prepared. From there, you own the path to our customers and partners.

Where a change is large enough to become a program in its own right, you own that program end to end. Other teams own their functional deliverables; you own the plan, the sequence, the cadence, the deadline, and the outcome. These programs carry hard cutoffs and significant revenue.

This is a cross-functional program management role at its core: a lot of coordination, judgment, and real accountability for the outcome. There's no playbook waiting for you — building it is part of the job.

Areas of ownership:

  • GTM to Product & Engineering Interface: Serve as the connection point for upcoming customer-impacting changes, bringing both sides together early to align on how customers and partners are affected and what they need to do. You determine which internal teams have to be enabled, from Engagement Managers and Sales to Solution Engineering, Partnerships, and Product Marketing.

  • Program Orchestration: Act as the single coordination point across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, and Engagement Managers. You steer cross-functional kickoffs, run the cadence that keeps programs moving, and hold functional owners to their commitments, including when that means escalating or re-sequencing.

  • Communication Sequencing: Design the plans for customer and partner communication so they experience one coordinated channel instead of several, and collect early customer and field feedback before it becomes an escalation.

  • Execution and Accountability: Track progress against plan, enforce deadlines, own escalation management end to end, and report to senior leadership in a way that makes risk visible early rather than defensible late.

  • Building the Discipline: Define and measure success metrics for each program, run retrospectives that produce process change rather than documents, and build the playbooks, SOPs, and governance cadence that make this function durable.

Who you are:

  • 5-7+ years in program or project management, owning complex cross-functional programs end to end — not workstreams inside someone else's program

  • You've worked as the connective tissue between technical and commercial teams, translating in both directions

  • Technically fluent in enterprise software platforms: you can assess what a change means for customers without Engineering explaining it each time

  • Energized rather than paralyzed by ambiguity; you build the playbook while running the plays

  • An exceptionally strong writer, equally at home in technical detail and executive narrative

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our Core Video & Data team, where quality work supports the platform athletes and coaches rely on to train, compete, and improve. This team builds the systems that power how Hudl understands sport at scale; from identifying players and teams across thousands of leagues to processing the moments that become highlights, stats and analysis, our services sit at the center of Hudl's platform. The systems you build won't support just one product or one sport, they'll become shared capabilities used across Hudl's ecosystem, powering experiences for teams, athletes and fans around the world.

As the Senior QA, you’ll;

  • Shape our quality strategy: You will use your customer and system understanding to build a risk-based testing approach tailored to our video and data platform architecture. You will measure quality to help define when a project is truly complete and prove your improvements with real, data-backed results.
  • Lead quality in your squad: As an integral part of a cross-functional team across Engineering, Product, Design, and Scrum, you will guide quality-focused conversations in sprint ceremonies. You will partner with stakeholders to explain how defects affect users and advocate for the right priority on backlog defects before they enter a sprint.
  • Test at scale and automate: Aligning our processes with development speed, you will make informed decisions on what, how, and when to automate versus when to rely on manual testing. You will lead large testing efforts, bringing your knowledge of our users into every test plan.
  • Coach and elevate the team: You will use your technical and quality expertise to guide others and raise the team's overall bar. As the quality point person, you will influence and challenge teams to incorporate best practices in everything they do.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Experienced. You have deep full-stack testing experience alongside an in-depth knowledge of automation.
  • Quality leadership. You understand quality in the big picture. You’ve successfully led quality initiatives and projects, and know exactly what success looks like at the project level.
  • User-focused. You think critically about the user experience, making sure our testing approach adapts seamlessly to match user workflows and exceed expectations.
  • Risk-aware. You can design a testing approach that effectively reduces risk, and you bring the sharp attention to detail necessary to catch what others miss.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Playwright Experience: Commercial experience with Playwright is a major plus, as this is one of our core frameworks.
  • A STEM Degree. A bachelor’s degree or equivalent is a plus.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

title: Senior Quality Systems Engineer, United Kingdom
department: Quality Reliability & System Safety : Quality Engineering : Quality Systems Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

Anduril’s Quality organization is seeking a Quality Systems Engineer to join our London team and help develop future opportunities for our internal quality management system and digitization efforts. The Quality team works with our customers, internal teams, and suppliers to ensure the deployment of reliable products that meet all mission requirements. We develop cutting-edge Quality processes and methods to secure scalable, long-term business success.
We are growing and this role will focus on internal site growth and implementing a world-class quality management system, supporting our internal manufacturing sites, supplier sites, and allied facilities. This role carries responsibility for ensuring compliance with UK and European regulatory frameworks, NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace, and UK Ministry of Defense (MOD) requirements as part of our London operations.
The right person for this role has extensive knowledge in Quality Management System (QMS) systems, data analysis, and continuous improvement to help shape our internal systems, tools, procedures and the culture of quality at Anduril. If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, help others succeed on the quality journey, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

About the Job

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a real time, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS and its top-level processes. Coordinate resources and prioritization of tasks to complete internal and external audits of the QMS.
  • Develop, lead, and manage the execution of the QMS software implementation and adoption across Anduril sites, including the London facility. Coordinate resources and prioritization of tasks to complete implementation, internal and external audits of the QMS.
  • Ensure full compliance with UK regulatory requirements, including UK MOD Defense Standards (DEF STANs), UKCA marking where applicable, and relevant UK Health & Safety Executive (HSE) regulations for defense manufacturing environments.
  • Drive compliance with NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107 (Mutual Acceptance of Government Quality Assurance and Usage of the Allied Quality Assurance Publications), STANAG 4159 (NATO Quality Assurance Requirements for Design, Development and Production — AQAP-2110), and STANAG 4161 (NATO Quality Management System Requirements for Aviation, Space and Defense — AQAP-2310).
  • Ensure conformance to STANAG 4404 and associated AQAPs for software-intensive aerospace systems, including AQAP-2210 (NATO Supplementary Software Quality Assurance Requirements) as applicable to Lattice OS and embedded mission systems.
  • Support implementation of STANAG 4685 (Airworthiness) requirements as they relate to quality assurance processes for unmanned aerial systems and aerospace components.
  • Liaise with the UK MOD Quality Assurance representatives, the Defence Quality Assurance (DQA) organisation, and NATO Quality Assurance authorities to support Government Quality Assurance (GQA) activities and audits.
  • Partner with business systems team, product quality engineers and manufacturing engineers to help prepare new processes, digital tools, and sites to meet QMS requirements, develop new capabilities to meet existing QMS requirements and conduct internal audits before manufacturing readiness review and production readiness review.
  • Develop our internal QMS road map for tools and capabilities to match the scaling of the company: to meet customer needs, to enable quality capabilities for new products, and scale quality processes as we grow — with particular attention to UK Export Control and ITAR/EAR interface requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with UK data protection requirements (UK GDPR / Data Protection Act 2018) as they relate to quality records, supplier data, and audit documentation.
  • Become a systems expert for Anduril’s quality tools, processes, and data sets to enable effective QMS execution across both US and UK operations.
  • Communicate with external audit agencies, including UKAS-accredited certification bodies and NATO quality assurance authorities. Support customer audits as necessary.
  • Manage the QMS internal audit program and lead internal audits.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities that benefit the QMS and product quality, aligned with AS9100, NATO AQAP, and STANAG frameworks.
  • Support investigations, initiatives, and projects as needed, at the team or organisation level.
  • Support developing QMS training modules and packages, including UK/NATO-specific regulatory and STANAG training. Facilitate training records and retention with manager of affected trainees.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective action with internal findings from audits and customer visits, including UK MOD and NATO audit findings.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3–5 years of experience in aerospace and/or defence manufacturing.
  • Expert knowledge of QMS requirements and auditing in a complex product environment, in one or more of the following QMS standards: ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, AS9110C, AS9120B, AS6500, IATF 16949:2016, ISO 13485:2016, TL 9000 R6.3.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of NATO Standardization Agreements (STANAGs) for aerospace quality, including STANAG 4107, STANAG 4159, STANAG 4161, and their associated Allied Quality Assurance Publications (AQAPs): AQAP-2110, AQAP-2210, and AQAP-2310.
  • Familiarity with UK MOD Defence Standards (DEF STANs) and Government Quality Assurance (GQA) processes.
  • Understanding of UK regulatory frameworks relevant to defence manufacturing, including UK Export Control Act 2002, HSE regulations, and UKCA/CE marking requirements.
  • Working knowledge with QMS software solutions which might include Net Inspect, Siemens, SAP, ETQ, One Factory, MasterControl, Compliance Quest, Hexagon, PTC, QT9.
  • Hands-on experience with data analytics platforms, reporting tools, and basic data visualisation.
  • Demonstrated project management for software system implementation and onboarding suppliers (external users) and internal users.
  • Working knowledge of design, development, manufacturing, supply chain, deployment, contracts, and other organisations that are part of a company-wide audit.

title: Senior Quantum Sales Director - DaaS & Satellite Sales, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Role Overview

Role:

IonQ is hiring a Senior Quantum Sales Director to drive new and expansion revenue for Capella Data as a Service (DaaS) and satellite systems across EMEA. You will own a portfolio of strategic enterprise, defence and government accounts, selling SAR imagery and analytics subscriptions, tasking capacity and complete satellite systems, and you will report to Garrick Ballantine.

This is a quota carrying, hunter oriented role for a seller who can run long cycle capital programmes alongside faster moving data subscriptions, and who can translate space based sensing into mission and business outcomes. The role is remote, employed through an IonQ entity in the UK (Oxford) or Switzerland, with travel of up to 20%.

Responsibilities:

You will own an annual new business and expansion quota across Capella DaaS subscriptions, tasking capacity and satellite system sales within an assigned enterprise, defence and civil government territory in EMEA. You will build and execute account plans for a named portfolio, mapping stakeholders across mission, programme, procurement and technical functions and building executive relationships at several levels in each account.

You will sell the full value chain, from SAR data and analytics subscriptions and recurring tasking commitments to ground segment integration and dedicated or jointly owned satellite systems. Working with product, engineering and mission solutions teams, you will bring customer requirements back into the roadmap and represent IonQ at industry, defence and geospatial conferences.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Run complex, consultative sales cycles from prospecting through to close, including discovery, technical validation with solutions engineering, pricing, contracting and negotiation of subscription and system purchase agreements.
  • Respond to RFIs, RFPs and government tenders in partnership with capture, proposal and contracts teams, and support prime and subcontractor teaming strategies.
  • Forecast accurately in CRM, keep disciplined pipeline hygiene and deliver reliable monthly and quarterly commits.
  • Develop executive relationships across mission, programme, procurement and technical stakeholders in each account.
  • Represent IonQ at industry, defence and geospatial events across EMEA, and feed customer requirements back to product and engineering.

Requirements:

You will bring substantial enterprise sales experience in geospatial data, earth observation, satellite systems, defence technology or adjacent data and SaaS markets, with a consistent record of exceeding quota. You will have closed both recurring data or subscription contracts and large capital or programme based hardware sales, and you will have sold to EMEA and allied government, defence and security customers, with a working knowledge of their procurement frameworks and contracting cycles.

You will have command of a structured sales methodology such as MEDDICC or Challenger, with disciplined CRM and forecasting rigour, and the ability to engage credibly with technical and mission stakeholders on remote sensing, SAR, tasking and data delivery workflows. A bachelor's degree in business, engineering or a related field, and willingness to travel up to 20%, are also required.

You’d be a great fit with:

  • Direct experience selling SAR, optical imagery or RF sensing data and analytics.
  • A background in satellite systems, ground segment or space mission integration.
  • Experience in early market development or category creation for an emerging technology.
  • The ability to obtain the relevant national security clearance in your country of employment, such as UK SC or NATO clearance.
  • Established relationships with EMEA government, defence or security customers, including NATO and allied programmes.

The total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a range of benefits available on our career site.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

title: Senior relatiebeheerder zakelijk
descriptionHtml:
Goed verzekerd zaken doen! Als senior relatiebeheerder zakelijk maak jij dit voor bedrijven mogelijk. Dankzij jou kunnen onze klanten de financiële gevolgen van bedrijfsrisico’s uitstekend opvangen. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht en vanuit huis ben jij voor hen hét aanspreekpunt. In een groeiende organisatie waar gebouwd wordt met collega’s die hart voor onze klanten hebben én oog voor elkaar. Kom jij meebouwen?

Jouw baan als senior relatiebeheerder zakelijk

Als relatiebeheerder zakelijke verzekeringen word je de rechterhand van je buitendienstcollega. Samen zijn jullie eigenaar van jullie portefeuille met bestaande én potentiële MKB - relaties in de regio Utrecht en omstreken. Deze portefeuille bestaat voornamelijk uit grotere klanten die o.a. actief zijn in de vastgoedsector. Ondernemend als je bent, bespreek je op jouw initiatief de zakelijke risico’s die jullie klanten lopen en welke financiële gevolgen dit kan hebben. Ook adviseer je over verzekerbare oplossingen én te treffen preventiemaatregelen.

  • Dankzij jou is de agenda van je buitendienstcollega goed gevuld met afspraken.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat je buitendienstcollega goed voorbereid het klantgesprek in gaat.

  • Je brengt op eigen initiatief offertes uit en legt alles netjes vast in onze systemen.

  • Je signaleert commerciële kansen en overtuigt klanten om totaalklant te worden.

  • Je handelt klantgesprekken af en neemt de nazorg volledig voor je rekening.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een goed salaris: schaal loopt van € 3.052,- tot € 5.755,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week. We stemmen de hoogte van je salaris af op je kennis en ervaring.

  • Deelname aan de collectieve pensioenregeling bij BeFrank.

  • Een maandelijkse netto internetvergoeding van € 20,-.

  • 27 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks maximaal 5 dagen bij te kopen.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer tot 40 km enkele reis of volledige vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op je zorgverzekering en de eigen verzekeringsproducten van HZG.

  • De mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen tegen fiscaal voordelige voorwaarden.

  • De flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken. Daarbij zorgen we ook voor een fijne en veilige thuiswerkplek.

  • Werken bij een topspeler in de Nederlandse assurantiemarkt die onderdeel is van de stabiele, internationale NN Group.

  • Blijvende aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en inzetbaarheid.

Jouw profiel

  • Werkervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening in een functie met zakelijk klantadvies.

  • De beroepskwalificaties Adviseur Schade en Inkomen. Heb je deze nog niet (allemaal)? Dan mag je ze op korte termijn en op onze kosten behalen.

  • Een gelukkige klant is jouw prioriteit. Jij houdt van klanten ontzorgen. Je toont interesse: je vraagt door en luistert aandachtig. Je signaleert commerciële kansen, denkt in oplossingen en bent in staat dit door te vertalen naar een duidelijk advies.

De afdeling
Je komt terecht in een team met drie collega’s op ons kantoor in Utrecht. Twee van hen werken ook in de binnendienst en één collega zit buiten bij onze klanten. In deze functie rapport je rechtstreeks aan de manager zakelijk advies Utrecht - Gelderland, Mike Peschke.

Dit zijn wij

Twee sterke bedrijven, Heinenoord Holding en Zicht, risico- en verzekeringsadviseurs. Samengebracht in één toekomstgerichte organisatie: HeinenoordZicht Groep. Een nieuwe naam, gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw ervaring. De kracht van digitale mogelijkheden combineren we met lokaal ondernemerschap én de professionaliteit van een grote landelijke Nederlandse speler.

Wij helpen elkaar en onze klanten vooruit. We geven onafhankelijk en professioneel advies en helpen bij het maken van bewuste keuzes over financiële risico’s. Dit geldt zowel richting onze klanten, als binnen de organisatie. Dit is wat ons energie geeft en waar ons talent ligt. Dit doen wij vanuit ons vakmanschap, onze passie, de rijke ervaring, maar ook de lokale verbinding. Dat is de reden waarom onze collega’s hier werken, waarom onze klanten bij ons komen. En wat ons verbindt. HeinenoordZicht Groep is een gaaf bedrijf: goed geregeld, aantrekkelijk voor medewerkers, aantrekkelijk voor klanten en financieel gezond.

Solliciteren?

Enthousiast geworden over deze vacature van senior relatiebeheerder zakelijk bij HeinenoordZicht Groep in Utrecht? Reageer dan via de solliciteerbutton.

We sluiten deze vacature als we een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden. Voor deze vacature werken wij niet samen met werving- en selectiebureaus.

title: Senior Sales Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Let's be honest: 2026 is a strange time to be in Talent Acquisition. Most recruiters are currently looking at their own internal dashboards with a sense of unease. They're seeing the pivots, the shrinking req loads, and the 'doing more with less' memos. If you're currently at a startup that's struggling to find its footing, or a business where the hiring bar has dropped just to fill seats, you know exactly how fragile that 'growth' story feels.

Samsara is the exception. We are a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy.

And we aren't just stable—we're expanding. Our UK Mid-Market team grew 70% year-over-year last year, and we need the talent engine to match that velocity. We aren't looking for someone to manage inbounds; we're looking for a recruiter who wants to move from a shaky seat into a high-conviction, high-growth environment where the fundamentals actually make sense.

The Challenge:

  • Self-Sourced: You own your destiny. You will be expected to find, engage, and convert your own pipeline using best-in-class tools like HireEZ, Juicebox, and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • The High Talent Bar: We aren't looking for CV pushers. You will be expected to act as a rigorous gatekeeper, ensuring that only the top 1% of gritty, A player sales hunters make it into our process.
  • Technical Assessment: You aren't checking vibes. You will be conducting deep-dive sales assessments, evaluating discovery mechanics, and ensuring every candidate has a structured methodology for success.

In this role, you will:

  • Execute & Deliver: Your mission is to fuel the Sales Account Executive engine. You will deliver high-quality, targeted pipelines at pace across EMEA, including the UK, France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
  • Own the Data: You are the CEO of your funnel. You will have total ownership of your response rates, passthrough rates, and talent market mapping. We make decisions based on data, not gut feel.
  • Partner with Sales Heavyweights: Work directly with our Sales VP and GTM leaders to align on hiring strategies that move the needle. You are a consultant, not an order-taker.
  • Master the Craft of Strategic Talent Acquisition: We hire for execution but develop for mastery. You will be mentored by some of the most sophisticated talent leaders in SaaS, learning how to move beyond execution to becoming a strategic talent partner who can influence the trajectory of an entire region.

Strong Backgrounds successful in this role:

  • The Agency Foundation: You started your career in a fast-paced recruiting agency. You still have that hunter DNA and the resilience to handle a relentless quarterly pace.
  • In-House Impact: In-house SaaS sales recruiting experience within a high-talent bar GTM organisation. You've proven you can translate agency grit into internal success.
  • EMEA Experience: You've successfully closed reqs in the UK and at least one other European market.
  • Technical Acumen: You can speak the language of sales. You know the difference between an order-taker and a territory owner. You have experience hiring for a scaling playbook environment and understand how to identify the elite within this market from the B players.

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Foundational Mastery: The goal is to bridge the gap between execution and influence. You are here to build the bulletproof foundations of an exceptional recruiter—learning how to own a region, influence high-level stakeholders, and use data as a weapon.
  • Focused & Structured: You understand that structuring your inputs—sourcing volume, message personalization, and rigorous screening—is the only way to get consistent output.
  • Data-Minded: You study your own conversion rates and market talent availability to stay ahead of hiring needs.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You iterate on your outreach and your screening questions based on what the data tells you.

What's in it for you?

  • Build the Foundation for Leadership: We believe leadership is a set of skills, not just a job title. In this role, you will develop the data literacy to lead a boardroom with metrics, the strategic insight to advise VPs on market conditions, and the technical acumen to assess elite GTM talent.
  • Elite Exposure: You will be exposed to a broad range of international roles and learn from some of the best sales and recruiting leaders in the industry.
  • The Fortress Stability: NYSE-listed, GAAP profitable, and essential to the global economy. We are building for the long term, which means your career development here is backed by real revenue, not just a VC's hopes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Scrum master
descriptionHtml:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

  • Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.


  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

  • PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

  • Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

  • Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.
